jobs.description:
Registered Nurse (Texas) - Bilingual, Spanish

Location: Remote (must be located in Texas)

Who We Are:

Tuesday Health is a value-based palliative care provider group dedicated to transforming serious illness and end-of-life care. We deliver goal-centered care focused on alleviating physical symptoms and emotional stress for individuals and their caregivers. Our interdisciplinary care teams reduce avoidable hospitalizations and improve quality of life wherever individuals call home. Through our leading-edge care model, Tuesday Health is shaping the future of community-based palliative care nationwide.

The Role:

The Complex Care Navigator RN is a vital leader in delivering comprehensive, person-centered care to individuals with serious illness. This role involves administering and interpreting a variety of assessments and screening tools to identify and prioritize member needs. As a key member of the multidisciplinary team, the RN is responsible for developing individualized care plans and leading care coordination efforts through active participation in internal and joint rounds. Utilizing Tuesday Health’s electronic systems and tools, the RN ensures a streamlined, technology-enabled approach to care. Central to this role is building strong, empathetic relationships with members, driving collaboration and transforming the member experience.

Key responsibilities of this role may include:

  • Administer multiple assessments and screening tools within the clinical model at different times throughout the care timeline
  • Interpret responses to assessments and screening tools and support prioritization of need based on responses
  • Be accountable for care plan development within the multidisciplinary care team
  • Lead in internal and joint rounds to ensure the member experience is optimal and coordinated
  • Learn the Tuesday Health electronic systems, tools, technology, to deliver a coordinated approach to ensure the members have a unique experience
  • Build a strong, trusting relationship with every member, where listening and empathy are the foundation of every interaction
  • Serve as the quarterback of the multidisciplinary team transforming care for members with serious illness

A strong candidate will demonstrate the following:

  • Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse license in the State of Texas without any board action
  • Bilingual in Spanish
  • Experience in clinical/medical setting preferred
  • Experience in a multi-disciplinary care model working across network providers, health plan care management support, and employed clinicians
  • Experience in a hospice setting is preferred
  • Strong communication and organization skills
  • Ability to multitask and work under pressure without sacrificing a positive member experience
  • Ability to know when to escalate and potentially act professionally in an emergent situation
  • Strong technical skills to navigate different documentation systems and tools; as well as ability to learn new systems as the company grows and evolves
  • Strong written skills
  • Ability to drive during daytime, nighttime, or inclement weather
  • Valid driver's license with safe driving record
  • State minimum automobile insurance coverage
  • Comfort with change and ambiguity; you understand that rapid changes to the business, strategy, organization, and priorities will come with rapid evolution of our business

What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation, reflecting our commitment to attracting, retaining, and motivating the best talent in the industry
  • Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, paid time off and holidays, employer 401(K) match, etc.
  • Remote work with multiple onsite sessions each year to maximize collaboration and team building
  • A dynamic and inclusive team environment where you can lean on your teammates, offer candid feedback, bring your true self to work each day, and deliver tremendous impact while having fun along the way
  • Meaningful work each day; we care deeply about our mission, our patients, and each other

Tuesday Health seeks to recruit and retain staff from diverse backgrounds and encourages qualified candidates to apply. Tuesday Health is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, sex, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, color, race, creed, national origin, ancestry, religion, marital status, political belief, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, military, or veteran status.

jobs.description:
Job Title:Strategic Account Manager - Wisconsin, Milwaukee, Green Bay, Madison, Vaccine (Open)
Location: Remote, US

About the Job

The Strategic Account Management organization is a highly skilled forward-thinking sales team serving our largest and most complex customers, while also managing our highest valued vaccine contracts. The customers we call on primarily include Health Systems, IHNs, Medical Groups, PBGs, FQHCs and state Awardees.

We are an innovative global healthcare company that helps the world stay ahead of infectious diseases by delivering more than 500 million vaccine doses a year. Across different countries, our talented teams are exploring new technologies to protect people and promote healthy communities. We chase the miracles of science every single day, pursuing progress to make a real impact on millions of patients around the world.

Join the team protecting half a billion lives every year with next-gen science, mRNA innovation, and AI driven breakthroughs. In Vaccines, you’ll help advance prevention on a global scale - and shape the future of immunization.

About Sanofi

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities

  • Assume the leadership role within assigned accounts, providing overall account leadership to cross-functional internal and external team members as needed. In this capacity, the SAM will assume responsibility for assigned strategic customers and manage each as a business partnership on behalf of Sanofi. Additionally, the SAM will bear full responsibility for building a strategic account plan for assigned accounts, as well as organizing and deploying the appropriate resources within Sanofi to drive value co-creation with customers and meet/exceed Sanofi’s revenue targets.
  • Effectively manage and grow a network of trust-based relationships with external stakeholders to generate revenue through genuine partnerships within Sanofi’s largest and most complex customers. The SAM will develop a deep understanding of the customer’s business which includes their pressures and drivers, priorities, as well as their related challenges and opportunities. They will maintain working knowledge of the customer’s business model, strategic goals and objectives, and their position within the healthcare environment including value-based health care, their competitors, and financial levers.
  • Identify and qualify high value opportunities within their accounts by working directly with the customer to develop and drive growth strategies, team-to-team alignment, and executive relationships together with internal cross-functional team members. Accordingly, the SAM will conduct business coaching and strategy session with their account teams to facilitate the co-creation of customer value and ensure ongoing internal alignment and account growth. The SAM will function as the central focal point for communications regarding account planning, strategy, collaboration, resource allocation and customer engagement.

About You

Basic Qualifications

Minimum required skills & experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • 5+ years of field sales or account management experience
  • Broad understanding of health system business, decision making processes & market trends with a proven track record of accessing C-suite to D-suite decision makers
  • Proven ability to translate health system market knowledge and develop strategic plans with internal stakeholders
  • The ability to execute tactical initiatives, provide ongoing feedback, and prioritize multiple projects.
  • Broad field sales experience with demonstrated success working with P&T committees, decision makers & influencers in Hospitals, Health Systems, IHNs and other large-organized customers
  • Possesses strong business acumen and strategic thinking skills
  • Self-directed and organized with excellent execution and planning skills
  • Ability to adapt and change in a shifting environment
  • Excellent communication skills both written and oral
  • Must possess valid driver’s license, be eligible for insurance coverage and must be able to safely operate a vehicle

Minimum preferred skills & experience:

  • MBA or other advanced degree
  • Strong data analytics
  • Experience working in Market Access, Pricing, Contracting or Finance
  • Proficient with MS Office and customer management databases
  • Experience leading teams with demonstrated impact & influence with key internal stakeholders

Travel:

  • Ability to travel up to 75% of the time to customers, conventions, training, and other internal meetings.

Why Choose Us?

  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
  • Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.
  • Help protect half a billion people every year, contributing to one of the largest global vaccination efforts in healthcare.
  • Develop your career with access to mentoring, international mobility programs, and opportunities to grow across four continents.
  • Make the impossible possible for millions by contributing to breakthrough moments like the world's first RSV toddler vaccine.

jobs.excerpt: At LifeStance Health, we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs.
jobs.description:
At LifeStance Health, we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs. Everywhere. Every day. It’s a lofty goal; we know. But we make it happen with the best team in mental healthcare.

Thank you for taking the time to explore a career with us. As the fastest growing mental health practice group in the country, now is the perfect time to join our team!

LifeStance Health Values

  • Belonging: We cultivate a space where everyone can show up as their authentic self.

  • Empathy: We seek out diverse perspectives and listen to learn without judgment.

  • Courage: We are all accountable for doing the right thing - even when it's hard - because we know it's worth it.

  • One Team: We realize our full potential when we work together towards our shared purpose.

Benefits
As a full-time employee of LifeStance Health, the following benefits are offered: medical, dental, vision, AD&D, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. Additional benefits include a 401k retirement savings with employer match, paid parental leave, paid time off, holiday pay and an Employee Assistance Program.



ROLE OVERVIEW

The Strategic Partnerships Executive, Industry Partnerships, is responsible for developing executive-level relationships with leaders of diverse healthcare organizations to drive behavioral health referrals to LifeStance. The position will report directly to the Senior Vice President, Corporate and Business Development, and will work closely with regional leadership to grow our referral base.


COMPENSATION: $140,000 - $160,000/annually, in addition to a competitive bonus plan.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Create standardized referral relationships with other behavioral health provider organizations, care management and navigation platforms, payors, and other referring organizations to drive patient volume for our practices.
  • Collaborate with the SVP, Business Development and Chief Growth Officer to develop a national strategy and execution plan to increase awareness of and drive referrals toward our clinical service offerings.
  • Navigate referral partner leadership at both the corporate and local level to drive standardization across the system and to ensure LifeStance is maximizing referral volume.
  • Champion a consultative approach to identify client needs, deliver tailored solutions, and establish long-term relationships that make a real difference in healthcare delivery.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, both internal and external to LifeStance.
  • Partner with LifeStance’s marketing team on collateral development.
  • As needed, develop new or adapt and iterate on existing go-to-market strategies.
  • Stay abreast of industry trends, analyzing market dynamics, and competitor activity to inform strategic decision-making.
  • In partnership with LifeStance’s clinical leadership, arrange educational opportunities to engage potential referral sources.
  • Maintain a comprehensive, organized customer relationship management system (CRM) and implement CRM improvements over time.
  • Collaborate with LifeStance’s Insights team to design and implement relevant reporting on business needs and team performance that in turn drive increased referral volume.
  • Maintain responsibility for both the quantity and quality of referrals.
  • Proactively identify areas of underperformance and take corrective action.
  • Operate with high integrity and comply with company policies and procedures.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, healthcare or a related field.
  • 5+ years of sales, and/or business development (BD) experience, preferably in healthcare services with experience selling to health systems and/or medical practices.
  • Experience working in the behavioral health industry is preferred.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel and PowerPoint
  • Thrive in a metrics-driven role and compensation structure; comfort using data to prioritize efforts and drive improved performance.
  • Excited about trailblazing a new sales channel and approach for LifeStance.
  • Comfortable navigating nonstandard sales processes and structuring mutually beneficial partnerships.
  • Passionate about mental healthcare and LifeStance’s mission.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.
  • Ability to be a strategic thought-partner with customers to help identify challenges and solutions to health system leadership.
  • Proactive self-starter who is motivated to achieve goals and metric-based targets.
  • Detailed-oriented and disciplined.
  • Enjoy blending strategic thinking and disciplined execution.
  • Cross functional collaboration and relationship building.
  • Ability to set the right expectations with referral partners.
  • Open to receiving constructive feedback.
  • Navigating conflict and tradeoffs between team goals and business objectives.
  • Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States.
  • Demonstrates awareness, inclusivity, sensitivity, humility, and experience in working with individuals from diverse ethnic backgrounds, socioeconomic statuses, sexual orientations, gender identities, and other various aspects of culture.
  • LifeStance is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, bend, talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to walk. The employee must be able to lift and/or move objects up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

LifeStance reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, or federal law.

jobs.description:
Description

Ledgebrook is an InsurTech MGA on a mission to bring Specialty insurance into the modern era. Burdened with legacy technology and processes, the industry has not kept pace with the speed of innovation seen in other sectors. Positioned at the cutting edge of the next generation of InsurTech, Ledgebrook offers the best of both worlds: innovative world-class technology deployed by a leadership team armed with over 100 years of insurance expertise.

Our long-term vision is to become a diversified full stack Specialty re/insurer competing with legacy carriers in product lines & markets across the globe. To get there, Ledgebrook builds its premium base by rolling out a new Specialty product every ~6 months until we prove enough traction to raise a balance sheet, become a full stack carrier and eventually compete in the reinsurance markets. Our initial product is a domestic primary and excess GL E&S policies sourced via wholesale brokers.

At Ledgebrook, everything we do is driven by our culture: Care, Strive, Thrive Together. To succeed in modernizing the industry, we must first succeed in changing the way we do business. Talent density is our north star; fewer, better people working together as one. To that end we’ve replaced all individual incentives with generous equity packages. We play as a team, we win as a team. Everyone benefits handsomely from Ledgebrook’s success.

About the Role

We’re looking for a talented Full Stack Software Engineer to help us solve the complex, technical challenges of a changing insurance landscape. The ideal candidate loves to build, communicates well with team members , and is motivated by a less bureaucracy. This person will be a key member of our engineering team, with direct ownership of many parts of the stack.

What you’ll do

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to develop new features and enhance existing applications.
  • Design and implement frontend and backend components using JavaScript (Node.js) and Python.
  • Develop RESTful APIs and integrate with third-party services as needed.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following best practices and coding standards.
  • Implement automated tests and ensure high code quality through code reviews and continuous integration.
  • Optimize application performance and scalability to handle growing user demands.
  • Dive into using and building LLMs (Large Language Models) to enhance our underwriters' productivity.
  • Debug production issues using the latest tooling.
  • Help set the direction of the small but growing engineering team.

About you

Here at Ledgebrook we are passionate about creating a team that is on a continuous learning journey and that shares our excitement about building a company from the ground up. Some of the characteristics we hold dear are:

  • A passion to deliver a world-class customer service experience to both internal and external customers
  • Intellectual curiosity and a desire to innovate processes/procedures versus being satisfied with the status quo
  • A desire to continue learning whatever your career stage
  • Agile prioritization skills coupled with a keen sense of urgency that seeks to balance getting it right versus getting it done right now
  • A strong drive and desire to win together as a high-performing team
  • A moral compass to “do the right thing, period”, we have zero tolerance for toxic behaviors.

Requirements

Must haves

  • 3+ years of experience with the full stack development
  • Ability to facilitate and gather business requirements and come up with scalable engineering solutions
  • Strong ability to design data models based on business domain use cases
  • Proven ability to write code for the future, with a strong focus on maintainability and testability
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools using Github Actions, AWS Code Pipelines, Jenkins, or other
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, organizational and time management skills
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple tasks/projects simultaneously per the objectives/goals of the organization and execute to deadlines

Nice to haves

  • Prior startup experience
  • Experience with Python, JavaScript
  • Experience solving insurance industry / domain related challenges
  • Experience in web technologies and frameworks (JS/TS, HTML, CSS/SCSS, Angular, React, Bootstrap, Node.js)
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

Benefits

  • Full remote flexibility and asynchronous work culture
  • Unlimited PTO and fully paid sick leave
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus HSA and FSA options
  • Additional financial protection and retirement benefits, including a 401(k), company-paid life insurance, and disability coverage
  • A high degree of ownership, autonomy, and the opportunity to help build and shape a growing company
  • The chance to make a meaningful impact while working alongside an ambitious, high-performing team
  • Exposure to the challenges and opportunities of a fast-growing startup environment

jobs.excerpt: THE PROJECT 📝 We're looking for an experienced Senior Cloud Security Engineer to join Form3 on a contract basis to deliver a strategic programme of security enhancements across our cloud-native payments platform.
jobs.description:
THE PROJECT 📝

We're looking for an experienced Senior Cloud Security Engineer to join Form3 on a contract basis to deliver a strategic programme of security enhancements across our cloud-native payments platform.

Focusing on improving cloud security, operational resilience and governance across our engineering ecosystem, you will work closely with our Platform Engineering and Security teams to design and implement practical security improvements that enhance how we build, deploy and operate critical payment infrastructure.

You'll play a key role in strengthening areas such as cloud platform security, software supply chain security, identity and access management, AI governance, cryptographic controls and automated security assurance, ensuring solutions are scalable, production-ready and aligned with regulatory expectations.

Key responsibilities

  • Assess the current cloud security posture across Form3 environments, identifying risks, control gaps and opportunities for improvement.
  • Design and implement scalable cloud security controls that improve the resilience and security of our cloud-native platform.
  • Enhance perimeter security controls across cloud infrastructure.
  • Strengthen CI/CD pipeline security through secure build processes, automated security testing, deployment governance and artefact integrity.
  • Improve production access security, including RBAC, least-privilege implementation, deployment tooling and operational processes.
  • Enhance software supply chain security through dependency management, container image scanning, provenance, signing and vulnerability remediation.
  • Contribute to the secure adoption and governance of AI-enabled engineering capabilities, including controls for data protection, auditability and operational resilience.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance on cloud security architecture and secure engineering practices.
  • Produce high-quality technical documentation, including solution designs, implementation plans, operational procedures and security evidence.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, platform and security teams to deliver maintainable, production-ready security improvements.
  • Ensure all deliverables align with operational resilience requirements, regulatory obligations and internal security standards.
  • Deliver changes using structured, low-risk change management practices while maintaining service availability.

WE’RE LOOKING FOR 🔍

Essential

  • Extensive experience designing and implementing cloud security solutions within large-scale cloud-native environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience securing public cloud platforms (AWS preferred).
  • Expertise in cloud security architecture, identity and access management, workload protection and infrastructure security.
  • Experience securing CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices.
  • Strong understanding of software supply chain security, including dependency management, artefact signing, provenance and vulnerability management.
  • Experience implementing least-privilege access models and RBAC.
  • Knowledge of security monitoring, risk assessment and security governance.
  • Experience working within highly regulated or business-critical production environments.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence engineering teams.
  • Strong technical documentation and design skills.

Desirable

  • Experience implementing security controls for AI or machine learning platforms.
  • Knowledge of cryptographic controls and key management.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code and policy-as-code tooling.
  • Familiarity with payment platforms or financial services environments.
  • Understanding of operational resilience frameworks and regulatory requirements affecting critical financial infrastructure.
  • Relevant cloud or security certifications (AWS Security Specialty, CISSP, CCSP or similar).

TECH STACK ⚙️

  • AWS – Cloud infrastructure and security controls.
  • Kubernetes – Container orchestration and workload security.
  • Terraform – Infrastructure as Code and security automation.
  • CI/CD tooling – Secure software delivery, build security and deployment governance.
  • Container security tooling – Image scanning, vulnerability management and runtime protection.
  • Identity & Access Management (IAM) – Least privilege, RBAC and privileged access controls.
  • Software Supply Chain Security – Dependency scanning, artefact signing, provenance and integrity controls.
  • Security monitoring & observability platforms – Detection, auditability and operational visibility.
  • AI governance and security controls – Supporting secure adoption of AI-enabled engineering capabilities.

INTERVIEW PROCESS ✍️

Stage 1: Screening Call with Talent Team

Stage 2: Kubernetes & Linux Interview

Stage 3: Cloud Security & Engineering Best Practices interview

We always aim to stick to the above process, however there may be occasions when an additional interview stage is needed for us to be sure we’re hiring the right fit for the role.

ABOUT FORM3 💭

Revolutionising the world of payments with our cloud-native, multi-cloud platform. For more information about Form3, check out the following pages:

What we do | Life at Form3 | Payments Cannot Fail Series | .Tech Podcast

OUR DEI&B COMMITMENT

We hire talented people from a variety of backgrounds and experiences and are committed to a work environment based on diversity, open-mindedness and curiosity. We’re united by our company values (we even created them together!) and we celebrate our unique differences.

Our employee lifecycle processes are designed to embrace equal opportunity and prevent discrimination against our people regardless of personal characteristics. It is our strong belief that the more inclusive and belonging we are as a business, the better our work will be.

As an inclusive employer, we guarantee to interview all neurodiverse and physically disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria for this role. The Data Exchange Specialist is responsible for managing the overall process, practice, and project implementation of electronic data interfaces with New York Life clients in support of Life, Accident, Disability, Family Medical Leave products, and various service offerings, with a strong focus on National Accounts and highly complex data integrations.

This role serves as both a technical and consultative resource, ensuring high-quality data exchange while educating clients on how their data powers downstream services including administration, billing, eligibility, enrollment, and reporting.

The Specialist understands how data flows through New York Life systems—from file receipt and validation to internal processing and operational impact—and proactively advises clients and TPAs on how data structure, file dependencies, and transmission timing affect service delivery and administration outcomes. They balance New York Life standards regarding layout, data integrity, and transmission protocols with client requirements to deliver compliant, scalable, and efficient solutions.

The Data Exchange Specialist manages multi-file data environments where multiple client files must be validated, sequenced, reconciled, and merged in order to support accurate system ingestion. These integrations often involve complex file structures, dependent file relationships, and conditional data mapping logic, requiring advanced technical expertise in file architecture, merge capabilities, and data validation.

This role also drives inventory control of active interfaces and milestone management in partnership with internal and external stakeholders. The Specialist demonstrates strong analytical capabilities to audit incoming files across multiple data sources, identify discrepancies or systemic errors, and implement corrective actions that improve data integrity and client experience.

The Data Exchange Specialist partners closely with Implementation IT, Family Medical Leave Operations, Account Management, and external Ben Tech vendors to ensure deadlines are met, key milestones are achieved, and implementation efforts stay aligned with business objectives.

Because this role supports large National Accounts and marquee clients, it requires the ability to manage high-volume, complex integrations with multiple vendors, benefit programs, and file dependencies. jobs.description:
About Ottimate

Ottimate is an AI-powered AP [Accounts Payable] automation platform that empowers finance teams to reduce costs, prevent overpayments, detect fraud, and enforce policy compliance across the entire invoice-to-payment lifecycle.

About the Role

Ottimate is expanding into the retail and grocery market. There, invoice and vendor data live inside store-level systems, such as POS, back-office, and inventory platforms like BRdata, rather than the ERPs we integrate with today.

The SMS Adapter makes that data usable: a secure connector that runs at the store or corporate office, pulls data directly from the store's system, and syncs it to Ottimate's AP platform. We're looking for a software engineer to own this adapter end-to-end, from the initial data connection and sync logic through to the security, reliability, and deployment experience that lets a non-technical store operator run it with confidence.

This is a high-ownership, high-autonomy role. You'll be one of the first engineers dedicated to this product line, working closely with the retail/grocery product owner and store-side IT contacts at pilot customers.

Rsponsibilities

  • Build and maintain the adapter that connects to in-store systems, starting with BRdata, and syncs invoice items, vendor, and PO data to Ottimate.
  • Design and harden a reliable sync process: delta and full syncs, retry and backoff behavior, conflict handling, and clear failure visibility when a store's network or data source is unreliable.
  • Own local data handling and credential storage so the adapter can run unattended and securely on a store's machine.
  • Build and improve the setup and monitoring experience that store staff and support use to configure connections, check sync health, and troubleshoot issues without engineering involvement.
  • Establish strong automated test coverage for the adapter and keep it reliable across all target deployment environments (Windows is the primary target).
  • Own packaging, updates, and installation for software running on store-owned machines, often behind restrictive IT policies.
  • Work directly with pilot retail/grocery customers to diagnose environment issues, such as network, permissions, and data access, and turn them into product and reliability improvements.
  • Define and evolve the adapter's data model and mapping layer as we onboard additional store systems beyond BRdata.

Requirements

  • +5 YoE in strong software engineering experience, with a track record of owning a product end-to-end, from the data layer through the user-facing experience.
  • Experience building and shipping software that runs on end-user machines, including the packaging and distribution concerns that come with that.
  • Solid database experience, including comfort reverse-engineering schemas in third-party systems you don't control.
  • A track record of writing dependable integration and sync code: idempotency, retries, partial-failure handling, observability.
  • Practical testing instincts. You know when to reach for integration and end-to-end tests, not just unit tests, to catch real-world failure modes like a flaky store network or a locked-down machine.
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity. This is a new, fast-moving product area without years of established internal convention to lean on.

About Teamified:

Teamified is a talent partner helping companies build exceptional remote teams across IT, software, product, and digital innovation. We collaborate with leading enterprises and fast-scaling tech businesses worldwide to help them access world class talent and accelerate growth. With operations across the globe our mission is to make building high performing global teams simple, fast, and cost-effective. Teamified has hundreds of clients with more than 200 engineers, testers, product managers, designers, and technology experts delivering impactful solutions every day.

About the client:

Our client is an innovative Australian health technology company developing an AI-powered anxiety coaching application based on an evidence-based psychological approach to managing anxiety.

The application is designed for iOS and Android using React Native, with a React-based website supporting user registration and subscriptions. Currently in the testing phase and approaching its soft launch, the platform features an AI-powered coaching assistant that uses Large Language Models (LLMs) to deliver structured, personalised coaching conversations.

The AI Coach operates within a clinically guided framework, incorporating structured coaching pathways, a toolkit of resources, conversational guidelines, and built-in safety mechanisms that can intervene when necessary.

As the platform handles sensitive mental health information, security, privacy, and responsible AI development are central to its design and ongoing operation.

About the role:

We are hiring one person to own the product's engineering end-to-end. You will be the technical owner of the AI Coach and the systems around it, reporting directly to a non-technical founder. You plan your own work, set your own technical direction within the product brief, and ship. There is no CTO above you and no agency to lean on - you are the engineering function, working at speed with AI-first tooling and agentic coding workflows.

  • Own the AI Coach: prompting, conversation state and progression, retrieval (Pinecone), model selection and evaluation, and the safety/crisis layer - tested against scripted clinical scenarios
  • Own the backend: Python 3.12, FastAPI, GraphQL (Strawberry), SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, AWS (Sydney)
  • Own mobile and web delivery: React Native (iOS + Android) and React, including App Store / Google Play / Stripe subscriptions
  • Own release engineering: CI/CD, environments, signing credentials, monitoring, backups, rollback - built for fast, safe, frequent releases
  • Bring a product eye: you care how screens look and feel on mobile and web, not just whether the API returns 200
  • Translate technical decisions into plain language for the founder and clinical team

How you work (this is the core of the role):

You are an AI-first engineer. You use agentic coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code or equivalent) as your default workflow - planning, generating, reviewing and shipping with AI leverage rather than writing everything by hand. You build evaluation harnesses so the AI Coach can be tested automatically against scenario suites on every change. You are a self-starter who takes a brief, breaks it into a plan, communicates the plan, executes it, and reports outcomes - with direction from the founder but without needing technical supervision.

  • Plan -> Approve -> Deliver: you propose the plan, get sign-off on direction, and own execution
  • Comfortable being the only engineer initially: you learn the system from the code (there is limited as-built documentation) and make it yours
  • Bias to shipping: small, frequent, reversible releases with monitoring and rollback in place
  • Judgement over heroics: this is a mental health product - safety thresholds and crisis handling are governed by legal and clinical sign-off, and you build the systems that enforce them

Requirements

What we're looking for:

  • Proven experience shipping LLM-based products to production: prompt architecture, conversation state machines, RAG/retrieval, evals, moderation and safety handling - not just API calls
  • Strong backend engineering: Python, FastAPI (or similar), SQL/PostgreSQL, AWS; comfortable owning infrastructure, CI/CD and production operations solo
  • Solid React Native and React: can ship and debug on both iOS and Android, including in-app purchase flows on both stores and Stripe on web
  • Demonstrated AI-first development practice: daily use of agentic coding tools, with the judgement to review and own what they produce
  • Product sensibility: a genuine eye for mobile and web UX; you notice broken layouts, bad copy and clumsy flows, and fix them
  • Self-sufficient operator: track record of owning a product or major system end-to-end with minimal technical oversight; excellent written communication for a non-technical founder
  • Care with sensitive data: experience (or demonstrable seriousness) with privacy, security and access controls around personal/health data

Nice to have:

  • Experience in mental health, health tech or other regulated/safety-critical consumer products
  • Experience taking over a codebase from an agency or departing team
  • Mobile release operations: App Store / Play Store review cycles, promo codes, staged rollouts
  • Analytics and growth tooling: AppsFlyer, GA4, event taxonomy design, experiment frameworks
  • Voice features (TTS/STT), push notification strategy, CRM/email platform integrations

Our stack:

Backend: Python 3.12, FastAPI, GraphQL (Strawberry), SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL. Mobile: React Native. Web: React. Hosting: AWS Sydney. AI: OpenAI (plus OpenAI Moderation), Pinecone vector DB. Mobile services: Firebase. Payments: App Store, Google Play, Stripe. Analytics: AppsFlyer, GA4, Meta Pixel. Code: Bitbucket. Admin: SQLAdmin-based panel.

Reporting and working style:

You report directly to the founder, who is not technical. You will get clear product direction, fast decisions and clinical/legal guardrails from the Founders team - and full ownership of how it gets built. You plan and manage your own process and keep the founder informed in plain language: what you're doing, why, what it costs, and when it lands.

Benefits

  • Flexibility in work hours and location, with a focus on managing energy rather than time.
  • Access to online learning platforms and a budget for professional development
  • A collaborative, no-silos environment, encouraging learning and growth across teams
  • A dynamic social culture with team lunches, social events, and opportunities for creative input
  • Health insurance
  • Leave Benefits

If you possess the required skills and are eager to contribute to our team's success, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Apply now!

Description

A Career at Clarius

Today, as many as 25 million medical professionals globally don’t have access to medical imaging, which is proven to improve patient care and reduce healthcare costs. That’s why we’re on a mission to make medical imaging accessible everywhere by delivering high-performance, affordable, and easy-to-use solutions powered by artificial intelligence and connected to the cloud.

By making Clarius your next career move, you’re joining a team of 140+ people who are talented, innovative, and highly collaborative. You’re also joining a community that includes thousands of physicians worldwide who use Clarius to deliver better patient care! And you’re joining a thrice-certified Great Place to Work!

Your Role

We're seeking an experienced Regulatory Specialist to support our Data Science and Regulatory Affairs teams in defining and executing regulatory strategies for AI/ML-enabled medical devices. You'll need deep expertise in the regulatory landscape for AI/ML devices, including AI/ML design and development methodologies, SaMD requirements, and the software development lifecycle. Over the next 24 months, your primary responsibilities will be translating complex machine learning concepts into clear, precise regulatory documentation including DHF creation, regulatory submission preparation, and related data documentation.

This is a two-year fixed-term contract.

Your Responsibilities Include:

  • Collaborate with ML engineers and RA team to define and execute regulatory strategies for AI/ML products
  • Maintain clear, detailed documentation of ML algorithms, datasets, and performance metrics for regulatory review
  • Create technical documentation, including AI/ML model training methodologies, data preparation procedures, and model verification and validation documentation
  • Collaborate with RA team to write technical sections of FDA 510(k) and equivalent submissions (e.g., Health Canada, EU MDR).
  • Collaborate with RA team on regulatory technical documentation and DHF documentation requirements
  • Maintain version control and document change management

📌 لمحة سريعة عن الوظيفة

  • المسمى الوظيفي: مسؤول الحصة التجريبية عن بُعد (Trial Class Manager — TCM) — بنظام العمل الحر للأسواق الناطقة بالعربية

  • نظام الدخل: يعتمد الدخل على الأداء والنتائج البيعية، من خلال نظام عمولات ومكافآت واضح.

  • التدريب والدعم: ستحصل على تدريب منظم، ومواد جاهزة، وتطبيق عملي، ودعم مستمر من الـ Trainer والـ Team Leader قبل بدء العمل مع العائلات الحقيقية.

إذا كان هذا النظام يناسب توقعاتك وجدولك، اقرأ التفاصيل التالية بعناية.

1. عن Kodland 👨‍💻👩‍💻

Kodland هي مدرسة دولية للتعليم عبر الإنترنت تساعد الأطفال والمراهقين على تطوير مهارات رقمية عملية واستخدام التكنولوجيا بطريقة إبداعية وفعالة.

  • نعمل مع طلاب تتراوح أعمارهم بين 5 و17 عامًا.

  • نقدّم برامج في البرمجة، الرياضيات، التصميم الرقمي، ومهارات التكنولوجيا وغيرها من المجالات الحديثة.

  • تعمل Kodland مع طلاب وعائلات في العديد من الأسواق حول العالم، بما في ذلك أوروبا والمملكة المتحدة والولايات المتحدة ودول رابطة الدول المستقلة وأمريكا اللاتينية ومنطقة الشرق الأوسط وشمال أفريقيا.

  • تُقدَّم الدروس مباشرة عبر الإنترنت، مع تركيز قوي على التعلم العملي القائم على المشاريع.

  • Kodland حاصلة رسميًا على اعتماد STEM.org Accredited™‎ في مجال تعليم STEM.

هدفنا هو مساعدة الأطفال على تطوير التفكير المنطقي، والثقة في استخدام التكنولوجيا، ومهارات حل المشكلات التي يحتاجونها للمستقبل.

2. تعرّف على تجربة الـ TCM قبل التقديم 🎥

قبل أن تكمل التقديم، ألقِ نظرة على هذه الصفحة التفاعلية:

ستساعدك الصفحة على فهم طبيعة الدور بشكل أسرع، ومعرفة ما إذا كان أسلوب العمل مناسبًا لك، والاطلاع على الخطوات الأولى من عملية التقديم.

👉 ننصحك بمراجعتها قبل متابعة الطلب.

3. ماذا يفعل مسؤول الحصة التجريبية (TCM)؟ 🎧

مسؤول الحصة التجريبية هو الشخص الذي يقدّم أول تجربة حقيقية للعائلة مع Kodland، ويجمع دوره بين التعليم، والاستشارة، والتواصل، والمبيعات.

خلال جلسة عبر Zoom مدتها حوالي 60 دقيقة، ستقوم بـ:

  • التعرف على الطفل وولي أمره وبناء تواصل مريح معهم.

  • فهم اهتمامات الطفل، وخبراته السابقة، وأهداف الأسرة.

  • تنفيذ نشاط عملي قصير باستخدام مواد Kodland الجاهزة.

  • اقتراح البرنامج التعليمي الأنسب بناءً على احتياجات الطفل واهتماماته.

  • شرح قيمة البرنامج والإجابة عن أسئلة ولي الأمر.

  • التعامل مع التردد أو الاعتراضات بطريقة مهنية.

  • مناقشة خيارات التسجيل والدفع ومساعدة الأسرة على اتخاذ قرار واضح.

لن تحتاج إلى البحث عن عملاء بنفسك.

يتم حجز الحصص التجريبية مسبقًا وفقًا لجدول عملك، ويتم تخصيصها لك من خلال أنظمة Kodland.

هذا الدور يجمع بين:

🎓 التعليم — شرح الأفكار بطريقة واضحة والحفاظ على تفاعل الطفل.

🗣 التواصل والاستشارة — الاستماع جيدًا، وطرح الأسئلة المناسبة، وتكييف أسلوبك مع كل أسرة.

💼 المبيعات — توضيح قيمة البرنامج، ومناقشة الأسعار بثقة، والمساعدة في إتمام التسجيل عندما يكون البرنامج مناسبًا للأسرة.

⚠️ مهم:

هذه ليست وظيفة تدريس تقليدية فقط، وليست وظيفة Call Center تعتمد على قراءة Script جاهز.

ستحصل على هيكل واضح، ومواد، وتدريب، ودعم، لكننا نتوقع منك أيضًا أن تفكر بشكل مستقل، وتتكيف مع كل أسرة، وتقود المحادثة بثقة.

4. المتطلبات ✅

المتطلبات الأساسية

  • إجادة اللغة العربية بطلاقة والقدرة على التواصل بثقة ووضوح.

  • جهاز Laptop أو PC موثوق مع كاميرا وميكروفون أو Headset يعملان بشكل جيد.

  • اتصال إنترنت ثابت مناسب لمكالمات Zoom بالفيديو.

  • مكان عمل هادئ ومناسب، مع الاستعداد لاستخدام الكاميرا أثناء العمل.

  • القدرة على توفير متوسط 25 ساعة أسبوعيًا على الأقل خلال أوقات الذروة.

  • الاستعداد للعمل يومًا واحدًا على الأقل خلال عطلة نهاية الأسبوع.

  • الراحة في التواصل مع الأطفال وأولياء الأمور.

  • الاستعداد للعمل في بيئة تعتمد على الأداء والمبيعات.

اللغة الإنجليزية

اللغة الإنجليزية ليست شرطًا للتقديم.

معرفة الإنجليزية تعتبر ميزة إضافية وقد تساعدك في بعض جوانب التواصل الداخلي، لكنها ليست متطلبًا أساسيًا للوظيفة.

تعتبر ميزة إضافية إذا كان لديك:

  • خبرة في المبيعات، خدمة العملاء، Customer Success، Call Center، الاستشارات، التدريس أو التدريب.

  • خبرة سابقة في التعامل مع الأطفال أو أولياء الأمور.

  • خبرة في العمل عن بُعد وتنظيم جدولك بشكل مستقل.

الخبرة السابقة ميزة، لكنها ليست شرطًا — سنقوم بتدريبك على طريقة العمل.

5. جدول العمل والتوفر 🕒

العمل عن بُعد بالكامل وبنظام Freelance.

نحتاج إلى توفر بمتوسط 25 ساعة أسبوعيًا على الأقل.

من الأحد إلى الخميس:

‎16:00 – 22:00‎

يتم شرح تفاصيل نظام العمولات والمكافآت بالكامل وبشكل واضح خلال عملية التوظيف.

نحن ندعم أعضاء الفريق من خلال التدريب المستمر، وتحليل الأداء، والـ Feedback، والـ Webinars، ومشاركة أفضل الممارسات.

لكن زيادة الدخل لا تحدث تلقائيًا أو فورًا. النتائج تعتمد على مهاراتك، وسرعة تعلمك، والتزامك، وقدرتك على تحسين أدائك باستمرار.

إذا كنت شخصًا يحب التعلم، وتحليل نتائجه، وتحسين أدائه خطوة بخطوة، فهذه الوظيفة تمنحك فرصة حقيقية لزيادة دخلك مع تطور مستواك.

7. مراحل التقديم والتدريب 🧭

لن تبدأ مباشرة مع عملاء حقيقيين.

لدينا عملية منظمة تساعدك على فهم الدور والتدرب عليه قبل بدء العمل.

رحلتك مع Kodland

1️⃣ قراءة تفاصيل الوظيفة والتقديم

تراجع معلومات الوظيفة وتتأكد من أن الجدول وطبيعة العمل يناسبانك، ثم ترسل طلبك.

2️⃣ مرحلة التقييم الأولي عبر الفيديو

إذا انتقلت إلى المرحلة التالية، ستصلك رسالة من Kodland على بريدك الإلكتروني تحتوي على رابط شخصي.

من خلال هذا الرابط ستجيب عن مجموعة قصيرة من الأسئلة وتسجل إجاباتك بالفيديو في الوقت المناسب لك.

نريد أن نسمع إجاباتك الحقيقية وخبرتك أنت، وليس نصًا محفوظًا أو إجابات مولدة بالذكاء الاصطناعي.

3️⃣ مراجعة فريق التوظيف

يراجع فريقنا إجاباتك، ومدى توافق جدولك، وتجهيزاتك التقنية، ومدى ملاءمتك الأساسية للدور.

إذا كان هناك توافق، سنتواصل معك بشأن الخطوة التالية.

4️⃣ مرحلة التدريب

ستحصل على مواد تدريبية منظمة تساعدك على فهم:

  • هيكل الحصة التجريبية.

  • طريقة التواصل مع الطفل وولي الأمر.

  • أسلوب عرض برامج Kodland.

  • المبيعات والتعامل مع الاعتراضات.

  • الأدوات والأنظمة المستخدمة في العمل.

يتضمن التدريب مواد Self-study، وWebinars مباشرة، وتطبيقات عملية وRole-plays مع Feedback.

5️⃣ مرحلة التقييم العملي

ستقوم بتنفيذ حصص تجريبية محاكاة مع الـ Trainer والـ Team Leader للتأكد من أنك مستعد للتعامل مع العائلات الحقيقية.

إذا احتجت إلى تحسين بعض النقاط، قد تحصل على Feedback وفرصة إضافية.

6️⃣ Onboarding وأول حصص حقيقية

بعد اجتياز المراحل المطلوبة، يتم استكمال إجراءات الانضمام، والحصول على الأدوات والصلاحيات اللازمة، ثم تبدأ العمل مع العائلات الحقيقية خلال فترة الـ Probation.

⏱ مدة العملية

قد تختلف المدة حسب مواعيد مجموعات التدريب وسرعة إكمال الخطوات المطلوبة، لذلك ننصح بإكمال كل مرحلة في أقرب وقت ممكن.

8. هل هذه الوظيفة مناسبة لك؟ 🎯

غالبًا ستستمتع بهذه الوظيفة إذا:

  • تستمتع بالتواصل مع الناس وطرح الأسئلة وفهم احتياجاتهم.

  • تشعر بالراحة في التعامل مع الأطفال وأولياء الأمور.

  • لا تشعر بعدم الارتياح تجاه المبيعات أو مناقشة الأسعار أو إتمام الصفقات.

  • تحفزك الأهداف والنتائج.

  • تستطيع الحفاظ على تركيزك والتطور حتى عندما لا تأتي النتائج فورًا.

  • يمكنك العمل في المساء ويوم واحد على الأقل خلال عطلة نهاية الأسبوع.

  • تتمتع بالانضباط الذاتي ويمكنك العمل من المنزل دون إشراف مستمر.

  • تهتم فعلًا بتعليم الأطفال وتطوير مهاراتهم باستخدام التكنولوجيا.

  • يعجبك نظام الدخل المرتبط بالأداء وتحسين النتائج.

قد لا تكون هذه الوظيفة مناسبة لك إذا:

  • تبحث عن وظيفة تقليدية من 9 إلى 5 براتب شهري ثابت.

  • لا تشعر بالراحة مع المبيعات أو مناقشة الأسعار.

  • لا تريد مساعدة العميل على اتخاذ قرار أو إتمام عملية التسجيل.

  • لا ترغب في العمل خلال المساء أو عطلة نهاية الأسبوع.

  • لا تريد استخدام الكاميرا أثناء العمل.

  • تجد صعوبة في تنظيم وقتك والعمل بشكل مستقل عن بُعد.

9. ماذا يحدث بعد التقديم؟ ⏭️

بعد إرسال طلبك:

  1. يراجع فريقنا المعلومات الأساسية في طلبك.

  2. إذا كان ملفك مناسبًا للمرحلة التالية، ستتلقى رسالة من Kodland عبر البريد الإلكتروني.

  3. ستستخدم الرابط الشخصي الموجود في الرسالة لإكمال مرحلة التقييم المطلوبة.

  4. يراجع فريق التوظيف إجاباتك وملاءمتك للدور.

  5. إذا اجتزت المرحلة، سنشرح لك الخطوات التالية للانضمام إلى التدريب.

إذا لم يكن هناك توافق في الوقت الحالي — على سبيل المثال بسبب جدول التوفر أو متطلبات الدور — فسنخبرك بذلك أيضًا.

Metric Systems LLC is a direct‑hire employer partner dedicated to helping companies connect with the right talent for their open roles. We are not a staffing agency—instead, we work alongside employers to identify strong candidates, streamline the hiring process, and support both sides through each step. Once hired, you become an employee of the client organization directly, ensuring a seamless transition into your new role and long‑term career alignment.

My client is seeking a Fully Remote Sr. Network Security Engineer SME to lead a high‑impact Zero Trust transformation for the FBI CJIS division, driving the shift from legacy network security to a modern, cloud‑first architecture powered by Zscaler. This role blends hands‑on engineering with architectural influence, contributing directly to TIC 3.0‑aligned modernization efforts within a mature SAFe Agile environment. You’ll work alongside a collaborative mix of federal and contractor engineers, shaping future‑state security capabilities, solving complex enterprise‑scale challenges, and gaining deeply marketable expertise in Zscaler (ZIA/ZPA), Zero Trust, SASE frameworks, cloud security, and identity‑driven access. Candidates with Zscaler experience or comparable cloud security/SWG/ZTNA platforms are strongly preferred.

About xCures

The best of medicine should belong to everyone. Nobody dreams of becoming good at being a patient. We have people to love, things we want to do, and plans we hope to keep. Illness already asks enough of us.

xCures® exists to give healthcare the capacity to care for everyone. Healthcare has more to give. Too much of its time, money, and talent goes into unnecessary work that keeps people waiting and drives up the cost of care. Freeing those resources can make excellent care possible for far more people.

xCures understands a patient’s history across the places they receive care and keeps that understanding current. It puts trusted information in the hands of the people who need it, when they need it, and uses that knowledge to take on more of the administrative work around care. Every extracted data point traces back to the exact document and page it came from.

Our ambition is to empower doctors to make better decisions, enable researchers to develop better treatments faster, and help healthcare organizations serve more people with fewer errors and lower costs. We work with diagnostic labs, providers, telehealth companies, health systems, payers, and consumer health platforms. We are a fully remote, venture-backed team that holds itself to the same standard as our product: trustworthy, precise, and purposeful.

We are building for the lives people want to live.

Here’s Where You’ll Make An Impact:

xCures is seeking an experienced, analytical, and driven Medical Science Liaison (MSL) to join our growing team. Reporting to the Vice President of Scientific and Medical Affairs, you will engage with key opinion leaders and clinical leadership at client organizations, supporting platform adoption. You will leverage emerging platform tools to showcase the capabilities of the xCures Clinical Clarity Engine, supporting Client Solutions and Customer Success teams in expanding client use cases. You will also articulate client needs to internal Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to ensure client delight. Outstanding communication and project management skills are essential with an ability to manage multiple complex and unrelated projects simultaneously. Comfort in a remote, fast-paced, growth-phase start-up environment is paramount.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as a key scientific liaison in client and partner discussions, helping to define data needs, manage expectations, and translate clinical and operational requirements into actionable strategies, ensuring alignment with xCures’ technical capabilities.
  • Lead external discussions around data quality and validation and communicate complex clinical data extraction capabilities and insights (e.g., genomics, oncology treatments, patient outcomes), ensuring clear understanding of product features and scientific accuracy.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in oncology and real-world data applications during client meetings and external engagements.
  • Support client research initiatives by advising on the interpretation, provenance, and internal use of real-world data (RWD), including data extracted through AI/ML algorithms such as large language models.
  • Provide scientific guidance on the design and execution of client-led real-world evidence studies utilizing xCures' platform.
  • Collaborate with internal product and engineering teams to inform the development of client-facing features and data offerings based on external medical and scientific requirements.
  • Propose and lead collaborations on joint publications and thought leadership efforts with clients and external researchers.
  • Represent xCures at conferences and external forums by presenting on platform capabilities, scientific findings, and applications of RWD in oncology, in support of the business development team.

Qualifications

  • PhD in a life sciences discipline
  • 4+ years of experience as an MSL in the oncology diagnostics industry
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex scientific concepts into clear, concise, and actionable insights for diverse audiences
  • Proven ability to build and maintain strong professional relationships with diverse stakeholders, including C-suite executives, clinical subject matter experts, and internal cross-functional teams (e.g., product, engineering, business development)
  • Experience with structured clinical data and real-world data analysis
  • Proven track record of managing multiple complex and unrelated projects simultaneously, with strong organizational and time management skills
  • Exceptional communication (written and verbal) and presentation skills

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic, and growth-phase start-up environment

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to critically evaluate and interpret scientific data
  • Experience with conversational AI agents
  • Familiarity with regulatory landscape governing real-world data and its use in healthcare

Location

xCures operates in a distributed, remote-first environment, with occasional travel to company offsites or key meetings throughout the year. Candidates may be located anywhere in the United States. The successful candidate must already have authorization to work in the United States. At this time, xCures does not offer sponsorship. All candidate information will be held in confidence and in accordance with EEOC guidelines.

Additional Considerations

We recognize that people bring a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the requirements listed in a job description. Diversity of experience and skills, combined with a shared passion for healthcare, is what drives us to innovate. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification listed. xCures is an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Benefits

jobs.description:
Senior Infrastructure Engineer

Remote (UK-based), with occasional on-site work at our data centres | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (). Our network handles over $75 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 50+ of the world’s leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what’s technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to help run and grow the network and cloud estate behind our trading platform. Networking in our colocation data centres is the core of the role. The estate spans London, New York and Singapore, and from Q1 2027 a new Tokyo data centre.

This is a hands-on role in a small, expert infrastructure team. You’ll work closely with our Head of Infrastructure, following problems from the cross-connect through hosts, containers and AWS. You’ll also help keep infrastructure delivery on track, from timelines and reporting to working closely with our TechOps team.

What You’ll Work On

  • Low-latency networking across our colocation sites: switching and routing, cross-connects, BGP peering with liquidity providers and clients, and the fabric that carries our trading traffic

  • Bringing new sites to application-ready, starting with Tokyo

  • Our hybrid connectivity into multi-region AWS, including Direct Connect, routing and failover

  • Linux hosts and containers on the critical path, with every change made through code (Ansible, Git, Terraform), never by hand

  • Monitoring and alerting that catches problems before clients do, plus runbooks and post-incident reviews that someone else can follow

  • Planning and capacity: forecasting growth, setting timelines and reporting progress to TechOps and engineering

What We Need

  • 4+ years running production infrastructure in a latency-sensitive environment, such as HFT, an exchange, market data or bank trading infrastructure

  • Strong networking: hands-on routing and switching (MLAG, LACP, VLANs), BGP in production, and a solid grasp of low-latency behaviour such as buffers, microbursts and congestion handling

  • Colocation experience: cabinets, cross-connects, remote hands and vendor management

  • Solid Linux (RHEL) and TCP/IP, and the ability to trace a problem from the wire to the application

  • Infrastructure as code and containers as your default way of working

  • Working knowledge of AWS networking, and the confidence to pick up the rest of our stack. Networking depth matters more to us than any particular cloud or platform tooling

  • Methodical, evidence-led troubleshooting and clear documentation

A strong plus:

  • Project management experience: owning timelines, reporting progress, and working with ops teams to hit deadlines

  • Kernel bypass (Onload/ef_vi), PTP and time synchronisation

  • Experience bringing up a new colo site

  • FIX protocol or OTC FX market knowledge

  • Python for tooling

Working pattern: Infrastructure changes are often scheduled outside trading hours, including weekends, and the team shares an on-call rota. We’re a team with flexible hours, so time worked out of hours is taken back during the week. Day-to-day work is remote, with occasional visits to our data centres, most often in London (Slough).

What You Get

  • Real ownership of a live global trading network, hands-on, with few layers of process

  • A build-out year, with a new Tokyo data centre in Q1 and more growth ahead

  • A senior seat in a small, expert team where your changes ship and are measured

  • Competitive package — up to 38 days leave (inc. bank holidays), private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly working with flexibility around out-of-hours work

  • Growth as the estate scales

We believe in transparency, honest feedback and writing things down, and we aim to build systems that don’t depend on the heroics of individuals.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages:

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition

Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Technical Deep Dive with our Head of Infrastructure
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~90 minutes

Stage 3: Leadership Conversation with our CDO

Format: Video call, ~45 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you’re invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you’ll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we’re happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.

Je bent de onmisbare schakel tussen de business van de klant en onze getalenteerde developers. Samen met je teams bouw je applicaties die dagelijks door miljoenen mensen worden gebruikt. Je doorziet technische en procesmatige risico's snel en vertaalt deze proactief naar concrete oplossingen.

Wat je gaat doen:

  • Complexe, organisatiebrede IT-trajecten en cross-platform projecten zelfstandig van initiatie tot succesvolle oplevering loodsen.

  • Duurzame relaties opbouwen met veeleisende enterprise-klanten en hen op C-level niveau overtuigend adviseren over prioriteiten en resources.

  • Multidisciplinaire, remote werkende ontwikkelteams (Android/Kotlin, iOS/Swift en backend) motiveren en optimaal laten presteren.

  • Projectkaders bewaken op het gebied van scope, tijd en budget via ons 'Assured Delivery Process'.

  • Technische risico's, zoals strenge store-richtlijnen van Apple en Google of complexe hardware-integraties, vroegtijdig tackelen.

  • Bestaande klantaccounts helpen groeien door proactief mee te denken over hun digitale transformatie.

Requirements

Wie ben jij?

We zoeken een daadkrachtige spin in het web met een scherpe blik op tastbare meerwaarde voor de klant. Je hebt aantoonbare, meerjarige ervaring als Projectmanager in het succesvol leiden van complexe, omvangrijke maatwerk softwareprojecten (ervaring in de mediasector is een pre). Je combineert een strategische langetermijnvisie moeiteloos met een hands-on executie. Ervaring in de mediasector is een pré.

Je schakelt soepel tussen Agile/Scrum-methodieken en traditionele fixed scope/fixed price - trajecten. Als communicatief sterke professional bewaar je de rust bij tegenslag en weet je hoe je met tact en daadkracht slecht nieuws overbrengt. Je hebt ervaring met stakeholdermanagement op C-level niveau van veeleisende corporate of Enterprise klanten, waarbij je duurzame relaties opbouwt, overtuigend adviseert en effectief onderhandelt over prioriteiten en resources. Je bent empathisch, verbindend en voelt je thuis in een 'remote first' werkomgeving waar vakmanschap de standaard is. Verder ben je woonachtig in Nederland en spreek je vloeiend Nederlands.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • De Organisatie: Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software.

  • Autonomie: Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie.

  • Maatschappelijke Impact: De kans om bij te dragen aan bekende, maatschappelijk relevante applicaties voor platformen zoals NPO Start, RTL Boulevard en het KNMI binnen een uitstekend beoordeeld top-tier maatwerk softwarebedrijf (Emerce100 koploper).

  • Salaris: Bruto maandsalaris passend bij jouw ervaring.

  • Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om lekker uit te rusten.

  • Werkplek & Sfeer: Een fijne remote-first cultuur met volledige flexibiliteit, een gezellige werksfeer en inspirerende maandelijkse co-working dagen.

  • Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken: Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding, gecombineerd met een maandelijkse thuiswerkvergoeding.

  • Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen.

  • Ontwikkeling & Extra's: Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen, plus actieve deelname en toegang tot het eigen event Appdevcon en diverse kennissessies.

  • De 'Gadget Kit': Alle devices die je nodig hebt om mee te kijken op jouw projecten én een volledig ingerichte thuiswerkplek.

  • Events & Fun: Toffe teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events.

Over Dawn Technology

We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er écht toe doen – van zorg en educatie tot duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dát maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend.

Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis, zoeken we de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken we elkaar. Benieuwd om te horen hoe het is om bij Dawn Technology te werken? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast.

Solliciteren

Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Ook als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren. Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360.

Have a great day. Dawn Technology.

We gebruiken voor nieuwe kandidaten een assessment (actueel binnen projectmanagement) om het niveau objectief vast te stellen. Hiermee onderbouwen we de totstandkoming van het salaris in het recruitmentproces op basis van feitelijke vaardigheden. Dit geeft ons een eerlijk en meetbaar kader voor iedereen.

jobs.title: HR Benefits Manager
jobs.excerpt: The intent of this job description is to provide a summary of the major duties and responsibilities performed in this job.
jobs.description:
The intent of this job description is to provide a summary of the major duties and responsibilities performed in this job. Incumbents may be requested to perform job-related tasks other than those specifically presented in this description.

The Benefits Manager is an experienced Human Resources professional responsible for owning and driving the administration, financial oversight, compliance, and continuous improvement of employee benefits programs across ~800 covered lives and 4 company plan structures. This role serves as the primary subject matter expert for benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and retirement programs.

A core strategic priority for this role will be project-managing and leading our upcoming 2027 transition from fully insured to self-funded medical plans in partnership with HR leadership, Finance, brokers, vendors, and other stakeholders to ensure programs are competitive, financially sustainable, and effectively administered.

In addition to benefits ownership, the Benefits Manager is expected to maintain broad working knowledge across Human Resources to provide cross-functional support, help resolve team escalations, and back up HR operations as needed.

Confidentiality & Information Security

All HR team members must sign and comply with Rancho Health MSO’s HR Department Confidentiality Agreement. This role requires regular access to sensitive employee and company information. A high level of discretion, data protection, and adherence to privacy policies is required at all times, including after employment ends.

Essential Job Duties

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Benefits Management & Administration (FULL OWNERSHIP)

  • Own day-to-day administration and oversight of employee benefits programs across MSO and Provider populations, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and supplemental benefits across 4 company plans.
  • Serve as the primary internal resource for benefits-related questions, escalations, vendor coordination, and complex issues.
  • Manage relationships with benefits brokers, carriers, third-party administrators, and other external partners.
  • Lead annual benefits renewals, open enrollment planning, implementation, employee communications, and post-enrollment reconciliation.
  • Partner with HR Operations to ensure accurate benefits eligibility, enrollment, deductions, and system configuration.

Self-Funded Medical Plans & Financial Oversight (FULL OWNERSHIP)

  • 2027 Self-Funded Transition: Lead the operational execution of our transition from fully insured to self-funded health plans, working closely with brokers, third-party administrators, stop-loss carriers, and Finance.
  • Monitor plan performance and financial exposure by reviewing claims experience, utilization trends, large claimant activity, and funding requirements.
  • Analyze benefits costs, identify trends and risks, and develop recommendations for HR and executive leadership.
  • Coordinate stop-loss renewals, funding arrangements, reporting, financial reconciliations, and support benefits budgeting and forecasting.

Benefits Compliance & Retirement Plan Oversight (FULL OWNERSHIP)

  • Oversee compliance with applicable federal and state employee benefits requirements, including ERISA, ACA, COBRA, HIPAA, and related regulations.
  • Coordinate required notices, plan documentation, reporting, audits, and compliance activities.
  • Oversee administration, vendor relationships, compliance coordination, and ongoing performance of the organization’s 401(k) retirement plans in partnership with Payroll and HR Operations.

HR Operations & Cross-Functional Support

  • Maintain broad working knowledge of HR functions, including employee relations, leaves of absence, workers' compensation, recruiting, onboarding/offboarding, and HRIS.
  • Provide general HR support and backup during peak workloads, absences, acquisitions, integrations, and special projects.
  • Partner with HR Business Partners and HR Operations on matters involving benefits, leaves, employee transitions, and overlapping responsibilities.
  • Identify issues requiring specialized expertise or HR leadership involvement and escalate appropriately.

Ownership & Accountability

Each role within HR has defined ownership. This position is expected to independently own employee benefits programs end-to-end, including financial oversight, compliance, vendor management, and the 2027 self-funded implementation. While collaboration across the HR team is expected, accountability for assigned benefits program outcomes remains with the Benefits Manager.

Team Collaboration & Flexibility

The Human Resources team operates with clear ownership and shared accountability. Each role is responsible for defined functions and outcomes, while also supporting one another during peak workloads, time off, audits, acquisitions, integrations, and special initiatives. Collaboration, cross-training, and flexibility are essential to ensuring continuity of service and team effectiveness.

Required Education and Experience

  • Minimum Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field preferred, or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum Experience: 3+ years of progressive employee benefits administration experience, including exposure to self-funded health plan administration, broker management, and annual open enrollments.
  • Broad understanding of Human Resources functions and employee lifecycle processes, with the ability to provide support beyond benefits administration.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage programs, vendor relationships, competing priorities, and complex issues.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in HRIS and benefits administration systems (ADP Workforce Now strongly preferred).
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including data analysis, reporting, claims reconciliation, and pivot tables.
  • Experience using project and workflow management tools (e.g., Monday.com) to organize initiatives and track deliverables.

Core Competencies

  • Strong ownership mindset and accountability for outcomes.
  • Analytical thinking, financial awareness, and sound judgment.
  • High attention to detail, confidentiality, and accuracy.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and support organizational growth.

Physical Requirements & Work Authorization

  • Workplace: Remote – California (with occasional travel to Riverside County and regional business locations as needed).
  • Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the United States.
