jobs.description:
Introduction

Join us at AIT, where we believe every day presents an opportunity to make a global impact!

We’re problem solvers, driven by our curiosity and creativity, in endless pursuit of solutions for our customers. Together, we champion the strength of our global teams. And, as trusted advisors, we go above and beyond, working together in a supportive and collaborative environment to ensure customer satisfaction. 

Through the company's continued growth, we challenge ourselves to be better, continuously learning and growing in our dynamic environment. Helping others is at the core of our culture, join us in finding fulfillment by giving back to our local communities as the united team that is AIT.  Find out what our people deliver.® means when you come move the world with us! 

Hear directly from our teammates at AIT Worldwide Logistics and make us the next stop on your career journey.

Overview

The Business Systems Analyst will support all areas of IT by understanding the diverse business need and product offerings, as well as the technology systems that support our business. This position will primarily focus on our customers’ business needs and offer products and/or solutions to meet those needs.

Responsibilities

  • Working with customers and/or business stakeholders to accurately capture business requirements for new projects and customer onboarding
  • Work with IT team members to review and clarify requirements as needed and act as the liaison between business project stakeholders and IT
  • Responsible for technical documentation of system components and processes
  • Maintains and manages customer service requests that are routed via our Service Desk
  • Manages and monitors existing functionalities and defines new functionality as needed for application integrity
  • Interfaces with internal and external technical staff to define application solutions and resolve problems as needed
  • Manage incident workflow from initial reporting to final resolution including incident handoffs with outsourced 3rd party organizations
  • Collaborate with IT to develop detailed project specifications
  • Conduct testing and deliver training related material for new customer IT enhancements
  • Contribute to a knowledge base of known problems and resolutions for customers and sales to resolve problems on their own
  • Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications

  • A team player who works well with others – being respectful to our teammates is a Core Value
  • A strong work ethic with an appreciation for ownership, independence, accountability, and autonomy in your role
  • Growth mindset – being passionate about your craft, always looking for ways to improve yourself and the company, being open to change and doing things differently
  • Customer service focus – we serve a wide variety of customers, both internal and external, and building relationships is a part of our culture

Other Skills We Hope to See:

  • Minimum 5 years related work experience and / or training
  • Ability to effectively present and promote technology and respond to questions from groups of managers, customers, and co-workers
  • Work with customers to resolve their business problems or inefficiencies using technology and business process
  • Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form
  • Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists

What AIT Can Offer You

In addition to your base compensation, you may be eligible for a bonus based on achievement of business and/or individual performance metrics (dependent on position). Benefits offered include Medical, Prescription, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Accounts, Dental, Vision, Life, AD&D, Disability, Supplemental Health, Employee Support, Paid Parental Leave, Pet Insurance, 401(k) and Tuition Reimbursement. In addition, teammates may be eligible for up to 10 to 20 days of vacation (depending on tenure), 2 personal days, 1 floating holiday, 5 sick days, 5 volunteer hours, and 6 company holidays (plus Veterans Day for Veterans) annually.

About AIT Worldwide

AIT Worldwide Logistics is a global freight forwarder that helps companies grow by expanding access to markets all over the world where they can sell and/or procure their raw materials, components and finished goods. For more than 40 years, the Chicago-based supply chain solutions leader has relied on a consultative approach to build a global network and trusted partnerships in nearly every industry, including aerospace, automotive, consumer retail, energy, food, government, high-tech, industrial, life sciences and marine. Backed by scalable, user-friendly technology, AIT’s flexible business model customizes door-to-door deliveries via sea, air, ground and rail—on time and on budget. With expert teammates staffing more than 150 worldwide locations in Asia, Europe and North America, AIT’s full-service options also include customs clearance, warehouse management and white glove services.

jobs.excerpt: BEWERBUNG ÜBER DIE "MITMACHEN"-FUNKTION AUF UNSERER WEBSITE krisenchat ist innerhalb kürzester Zeit zum größten Online-Beratungsangebot Deutschlands für junge Menschen in Not geworden.
jobs.description:
BEWERBUNG ÜBER DIE "MITMACHEN"-FUNKTION AUF UNSERER WEBSITE

krisenchat ist innerhalb kürzester Zeit zum größten Online-Beratungsangebot Deutschlands für junge Menschen in Not geworden. Wir sind eine agile Non-Profit-Organisation und bieten Kindern und Jugendlichen rund um die Uhr niedrigschwellige, effektive und wirksame psychosoziale Ersthilfe per Chat an. Seit Mai 2020 konnten die 300+ Krisenberater:innen schon in über 80.000 Krisensituationen helfen. Dabei erfolgt die Krisenberatung komplett remote und ist zeitlich flexibel einteilbar.

Aufgaben

Du berätst Kinder, Jugendliche und junge Erwachsene unter 25 Jahren bei ihren Problemen und Sorgen und leistet dabei wichtige Hilfe zur Selbsthilfe. Du bietest den Hilfesuchenden die Möglichkeit, Selbstwirksamkeit zu erleben, indem du lösungsorientiertes Denken der Chatter:innen aktivierst und förderst.

Dabei arbeitest du in frei wählbaren 2-Stunden-Schichten mit anderen Berater:innen zusammen. Neben diesem Prinzip der Peer-Beratung, sorgen auch die im Hintergrund verfügbaren Teammitglieder, sowie die große Anzahl an verfügbaren Ressourcen für ein sicheres Beratungsumfeld. Natürlich absolvierst du außerdem zum Start ein ausführliches und flexibel planbares Onboarding.

Qualifikation

Um unsere Qualität in der Beratung nachhaltig zu sichern, können bei uns Personen mit einem akademischen Abschluss in den folgenden Fächern beraten:

  • Abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium Psychologie oder Bachelorstudent:in mit Zusatzqualifikation oder intensiver Beratungserfahrung (keine Pflichtpraktika)
  • Psychotherapeut:innen in Ausbildung oder abgeschlossen in den nach den Psychotherapierichtlinien anerkannten Verfahren
  • Ärzt:innen mit Zusatzqualifikation Psychotherapie
  • Lehrer:innen und Pädagog:innen mit zusätzlichen Beratungserfahrungen
  • Sozialarbeiter:innen und Sozialpädagog:innen mit staatlicher Anerkennung
  • Nach individueller Prüfung auch andere, ähnliche Hintergründe mit sehr intensiver psychosozialer Beratungserfahrung

Als vollständig digitales Angebot benötigst du, neben deiner Fachkompetenz, einen PC oder Laptop für die Beratung, sowie ein Handy zur Anmeldung auf unserer Plattform. Du bist grundsätzlich im Umgang mit digitalen Tools geübt - den spezifischen Umgang mit unserer Plattform lernst du im Onboarding kennen. Du kannst bei Bedarf Deutschkenntnisse auf dem Niveau C2 nachweisen.

Das Ehrenamt umfasst die Übernahme von mind. 2 Chatschichten pro Monat und die Teilnahme an einer Supervision. Eine Schicht dauert inkl. Vor- und Nachbereitung 2,5 Stunden.

Benefits

Dein Ehrenamt bei krisenchat ist eine Gelegenheit, Erfahrungen in einem innovativen, digitalen Beratungsfeld zu sammeln. Durch die Niedrigschwelligkeit wirst du mit einem breiten Spektrum an Themen und Krisen konfrontiert. So wird dir ermöglicht, deine Kenntnisse im Bereich der Krisenintervention auszubauen. Du wirst eng mit einer sehr engagierten und diversen Community zusammenarbeiten und von den unterschiedlichen Erfahrungen und dem Austausch miteinander profitieren. Das Netzwerk, das sich dir durch das Ehrenamt eröffnet, ist damit auch über die Beratungstätigkeit bei krisenchat hinaus extrem wertvoll.

Zudem bieten wir kostenfreie Supervisionen in kleinen Gruppen und Feedbackgespräche an. Die herausfordernden Situationen, die du im Chat erlebst, kannst du so reflektieren und sie helfen dir bei deiner persönlichen Weiterentwicklung.

jobs.excerpt: About KeyrockSince 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets.
jobs.description:
About Keyrock

Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 200+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris and New York.

We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management.

We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement.

We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it.

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Head of Marketing to take full ownership of our marketing strategy, rebrand Keyrock and reposition us as the market evolves from crypto-native to institutional, merging with traditional finance.

This is not a maintenance role. It is a transformation mandate with full discretionary decision-making on how to implement our commercial strategy. You will work as a close strategic partner to the CCO, operating almost as co-marketeers.

The team is lean by design: 2-3 direct reports plus heavy use of AI and agentic tooling. We are looking for someone who inspires and sets direction, not someone who runs campaigns. Operational execution will increasingly be handled by AI agents.

What You Will Do

  • Own and execute the complete rebrand and repositioning of Keyrock in the market

  • Define and drive the marketing strategy across institutional and crypto-native audiences

  • Build a premium, forward-looking brand identity. Think distinctive, audacious, credible to both institutional allocators and crypto-native operators

  • Push information into the market in ways that make people pay attention and take Keyrock seriously

  • Partner closely with the CCO and commercial team to drive measurable commercial impact

  • Build and lead a small, high-impact team augmented by AI tooling

  • Shape how Keyrock is perceived as the industry converges with traditional finance

Who You Are

  • Crypto-native. You have been through market cycles. You understand blockchain technology deeply but you are pragmatic, not ideological. You know this is not a binary world.

  • A brand-builder, not an ops person. You are inspiring, not operational. You set direction, tone and creative vision.

  • An exceptional communicator. You can face institutional allocators who care about regulation and licensing, and crypto-native counterparties who value speed and edge. You switch between both with ease.

  • Confident and assertive. You project authority. You bring conviction and directness - you challenge constructively and don't default to consensus. You bring edge, energy and a slightly audacious style.

  • Human-centric. You connect with people, build followership and bring teams along.

  • Detail-oriented. Despite the strategic focus, you sweat the details on brand consistency, messaging precision and design quality.

  • A challenger mindset. You dare to think differently, question the status quo and push things forward through constructive tension.

Our Recruitment Philosophy

We look for self-aware candidates who bring both the core skills required for the role and a deep alignment with our performance principles. We seek fiercely passionate, mission-driven people who communicate with purpose and practice proactive ownership. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who prioritizes mission over ego, maintains a commercial mindset, and delivers long-term value through pragmatic flexibility.

Experience and Background

Required

  • Significant experience in marketing leadership at a crypto or digital-asset firm

  • Deep understanding of the crypto market, its participants and its culture

  • Track record of building or transforming a brand in a fast-moving, commercially-driven environment

  • Strong communication skills Exceptional fluency in English, both written and spoken.

  • Based in or closely aligned with the CET time zone.

Preferred

  • Experience positioning a firm through a TradFi/crypto convergence narrative

  • Exposure to publicly listed or IPO-track companies

  • Familiarity with EU regulatory environment (MiCA) and how it shapes marketing and financial promotions

  • Experience working with or building AI-augmented marketing functions

Why Keyrock

  • Step-up opportunity. Own the function globally, report directly to the CCO, shape the brand from scratch.

  • Transformation moment. Keyrock is pivoting from appreciated-but-underrated to a firm that commands respect. This is a before-and-after career story.

  • Commercial partnership. Not a siloed marketing role. Deeply embedded in commercial strategy with commission upside.

  • Lean and AI-augmented. Small team, big impact. No bureaucratic bloat. Use agents and tools to move fast.

  • Global footprint. Offices across EU, UK, US and Switzerland. International exposure from day one.

  • Competitive offer. A competitive compensation package, attractive global benefits, and a performance-based variable.

  • Annual Team Retreats. A yearly offsite dedicated to strategy, celebration of our wins and fun team activities

jobs.description:
You’re a Compensation professional looking to use your experience to add value to a variety of interesting clients while maintaining a work-life balance. You have endured long hours, nonstop pressure, and residual headaches from years of in-house work and you are ready for your career to look and feel differently but aren’t sure if that opportunity really exists.

You love data, not just working in a spreadsheet, but what the numbers say. Your natural communication approach is one that effectively and respectfully builds a sense of competence with clients. You are a strategic thinker and a proactive problem solver.

You enjoy analyzing data and developing compensation structures, including job matching, benchmarking, data manipulation, pay range design, cost modeling, and internal equity reviews. You can clearly and professionally present your findings, translating complex analysis into practical insights for business leaders. You understand that data informs decisions, but how an organization applies it makes the difference. You recognize the importance of a compensation philosophy and can bring differing perspectives together to find common ground. Because one size does not fit all, you are open to exploring how compensation strategies can reflect an organization’s culture and values. Your superpower is turning data into clear guidance that helps clients shape their overall compensation strategy.

When you’re considering a new job, it’s normal to have a ton of questions. Here are a few things we get asked all the time:

If I am working part-time, can I still be eligible for benefits?

YES! BPM employees who work a minimum of 30 hours a week are eligible for paid holidays, PTO, health insurance benefits, and more!

I am tired of the commute, and just too many work hours. What will my day look like?

With the exception of scheduled video meetings with clients, you get to work in the comfort of your own home! Travel is rare and your personal priorities are respected. Plus, you choose how many hours you work, how many clients you support, and both can fluctuate!

What makes BPMs HR Team so special?

The people! Each of us come from different backgrounds and bring different experiences to the table. You aren’t expected to know it all because we all are a collaborative team of HR professionals that are here to support each other as we support our clients.

BPM is a full-service accounting firm providing comprehensive assurance, tax, and advisory services to clients globally. We are one of the largest California-based accounting firms and have built our success by focusing on our clients and our people. Our people-centered culture and firm motto “Because People Matter” has allowed us to be consistently recognized as one of the Best Places to Work in the Bay Area. We are dedicated to providing meaningful careers for all of our employees. Our flexible culture allows our professionals to live a balanced lifestyle between their work responsibilities and personal commitments.

Are you ready to learn more?

Wondering if you should apply?

At BPM we are people who value people. We are progressive and purposeful. We are a firm with flexibility. Our shared entrepreneurial spirit drives us to see and do things differently. And our passion for people makes BPM a place where everyone feels welcome, valued, and part of something bigger.

BPM welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

jobs.description:
We enable financial institutions to become AI-first digital leaders.

As a professional team of global scale, we work with best clients for great and exciting projects, in an environment where we learn amazing things every day. Each code, each voice, each contribution, each challenge, each success is celebrated here.

We welcome candidates who share our values, have the skills and are passionate to enjoy our journey to build the digital future of finance, together.

About The Job:

We are seeking a highly skilled Software Development Manager to lead the Product Engineering Team responsible for VeriTouch, our solution built on Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE and Microsoft Power Platform. This role combines technical leadership, people management, and hands-on oversight of engineering processes to deliver a scalable, secure, maintainable, and high-quality product.

The Software Development Manager owns the engineering delivery, technical quality, release readiness, and production stability of the VeriTouch product. The role works closely with Product Management, Architecture, Quality Engineering, DevOps, and Implementation teams, while customer project delivery remains under the relevant implementation governance structure.

The role is responsible for ensuring that engineering practices, technical decisions, development processes, and delivery standards support the product's long-term scalability, maintainability, security, and operational stability.

The Software Development Manager works closely with Product Management, Project Management, Solution Architects, Technical Leads, Business Analysts, Quality Engineers, DevOps, and clients to ensure successful technical delivery throughout the software development lifecycle.

What You Will Be Doing

Product Engineering & Engineering Leadership

  • Own the engineering delivery lifecycle for VeriTouch, from requirements analysis, estimation, and solution design through development, testing, deployment, release, go-live, warranty, and transition to support.
  • Lead a high-performing product development team consisting of developers, business analysts, quality engineers, technical leads, and other technical specialists, ensuring effective planning, execution, and delivery.
  • Establish and manage engineering plans, milestones, dependencies, assumptions, risks, acceptance criteria, and resource requirements.
  • Ensure development tasks, estimates, engineering plans, and resource allocations are realistic, aligned, and consistent with product priorities.
  • Monitor engineering progress through work-management tools and engineering metrics, including backlog health, planned versus completed effort, defect trends, technical debt, cycle time, and deployment readiness.
  • Identify delivery deviations early and lead recovery actions through reprioritization, resource allocation, scope adjustment, process improvement, automation, or timeline reassessment.
  • Continuously improve software engineering practices, development standards, quality processes, and governance mechanisms.
  • Maintain clear engineering ownership while collaborating with Product Management and Implementation teams to align product priorities with customer and business objectives.

Solution Design & Technical Governance

  • Provide technical leadership across the design and implementation of VeriTouch, Dynamics 365 CE, and Microsoft Power Platform solutions.
  • Partner with Solution Architects, Product Management, and business stakeholders to define high-level designs, technical roadmaps, product-level solution designs, and implementation approaches.
  • Govern the transition from requirements and Statement of Work through functional requirements, gap analysis, solution design, technical design, development, testing, and deployment where applicable.
  • Review technical design documents, integration specifications, data models, security designs, deployment architecture, and non-functional requirements.

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Job Summary

The Presales Solutions Architect — Full Stack Observability at SHI International is responsible for being SHI's Subject Matter Expert on all aspects of full stack observability architecture, including application performance monitoring (APM), infrastructure and cloud monitoring, log analytics, digital experience monitoring, network performance monitoring, and the telemetry pipelines and AIOps capabilities that unify them.

In this role, you will split your time between presales client engagements and internal practice development. On the presales side, you'll take a consultative approach, leading technical discovery sessions with clients to assess their observability maturity, designing target-state monitoring and telemetry architectures, and delivering compelling demos, POCs, and technical presentations. On the internal side, you'll build reusable collateral such as reference architectures, battle cards, and enablement content; evaluate and qualify new vendor partnerships; and conduct training sessions that keep our engineering and sales teams current on emerging observability technologies, platform capabilities, and best practices.

Your credibility and technical depth will make you a trusted advisor to both SHI's most strategic customers and our internal stakeholders, driving meaningful observability outcomes and revenue growth across the Observability practice.

This position is a remote position with Home Office setup as determined by SHI management.

Role Description

  • Design and deliver product demonstrations, proof-of-concepts (POCs), and technical presentations focused on full stack observability solutions including APM, infrastructure and cloud monitoring, log analytics, digital experience monitoring, and network performance monitoring platforms

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients and partners, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and retention through product briefings, demonstrations, and knowledge transfer
  • Stay current with new observability technologies and industry developments; track evolving approaches such as OpenTelemetry standardization, telemetry pipelines, eBPF-based instrumentation, and AIOps to inform architectural recommendations
  • Contribute to practice development by identifying areas for growth, leading innovation initiatives, and creating and maintaining practice standards to ensure high-quality service delivery

  • Self – Motivation: Can proactively seek out challenges, initiate self-development projects, and contribute to personal or professional innovative ideas.

  • Deep understanding of end-to-end observability design including instrumentation strategy, telemetry pipeline and data management, tool consolidation and migration planning, SLO-based operating models, and continuous improvement frameworks

Other Requirements

jobs.title: Knowledge Graph Engineer
jobs.excerpt: BioAge Labs (BIOA) is finding new ways to treat disease by targeting the mechanisms of aging, with the ultimate goal of increasing healthy human lifespan.
jobs.description:
BioAge Labs (BIOA) is finding new ways to treat disease by targeting the mechanisms of aging, with the ultimate goal of increasing healthy human lifespan.

We discover drug targets for aging and age-related disease by combining longitudinal human data with causal evidence from genetics and animal models, structured ontologies and curated external knowledge. A knowledge graph harmonizes these disparate sources to enable scientific discovery of targets, indications and mechanism of action.

We are seeking a Knowledge Graph Engineer with hands-on experience in data engineering and graph technologies to design, build, and maintain scalable knowledge graph solutions. You will translate ontologies and semantic models into production systems, develop pipelines that connect enterprise data to graph platforms, and build queries that support downstream analytics and intelligent applications.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with an understanding of graph modeling and semantic data. You will own solutions from architecture and technology selection through implementation, testing, and performance optimization, working closely with data engineers, AI teams, and stakeholders to turn business requirements into reliable systems.

What you will do

  • Maintain and extend our knowledge graph, including its schema, ingestion pipelines and query layer (Neo4j, Cypher, Apache Jena Fuseki, BigQuery on Google Cloud).
  • Build and run validation and data-governance pipelines to maintain data quality, consistency, and performance. This covers schema and constraint checks, identifier reconciliation, provenance and versioning.
  • Maintain our ontologies and semantic models with the biology and data science teams, and develop the mapping tool scientists use to annotate new terms and analyses. This includes the validation that keeps their mappings consistent with the graph.
  • Integrate knowledge graph solutions with cloud platforms and enterprise data ecosystems, including Google Cloud and BigQuery.
  • Collaborate with data engineers, data science, AI and biology teams to make graph data accessible and useful for downstream applications.
  • Write clean, testable, production-grade code and apply engineering best practices throughout development and delivery.

What you bring

Basic qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in computer science, data engineering, AI or a related field, with 3+ years of industry experience in data engineering.
  • Experience working with biological or biomedical data, such as genomics, proteomics, clinical or phenotype data, and familiarity with standard biomedical ontologies and identifiers (e.g. UniProt, Gene Ontology, EFO, MONDO).

Technical qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with graph databases such as Neo4j, Stardog or GraphDB, including writing and optimizing queries in Cypher or SPARQL.
  • Working knowledge of semantic modelling concepts and standards such as RDF and OWL, and the ability to turn an ontology into a working schema.
  • Experience designing and building APIs (e.g. REST or GraphQL, using frameworks such as FastAPI) that give applications and users access to graph data.
  • Experience building data-quality or validation frameworks.
  • Familiarity with Google Cloud and BigQuery.
  • Strong Python and working knowledge of JavaScript for building data pipelines, graph integrations, and production applications.
  • Strong software engineering practices, including data modeling, system design, testing, documentation and version control.
  • (Preferred) Experience with LLM or agent systems
  • (Preferred) Experience with Open Targets and other drug-discovery knowledge bases.

Collaboration and ownership

  • Strong problem-solving skills and sound technical judgment when requirements are still evolving or design priorities compete.
  • Ability to take ownership of a solution from initial design through implementation and ongoing maintenance.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain architecture decisions and technical trade-offs to clients and stakeholders.
  • Ability to work effectively across data engineering, biologists and AI teams.

Our company

BioAge is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing therapeutic product candidates for metabolic diseases by targeting the biology of human aging. The Company's lead product candidate, BGE-102, is a potent, orally available, brain-penetrant small-molecule NLRP3 inhibitor being developed for cardiovascular risk and retinal diseases including diabetic macular edema. BGE-102 has completed a Phase 1 SAD/MAD trial demonstrating a well-tolerated profile and potential best-in-class reductions in hsCRP and other inflammatory biomarkers in participants with obesity and elevated inflammation. Phase 2 cardiovascular risk proof-of-concept data are anticipated in H2 2026, and Phase 1b/2a diabetic macular edema proof-of-concept data are anticipated in mid 2027. The Company is also developing long-acting injectable and oral small molecule APJ agonists for obesity. BioAge’s additional preclinical programs, which leverage insights from the Company’s proprietary discovery platform built on human longevity data, address key pathways involved in metabolic aging. BioAge has been listed on Nasdaq (BIOA) since 2024. For additional information about BioAge, visit the company’s website at .

Our workplace

BioAge offers competitive salary, a comprehensive compensation package, and generous paid time off in addition to company-observed holidays. We provide comprehensive health and wellness benefits (medical, dental, and vision insurance) and a 401(k) retirement savings plan with matching employer contributions, and we support families through childcare and fertility benefits. We also pride ourselves in giving employees many opportunities for career development, including a generous annual budget for continued learning and a dedication to training and skill development. Many positions (including this one) are remote, allowing our team members to work from anywhere. The salary for this role is expected to be approximately $140,000 - $175,000, depending on experience. We are open to the concept that different experience levels add value to the team in different ways, and therefore will consider a variety of experience and offer commensurate pay.

At BioAge, we embrace diversity and differences while we learn from each other, and we believe that every team member has an important role to play. We are an equal opportunity employer. BioAge prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. BioAge conforms to the spirit as well as to the letter of all applicable laws and regulations.

jobs.description:
About BJAK

BJAK was founded on a simple belief: people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. That is where our name comes from.

We started in 2019 by building the region's first mobile-first insurance platform, making insurance accessible online to millions. Today we are Southeast Asia's leading insurance platform, and we are expanding into everything else people do with their money — spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling.

Our teams span more than 20 nationalities across our offices and remotely. We look for people who work for the thing itself rather than the hours, who want to build the next generation of products rather than maintain the current one, and who care about getting great financial tools into everyone's hands rather than a select few.

If that sounds like you, we would like to talk.

The role

You will be BJAK's person on the ground, responsible for getting the business established and growing. That means building partner relationships from scratch, working out how the market operates, and shaping the strategy that sits behind both.

This is a broad role in a new market. Some weeks will be partnership negotiation, others will be regulatory groundwork, operational setup, or working out why something is not converting. We are looking for someone comfortable moving between all of it rather than a specialist in any one part.

What you will do

Partnerships

  • Identify, approach and close partnerships with financial institutions and ecosystem players

  • Own each relationship end to end, from first conversation through negotiation, onboarding, integration and go-live

  • Lead commercial negotiations, with sound judgement on pricing and partnership economics

  • Keep a visible pipeline, with disciplined follow-up and clear reporting

  • Work with legal, product, technology and compliance to get agreements live quickly

Get the market working

  • Establish how we operate locally, including the regulatory requirements that apply to us

  • Work with external counsel and internal compliance on the policies we need in place as we grow

  • Act as a primary point of contact for regulators and manage filings and communications

  • Own monthly revenue, volume and activation targets, and drive partner productivity after go-live

Strategy and operations

  • Set the local strategy — which segments we go after, which partners matter most, where we compete and where we do not

  • Build the operating rhythm behind it, from reporting and planning through to the processes the team runs on

  • Feed what you learn locally into our wider regional and global strategy, and bring the global playbook back into the local market

  • Work with teams across the group, taking what has already worked elsewhere rather than rebuilding from scratch

What we are looking for

  • Fluent Indonesian and English, written and spoken

  • At least five years across technology, financial services or a comparable commercial environment, with real negotiation and partnership experience

  • A generalist who has operated across functions — you have done commercial work, but also picked up operations, regulatory, product or whatever else the situation needed

  • Comfortable moving between strategy and execution, and willing to do both in the same week

  • Evidence of building something from nothing, whether a market, a function or a business line

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and self-directed. We expect initiative rather than instruction, and this role will not suit someone who needs to be nudged or handheld

This is a role that will require UX and technical acumen to deliver high quality agents in a genuinely complex domain, while also up-leveling our core agentic infrastructure and data flywheel.

Submitting a permit means comprehending construction documents, extracting project details, confirming every requirement has been met and often filling in pdf forms. Errors compound across steps and a failed submission adds real cost for our customers as projects slow.

The ideal candidate will mix an exceptional history of product delivery with true experience building AI and Agentic infrastructure from the ground up. You ship quickly, instrument everything, hold a high quality bar, and stay close to the users of what you build.

This role reports directly to our VP of Engineering. We're hiring at Staff or Principal, with the level based on past experience and interview performance.

What You'll Do

  • Own the agent architecture. Design the reasoning loop, planning and decomposition strategy, state and session model, and recovery behavior for long-running tasks.

  • Build the context layer. Retrieval, memory, and context-window management over project documents, jurisdictional requirements, prior submissions, and customer-specific conventions.

  • Design the action surface. Define the tools the assistant can call, the permissions model around them, and the human-in-the-loop checkpoints for actions that are expensive or irreversible.

  • Make evaluation the engine of progress. Stand up offline and online eval harnesses that measure task completion and failure modes. Build the iteration loop that lets the whole team improve agent quality on evidence.

  • Set the bar for the org. Establish the abstractions, SDKs, and review standards other engineers build agentic features on.

  • Stay close to the customer. Sit with permit coordinators and builders, watch the assistant fail in real conditions, and bring that back into the system design.

What We're Looking For

  • You've shipped an assistant or agentic product at meaningful scale

  • Deep, current knowledge of the agentic stack (tool calling and tool design, context engineering, memory, retrieval, orchestration patterns, etc)

  • You’ve built eval harnesses that changed what a team worked on, and you can articulate what makes an eval trustworthy.

  • You are a genuinely strong software engineer, not an AI specialist who needs someone else to make it production-ready. You’ve owned services in production and you write code that other people are glad to inherit.

  • You operate with earned authority. You influence through demonstrated judgment, working code, and clear writing rather than title or mandate.

Adjunct faculty play a vital role in creating engaging learning experiences that prepare students for ethical and effective leadership. Faculty members teach online undergraduate courses, foster meaningful discussion, provide timely feedback, and help students understand how biblical principles influence business decisions, organizational leadership, innovation, and professional success.

What Makes This Program Unique

Moody's Bachelor of Science in Business Administration combines a rigorous business curriculum with a strong biblical and theological foundation. The program also emphasizes emerging business technologies, including generative artificial intelligence, preparing graduates to lead with wisdom, innovation, and integrity in a rapidly changing marketplace.

DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high-performance building systems. With over four decades of expertise, we partner with some of the world’s most influential companies to design and optimize environments that demand precision, scalability, and resilience.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title:Senior Project Manager – Construction Administration

Position Location: Remote

JOB SUMMARY

The Senior Project Manager for Construction Administration is accountable for leading all aspects of a project once the construction phase starts. This person will work as part of the project team and interact closely with the owner, designers, contractors, subcontractors, and other trades on projects in mission critical environments.

This is a unique opportunity as we are looking for someone with a background or experience in MEP design who is ready to transition to leading construction administration teams, project coordination, and management. Candidates with existing design and construction administration experience are also encouraged to apply.

This position will coordinate with the Senior Project Manager for Design and be included in the design phase of work, familiarizing themselves with the project and client specifics including site considerations, project scope, client standards, codes, etc., in order to understand what design decisions were made to build the project documents. Client relations will also be built during the design phase to be a cohesive hand-off for the DLB point-of-contact from design into construction. The Senior Project Manager for Construction Administration will act as the first reviewer of most submittals, RFIs, and issues on site, with support provided by a construction administrator, the design engineers, and the design PM.

The role continues through the project progressing into managing the construction administration and closeout phase of projects including reviewing RFIs and submittals, reviewing change proposals, performing site visits, leading and representing DLB in client meetings, coordinating with internal and external members, and general project overhead tasks.

The Senior Project Manager for Construction Administration will be self-directed on day-to-day work and independently perform most responsibilities. The Senior Project Manager for Construction Administration will communicate and operate in line with organizational and client goals/values and departmental objectives.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Manage all Elements of Routine and Complex Projects (50%)

  • Contribute to the design phase of projects based on experience and lessons learned during construction.
  • Drive project construction administration from completion of the design through construction and closeout phases.
  • Conduct site visits during construction including existing condition surveys and punchlists.
  • Coordinate and issue field reports (photos and documentation) and identify deficiencies or items requiring resolution.
  • Evaluate and review subcontractor proposals and provide recommendations on contract award.
  • Coordinate and liaise between internal design trades, external team members, and contractors on technical and project execution matters.
  • Attend project meetings, including weekly design and OAC meetings, providing updates on documentation, answering questions, and managing open items.
  • Manage the construction administration phase, including RFI responses, submittal and change order reviews, and implementation of contractor redlines/record drawings.
  • Coordinate issuance of bulletins and ASIs with the design team.
  • Provide risk management and conflict resolution.
  • Oversee / perform QA / QC reviews of plans and specifications to ensure alignment with project scope and guidelines.
  • Coordinate resource scheduling, ensuring alignment with project goals.

Manage Stakeholder Relations (20%)

  • Lead preparation of change proposals, presentations and the overall marketing efforts of the firm.
  • Lead the promotion of the firm, service, and expertise to existing or potential clients.
  • Maintain client relationships to ensure an ongoing positive relationship and work with clients to identify and develop new projects.
  • Be the primary contact for clients and build effective, long-term client relationships.
  • Ensure client satisfaction through active communication.

Administrative (20%)

  • Review and distribute site visit reports, meeting notes, punchlists and the like.
  • Accountable for project contract administration timeliness and accuracy.
  • May manage personal and project hours using company tools.
  • Create / complete departmental reports.

Monitor and Coordinate Project Financials (10%)

  • May prepare, forecast and monitor project budgets, profitability, margins, bill rates and utilization and maintain overall accountability for the profitability of the project’s construction administration phase.
  • Communicate with the client and design project manager when additional fees / change orders are required.
  • Identify potential project risks and develop / implement strategies to minimize impact and control deviations from estimated costs and project deadlines during the construction administration phase.
  • May be accountable for development of cost schedules / schedules of value for client progress billing and review / approval of monthly billings.
  • Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Technology, Digital Tools & AI-Enabled Efficiency

  • Identify opportunities and lead the strategic use of technology, digital platforms, and AI-enabled tools to enhance efficiency through workflow automation, reduced manual effort, and improved accuracy in forecasting, documentation, reporting, and quality processes.
  • Support adoption of emerging technologies - including advanced analytics, data visualization tools, and digital construction management platforms - to strengthen readiness, quality assurance, and project controls.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure technology solutions align with DLB standards for data security, privacy, and operational integrity.
  • Promote a culture that embraces innovation, continuous improvement, and the strategic use of technology to optimize performance and scalability.

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

POSITION REQUIREMENTS (ADVANCED LEVEL FOR ALL THE FOLLOWING)

  • Knowledge of MEP / FA / FP trades and the general requirements for each.
  • Knowledge of industry trends, project management and construction procedures and best practices.
  • Knowledge of business and management principles involved in strategic planning, resource allocation, leadership technique, production methods and coordination of people and resources.
  • Knowledge of materials, methods and the tools involved in the construction mission critical, commercial buildings or other structures.
  • Knowledge of the importance of the Method of Procedure (MOP) process and work notifications.
  • Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management.
  • Skilled at using construction management software such as Procore.
  • Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail.
  • Skilled at managing personnel and material resources.
  • Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability to effectively plan and delegate the work of others.
  • Ability to follow company and site safety requirements.
  • Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports and correspondence.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non-technical information).
  • Ability to communicate effectively directly with clients and at times serve as primary point of client contact.
  • Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with moderate supervision.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with onsite and remote team members.
  • Ability to effectively plan and delegate the work of others.
  • Ability to analyze complex information and develop plans to address identified issues.
  • Skilled at producing drawings and visual aids using AutoCAD and / or Revit a plus.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position
  • Frequently moving through office, facility and other environments
  • On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS

  • Travel to project(s) weekly up to 40% per month.
  • Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meeting for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE

  • B.S. degree in mechanical, electrical, architectural, structural, industrial or civil engineering or construction management

PLUS

  • Minimum of eight years of experience in related field
  • Minimum of three years onsite / field experience

Benefits

DLB Associates offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include

  • Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)
  • Flex spending accounts (FSA)
  • Dental and vision plans
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26
  • 401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option
  • PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year
  • Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents
  • Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage
  • Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance
  • Paid parental leave after one year of employment

CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is DLB's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

DLB Associates is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and participates in the E-Verify program with the Department of Homeland Security. We encourage diversity in our workforce.

Are you ready to challenge yourself and redefine standards in the AEC industry? Apply now and join our award-winning team!​

DLB does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to DLB in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where DLB has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of DLB and DLB will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Join a small engineering team at a Series A logistics technology company, building partner-facing integrations and data-heavy distributed systems for temperature-controlled and high-value shipments. Your work will help logistics teams understand shipment conditions, assess risk, and respond to exceptions.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and own end-to-end data flows across partner APIs, webhooks, carriers, sensors, and other vendors.

  • Develop backend services that ingest, normalize, contextualize, and process operational and IoT data.

  • Build systems that support real-time shipment risk analysis, on-time and in-full prediction, and automated exception workflows.

  • Maintain reliable data pipelines through warehousing, monitoring, observability, and on-call support.

  • Work independently as a senior individual contributor, collaborating with a small team to deliver scalable, dependable integrations.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 5 years of backend engineering experience building scalable distributed systems, including 10 or more years building production data pipelines.

  • Hands-on proficiency in Python and TypeScript or Node.js, plus SQL and relational data modeling.

  • Experience with external partner integrations, multi-vendor ingestion, config-driven transformations, and production data flows.

  • Knowledge of IoT data ingestion and contextualization, event-driven architecture, and messaging systems such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.

  • Experience with REST or gRPC APIs, Docker, Kubernetes, and a cloud platform such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.

  • Strong software engineering practices, including testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and observability.

  • Logistics, supply chain, cold-chain, shipment risk, or regulated healthcare data experience is beneficial.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary is $130,000 to $160,000 annually, plus equity and a cash bonus. Visa sponsorship is available.

Location

Remote within the United States.

jobs.title: Senior Risk Analyst
jobs.excerpt: About AlphaSense: The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making.
jobs.description:
About AlphaSense:

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Role

AlphaSense is maturing its security risk management program and needs a Senior Risk Analyst to be a core builder and operator of that function. You will design, implement, and mature a risk framework that spans information security, AI, and operational risk—building toward a program that is quantitative-leaning, connected to live data sources, and actionable at every altitude from service owner to executive leadership. You will establish risk identification and scoring methodologies, own the enterprise risk register, and produce risk intelligence that drives real decisions. You will also support the TPRM function led by a dedicated TPRM lead, contributing to assessments and risk tracking as needed. You approach this with an AI-native mindset: using AI to monitor threat landscapes, analyze risk data, draft risk narratives, and surface emerging risks faster than a traditional manual program could. The goal is a risk function, not a risk register—one that measures outcomes and reduced exposure, not just activity.This is not a role for someone looking to maintain a program that already exists. AlphaSense is building a risk management discipline that we believe can serve as the blueprint for how AI-era companies measure, communicate, and act on risk. Risk management across the industry is still largely qualitative, reactive, and disconnected from the systems that generate real signal. We intend to change that—and we want someone on this team who shares that ambition and wants to be part of building the model that others will eventually follow.

Key Responsibilities

Risk Program Design & Maturation

Design and implement a structured risk management program, including risk taxonomy, scoring methodology, risk appetite statements, and escalation thresholds. Align the program with ISO 27005, NIST RMF, or ISO 31000 as appropriate. This is largely greenfield work—you will help define the architecture and continuously mature the discipline as the company scales.

Risk Register Ownership

Build and maintain the enterprise risk register as a living operational tool, not a compliance artifact. Lead periodic risk identification workshops with business, engineering, and legal stakeholders to surface new and evolving risks. Ensure every risk has a documented owner, risk rating, treatment decision, and remediation timeline—and that the register reflects current reality, not last quarter's snapshot.

AI-Augmented Risk Analysis

Leverage AI tools to monitor threat intelligence, identify patterns across risk data, accelerate risk narrative drafting, and keep the risk register current between formal review cycles. Build AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual risk review burden and surface emerging risks earlier. Apply judgment to validate AI output before it informs a risk decision.

Third-Party & Vendor Risk Support

Support the TPRM function in partnership with the dedicated TPRM lead. Contribute to vendor risk assessments, risk scoring, and finding documentation as needed. Provide risk framework input to ensure third-party risks are consistently rated and tracked in alignment with the broader risk register.

AI & Emerging Technology Risk

Identify and assess AI-related risks including data privacy, model bias, explainability, security misuse, agentic system behavior, and third-party AI dependencies. Support compliance with AI governance frameworks (ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act). Maintain current knowledge of the evolving AI risk landscape and help AlphaSense stay ahead of regulatory and operational risks from AI deployment.

Risk Reporting & Executive Communication

Produce clear, executive-ready risk reports, dashboards, and periodic risk summaries. Translate technical risk findings into business impact language that drives informed decisions at the service owner, leadership, and board levels. Make risk actionable at every altitude—engineers understand their exposure, executives understand portfolio risk.

Cross-Functional Risk Advisory

Provide cross-functional risk and control guidance on process improvements, new technology adoption, post-implementation reviews, and remediation activities. Support stakeholders in interpreting risk requirements and embedding risk management practices into how they build and operate—not as a checkpoint, but as an enabling partner.

What Success Looks Like

  • Security and compliance controls are clearly documented, tested, and consistently implemented—with evidence generated by integrations, not collected by hand
  • Risks and compliance gaps are identified early, tracked with owners, and remediated in partnership with technical teams before auditors find them
  • GRC processes scale alongside platform growth and new customer or regulatory requirements without proportional headcount growth
  • Stakeholders across Engineering, Legal, and Product view the GRC function as a trusted, enabling partner—not a compliance checkpoint
  • AI tools are used deliberately and responsibly: output is validated, sensitive data is protected, and automation creates leverage without introducing new risk
  • The risk register is a live operational tool that reflects current exposure—engineers know their risk posture, executives can explain portfolio risk, and risk scores change when the environment changes
  • Risk reporting is driven by KRIs and live data sources, not manually assembled status updates—leadership has real-time visibility into risk posture

Who You Are

Basic Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in GRC, information security, risk management, or IT audit, preferably in a SaaS or cloud-native environment
  • Strong understanding of security and compliance frameworks including SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF 2.0, and CIS Controls; working knowledge of ISO 42001 and NIST AI RMF
  • AI-native mindset: you use AI tools—LLMs, agents, automation—for real, substantive work including analysis, drafting, evidence gathering, and workflow automation. You apply judgment about where AI creates leverage and where a human must stay in the loop
  • Proficiency with GRC platforms for evidence management and control testing (Drata, Vanta, AuditBoard, ServiceNow GRC, or equivalent)
  • Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and the security and compliance posture tooling that runs on them (CSPM, SIEM, identity platforms)
  • Experience supporting external audits across security or privacy domains, including evidence collection, control walkthroughs, and auditor interaction
  • Ability to interpret technical controls and translate findings into compliance, risk, and policy documentation that engineers and non-technical stakeholders both understand
  • Working knowledge of risk registers, control libraries, and policy governance lifecycles
  • Working knowledge of privacy and data protection requirements (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA) and how they intersect with security controls, in partnership with Legal and Product teams
  • Strong written communication, analytical thinking, and attention to detail; able to produce clear audit responses, risk narratives, and control documentation under deadline
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in information security risk management or a combined GRC/risk role with responsibility for building or significantly maturing a risk register and scoring methodology
  • Demonstrated use of AI or data tools to surface risk insights, analyze trends, draft risk narratives, or automate risk register workflows—with clear judgment about validating AI output before it informs a decision
  • Proven experience maturing an organization's risk program from qualitative to quantitative risk measurement—including introducing scoring models, KRI frameworks, and data-driven risk reporting that changed how leadership makes risk decisions
  • Experience with data warehousing concepts, KRI development and tracking, and risk reporting pipelines that connect live data sources to dashboards and executive reporting
  • Proficiency with GRC platforms for risk tracking, control testing, and evidence management (Drata, Vanta, AuditBoard, ServiceNow GRC, or equivalent)
  • Strong analytical skills: comfort with qualitative and quantitative risk scoring, heat maps, likelihood/impact matrices, and risk appetite articulation
  • Experience producing executive-ready risk reports and translating technical findings into business impact language for non-technical audiences
  • Experience supporting TPRM assessments and contributing to vendor risk documentation in partnership with a dedicated TPRM function

Nice to Have

  • Relevant certifications: CISA, CRISC, CISM, CISSP, CCSK, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer
  • Experience with AI governance frameworks including ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, or OECD AI Principles
  • Exposure to SOX ITGC cycles—managing evidence, walkthroughs, and findings with external auditors
  • Privacy program crossover: data mapping, DPIAs, GDPR/CCPA operational compliance
  • Scripting or automation experience (Python, JavaScript, or low-code tools) applied to GRC or compliance workflows
  • Quantitative risk experience: FAIR-style decomposition, Monte Carlo simulation, or loss exceedance analysis applied to real risk decisions—not just theoretical familiarity
  • Experience with AI risk domains: model risk, algorithmic bias, AI system failure modes, agentic system risks, and governance frameworks including NIST AI RMF or ISO 42001
  • Familiarity with risk aggregation and BI tooling (Tableau, Looker, Power BI) for risk dashboarding and executive reporting
  • Background in financial services regulatory risk environments (SOX, FFIEC, or equivalent).

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @ email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

We are looking for a Sales Trainer to join our Sales Team; as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.


The role

As Sales Trainer, you equip our sales force in your region with the tools, skills and knowledge to sell new and existing products well. You will raise the productivity of new DSRs, make sure newly recruited DSRs convert, and support sales activity across the region. You sit in the Sales department and report to the Regional Sales Training Lead.

About Us

M-KOPA is a pan-African fintech providing asset financing and credit to underserved customers. We have reached 10 million customers and extended $2B+ in credit. 86% of customers report a better quality of life, and 55% are accessing financial services for the first time. Our 2,300+ employees and 35,000+ field agents make it happen, and the Direct Sales Representatives (DSRs) you train are where every customer relationship begins.

This is a hybrid role, you would be working from our offices in Ghana, partnering with a diverse group of employees from our different markets and locations across the UK, Europe and Africa. You will be reporting to the Head of Sales.

What You'll Do

  • Own the conversion of every newly recruited DSR, measured by F7 (at least 1 sale within 7 days of registration), F30 (at least 8 sales within 30 days) and F60 (at least 8 sales in the next calendar month after F30).

  • Deliver regular in-class onboarding per territory each month, plus DSR career training and FSM/SE training as required. Teach proper onboarding and KYC fidelity so Quality of Sales reaches 95%.

  • Build the annual training calendar from needs surveys, assessments and feedback. Define clear outcomes with stakeholders, design training that can be applied the day after, and document your results.

  • Keep DSRs informed during outages such as system downtime, credits not updating or internet issues.

  • Reach at least 80% satisfaction and make sure every team is trained and ready to perform.

What You'll Need

  • At least a bachelor’s degree from a recognised university and at least 18 months as a Sales Trainer.

  • Strong command of Learning Management Systems, excellent presentation and MS PowerPoint skills, and solid business strategy, reporting, coaching and data analysis skills.

  • Self-motivation, a drive for results and a professional approach. You can train effectively in English and a local language, and Twi is an added advantage.

The honest part
This role is accountable. Your DSR conversion numbers are visible, the 95% Quality of Sales and 80% satisfaction targets are real, and outages will ask you to communicate clearly at short notice. If you want your training judged by what your people go on to sell, you’re probably ready for exactly this.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at .

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.
