Can you take a big growth ambition, break it into a clear operating rhythm, and keep a room full of sales, marketing, strategy, and analytics partners moving in the same direction? Do you get energized by helping build something new? If so, this might be the opportunity for you!

Autodesk Flow is our industry cloud for Media & Entertainment, connecting artists, productions, and studios from first frame to final pixel. Two of its fastest growing businesses are Flow Capture, our secure, cloud-based camera-to-cloud dailies and review solution connecting production and post, and Flow Studio, our AI-powered toolset that turns live-action footage into editable CG scenes and helps creators move from idea to final frame faster. Both sit at the center of how content is being made today, and both have a significant opportunity to scale.

To capture that opportunity, the Director of Sales, Flow is standing up two Cross-Functional Growth Teams, one dedicated to Flow Studio and one dedicated to Flow Capture. Each brings together partners from Sales, Marketing, Strategy, and Analytics who share accountability for scaling these businesses. We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to serve as the Sales Director's right hand in building and running these teams. You will help shape the operating model from the ground up, then own the program management that keeps both teams focused, aligned, and delivering.

In this role you will be at the center of it all, working closely with the Director and senior leaders across Go-To-Market, Product, Marketing, Sales, Strategy, and Business Analytics. You will use your analytical mindset and strong program leadership to bring structure, clear accountabilities, and decision ownership to the work, and you will keep stakeholders engaged with regular communication on progress, risks, and wins.   • Translate the Director's growth strategy into executable plans with clear goals, milestones, owners, and measures, and track progress against them

jobs.description:
Company: TurFresh

Reports to: Growth Operations Manager

Type: Full-time

Location: Remote, with working overlap with U.S. Pacific Time business hours

Compensation: to be defined

About TurFresh

TurFresh is a professional artificial turf cleaning and pet odor removal company serving homeowners and businesses in 22 U.S. metro areas, with more than 150,000 jobs completed. Customers find us on Google, on social media and through reviews, and they trust us when they see real work from real technicians.

The role

    You are TurFresh's voice in public. You run our social channels as a community manager: you write the posts, talk with our community, listen to what people say about us and our category, and own our reputation on review sites. Strong writing is at the core of this job.

    TurFresh already has graphic design and creative resources, so this is not a design role. You brief them on what you need, and you can make basic edits yourself when it's faster (crop, resize, change text on a template, trim a clip). You work alongside AI agents that draft calendars, captions and review replies, and your judgment decides what goes live. This is a hands-on seat: you will be in the tools every day.

What you'll do

    1. Own reviews and reputation

    • Respond to every review on Google Business Profile, Yelp and Birdseye within 48 hours, in a voice that sounds human and local. Use approved guidelines and AI-drafted replies that you review and edit.

    • Handle negative reviews and public complaints with care: acknowledge, take the conversation offline and escalate to Customer Service for resolution. A public reply never replaces fixing the customer's problem.

    • Write and maintain our review response guidelines: tone, replies by scenario, what never to say and when to escalate.

    • Work with Customer Service on review generation, so more happy customers leave a review after a job.

    • Track rating, review volume, response rate and recurring themes by location; flag at-risk locations and brand risks early.

    • Profile data, NAP, categories and citations stay with our SEO and Local SEO team.

    1. Build and manage the community

    • Answer comments, DMs and mentions on our channels with a consistent, helpful voice.

    • Monitor conversations about TurFresh, competitors and turf care in local groups, Reddit and review sites, and join them when it helps.

    • Route every sales or service inquiry to our Customer Service team in GoHighLevel and confirm it was received.

    • Send a weekly listening digest: recurring questions, objections, complaints, competitor moves and content ideas.

    1. Write and run the channels

    • Turn the content pillars set by our Content & Campaign Strategist into a weekly channel calendar: formats, series and timing.

    • Write the posts: hooks, captions, story text and calls to action, adapted to each channel's tone.

    • Brief our creative resources on the visuals you need and make basic edits yourself when it's faster.

    • Coordinate field capture with our technicians shot lists, what to film and how to send it.

    • Schedule and publish in GoHighLevel Social Planner (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube); verify every post is live, links work and UTM tags are in place. Fix publishing issues or escalate them with evidence.

    1. Work with AI agents and measure

    • Review and approve agent outputs (calendar drafts, caption variations, reply drafts, weekly reports) and improve prompts, brand voice rules and the prompt library.

    • Report weekly on what was published and what performed, with organic and paid separate, tracked clicks and inquiries handed to Sales.

    • Propose and run copy and format tests, and record what you learn.

What you bring

    • 3+ years managing social media and online communities for a brand or agency, ideally in home services, local services or multi-location businesses.

    • Excellent written English: clear, warm, persuasive copy with a natural tone for U.S. homeowners. This is the most important skill for the role.

    • Proven community management: you have grown engagement and kept a busy inbox of comments and DMs under control.

    • Reputation management experience: responding to reviews at scale on Google Business Profile, Yelp or Birdseye, with sound judgment on negative reviews and public complaints. Multi-location experience is a plus.

    • Social listening experience, using native tools or platforms such as Sprout Social or Brand24.

    • Results you can show with numbers: channels you grew and posts that performed.

    • Basic visual editing (Canva, CapCut or similar) to adjust templates and trim clips. You don't need to be a designer.

    • Comfort using AI as a drafting partner while keeping quality, accuracy and brand judgment your own.

    • Organized and self-directed: you close the loop on your own work and escalate early, with a recommendation.

Nice to have

    • Experience with GoHighLevel

    • Birdseye or another review management platform

    • Experience writing ad copy for Meta

    • UGC and creator-style content

    • experience with pet-owner audiences

What success looks like in the first 90 days

    • Days 1–30: access to every channel and tool confirmed; baseline set for each channel and for rating, review volume and response rate by location; review queue at zero with the 48-hour response time running; first draft of the review response guidelines.

    • Days 31–60: the agreed weekly cadence published on time for four consecutive weeks; review response guidelines approved; first weekly listening digest and reputation report by location delivered; review generation routine agreed with Customer Service.

    • Days 61–90: AI drafting workflow running for calendar, captions and review replies, with your approval on every item; at least two copy or format tests completed with findings; every inquiry from social and reviews handed to Sales with confirmation.

Selection process: written test

    The test is about writing and judgment, not design. Using sample photos, clips and brand templates that we provide, you will:

    1. Write one week of posts for Instagram, Facebook and TikTok (hooks, captions and calls to action), with one line on why each post should work.

    1. Reply to three reviews (5-star, 3-star and a 1-star complaint), to one DM asking for a price and to one public complaint in the comments.

    1. Write a half-page listening read: what people ask about turf cleaning and how we should respond.

    1. Optional: make a basic edit to one of our templates or clips.

    We look at writing quality, judgment on sensitive replies and how you use AI, not at design skills or tool familiarity.

How to apply

    Send your resume, plus:

    • Channels you managed: a portfolio of channels or profiles you manage now or managed before, with the progress you drove and proof of performance (for example follower and engagement growth, reach, leads, review rating or response time).

    • Posts that performed: a portfolio of posts you wrote or built that had high engagement or performance, with the thinking behind each one. We want the posts and your reasoning, not graphic design work.

    • A reputation example: one review, complaint or reputation situation you handled: what happened, what you wrote and the result.

TurFresh shares a recruiting platform with our sister company, Express Chipping. As a result, you may see the Express Chipping name in the application URL or automated communications. This position is exclusively with TurFresh.

jobs.excerpt: ServiceNow Application DeveloperAstreya | Full-Time | ServiceNow Platform Team — ITSM · HAM · SAM About the RoleAstreya is building ServiceNow into the day-to-day operating platform for our service delivery teams (Fulfillers) across IT Service Management (ITSM), Hardware Asset Management (HAM), and Software Asset Management (SAM).
jobs.description:
ServiceNow Application Developer

Astreya | Full-Time | ServiceNow Platform Team — ITSM · HAM · SAM


About the Role

Astreya is building ServiceNow into the day-to-day operating platform for our service delivery teams (Fulfillers) across IT Service Management (ITSM), Hardware Asset Management (HAM), and Software Asset Management (SAM). Our ServiceNow Process Advisors define what belongs on the platform, how processes should work, and the governance guardrails the build must follow. We are hiring a ServiceNow Application Developer to turn those designs into working, supportable platform capability.

This is a hands-on build role. You will take approved process designs — intake structures, catalog items, fulfillment workflows, asset lifecycle processes, CMDB data standards — and implement them on the platform: configuring, scripting, testing, and releasing. You will work day-to-day with the Process Advisor, who acts as the process authority for the program, and you will be expected to build to the agreed design rather than around it — favoring out-of-the-box capability and configuration over customization, and raising a flag when a requested build conflicts with the platform’s guardrails or long-term maintainability.

What You Will Do

  • Build to design: Implement approved process designs across ITSM (Incident Management, Request Fulfillment, Service Catalog items, RITM/SCTASK structures, SLA definitions), HAM (asset lifecycle, stockroom and inventory processes), and SAM (software requests, entitlements, license allocation, reclamation workflows).
  • Platform development: Configure and develop on the platform using Flow Designer, business rules, client scripts, UI policies, script includes, notifications, ACLs, and Service Portal / Employee Center configuration — using JavaScript and Glide APIs where scripting is genuinely required.
  • CMDB and data model: Implement and maintain the agreed CMDB and asset data model: CI classes, Asset–CI relationships, identification and reconciliation rules, and data quality jobs, in line with the data standards set by the Process Advisor.
  • Integrations: Build and maintain integrations with adjacent systems (e.g., procurement, discovery, HR, endpoint management) using IntegrationHub, REST APIs, and import sets / transform maps.
  • Quality and release: Write and maintain Automated Test Framework (ATF) coverage for what you build; follow update set / source control discipline, instance hygiene, and release practices across dev, test, and production.
  • Guardrail discipline: Prefer configuration over customization; document every deviation from out-of-the-box behavior and its rationale. Surface conflicts between requested builds and platform guardrails to the Process Advisor and platform owner before building.
  • Fulfiller experience: Support the teams who live in the platform: tune forms, views, and queues for Fulfiller productivity, fix defects quickly, and turn recurring pain points into small platform improvements.
  • Documentation: Maintain clear technical documentation — configuration records, integration specs, runbooks — so what you build is supportable by others.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–6 years of hands-on ServiceNow development and configuration experience, with at least one substantial implementation or major module rollout delivered end-to-end.
  • Strong working knowledge of ITSM applications (Incident, Request, Service Catalog, SLAs) and practical exposure to HAM and/or SAM modules, CMDB structures, and the Asset vs. CI distinction.
  • Proficiency in JavaScript and ServiceNow Glide APIs (GlideRecord, GlideAjax, GlideSystem), Flow Designer, business rules, client scripts, UI policies, and ACLs.
  • Experience building integrations via REST/SOAP, IntegrationHub, and import sets / transform maps.
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification.
  • Disciplined delivery habits: update set / source control hygiene, testing before release, and documentation as part of done — not an afterthought.
  • Ability to work from written process designs and governance standards, ask sharp clarifying questions, and communicate clearly with non-technical process owners.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) in ITSM, HAM, or SAM; CAD (Certified Application Developer) is a plus.
  • Experience with Automated Test Framework (ATF), Performance Analytics, or Service Portal / Employee Center customization.
  • Exposure to Discovery, asset integrations (procurement, endpoint management), or software license management tooling.
  • ITIL 4 Foundation certification, or equivalent grounding in ITIL-aligned processes.
  • Experience in managed services or IT services environments where SLA performance directly drives client outcomes.

How This Role Fits

  • You will work alongside a senior ServiceNow Process Advisor (consulting) who owns process design and scoping decisions — what goes into ServiceNow and what stays out. You own the build.
  • You report into Astreya’s ServiceNow platform / program leadership and work daily with operations, service delivery, and asset management stakeholders.
  • Over time, you will become the go-to platform builder for the Fulfiller organization as ServiceNow becomes their primary day-to-day toolset.

Astreya is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, , H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

As a Staff Product Designer, you'll shape the future of Imprint's member experiences, leading complex product initiatives from discovery through execution. You'll combine exceptional design craft with strategic thinking and strong product judgment to identify opportunities, simplify complex problems, and deliver intuitive, high-impact solutions. Partnering closely with Product and Engineering, you'll influence product direction, champion exceptional user experiences, and raise the bar for design craft, collaboration, and decision-making across the organization.

What You’ll Do

Shape Product Strategy & Direction

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to identify high-impact opportunities grounded in customer needs, business goals, and product insights.

  • Proactively define problems, challenge assumptions, and influence product priorities and direction.

  • Lead complex, ambiguous initiatives from early discovery through launch and iteration.

  • Balance near-term product improvements with longer-term opportunities to meaningfully improve the customer experience.

  • Bring clarity and structure to ambiguous problems, helping teams make thoughtful decisions and move forward.

Lead End-to-End Product Design

  • Own the design process from discovery and concept exploration through detailed interaction design, prototyping, and delivery.

  • Translate complex financial products and workflows into simple, intuitive, and engaging experiences.

  • Explore multiple approaches, establish clear design principles, and articulate the rationale behind decisions.

  • Create thoughtful, high-quality experiences that balance usability, accessibility, business objectives, and technical feasibility.

  • Partner with Engineering throughout implementation to ensure the quality and integrity of the shipped experience.

  • Use research, data, and customer feedback to validate solutions and continuously improve the product.

Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Build strong, trusted partnerships with Product Managers and Engineers, operating as an equal partner in shaping product outcomes.

  • Facilitate collaborative problem-solving, bringing teams together around shared goals and thoughtful solutions.

  • Navigate competing priorities and constraints, making pragmatic tradeoffs without losing sight of the customer experience.

  • Communicate design decisions clearly and persuasively, building alignment across stakeholders and leadership.

  • Take shared ownership of product outcomes, not just design deliverables.

Elevate Design Quality & Team Impact

  • Set a high bar for UX craft, interaction design, and the overall quality of our product experiences.

  • Contribute to a culture of thoughtful critique, continuous learning, and collaborative problem-solving.

  • Mentor and support other designers and teammates, helping strengthen their craft, judgment, and strategic thinking.

  • Identify opportunities and propose solutions to improve design practices, workflows, and collaboration across the organization.

  • Contribute to the evolution and adoption of our design system, balancing consistency with opportunities for innovation.

Explore the Future of Product Design

  • Embrace emerging AI tools and workflows to accelerate discovery, exploration, prototyping, and execution.

  • Experiment with new ways of working that increase design velocity without compromising quality.

  • Help shape how Design collaborates with Product and Engineering as AI transforms the product development process.

  • Bring curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to challenge traditional approaches to designing and building software.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 7+ years of product design experience, with a track record of leading complex, high-impact initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration.

  • Exceptional UX and interaction design skills, demonstrated through strong craft, thoughtful problem-solving, and measurable outcomes.

  • Strong product judgment, connecting customer needs with business goals and balancing near-term improvements with long-term vision.

  • Proven experience independently identifying opportunities, framing problems, exploring compelling solutions, and influencing product direction.

  • Strong partnership with Product and Engineering to navigate ambiguity, evaluate tradeoffs, and prioritize solutions based on impact and effort.

  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, articulating design rationale, building alignment, and influencing stakeholders at all levels.

  • A pragmatic, iterative approach to design, balancing speed and quality, incorporating feedback, and thoughtfully phasing solutions to deliver value over time.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing complex financial products, consumer fintech experiences, or regulated workflows.

  • Experience working in fast-moving, high-growth startup environments.

  • Experience evolving and scaling design systems, identifying opportunities to improve patterns, strengthen consistency, and contribute to a more cohesive product experience.

  • Familiarity with experimentation, product analytics, and research-driven design.

  • Experience using AI-assisted design, prototyping, or development tools.

  • Familiarity with frontend technologies and modern design-to-development workflows.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12 months:

  • You've led meaningful product initiatives from problem definition through launch, delivering measurable customer and business impact.

  • You've built trusted partnerships with Product, Engineering, Commercial, and other stakeholders, helping shape priorities and improve product decisions.

  • You've introduced thoughtful, innovative and intuitive solutions to complex customer problems while maintaining a high bar for usability and craft.

  • You've helped the team move faster and make better decisions through clear design rationale, effective collaboration, and pragmatic execution.

  • You've elevated the quality of design across the team through mentorship, critique, and shared practices, and contribution to our design system.

  • You've helped evolve how we design and build products, embracing new tools and approaches that increase our effectiveness.

We don't expect every candidate to check every box. If this role excites you and you bring strong fundamentals, we encourage you to apply.

Stack

Figma, Storybook, design tokens. Frontend component libraries (React/TypeScript). AI-assisted design and development tooling.

Learn More

Learn more about how we build at Imprint on our engineering blog:

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Leading configured work computers of your choice

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage

  • Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the option to enroll in an FSA

  • 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents

  • Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.

jobs.excerpt: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility About UsWe are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies.
jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of iOS development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior iOS App Developer with an excellent background in native iOS development using Swift and SwiftUI, together with practical experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into iOS applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our iOS application, integrate shared application logic, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development.

Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build mobile applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our native iOS application using Swift and SwiftUI.
  • Integrate Kotlin Multiplatform modules into the iOS application and collaborate on shared business logic.
  • Implement platform-specific functionality while maintaining consistent behavior across iOS and Android.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical iOS challenges such as permissions, application lifecycle, background execution, battery consumption, and device compatibility.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and investigate issues that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and clear explanations.
  • Support application signing, release preparation, and distribution through TestFlight and the App Store.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production iOS applications.
  • Excellent practical knowledge of Swift, SwiftUI, and the iOS development ecosystem.
  • Practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and its integration into native iOS applications.
  • Solid understanding of application architecture, asynchronous programming, lifecycle management, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills across application code, shared modules, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain technical decisions.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, geofencing, and sensor data.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and proximity detection.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Interoperability between Swift and Kotlin Multiplatform, including asynchronous operations and error handling.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful iOS development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing and releasing iOS applications.
  • Your experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into native iOS projects.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, App Store references, or GitHub links are welcome where available.

The Bedded Insurance Authorization Specialist is responsible for performing initial and concurrent insurance authorization securement, clinical submission and denial prevention for all patients admitted to the hospital for clients. They are responsible for performing these functions while meeting the mission and goals of Ensemble Health Partners and all regulatory compliance requirements. The Bedded Insurance Authorization Specialist will work within the policies and processes as they are being performed across the entire organization.


- Confirm that a patient’s health insurance(s) is active and covers the patient’s procedure; may be completed multiple times during, and after a patient’s visit/stay.


- Confirm what benefits of a patient’s upcoming visit/stay are covered by the patient’s insurance(s) including exact coverage, effective date of the policy, coverage limitations / requirements, and patient liabilities for the type of service(s) provided.


- Check benefits to determine deductible, coinsurance, and copayment amounts due. If applicable; use procedure estimate process/program to notify the patient in advance of the amount due.


- Ensure payer requirements including the following are met:

  • Verify and document insurance eligibility; confirm and document benefits.
  • Review and submission of clinical documentation to ensure the treatment/services are appropriate for the diagnosis as determined.
  • Obtain and verify that insurance authorizations are obtained and maintained on designated patients.
  • Ensure that initial and all subsequent authorizations are obtained in a timely manner.
  • Work to reduce and eliminate authorization denials.

- Review and analyze patient visit information to determine whether authorization is needed and understand payor specific criteria to appropriate secure authorization and provide clinical to support medical necessity.


- Ensure that services provided to eligible members are within benefit plan and appropriate contracted providers are being utilized.


- Responsible for reviewing visit data to ensure appropriate and accurate information is provided to the payor to support the authorization request and follow-up timely. Among the expectations of this role, the Specialist will achieve: >95% accuracy/quality and productivity.

jobs.title: Customer Growth Specialist
jobs.excerpt: What we're doing at UscreenUscreen is the video monetization platform for businesses building recurring revenue from video content.
jobs.description:
What we're doing at Uscreen

Uscreen is the video monetization platform for businesses building recurring revenue from video content. Our customers replace a patchwork stack of separate hosting, community, courses, email, and app vendors with one branded experience across web, mobile, and TV.

The platform is only half of it. We believe growth requires behavior, not just software. Customers don't stall because a feature is missing. They stall because they priced wrong, never built an email list, or launched an offer nobody wanted. Coaching is how we fix that, and it's part of the product rather than an add-on.

The job

You own a segment.

We have a cohort of smaller video businesses where retention is not where it should be. Nobody owns it today. You will. That means the revenue that stays in that segment, and the revenue that grows inside it, is yours. Your lemonade stand, your numbers, your call on how to run it.

This is a coaching role measured in dollars. You'll be accountable for gross revenue retention in your cohort first, and expansion second. Not tickets closed, not calls booked.

It's also a one-to-many job. Your cohort is larger than a 1:1 book, so the work is designing coaching that scales: cohort programs, group sessions, office hours, triggered outreach when the data says a business is drifting. You'll build that motion rather than inherit it.

What you'll do

  • Own gross revenue retention and expansion for an assigned segment of customers
  • Find the pattern in why businesses in your cohort stall, and build coaching that addresses it at scale rather than one conversation at a time
  • Run group coaching sessions, cohort programs, and asynchronous coaching inside Membership+
  • Coach customers through the decisions that move revenue: pricing, packaging, positioning, offer design, email and funnel strategy, retention mechanics
  • Read your own data. Spot the accounts drifting before they churn, and know which interventions actually worked
  • Build the playbooks and session formats that make this repeatable. You're the first person in this seat, and what you build becomes how we scale it
  • Bring what you learn back to Product and Success. You'll be closer to this segment than anyone at the company.

Who we're looking for

Someone who has grown something online and can explain how. Maybe you ran marketing for a small business, coached founders, built your own audience, or worked inside a membership or subscription business. What matters is that you can sit with an operator, see the real constraint, and say the honest thing.

  • 3 to 5 years in coaching, consulting, customer success, or digital marketing, with real ownership of an outcome
  • Comfortable advising solo operators and small teams on how to grow
  • Strong live facilitation: group sessions, workshops, webinars, 1:1 calls
  • Can read a dashboard and form a point of view on retention curves, cohort behavior, and funnel conversion
  • Working fluency with AI tools for research, prep, and synthesis. Our team uses Claude daily to prep sessions, analyze customer data, and build coaching assets. You don't need to be technical, but you should reach for these tools rather than around them.
  • Motivated by being paid on results. A third of this package is variable and there's no ceiling on it.
  • Clear, simple communication. Complex idea in, plain sentence out.

Bonus points if you:

  • Have been a creator, coach, or small business owner yourself
  • Have worked with video businesses, online educators, or subscription and membership businesses
  • Know the surrounding stack: Kit/ConvertKit, YouTube, Kajabi, Circle, Squarespace, Meta and IG
  • Have built a scaled or one-to-many customer program before

What's hard about this job

We'd rather you know now.

  • You'll own a number you can't fully control. Some customers won't take the advice and will churn anyway. You have to be able to own influence over an outcome rather than the outcome itself.
  • It's a lagging metric. Retention moves slowly. Your first two quarters are guaranteed at target because of this, but you'll be doing the work for months before the number reflects it.
  • The motion doesn't exist yet. Playbooks exist for our 1:1 coaching. The scaled version for this segment is an open question you'll help answer. If you need a finished playbook on day one, this will frustrate you.
  • You'll deliver honest assessments to people emotionally invested in what they've built. That takes a specific kind of nerve.

What we offer

  • 100% remote first company
  • Flexible PTO + 8 company holidays
  • Remote, global team
  • Paid parental leave
  • Medical, dental, and vision (US Based)
  • Technology and home office stipend
  • Coworking space stipend
  • Annual learning stipend

Note: Benefits may vary depending on location and local regulations. Final eligibility and coverage details will be shared during the hiring process.

jobs.description:
We're building software that helps cloud partners and operators understand why AI workloads fail and keep GPU clusters ready for work. You'll bring deep experience in GPU cluster operations to help automate investigations across hardware and software. Working with engineering and operations teams, you'll turn those findings into product priorities. We're hiring a Technical Product Manager to own AI infrastructure resilience platform capabilities and developer experience, including GPU node health contracts and interfaces, workload failure attribution, and the open-source software that operators and cloud partners build on. You will own the roadmap and work directly with the engineering and operations communities that deploy and extend this software. This role contributes to NVIDIA's open, modular infrastructure software for designing, operating, and optimizing AI factories at scale.

We encourage technical product managers, architects, site reliability engineers, and infrastructure engineers who understand the management of GPU clusters and want to help operators solve these problems to apply.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery priorities for AI infrastructure resilience, partnering with engineering on architecture and execution.
  • Work with customers and partners to identify gaps in GPU cluster operations and define platform capabilities that address them. Help operators assess node readiness and distinguish hardware failures from application failures, while shaping which signals are available through public interfaces or extensions that require additional access.
  • Work directly with cloud partners and cluster operators to translate their operational requirements into platform capabilities.
  • Lead community engagement for open-source platform projects, including contribution models, ecosystem partnerships, and developer adoption.

What we need to see:

  • 12+ years of experience across product management, solutions architecture, software engineering, or site reliability engineering on technical infrastructure products. Technical depth in GPU or AI infrastructure is required.
  • Knowledge of GPU failure modes: XID codes, ECC correctable and uncorrectable errors, DCGM metrics, NVLink and PCIe health signals.
  • Understanding of why AI workloads fail and GPU nodes become unavailable for scheduling. This includes distributed training failures (NCCL timeouts and framework errors), distinguishing hardware from application faults, scheduler health and drain behavior, and interpreting signals from DCGM, sysfs, and dmesg.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with senior technical customers and translate operational requirements into product decisions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Hands-on experience as a site reliability or infrastructure engineer supporting GPU clusters. You have triaged workload failures, interpreted XID logs, and worked across teams to investigate failed training runs spanning thousands of GPUs.
  • Deep familiarity with GPU scheduling, topology-aware placement, or multi-tenant GPU cluster management: Slurm prolog/epilog, Kueue, or Kubernetes-native scheduler environments.
  • Experience building products that produce structured diagnostics or attribution output: health verdict schemas, log analysis pipelines, rules-engine systems, or observability APIs at data center scale.

About xCures

The best of medicine should belong to everyone. Nobody dreams of becoming good at being a patient. We have people to love, things we want to do, and plans we hope to keep. Illness already asks enough of us.

It puts trusted information in the hands of the people who need it, when they need it, and uses that knowledge to take on more of the administrative work around care. Every extracted data point traces back to the exact document and page it came from.

Our ambition is to empower doctors to make better decisions, enable researchers to develop better treatments faster, and help healthcare organizations serve more people with fewer errors and lower costs. Job Description

About GAM Tech

GAM Tech is a security-first Managed Service Provider (MSP) supporting small and mid-sized businesses across Canada. We are SOC2 certified and a Certified B Corporation, with our largest team at our Calgary HQ and people in several other provinces. Our mission is to create fun, success, and innovation for our people and customers. We live by our core values of Teamwork, Care, Communication, Accountability, and Positive Attitude to ensure our clients receive the best possible IT support and business solutions.

Position Overview

We're looking for an enthusiastic L1 Support Hero to join our Service Delivery team as the first line of defense for IT support. As a key member of our front-line team, you will handle incoming support requests, troubleshoot user issues, and escalate more complex problems to the L2 team when necessary. You are the first voice our clients hear when something is broken, and the person who decides how quickly it gets fixed.

Clear communication and ownership of every ticket you touch are essential for success in this role.

Your goal: deliver fast, friendly, and effective technical support that leaves our customers feeling cared for and confident in our service.

Key Responsibilities

Front-Line Service Desk

  • Serve as the first point of contact for clients via phone, email, or ticketing system, ensuring all requests are logged accurately.
  • Triage and prioritize incoming tickets against our service level agreements, escalating urgent issues without delay.
  • Maintain excellent customer communication, ensuring users are informed of progress and resolution status.
  • Escalate unresolved incidents to the L2 Support Team with clear documentation and a full history of what you have already tried.

Technical Troubleshooting

  • Troubleshoot and resolve common technical issues related to hardware, software, networks, and cloud services.
  • Support Microsoft 365, Windows, macOS, Entra ID and Active Directory, printing, and end-user connectivity.
  • Complete user onboarding and offboarding requests, account changes, and permission updates accurately and on time.
  • Follow established troubleshooting workflows and company best practices.

Security & Compliance

  • Handle client data and credentials in line with our SOC2 controls and internal security policies.
  • Respond to security alerts and suspicious activity by following documented procedures and escalating promptly to the security team.
  • Support multi-factor authentication, endpoint protection, and patching tasks across managed client environments.

Documentation & Continuous Improvement

  • Document all interactions, steps, and resolutions in HaloPSA with attention to detail.
  • Assist in maintaining and improving the knowledge base and internal documentation.
  • Flag recurring issues and manual tasks that should be fixed at the root or automated.
  • Collaborate closely with other IT support teams to ensure smooth service delivery.
  • Stay current with new technologies, IT tools, and industry best practices to continually improve service quality.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 1+ years of experience in IT support, help desk, or a customer service role within a technical environment.
  • Basic understanding of Windows, macOS, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, and networking fundamentals.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills; you work a problem methodically rather than guessing.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills; you explain technical issues in plain language and keep people updated without being asked.
  • Strong personal organization and follow-through; you manage a queue of competing tickets without letting anything go quiet.
  • Fluency in English is required; French is considered an important asset.
  • Experience using HaloPSA, N-able, or similar RMM/ITSM tools is an asset.
  • Certifications such as CompTIA A+, ITIL, or Microsoft 365 fundamentals are an asset but not required.
  • A passion for technology and learning; eager to grow and advance within the team.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.
  • A defined technical growth path from L1 to L2 and beyond, with mentorship from senior technicians.
  • Exposure to a modern, security-first stack across a wide range of client environments; you will learn faster here than in a single internal IT department.
  • A collaborative work environment with a supportive and friendly team.
  • Fun, inclusive workplace culture focused on teamwork and continuous improvement.

Our Hiring Process

  1. Apply online.
  2. Complete a short personality and aptitude assessment to help ensure you're a great fit for our awesome team.
  3. Show off your personality in a short video interview.
  4. Meet your future manager for a technical and behavioural conversation.
  5. Final chat with our Service Delivery leadership to make sure we're the right fit for each other.
  6. Start your dream job at GAM Tech!

Additional Information

We value a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you require accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know and we'll ensure reasonable arrangements are made.

We appreciate all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

No phone calls or website inquiries, please.

Kong is looking for a Director, Performance Marketing to lead and scale our global performance marketing engine.

This role will own Performance Marketing strategy, budget, investment allocation, forecasting, and paid acquisition outcomes across channels, audiences, and regions. You'll be accountable for translating investment into qualified demand, pipeline, and measurable return, continuously determining where to scale, optimize, reallocate, or pull back investment.

This is a hands-on leadership role. We're looking for someone who can set strategy and own the numbers while staying close to the channels, data, and execution. You'll lead agency partners, work closely across Marketing, Sales, Finance, and RevOps, and regularly translate performance into clear recommendations for senior leadership.

Position Title: Sr. Fire Safety Engineer

Department: Engineering (Primary) but will support other departments

Entity: CS e-Storage
Reports To: Director of Project Engineering, EMEA

Location: Remote -UK based but covers EMEA region

Position Summary:

The Senior Fire Safety Engineer will play a critical role in ensuring the safety, compliance, and performance of our utility-scale and commercial energy storage systems (ESS) deployed throughout the EMEA region. As part of the Energy Storage Solution Management team, this individual will support product design, track evolving fire safety regulations and standards, and provide project-level technical support across multiple phases of ESS deployment.

 

The role requires deep familiarity with UL 9540, 9540A, NFPA 855, BS and IEC standards, and other applicable fire detection and protection standards, along with strong collaboration and documentation skills. The ideal candidate brings a background in fire protection or mechanical engineering, with experience in system-level safety design, regulatory engagement, and large-scale fire testing.

 

Responsibilities

 

Product Design Support

 

  • Provide fire safety guidance during the design and development of BESS enclosures and integrated energy storage solutions for global markets.
  • Evaluate system layouts, battery configurations, fire detection and alarming, ventilation strategies from a safety perspective.
  • Participate in product design reviews and collaborate with product and solution managers to ensure safety considerations are embedded early.
  • Interpret and review third-party fire testing reports and modelling data to recommend design or process improvements.
  • Support fire safety validation through internal and third-party test campaigns, including UL 9540A and IEC 62933-based evaluations.
  • Support system integration testing activities related to fire safety systems

 

Regulatory Tracking, Continuous Improvement, and Documentation

 

  • Monitor updates in fire safety codes and standards (e.g., NFPA 855, UL 9540A, BS/IEC) relevant to energy storage products and technology across global markets.
  • Maintain and update internal fire safety guidelines, technical notes, and design templates based on evolving standards and field experience.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives related to safety documentation, including emergency response plans, fire protection strategies, and permitting support packages.
  • Consolidate feedback from test results, project experience, and internal reviews into actionable improvements for future product iterations.
  • Lead the review or drafting of fire safety documents, including safety manuals and safety training materials.

 

Project Engineering Fire Safety Support

 

  • Provide project-specific technical support on fire safety requirements, including code interpretations, layout reviews, and compliance documentation.
  • Assist in preparing technical documentation for customer due diligence and local planning authority (LPA) submissions, specific to the technology and project design. Includes: Emergency Response Plan (ERP), Hazard Mitigation Analysis (HMA), Heat Flux Analysis (HFA), Fire Risk Assessments (FRA), Dangerous Substances Explosive Atmosphere Regulations (DSEAR).
  • Experience of modelling software such as FDS would be a bonus.
  • Experienced in reviewing fire detection and alarm system designs.
  • Support project engineers in interpreting fire test data and applying protection strategies at the project level.
  • Coordinate with third-party testing labs, consultants, and regulatory bodies to meet project compliance goals.
  • Review project drawings and documentation for compliance with eStorage product design and requirements
  • Review contractual agreements for conformance with our equipment solution
  • Lead resolution of Customer, Insurer, Owners Engineer and Local Planning Authority inquiries related to fire protection and safety strategy implementation.
  • Focused on UK and EU markets
  • Comfortable dealing with Fire and Rescue Service, including site familiarisation visits and training.

 

Qualifications and Experience:

  • Fire Engineering (or related: Mechanical, Building Services, Structural with fire modules)
  • IFireE / MFireE membership with the Institution of Fire Engineers (IFE)
  • Chartered Engineer (CEng) or working toward it
  • Thirdparty accreditation in fire risk assessment (e.g., FRAP, IFSM)
  • Minimum 3 years of fire safety engineering experience, preferably in the energy storage, battery systems, or industrial power sector.
  • Deep understanding of fire protection codes and standards including UL 9540A, NFPA 855, NFPA 68/69, BS7671, BS 5839, BS 9999, BS 7974, BS 5306, PD 7974 series & BS/IEC standards.
  • Experience planning, managing, and reviewing large-scale fire testing programs and interpreting test results and modelling data.
  • Familiarity with ESS hardware development, BESS enclosure designs, fire safety system integration, and emergency response planning.
  • Strong technical communication skills, with experience preparing test reports, compliance packages and local planning authority documentation.
  • Knowledge of industry fire alarm systems and manufacturers, including networking design
  • Ability to collaborate across global teams including product development, compliance, engineering, and external consultants.
  • Flexibility to travel and coordinate across global time zones as needed.

 

Personal Qualifications:

 

  • Comfortable in a collaborative and fluid environment. 
  • An excellent time manager, able to balance multiple projects and prioritize a wide variety of issues, initiatives and objectives concurrently.
  • Good technical writing skills
  • Exceptional ability to simplify and report complicated scenarios to the management team, with outstanding judgment and decision-making abilities. 
  • Solid and effective interpersonal and communication skills (including oral, written and visual)
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships internally and externally with staff, management, clients, suppliers, community partners and external stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated sound judgment and the ability to be decisive in crisis situations.
  • Strong organizational skills with excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Knowledge of BESS product validation, system integration, and testing methodologies.
  • Flexibility to travel up to 10%, including international travel as required , for vendor assessments, testing, and industry events.

jobs.description:
Windows Server Architect

Overview

The Windows Server Architect leads the design and technical direction for migrating a federal client's Windows Server estate, hosted in a FedRAMP-authorized AWS GovCloud environment, from Windows Server 2016 to Windows Server 2019 or 2025 ahead of end of support. As the Windows subject matter expert, the role owns the upgrade architecture end to end, from discovery through hardening, testing, and rollback, and guides DevSecOps, Security, and Test team members to deliver compliant, low-risk upgrades for mission-critical systems.

Key Functions

  • Lead discovery of in-scope servers, cataloging roles, services, installed software, and dependencies.
  • Design the upgrade approach for each server (in-place vs. rebuild), including AMI selection, EC2 sizing, and a phased, wave-based sequence with go/no-go checkpoints between waves.
  • Define and validate OS hardening baselines (e.g., DISA STIGs, CIS Benchmarks, Active Directory Domain) and remediate outstanding security findings.
  • Design secure administrative access, including RDP/jump server configuration and CyberArk privileged access integration.
  • Plan certificate management and renewal, including certificate chain validation.
  • Design Windows IIS-dependent workloads, such as Power BI Gateway servers.
  • Partner with DevSecOps Engineers to automate Windows build standards and correct configuration drift.
  • Partner with the Test Manager on each wave's test strategy, success criteria, and rollback procedures, and maintain the project Risk Register.
  • Produce architecture artifacts (Implementation Blueprint, design documents, runbooks) in Confluence and Jira, ensuring alignment with the client's Technical Reference Model and audit, vulnerability requirements.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree and 7 years of relevant experience.
  • An additional 2 years of experience (9 years total) with an Associate’s Degree in lieu of a Bachelor’s Degree.
  • An additional 4 years of experience (11 years total) with a High School Diploma in lieu of a Bachelor’s Degree.
  • Demonstrated experience leading Windows Server 2016 to 2019 or 2025 migrations in AWS (GovCloud experience preferred), including upgrade planning, testing, and rollback.
  • Hands-on Windows Server OS hardening experience using federal and industry baselines.
  • Experience integrating Windows servers with CyberArk for privileged access management.
  • Deep Windows Server expertise (Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, PKI, patching, Remote Desktop Service) and strong PowerShell skills.
  • Working knowledge of AWS services for Windows workloads (EC2, AMIs, VPC, Systems Manager, EBS snapshots).
  • Experience with windows configuration management using Ansible (WMI, WinRM, PowerShell)
  • Strong technical leadership and communication skills, with the ability to direct engineers and lead discussions with federal stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications or Skills

  • Microsoft Windows Server certification: Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate, or the legacy MCSE: Core Infrastructure; equivalent hands-on experience may be considered.
  • AWS certification (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional).
  • Experience with AWS Systems Manager (Automated system patching)
  • Experience in managing software deployments through group policy.
  • Experience with Microsoft Power BI, including Power BI Gateway administration.
  • Experience configuring and hardening Windows IIS servers1.
  • Experience supporting federal government systems with audit and vulnerability management.

Position Details

  • Employment type: Full-Time, W2
  • Location: 100% Remote (US-based)
  • Hours: 40 hours/week with availability during core business hours of 8am-5pm ET
  • Eligibility: Must be eligible to obtain a Public Trust clearance

BEWERBUNG ÜBER DIE "MITMACHEN"-FUNKTION AUF UNSERER WEBSITE

krisenchat ist innerhalb kürzester Zeit zum größten Online-Beratungsangebot Deutschlands für junge Menschen in Not geworden. Wir sind eine agile Non-Profit-Organisation und bieten Kindern und Jugendlichen rund um die Uhr niedrigschwellige, effektive und wirksame psychosoziale Ersthilfe per Chat an. Seit Mai 2020 konnten die 300+ Krisenberater:innen schon in über 80.000 Krisensituationen helfen. Dabei erfolgt die Krisenberatung komplett remote und ist zeitlich flexibel einteilbar.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgabe wird in der Beratung von Kindern, Jugendlichen und jungen Erwachsenen liegen. Dabei treten häufig Themen, wie Ängste, Einsamkeit, depressive Symptomatiken oder Probleme in der Schule und Familie auf.

Jede Chatschicht geht über einen Zeitraum von 2,5 Stunden, die du dir zu einer freien Zeit deiner Wahl eintragen kannst. Da wir ein 24/7 Angebot sind, kannst du deine Zeit sehr flexibel über den Tag einteilen. Wir wünschen uns mind. 5 Stunden ehrenamtliche Tätigkeit im Monat. Über den genauen Ablauf wirst du in unserem Onboarding (Einführungsprogramm) informiert.

Du brauchst keine Sorgen zu haben, es wird immer ein:e Ansprechpartner:in da sein und in den Chatschichten achten wir darauf, dass ihr nicht alleine seid! Es gibt auch die Möglichkeit sich jederzeit mit einem unserer Team-Mitglieder auszutauschen.

Qualifikation

Um unsere Qualität in der Beratung nachhaltig zu sichern, können bei uns Personen mit einem akademischen Abschluss in den folgenden Fächern beraten:

  • Abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium Psychologie oder Bachelorstudent:in mit Zusatzqualifikation oder intensiver Beratungserfahrung (keine Pflichtpraktika)
  • Psychotherapeut:innen in Ausbildung oder abgeschlossen in den nach den Psychotherapierichtlinien anerkannten Verfahren
  • Ärzt:innen mit Zusatzqualifikation Psychotherapie
  • Lehrer:innen und Pädagog:innen mit zusätzlichen psychosozialen Beratungserfahrungen
  • Sozialarbeiter:innen und Sozialpädagog:innen mit staatlicher Anerkennung
  • Nach individueller Prüfung auch andere, ähnliche Hintergründe mit sehr intensiver psychosozialer Beratungserfahrung

Für die Beratung benötigen alle Krisenberater:innen einen PC. Unsere Beratungstätigkeit erfolgt ausschließlich digital und unter Zuhilfenahme weiterer digitaler Werkzeuge. Grundlegende Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Computern werden vorausgesetzt.

Das Beraten von einem Mobilgerät (z.B. Tablet oder Handy) ist grundsätzlich nicht möglich. Kenntnisse der deutschen Sprache (in Schriftform) auf C2 Niveau werden zusätzlich benötigt. Der persönliche Kontakt ist für uns entscheidend - alle Interessent:innen lernen wir zunächst persönlich in einem Video-Call kennen. Das Vorlegen eines erweiterten polizeilichen Führungszeugnisses ist Pflicht.

Benefits

Dein Ehrenamt bei krisenchat ist eine Gelegenheit, Erfahrungen in einem innovativen digitalen Beratungsfeld zu sammeln. Durch die Niedrigschwelligkeit wirst du mit einem breiten Spektrum an Themen und Krisen konfrontiert. So wird dir ermöglicht, deine Kenntnisse im Bereich der Krisenintervention auszubauen. Du wirst eng mit einer sehr engagierten und diversen Community zusammenarbeiten und von den unterschiedlichen Erfahrungen und dem Austausch miteinander profitieren.

Zudem bieten wir kostenfreie Supervisionen in kleinen Gruppen und regelmäßig stattfindende Feedbackgespräche an.

Da uns die Aus- und Weiterbildung unserer Krisenberater:innen sehr am Herzen liegt, bieten wir neben unserem ausführlichen E-Learning-Programm die Teilnahme an diversen Workshops, Fachsprechstunden sowie Vorträgen externer Expert:innen zu unterschiedlichen Fachthemen an. Darüber hinaus hast du bei zahlreichen nicht-fachlichen, analogen und digitalen Austauschformate die Möglichkeit, deine Kolleg:innen kennenzulernen.

In this field-based position, the Director, Field Reimbursement, reports to Senior Director, Field Reimbursement and leads related work within the Rare Blood Disorders Patient Support Services group.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi

We're an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. jobs.excerpt: About Keyfactor Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI.
jobs.description:
About Keyfactor

Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. Keyfactor is the leader in trust infrastructure for AI and machines, helping the world's largest enterprises and government agencies take control of the cryptographic identities that safeguard every digital interaction. Behind the platform is a global team of people who care deeply about the work and each other. We move fast, think big, and show up for one another every day. If you're looking for work that matters and a team that brings out your best, we hope you'll trust your future with Keyfactor!

Title: Enterprise Sales Account Executive, Federal (formal title is Sales Director, Federal)

Location: United States, Washington DC Metro Area (Remote)

Experience: Senior Level

Job Function: Sales

Employment Type: Full-time

Industry: Computer and Network Security 

About the position

Keyfactor is seeking a Federal Sales Director to lead and grow our public sector business across U.S. federal civilian, defense, and intelligence agencies. In this role, you will own the federal go-to-market strategy for Keyfactor digital trust solutions, in your assigned territory.

You will work as part of a high-performing federal sales team, develop strategic relationships with agency stakeholders, system integrators, and channel partners, and navigate the federal procurement landscape, including contract vehicles, compliance requirements, and long-cycle opportunities. You will be accountable for pipeline development, forecasting, and revenue attainment, and will work closely with Marketing, Product, Solutions Engineering, and Legal to position Keyfactor as a trusted partner in the federal market.

The ideal candidate brings a proven record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder federal deals, deep familiarity with how agencies buy, and credibility with technical and executive audiences. Experience in cybersecurity, identity, or cryptography is strongly preferred.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Responsibilities

• Understands and contributes to contract negotiations.
• Delivers reliable forecasts and accurate reporting for the territory.
• Collaborates with marketing to build out the go-to-market (GTM) strategy.
• Manages pipeline over long sales cycles.
• Develops new accounts while maintaining and sustaining successful long-term relationships with key decision-makers up to and including the C-level.
• Contributes to the development of product, market, and competitor knowledge.

• Participates in events and tradeshows.

• Maintains a commitment to the company’s sales processes, values, and target visions.

Minimum Qualifications, Education, and Skills

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Technology, or equivalent experience.
• Strong understanding of IT security, PKI, and certificate lifecycle management.
• In-depth knowledge of market dynamics and competitor strategies.
• Familiarity with regulatory requirements in the IT Security industry.
• Experience with and knowledge of MEDDPICC, Solution Selling, and SPIN Selling.
• Ability to develop and execute strategic direction aligned with company goals.
• Proficient in using advanced sales tools and technologies.
• Ability to identify and develop opportunities for future business growth, including strategically important partnerships and key customers.
• Ability to coach others and share knowledge, insights, and skills with the broader team.
• Ability to influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

Compensation

Salary will be commensurate with experience. 

Culture, Career Opportunities and Benefits

We build teams that continually strive to get better than the day before. You will be challenged daily and given opportunities to grow personally and professionally. We balance autonomy and structure to create an entrepreneurial environment to spur creativity and new ideas. 

Here are just some of the initiatives that make our culture special:  

  • Second Fridays (a company-wide day off on the second Friday of every month minus November and December due to the Holiday schedule). Please note that this benefit is subject to change.
  • Comprehensive benefit coverage globally.
  • Paid Parental Leave is available to new parents. Structure varies based on regional/government requirements. In regions where government-paid leave doesn’t exist, like in the U.S., the company offers generous paid parental leave, along with comprehensive adoption and fertility support.
  • Competitive time off globally.
  • Dedicated employee-focused ambassadors via Key Contributors & Culture Committees.
  • DIVERSE Commitment, a call to action for a more inclusive and diverse future in business, society, and technology.
  • The Keyfactor Alliance Program to support DEIB efforts.
  • Wellbeing resources, wellness allowance, mindfulness app free membership, Wellness Wednesdays.
  • Global Volunteer Day, company non-profit matching, and 3 volunteer days off.
  • Monthly Talent development and Cross Functional meetings to support professional development.
  • Regular All Hands meetings – followed by group gatherings.

Our Core Values

Our core values are extremely important to how we run our business and what we look for in every team member:  

Trust is paramount.  

We deliver security software and solutions where trust and openness are of the highest importance for our customers. We are honest and a trusted partner in every aspect of business.  

Customers are core.  

We strategize, operate, and execute through a customer-centric view. We prioritize the security interests of our customers, and we act as if their data were our own.  

Innovation never stops, it only accelerates.  

The speed of change is accelerating. We are committed, through investment and focus, to stay ahead of the innovation curve.  

We deliver with agility.   

We thrive in high-paced and continually changing environments. We navigate through newly added variables, adjust accordingly, while driving towards our strategic goals.  

United by respect.   

Respect for all is what unites us. We promote diversity, inclusivity, equity, and acting with empathy and openness, both in our business and in our communities.  

Teams make “it” happen.  

Vision and goals are not individually achievable – they require teamwork. We pride ourselves in operating as a cohesive team, creating promoters and partners, and winning as one.  

Keyfactor is a proud equal opportunity employer including but not limited to veterans and individuals with disabilities. 

REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION: Applicants with disabilities may contact a member of Keyfactor’s People team via and/or telephone at 1.216.785.2990 to request and arrange for accommodations at any time.
