jobs.excerpt: Title: Director, Field Sales - Industrial Group (Fluke Test & Measurement) Location:Americas (Remote) Role SummaryThe Director, Field Sales Industrial Group is responsible for the commercial performance of Fluke's industrial field sales organization across the United States.
jobs.description:
Title: Director, Field Sales - Industrial Group (Fluke Test & Measurement)

Location:Americas (Remote)

Role Summary

The Director, Field Sales Industrial Group is responsible for the commercial performance of Fluke's industrial field sales organization across the United States. The role leads five District Sales Managers and, through them, the frontline territory sales team, with accountability for bookings, point-of-sale growth, funnel creation and conversion, market-share expansion, and customer retention across the industrial portfolio.

This is a role that balances tactical and strategic work. It sets the field operating rhythm- forecasting, funnel discipline, territory design, performance management while shaping where the organization places its coverage as industrial demand shifts toward data centers, electrification and distributed energy, grid and utility infrastructure, and advanced manufacturing. The Director is expected to be in market with local teams, close to customers and channel partners, and equally comfortable in a quarterly business review and on a plant floor.

The role spans the full industrial commercial value chain: end-user maintenance and reliability organizations, plant and facility engineering teams, electrical and mechanical contractors, industrial and electrical distribution partners, national accounts, OEMs and system integrators, utilities, and early-in-career and workforce training institutions. A working understanding of electrical test and measurement, thermal imaging, power quality, and condition monitoring workflows — and of how distributors and contractors actually buy — is essential.

Fluke has been an anchor business within Fortive for many years and materially influences segment profitability. It offers the opportunity to shape commercial strategy, develop future leaders, and influence growth across one of Fluke’s most important customer segments. This role carries real career upside: it is a proving ground for Vice President and General Manager succession within Fluke and across Fortive operating companies.

How We Sell - Our Commercial Beliefs

These beliefs shape how this role leads, coaches, and measures the field organization. The Director is expected to embody them personally and to build them into district operating rhythm, coaching conversations, and performance expectations.

  • We accelerate innovation through customer centricity:When we listen deeply to customers and understand their toughest challenges, we uncover opportunities to develop solutions that make a real difference.
  • We accelerate commercial execution through trust:Trust underpins all customer relationships, and we earn that credibility through every interaction, every day – even, and especially, before a customer makes a purchase.
  • We delight our existing customers by continuously creating value:Some of our greatest opportunities come from continuing to innovate and create value for the customers who already trust us. Our goal isn’t to close a single deal; it’s to help our users succeed in the long term.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership & Team Performance

  • Lead all aspects of field sales activity across the U.S. , creating a culture of accountability, execution excellence, and consistent delivery against customer and business commitments.
  • Manage, coach, and develop five District Sales Managers by creating an environment of trust, ownership, accountability, and continuous development that enables leaders and sellers to perform at their highest potential.
  • Empower District Sales Manager to make customer-focused business decisions, remove barriers to execution, and drive accountability within their teams.
  • Foster curiosity and a willingness to challenge assumptions, learn from setbacks, and continuously improve individual and organizational performance.
  • Mentor, evaluate, and appraise individual and district performance with a constant performance-improvement focus, applying Situational Leadership and structured coaching models.
  • Measure performance through a defined set of critical metrics, diagnose gaps, take ownership for organizational outcomes and install countermeasures that address root causes rather than symptoms.
  • Promote employee engagement through open communication, connecting individual performance to the commercial strategy, and to Fluke's broader vision.
  • Model in-market leadership by remaining close to customers, frontline sellers, and channel partners, actively listening to feedback and using those insights to improve decisions and organizational effectiveness.
  • Foster a culture of continuous learning, curiosity, and openness to feedback where successes are celebrated and lessons learned are openly shared.

Commercial Strategy & Market Expansion

  • Contribute to the development and execution of the Americas industrial commercial field strategy, translating it into district-level plans, coverage models, and quotas.
  • Shape territory design, coverage, and resource allocation to follow demand while proactively anticipating market shifts, building organizational capability ahead of emerging opportunities, and leading teams through change with clarity and confidence.
  • Identify underpenetrated segments, geographies, and product categories, and direct the organization's effort toward the highest-return growth opportunities.
  • Partner with Business Development, specialist, and key account resources to convert vertical strategies into territory-level execution and multi-site expansion.
  • Analyze competitive activity, pricing dynamics, and displacement risk, and develop field responses that protect installed base and win share.

Funnel Management & Operating Rigor

  • Elevate sales efficiency and drive consistent, repeatable sales processes across all districts while simultaneously growing customer point-of-sale and funnel.
  • Own forecast accuracy and pipeline integrity while fostering disciplined operating mechanisms that enable predictable execution and business performance.
  • Encourage experimentation with new selling approaches, growth initiatives, and customer engagement strategies that improve commercial effectiveness and customer outcomes.
  • Establish and run a disciplined cadence of funnel and pipeline success reviews, with particular focus on large and very large opportunities, hedging strategies, and conversion velocity.
  • Drive demand-generation follow-through, ensuring marketing-generated and event-generated leads are worked to a measurable conversion standard alongside seller-generated pipeline.
  • Use data to manage win rates by category, funnel additions and closed-won trends, coverage ratios, backlog conversion, and lead-time or delivery risk that could affect bookings.

Customer, Channel & Key Account Engagement

  • Establish and manage relationships with key customers and executive stakeholders, facilitating the team's efforts to identify, expand, and close opportunities.
  • Participate in and lead Key Account Reviews and other operational and business reviews, engaging cross-functional stakeholders as appropriate.
  • Strengthen joint execution with electrical and industrial distribution partners — including national and regional distributors — through joint planning, joint selling motions, workshops, and lunch-and-learn programs that expand end-user reach.
  • Champion the customer experience end to end, escalating and resolving barriers to growth such as lead-time visibility, service and calibration responsiveness, order support, and credit or commercial friction.
  • Influence specifications, standards, and approved-vendor decisions at large end users, contractors, and utilities so that Fluke solutions are specified in industrial workflows.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Marketing and Product Management to define industrial customer personas and workflows, and translate field insight into messaging, positioning, and campaign priorities.
  • Deliver structured voice-of-customer to Product Management, Marketing, and commercial leadership to identify emerging customer needs, improve solutions, and drive innovation priorities.
  • Break down organizational barriers and create alignment across commercial, marketing, product and operations teams to improve execution and customer outcomes.
  • Work with Sales Enablement to build segment- and product-specific training for sellers, distributors, and contractor-facing teams, and to raise NPI adoption in the field.
  • Collaborate with Service, Operations, and Customer Support to improve fulfillment, calibration capacity, and post-sale responsiveness where these constrain commercial performance.
  • Coordinate with Channel, National Account, and other Fluke business unit teams to pursue enterprise and cross-portfolio opportunities.

Talent, Culture & Organizational Development

  • Recruit, retain, and cultivate top sales talent; build and maintain a credible succession bench for District Sales Manager and other leadership roles.
  • Develop leadership bench strength by creating meaningful growth opportunities, expanding leadership capability across the organization, and producing future leaders prepared for broader responsibility across Fluke and Fortive.
  • Build engagement and cohesion across a geographically distributed, largely remote sales team.
  • Reinforce a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and safety- and integrity-first customer engagement.

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of progressive sales and sales leadership experience in a dynamic, matrixed organization, including experience leading second-line managers.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead organizations through periods of growth, change, and ambiguity while maintaining engagement, accountability, and performance.
  • Demonstrated success creating highly engaged teams through empowerment, coaching, and talent development.
  • Demonstrated ability to build collaborative relationships across functions and incorporate diverse perspectives into decision-making.
  • Proven track record of consistently driving bookings and revenue growth, customer expansion, and market-share gain through the leadership of a distributed field sales organization.
  • Demonstrated success in change management and cross-functional collaboration in a commercially complex environment.
  • Experience owning forecast accuracy, funnel management, and CRM discipline at an organizational level rather than individual level.
  • Experience leveraging customer insights and market trends to influence commercial strategy, solution development, or go-to-market innovation.
  • Experience selling through and with distribution channel partners and building joint go-to-market motions with distributors and contractor networks.
  • Strong executive presence and polish, with the potential and appetite for succession into Vice President or General Manager roles within Fluke and Fortive.
  • Consistent record of building engagement across a virtual sales team while recruiting, retaining, and developing top sales talent.
  • Excellent analytical skills and a validated eye for business, with the ability to balance the needs of the marketplace against sound business judgment.
  • Strong leadership and sales competence paired with a hands-on, 'get it done' mentality that is a hallmark of successful leaders at Fortive.
  • Ability to operate effectively in both highly structured processes and ambiguous, build-it-from-scratch situations.
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% across North America.
  • Bachelor's degree required.

Preferred Experience & Skills:

  • Direct experience in test and measurement, electrical or industrial equipment, industrial maintenance and reliability, or adjacent technical industries.
  • Familiarity with industrial customer workflows including electrical troubleshooting, preventive and predictive maintenance, power quality analysis, thermal imaging, and condition monitoring.
  • Experience leading sales into growth verticals such as data centers, distributed energy and EV charging, utilities and power generation, or advanced manufacturing.
  • Experience with national and regional electrical or industrial distribution partners, and with national account structures.
  • Track record of influencing standards, specifications, or approved vendor lists within large end users, contractors, or utilities.
  • Experience improving sales productivity through process design, tooling, analytics, or commercial operating systems.
  • Experience building or scaling business development, specialist, or vertical-focused selling resources within a field organization.
  • Exposure to workforce development, technical education, or early-in-career channel programs as a demand-creation lever.
  • Experience operating within a continuous-improvement or business-system-driven environment.
  • Master of Business Administration (MBA)or advanced degree preferred.

Fortive Corporation Overview

Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.

At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.

At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.

At Fortive, we believe in growth. We're honest about what's working and what isn't, and we never stop improving and innovating.

jobs.description:
This role is part of our Central Marketing Team at saas.group.

What is saas.group?

Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 400 colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.

Also, don't forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company.

Profile Overview

At saas.group paid acquisition across our portfolio runs through a small network of experienced PPC freelancers. We're looking for a German-speaking Performance Marketing Lead to oversee this: someone who owns the standards, strategy and quality bar for paid across our portfolio, from accounts ranging from small to large monthly budgets. The role goes beyond people-management, with continued hands-on responsibilities. You'll set the systems and direction and lead the freelancer network, but you'll also be in the accounts yourself on the most valuable brands, and you'll be the person we trust to judge whether the work being done is actually good. If you want real ownership of a function where your work impacts 25+ brands, this is that role.

Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:

  • Take ownership of our most valuable paid accounts and demonstrably move performance, while keeping smaller-budget accounts efficient.
  • Set a consistent standard across all brand accounts: how campaigns are structured, how conversions are tracked, how performance is reported, so there's a consistent quality bar across the whole portfolio.
  • Take over the paid accounts of a newly acquired brand cleanly: audit, tracking check and handover with no performance dip.

Your responsibilities

  • Own paid performance strategy and standards across the portfolio, and run the most valuable accounts hands-on yourself (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn, and others), including ad copy and landing page testing.
  • Lead and support our PPC freelancers: set targets, review accounts, approve budgets, run regular syncs, challenge the "why" behind decisions, and keep the rest of marketing in the loop.
  • Advise brands directly on strategy and budget allocation, with the ability to push back, manage expectations and tell a brand honestly when a channel or budget won't deliver.
  • Take over newly acquired brands' paid setups and build the systems, documentation and reporting that let performance scale across more brands and freelancers without losing the quality bar.
  • Partner closely with our data analytics team on tracking, attribution and the flow of CRM data back into the ad platforms, and support the M&A team on due diligence for paid-heavy acquisition targets.
  • Regularly connect with the SEO Team Lead to remain aligned with campaigns and strategies.

What you bring to the table

  • Several years owning paid budgets (think €1M+ a year) while staying genuinely hands-on: you can open an account, diagnose it and run the full campaign yourself.
  • Demonstrated B2B lead-gen experience on search: comfortable with low conversion volumes, long sales cycles and optimising for lead quality over click counts (B2B SaaS, B2B or adjacent backgrounds such as gaming portfolios are welcome, as long as you can translate them to B2B).
  • A track record across very different budget sizes, from a few thousand a month to six figures a month, making small budgets work through sharp targeting and prioritisation rather than leaning on automated bidding.
  • Deep Google Ads and Microsoft Ads expertise, strong LinkedIn Ads experience, and the curiosity to pick up new platforms as brands need them. You're also confident with the measurement stack behind paid: GA4, Google Tag Manager, offline conversion imports and CRM integration. Experience with ChatGPT ads is a bonus.
  • German at C1 or native: strong enough to write compelling German ad copy, alongside fluent English.
  • Genuine AI fluency, and the drive to put it to work. You already use AI tools (Claude especially) in your day-to-day, and you're the kind of person who looks for where they can sharpen paid performance, from research and analysis to campaign and reporting workflows.

What's in it for you

  • Ultimate flexibility: We're 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like.
  • Freedom and autonomy: We're a high-trust team, and you'll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way - with plenty of help from the team when you need it.
  • Minimum bureaucracy: We don't like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable.
  • Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.
  • Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally.
  • Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.

We don't just simply offer you to "take a job with us" but rather to "join us on this journey" to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.

Sounds like something you're up for? Feel free to apply even if you don't check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!

jobs.title: Security Analyst, NHI (Non-Human Identity)
jobs.excerpt: GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk.
jobs.description:
GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

General Description

We are looking for a skilled Security Analyst, NHI to support the discovery, governance, and security of non-human identities — service accounts, application and machine identities, workload identities, secrets, tokens, and certificates — across enterprise, cloud, and DevOps environments. This role will engage in the development of NHI discovery and inventory, risk scoring and prioritization, and lifecycle and remediation programs while providing "Wow Them" service to clients and/or internal customers or co-workers.

The Security Analyst, NHI will be required to demonstrate strong identity security, cloud security, and secrets management skills, lead by influence, and strong business/financial acumen to drive the use of progressive non-human identity security and Zero Trust programs that will align the delivery business objectives and priorities.

About the Non-Human Identity (NHI) Security Practice

The Non-Human Identity (NHI) Security practice is responsible for securing the rapidly growing population of machine and workload identities that power modern enterprise, cloud, and automation environments. We discover, classify, govern, monitor, and remediate non-human identities and their credentials across the organization.

Our team of NHI security analysts, identity architects, and consultants focuses on service and application accounts, workload and machine identities, API identities, secrets, tokens, certificates, and cloud-native credentials — applying Zero Trust, least privilege, and secrets management principles with modern NHI platforms such as Oasis Security, Clutch Security, and Entro. We partner with application owners, DevOps, cloud engineering, infrastructure, and security teams to reduce credential sprawl, eliminate excessive privilege, and deliver measurable, lasting identity security outcomes.

  • Establishing enterprise-wide NHI discovery, inventory, ownership, and lifecycle governance across cloud, on-premises, SaaS, and DevOps environments.
  • Reducing non-human identity risk through risk scoring, remediation of orphaned, stale, and over-privileged identities, and secrets protection.
  • Integrating NHI security with IAM, PAM, CIEM, CSPM, SIEM, and DevSecOps platforms to secure machine-to-machine and emerging AI agent identities.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a senior subject matter expert for Non-Human Identity (NHI) security, including service accounts, application identities, machine identities, workload identities, API identities, secrets, tokens, certificates, and other machine-to-machine credentials.
  • Develop and implement NHI discovery, inventory, classification, ownership, lifecycle management, and governance processes across enterprise environments.
  • Conduct assessments to identify unknown, orphaned, excessive, over-privileged, stale, and high-risk non-human identities.
  • Define and implement NHI security controls aligned with Zero Trust, least privilege, identity security, and secrets management principles.
  • Leverage modern NHI security platforms, preferably Oasis Security, Clutch Security, and Entro, to discover, analyze, monitor, and remediate non-human identities.
  • Develop NHI risk scoring and prioritization models based on privileges, exposure, usage, ownership, credential type, business criticality, and potential blast radius.
  • Analyze NHI relationships and dependencies across applications, infrastructure, cloud environments, APIs, databases, DevOps pipelines, and third-party platforms.
  • Identify and remediate credential sprawl, hardcoded secrets, excessive privileges, unused credentials, unmanaged identities, and insecure authentication mechanisms.
  • Establish NHI ownership and accountability by working with application owners, development teams, infrastructure teams, DevOps, cloud engineering, and security teams.
  • Develop and maintain NHI lifecycle processes covering creation, onboarding, authentication, authorization, rotation, monitoring, certification, suspension, and retirement.
  • Integrate NHI security capabilities with enterprise IAM, PAM, CIEM, CSPM, SIEM, ITSM, secrets management, and DevSecOps platforms.
  • Analyze authentication and activity data to identify anomalous or suspicious behavior involving non-human identities.
  • Support implementation of least privilege and just-in-time access for workloads, applications, APIs, and machine identities.
  • Develop automation to improve NHI discovery, remediation, credential rotation, ownership assignment, and policy enforcement.
  • Define and maintain NHI security standards, procedures, control requirements, and operating processes.
  • Conduct periodic NHI reviews and support access certification, audit, compliance, and risk assessments.
  • Develop dashboards and metrics to track NHI security posture, including inventory coverage, ownership, risk, privilege levels, credential age, remediation status, and policy compliance.
  • Collaborate with PAM and IAM teams to establish clear boundaries and integration between human identity, privileged identity, and non-human identity management.
  • Support NHI strategy, architecture, proof-of-concepts, technology evaluations, and implementation initiatives.
  • Stay current on emerging NHI threats, attack techniques, industry standards, and technologies related to machine identities, workload identities, secrets, APIs, and AI agents.
  • Mentor junior analysts and contribute to the development of NHI security playbooks, standards, and reusable analytical processes.

Required Experience and Education:

  • 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, IAM, PAM, cloud security, application security, or a related security discipline.
  • 2+ years of experience working with non-human identities, service accounts, application identities, machine identities, workload identities, or secrets management.
  • Strong understanding of the Non-Human Identity security lifecycle, including discovery, classification, ownership, risk assessment, governance, monitoring, remediation, and retirement.
  • Strong understanding of different NHI types, including:
    • Service and application accounts
    • Workload and machine identities
    • API identities and API keys
    • Service principals
    • Access tokens and OAuth credentials
    • SSH keys
    • Certificates
    • Secrets and credentials
    • CI/CD identities
    • Cloud workload identities
    • Containers and Kubernetes identities

About Wealth Enhancement


Wealth Enhancement is an independent wealth management firm with an endless passion for enriching the lives of our clients. We proudly provide unique financial plans and investment management services to over 90,000 households from our over 175 offices - and growing - nationwide.


Since 1997, Wealth Enhancement has tirelessly raised the standard of wealth management with specialized knowledge and more attentive service that helps every client craft their future. For more information, please visit .


The Senior User Interface Designer – Platform Development is the primary owner and subject-matter expert for Wealth Enhancement's Design System. This senior individual contributor defines and maintains the system's standards, component architecture, design tokens, governance, and documentation so it remains consistent, scalable, accessible, developer usable, and understandable by approved AI-assisted tools.


The designer also creates polished interfaces for new screens, workflows, and features across enterprise products. The role partners with user experience, product, engineering, architecture, and business teams at defined points in the service delivery process, carries design intent through implementation validation, and enables teams to apply established patterns independently.


This is a fully remote position.


In the spirit of pay transparency, we are excited to share the base salary range for this position is $110,000.00 to $120,000.00, exclusive of bonuses and benefits. The role is also eligible to participate in the corporate bonus plan. We encourage you to apply and provide us with your compensation expectations when you do. We're big on open conversations, so, let's have one.


Primary Job Functions


Design System Ownership and Governance

  • Own and evolve the enterprise Design System, including libraries, components, variables, patterns, and documentation
  • Prioritize the design-system roadmap using product needs, adoption data, accessibility risks, and implementation gaps
  • Define token architecture, naming, metadata, usage guidance, and front-end alignment
  • Govern contributions, releases, deprecation, migration, and adoption, audit for duplication, inconsistency, accessibility, and reuse

UI Design and Prototyping

  • Design responsive screens, workflows, and complete interface states using approved patterns
  • Translate user, business, and workflow needs into clear, efficient interfaces
  • Create high-fidelity designs and prototypes aligned with approved Design Systems

Implementation Quality

  • Partner across cross-functional teams to translate Design System specifications into implemented experiences
  • Review implementation for fidelity, responsive behavior, system use, and accessibility; document material defects in Jira and confirm resolution
  • Serve as the design authority during validation and user acceptance activities, using recurring gaps to improve the system

Accessible and Inclusive Design

  • Apply current accessibility standards and inclusive design practices to components and interfaces
  • Document and validate contrast, hierarchy, focus, keyboard interaction, responsive behavior, and content structure

AI Ready Design Standards

  • Structure components, tokens, metadata, and guidance for reliable use by people and approved AI tools
  • Direct AI-assisted work toward approved patterns and reusable components through clear guardrails
  • Evaluate AI-assisted outputs for quality, accessibility, brand alignment, and system compliance

Service Delivery and Collaboration

  • Collaborate across cross-functional teams to deliver consistent, high-quality experiences
  • Engage at defined Service Delivery Framework checkpoints and provide specifications, assets, acceptance guidance, rationale, and tradeoffs suited to the work's complexity and risk
  • Manage priorities and documentation in Jira and Confluence; use experience-quality measures to guide improvements and coach partners to apply standards independently

Improve Service Quality by Using AI and Digital Tools

  • Use approved AI and digital tools to simplify work, improve service quality, and increase efficiency, while validating outputs for accuracy, privacy, and business alignment
  • Identify and escalate inaccurate information and knowledge gaps, or issues related to digital tools

Education/Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a design-related field or equivalent professional experience required (as demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, or education)
  • Five or more years of professional UI, UX, product, interaction, or visual design experience, including significant responsibility for building, governing, or evolving a Design System
  • Portfolio demonstrates strong visual craft, systems thinking, responsive design, accessible interface solutions, and reusable systems work
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, including libraries, components, variants, properties, variables, modes, and prototyping
  • Strong understanding of design-token architecture, responsive behavior, complete interface states, and accessible interaction patterns
  • Working knowledge of front-end component architecture and the relationship between design standards and coded components - coding is not required
  • Clear written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to explain complex design decisions, tradeoffs, and implementation guidance to technical and nontechnical partners
  • Ability to manage priorities independently and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams
  • Proficient at using AI and digital tools, creating and maintaining knowledge content, and driving improvements based on data and feedback
  • Experience with enterprise software, financial services, or another regulated industry preferred
  • Experience designing for platforms such as Salesforce, Workday, Drupal, or comparable enterprise systems preferred
  • Familiarity with coded component libraries, design-to-code workflows, and design-system adoption or health metrics preferred
  • Experience using or governing AI-assisted design and development workflows preferred
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud or complementary visual design tools preferred

jobs.excerpt: À propos de nous:Apertera est à la tête de l’évolution des solutions linguistiques pour les contenus à enjeux élevés.
jobs.description:
À propos de nous:

Apertera est à la tête de l’évolution des solutions linguistiques pour les contenus à enjeux élevés. Nous collaborons avec les entreprises en tant que prolongement de leurs équipes, en alliant une expertise professionnelle et une IA adaptative qui est continuellement affinée par le contenu du client.

Résumé du poste:

Vous êtes avocat(e) et passionné(e) par la précision des mots autant que par la rigueur du droit? Vous souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement où l’excellence linguistique rencontre l’expertise réglementaire et l’innovation technologique?

Ce rôle stratégique vous place au cœur de la qualité juridique et linguistique d’Apertera. Vous y assurerez la traduction et la révision de documents complexes en droit, tout en jouant un rôle clé dans la formation continue et la montée en expertise de nos équipes linguistiques.

Votre mission: garantir une exactitude irréprochable, transmettre votre savoir et contribuer activement à l’évolution des pratiques linguistiques soutenues par l’intelligence artificielle.


Fonctions et responsabilités:

Traduction et révision:

  • Traduire et réviser de l’anglais vers le français des documents complexes liés au droit des affaires et à la finance réglementée.
  • Assurer l’exactitude terminologique, la conformité aux cadres légaux et la fidélité au système juridique de chaque langue.
  • Garantir la cohérence entre les textes sources et textes cibles lors de la révision.
  • Signer à titre d’avocate des avis juridiques attestant la conformité et la précision des documents.
  • Assurer un suivi rigoureux des demandes incluant la gestion proactive des questions et rétroactions clients.
  • Maintenir et enrichir les bases terminologiques et guides stylistiques propres à chaque client.
  • Contribuer à l’amélioration continue de la plateforme de traduction neuronale Apertera IA.
  • Fournir des rétroactions constructives et soutenir le développement des membres de l’équipe.

Formation et développement de l’expertise:

  • Recueillir et analyser les besoins de formation en collaboration avec les gestionnaires linguistiques ainsi qu’avec la directrice des ressources.
  • Développer des programmes et des supports pédagogiques linguistiques et techniques, incluant l’utilisation des outils et de la plateforme Apertera IA.
  • Animer les formations auprès des équipes internes et externes.
  • Assurer la qualité, l’efficacité et la pertinence des formations afin de renforcer les compétences et la professionnalisation des experts linguistiques.
  • Élaborer des plans d’amélioration continue favorisant l’excellence linguistique.

Qualifications:

  • Diplôme universitaire en droit.
  • Diplôme universitaire en traduction anglais-français, avec spécialisation en finance, économie ou en droit.
  • Membre actif du Barreau du Québec ou du Barreau de l’Ontario.
  • Membre d’un ordre professionnel reconnu, par exemple l’OTTIAQ, l’ATIO ou équivalent dans la combinaison de langues anglais-français.
  • Excellentes connaissances des secteurs juridique et financier.
  • Maîtrise des outils de TAO (notamment Phrase) et intérêt marqué pour l’IA appliquée à la traduction.
  • Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.
  • Capacité démontrée à former et à s’adapter à différents styles d’apprentissage.

Expérience:

  • Minimum 7 ans d’expérience en traduction et révision de documents liés en droit.
  • Minimum 3 ans d’expérience en formation et développement de compétences auprès d’équipes linguistiques.
  • Expérience dans un cabinet de traduction ou au sein d’un service linguistique interne.

Aptitudes et compétences:

  • Maîtrise approfondie de la terminologie en droit et finance.
  • Respect rigoureux des consignes et préférences clients.
  • Bonne connaissance des outils de TAO (ex. : Phrase) et intérêt marqué pour l’IA appliquée à la traduction.
  • Excellentes compétences pédagogiques et capacité de transmission claire du savoir.
  • Esprit analytique, adaptabilité et sens des priorités.
  • Rigueur, souci du détail, organisation et respect des échéances.
  • Autonomie, initiative et capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément.
  • Curiosité envers les avancées technologiques en services linguistiques.
  • Esprit d’équipe développé.

Ce que nous offrons:

  • Un rôle hautement spécialisé à l’intersection du droit, de la finance et de la linguistique.
  • Une contribution directe à l’innovation en traduction assistée par l’intelligence artificielle.
  • Un environnement où votre expertise juridique et linguistique a un impact concret et reconnu.
  • L’occasion de former, influencer et faire évoluer une communauté d’experts linguistiques de haut niveau.

Bookkeeper – Xero, Account Reconciliation & Financial Reporting | Private Aviation | Remote

Industry: Private Aviation / Charter Services
Department: Accounting & Financial Operations

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients, a growing private aviation company, is hiring an experienced Bookkeeper to manage financial records, account reconciliations, vendor payments, and operational reporting.

The company provides on-demand private charter flights and personalized travel experiences for high-net-worth individuals, executives, and entrepreneurs. Its operations involve coordinating aircraft, operators, catering, ground transportation, and other services across multiple destinations worldwide.

This is a hands-on accounting role requiring strong experience with Xero, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, international payments, and financial reconciliation.

You’ll be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, reconciling 10+ accounts, tracking payments to international vendors and operators, and helping leadership understand the profitability of individual flights.

Beyond day-to-day bookkeeping, you’ll have the opportunity to improve accounting processes through better reporting, dashboards, templates, and automation.

What You’ll Own

Bookkeeping & Account Reconciliation

  • Perform monthly and quarterly reconciliations across 10+ bank, credit card, HubSpot, and accounting accounts.
  • Maintain accurate financial records using Xero.
  • Review, categorize, and reconcile business expenses.
  • Manage consistent expense coding and chart-of-accounts classifications.
  • Identify duplicate payments, missing transactions, unusual charges, and discrepancies.
  • Reconcile bank statements and corporate card transactions.
  • Maintain supporting documentation for financial transactions.
  • Ensure accounting records remain organized, accurate, and ready for reporting.

Accounts Payable, Receivable & Vendor Payments

  • Track vendor and customer payments, outstanding balances, and payment statuses.
  • Coordinate domestic and international vendor payments.
  • Process and monitor foreign-currency transactions through platforms such as Convera GlobalPay.
  • Maintain accurate payment records and supporting documentation.
  • Coordinate with international operators, vendors, and internal teams to resolve payment discrepancies.
  • Monitor recurring expenses and vendor costs.
  • Identify changes in fixed expenses, including increases, decreases, and discontinued services.
  • Respond promptly to urgent payment issues affecting active trips.

HubSpot & Booking Management

  • Maintain accurate booking and payment information within HubSpot CRM.
  • Update deal stages as bookings progress from quotation through completion.
  • Track booking details, including:
    • Trip dates and routing
    • Aircraft and operators
    • Booking prices
    • Invoice status
    • Payment status
  • Reconcile HubSpot deal information against Xero financial records.
  • Ensure booking, sales, and accounting records remain aligned.
  • Investigate discrepancies between recorded revenue and booking information.

Trip Profitability & Financial Reporting

  • Track gross and net profit margins for individual flights and trips.
  • Monitor expenses associated with:
    • Aircraft charter services
    • Catering
    • Ground transportation
    • Operators and vendors
    • Additional operational costs
  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual expense reports.
  • Maintain consolidated financial reporting.
  • Develop vendor and fixed-cost variance reports.
  • Identify spending trends and unusual financial activity.
  • Prepare management reports covering expenses, margins, payments, and operating costs.
  • Provide accurate financial information to support leadership decisions.

Accounting Systems & Process Improvement

  • Develop and maintain financial reporting templates using Excel and Google Sheets.
  • Build dashboards for profitability, expense tracking, and financial variance analysis.
  • Combine and clean financial data exported from multiple systems.
  • Organize accounting documentation and shared financial folders.
  • Improve reporting accuracy and reduce repetitive manual work.
  • Identify opportunities to automate bookkeeping and reconciliation processes.
  • Help develop scalable accounting workflows as the company grows.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in bookkeeping, accounting operations, financial analysis, or a related role.
  • Proven hands-on experience using Xero for bookkeeping, reconciliations, expense coding, and reporting.
  • Experience managing monthly and quarterly reconciliations across 10 or more accounts simultaneously.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.
  • Experience processing international payments and foreign-currency transactions.
  • Strong understanding of accounts payable, accounts receivable, and expense management.
  • Experience preparing financial reports and analyzing discrepancies.
  • Fluent English with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work 9:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday.
  • Availability for occasional after-hours, weekend, and holiday emergencies.
  • Reliable phone access for urgent financial matters.
  • Dedicated, secure remote workspace with reliable high-speed internet.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to work independently.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and sound judgment when handling confidential financial information.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience with Convera GlobalPay, including international payment processing and approval workflows.
  • Experience with HubSpot CRM or similar deal-management platforms.
  • Previous experience in private aviation, charter services, luxury travel, or hospitality.
  • Experience supporting U.S.-based businesses.
  • Familiarity with U.S. dollar accounting and international vendor transactions.
  • Experience building automated financial reports and dashboards.
  • Xero Advisor Certification.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

Tools & Technical Skills

Xero – Required

Candidates should be comfortable with:

  • Bank feeds and bank rules
  • Bank and corporate card reconciliations
  • Chart of accounts management
  • Expense categorization and coding
  • Bills, invoices, and payment tracking
  • Supporting financial documentation
  • Tracking categories for trip-level reporting
  • Profit & Loss statements
  • Balance Sheets
  • Aged Payables and Aged Receivables

Microsoft Excel & Google Sheets – Required

Advanced skills should include:

  • XLOOKUP and VLOOKUP
  • INDEX/MATCH
  • SUMIFS
  • Conditional formulas
  • Pivot tables
  • Data validation
  • Conditional formatting
  • Financial dashboards
  • Expense and variance reporting
  • Cleaning and combining data exports

Convera GlobalPay

  • International beneficiary management
  • Domestic and international payment processing
  • Foreign-currency transactions
  • Payment approval workflows
  • Payment tracking and confirmations
  • Reconciliation reporting

HubSpot CRM

  • Deal and pipeline management
  • Booking and payment tracking
  • Deal-stage updates
  • Contact and company records
  • Exporting booking and payment information
  • Reconciling CRM data against accounting records

Additional Platforms

Google Drive | Banking Platforms | Corporate Card Systems | Financial Reporting Tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Take pride in maintaining accurate, organized financial records.
  • Have extensive hands-on experience with Xero.
  • Can confidently reconcile 10+ accounts without missing deadlines.
  • Naturally investigate discrepancies and unusual transactions.
  • Understand international vendor payments and foreign-currency transactions.
  • Can translate financial data into useful reports for leadership.
  • Have strong Excel and Google Sheets skills.
  • Are comfortable working with multiple financial systems.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve accounting processes.
  • Can work independently without constant supervision.
  • Understand the importance of discretion when handling confidential financial information.
  • Remain responsive when urgent payment issues arise.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing bank and corporate card activity, reconciling transactions in Xero, and identifying any discrepancies requiring attention.

You might then process an international vendor payment through Convera, update payment records in HubSpot, reconcile booking information against accounting records, or follow up on outstanding balances.

Throughout the day, you’ll review trip-related expenses, calculate flight profitability, prepare financial reports, and maintain dashboards that help leadership understand business performance.

You may also improve an existing spreadsheet, automate a recurring report, or organize financial documentation to make accounting processes more efficient.

In short: You’ll keep the company’s books accurate, vendor payments organized, and flight profitability visible while building more efficient financial systems.

Schedule & Availability

This is a fully remote, full-time position open to candidates worldwide.

Core Working Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, Monday–Friday.

Because private aviation operates across different time zones, occasional support outside standard business hours is required.

You must be available to respond to time-sensitive financial matters, including:

  • Urgent operator payments
  • Declined corporate cards during active trips
  • International vendor payment issues
  • Financial problems that could disrupt a scheduled flight

Occasional evening, weekend, and holiday availability is required when emergencies arise.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Accurate monthly and quarterly reconciliations across 10+ accounts
  • Timely completion of month-end close
  • Accuracy of Xero financial records
  • Alignment between HubSpot booking records and accounting data
  • Timely and accurate vendor payments
  • Accurate tracking of international and foreign-currency transactions
  • Reliable trip-level gross and net margin reporting
  • Identification and resolution of financial discrepancies
  • Quality and timeliness of management reporting
  • Improved accounting workflows and reduced manual processes

What Success Looks Like

First 90 Days

You’ll have:

  • Learned the company’s accounting systems and vendor network.
  • Aligned HubSpot deal records with financial records.
  • Completed a full monthly close.
  • Reconciled all 10+ relevant accounts.
  • Delivered the first trip-level profitability report.
  • Established reliable processes for ongoing financial tracking.

Within Your First Year

Leadership will rely on your reporting to:

  • Evaluate flight profitability.
  • Make informed pricing decisions.
  • Compare vendor costs.
  • Monitor operational expenses.
  • Identify financial trends and opportunities.

You’ll also have helped make the monthly and quarterly close process faster, more organized, and increasingly automated.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced Bookkeeper, Accounting Specialist, or Financial Operations professional with strong expertise in Xero, account reconciliations, Excel, Google Sheets, international payments, and financial reporting, we’d love to hear from you.

Join a growing private aviation company where you’ll take ownership of financial accuracy, support international operations, and help develop scalable accounting systems.

This opportunity is fully remote and open to qualified candidates worldwide who can work U.S. Eastern Time hours.

jobs.description:
WHAT DOES A VP, GROUP CREATIVE DIRECTOR DO?

As the VP, Group Creative Director at EVERSANA INTOUCH, you will lead the creative vision and strategy for a group of brands, ensuring the delivery of innovative and impactful creative solutions. This role requires a visionary leader with a deep understanding of creative strategy, execution, and management, who can drive excellence and innovation in creative delivery. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including Creative, Account, and Technology, to develop and implement creative strategies that align with business goals and client needs. The VP will also oversee the creative team, fostering a culture of creativity, collaboration, and continuous improvement. .

  • Think AND execute. Exceptional conceptual abilities and art direction talent within a multimedia landscape. Make smart look pretty. 

  • Be curious. Must have an unquenchable thirst for knowledge — of the problem, the possible solutions and our target — in order to sculpt the big ideas that matter. 

  • Inspire. Set expectations of high work standards by exposing your teams to excellent creative in-industry, in-category or anywhere excellent creative is found. 

  • Push it. Leverage industry knowledge and creative chops to push past the safe option into compelling, uncharted territories. Push it real good. 

  • Be a leader and team player. Ability to guide creative and collaborate as part of a larger team in an ever-changing environment. Bring laughs. Leave ego. 

  • Present the vision. Eloquently explain every aspect of a creative solution and how it solves the client challenge. This means leading rock-solid pitch efforts and presentation prowess. 

  • Rock a can-do attitude. You can anticipate and adjust for problems and roadblocks throughout any stage of the creative process. No time? No problem! 

  • Stay hungry. You’re a part of the inner circle and responsible for the health of the Creative department. That means finding more ways to feed and grow clients’ brands as well as our own. Easy as pie, right? 

  • Juggle. In a fast-paced, multi-faceted department, your ability to focus on multiple priorities such as work quality, staffing, workload, workflow, team happiness and client relations is key.  

  • Model the work. Bring innovative ideas and approaches to your teams, and represent Creative POV to the senior management team. 

  • Nurture. Help guide and grow CDs and ACDs through inclusion, empowerment and collaboration with account and planning teams. Release your inner mama bear. 

  • Be the director of harmony. An appropriate workload for each individual is critical to sustaining high standards of quality work and a healthy work-life balance. Keep a clear pulse on the team, and make necessary changes via conversations and negotiations with account teams or PMs. 

  • Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.

  • All other duties as assigned

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent education plus professional experience required 

  • 12+ years of digital, print, traditional and trade marketing experience 

  • Deep knowledge of happenings in health, pharma and digital and the ability to harness it to drive outstanding creative 

  • Strong knowledge of pharmaceutical marketing and all that it entails: disease state and product science, therapeutic industry standards, legal restrictions and competitive markets 

  • Oncology experience is a must 

  • Superior negotiating skills when problem solving with other SMEs and/or partner agencies 

  • Book of strategic and beautiful work 

  • Proven ability in creative, management and strategic aspects of advertising and leadership 

OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:

Patient Minded I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

Client Delight I own every client experience and its impact on results.

Take Action I am empowered and empower others to act now.

Grow Talent I own my development and invest in the development of others. 

Win Together I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.

Communication Matters I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.

Embrace Diversity I create an environment of awareness and respect.

Always Innovate I am bold and creative in everything I do.

Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.

EVERSANA is committed to providing competitive salaries and benefits for all employees. If this job posting includes a base salary range, it represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position and is not applicable to locations outside of the U.S. Compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, other job-related qualifications/skills, and geographic location (to account for comparative cost of living). This role is eligible for hire in select U.S. locations based on business and operational considerations. For a full list of locations, visit eversana.com/careers. More information about EVERSANA’s benefits package can be found at eversana.com/careers. EVERSANA reserves the right to modify this base salary range and benefits at any time.

From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws, it is the policy of EVERSANA to provide reasonable accommodation when requested by a qualified applicant or candidate with a disability, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship for EVERSANA. The policy regarding requests for reasonable accommodations applies to all aspects of the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the interview and hiring process, please contact us at .

Follow us on LinkedIn | Twitter

EVERSANA INTOUCH® is a global, full-service marketing agency network serving the life sciences industry, and is the first – and only – agency network to be part of a fully integrated commercialization platform through EVERSANA®. We provide next-generation creative and media services, enterprise solutions and data analytics services for clients.

We get fired up when people talk about getting—and staying—healthy. That’s where we find our inspiration: in the very human experiences of patients, doctors, and even each other. Then, we collaborate on ways to make caring for one’s health more achievable, connecting patients and physicians with the information and tools they need.

We embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs.

jobs.title: Staff Frontend Engineer - Commerce
jobs.excerpt: About HighLevel: HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale.
jobs.description:
About HighLevel:
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts.

About the Role:

    You are the technical owner of every pixel a Commerce merchant or shopper sees. You also raise the frontend bar for all of HighLevel. The role has two horizons.

    Commerce first. You set the architecture. You write the standards. You review the code. You hire the team. You hold the line on performance, accessibility, and quality while engineers and their coding agents ship into Commerce every day.

    Then HighLevel. Commerce is greenfield. That makes it the place to prove what excellent frontend engineering looks like at HighLevel. What works in Commerce becomes a shared capability, so every organization benefits.

    The central frontend platform team is your closest partner on both horizons. They own the shared foundation. You are their most demanding customer and one of their strongest contributors. You bring Commerce requirements early. You co-design solutions with them. You upstream what Commerce builds, so HighLevel keeps one foundation.

    This is an individual contributor role at staff level. You lead through design documents, code, reviews, and the people you grow. You will write production code every week.

    The bar is high. A storefront that loads in six seconds loses the sale. A checkout a screen reader cannot use excludes a customer and breaks the law in some markets. An architecture that couples every team slows every one of them. A pattern that stays inside one organization helps only that organization. You own all four problems.

Responsibilities:

    First 90 days

  • Publish the Commerce frontend standard: architecture, state, data fetching, testing, accessibility, and performance. Every Commerce team adopts it.
  • Instrument real-user monitoring on every Commerce surface. Publish field metrics for LCP, INP, and CLS per surface, with an owning team for each.
  • Review frontend pull requests across Commerce. Raise the quality of every one you touch, and write down the patterns so reviews scale beyond you.
  • Map the central frontend platform roadmap against Commerce needs. Agree a working contract with that team: what the platform provides, what Commerce builds, and how requests and contributions flow both ways.
  • Set up a standing design review with the central platform team, so Commerce decisions and platform decisions stay aligned.
  • Produce a frontend hiring plan: how many engineers, at what levels, and in what order.

    • First 6 months

  • Ship the architecture that lets every Commerce team build and deploy its surfaces independently, with enforced module boundaries. Build it on the central platform's foundation wherever one exists, and close gaps jointly with that team.
  • Put performance and bundle budgets in CI for every Commerce route. A regression fails the build.
  • Make accessibility a gate: automated checks in CI and manual audits on checkout and storefront flows against WCAG 2.2 AA.
  • Land typed, generated API clients end to end, so a backend contract change breaks at compile time.
  • Contribute at least one Commerce-built capability to the central platform, adopted by another organization.
  • Hire and onboard the first Commerce frontend engineers.

    • First 12 months

  • Commerce storefronts meet "good" Core Web Vitals at the 75th percentile in field data, on mid-range mobile devices.
  • Checkout and storefront pass a WCAG 2.2 AA audit.
  • Backend engineers ship frontend features that meet the standard without your direct involvement.
  • Coding agents across Commerce follow the frontend standard by default, through shared instructions, skills, and review gates you designed.
  • Commerce is HighLevel's reference implementation for frontend excellence. Its standards, performance budgets, and agent guidance reach other organizations through the central platform.
  • You lead or co-lead HighLevel-wide frontend decisions with the central platform team, written as RFCs other organizations build on.
  • The Commerce frontend team runs on its own. You spend your time on the next hardest problem at HighLevel.

Requirements:

  • You have 9+ years of experience in building frontend systems
  • You have built commerce surfaces at scale: storefronts, checkout, or point of sale.
  • You have built or led a design system consumed by many teams, and shipped breaking changes through it safely.
  • You have used ConnectRPC, gRPC-Web, or protocol buffers from the browser.
  • You can read and write Go well enough to build or review a backend-for-frontend.
  • You contribute to open source, web standards discussions, or the frontend community.
  • You have taught backend engineers to ship good frontend code.
  • You have contributed to a shared frontend platform or design system used by several product organizations.

Our Stack & Direction

    Frontend. Vue.js across HighLevel. TanStack Query for server state. Webpack and Rspack for builds, with micro-frontends where teams need independent deploys.
    Contracts. ConnectRPC with protocol buffers from the browser to the backend. The client calls typed functions and receives typed responses. No hand-written REST clients.
    Backend. Go services on Kubernetes, with Postgres as the primary store. Backend-for-frontend layers run inside the cluster, close to the services they call.
    Rendering. Static generation where content allows it, client-side rendering for interactive surfaces, and a backend-for-frontend to aggregate data. You will challenge and refine this direction with evidence.
    Engineering practice. Every engineer works with coding agents. Standards live as written documents, shared agent instructions, and review gates.

What you bring on day one:

    Scope. You have owned frontend architecture across several teams for a multi-quarter effort. Other teams still build on decisions you made. You can show us the before and after.
    Platform partnership. You have worked with a central platform team as both a consumer and a contributor. You influence roadmaps you do not own. You negotiate scope with evidence. You land changes in shared code that many organizations depend on, without breaking them. You have taken a standard from one team and made it company-wide.
    The browser platform. You know the rendering pipeline, the event loop, and what makes a long task. You follow new platform features through Baseline and MDN, and you have shipped some of them. You reach for the platform before a library, and you have deleted dependencies because the browser made them unnecessary.
    Performance. You diagnose with field data, performance traces, and network waterfalls. You have moved Core Web Vitals in production and kept them there with budgets and ownership. You can explain where every millisecond of a page load goes, from DNS to interaction.
    Architecture for many teams. You have designed systems where many teams deploy independently into one product. You know module federation, native ES modules, import maps, monorepos, and when each one fits. You know what each costs: duplicate dependencies, runtime integration bugs, build infrastructure. You pick deliberately.
    Data and contracts. You design how the client talks to the server: backend-for-frontend layers, typed RPC contracts, caching, and invalidation. You understand why twenty sequential calls over the public internet cost seconds, and how to collapse them.
    Accessibility. You build with semantic HTML first and add ARIA only where semantics fall short. You know WCAG 2.2, colour contrast requirements, and keyboard and screen reader behaviour. You have led an accessibility audit and fixed what it found.
    Security. You treat user-generated content as hostile. You know XSS, content security policy, sandboxed rendering, and supply chain risk in the npm ecosystem.
    Code review. Your reviews make engineers better. You find the race condition before the naming nit. You turn repeated feedback into lint rules, patterns, and documentation.
    AI-assisted engineering. You use coding agents every day with discipline. You write the context, specs, and skills that make agent output match the standard. You verify generated code with tests and review. You have a view on how teams keep a codebase understandable when everyone generates three times more code.
    Writing. You write design documents and decision records that other engineers can act on without a meeting.
