jobs.description:
Director of Brand & Creative Marketing

Marketing | Full-Time, Exempt | Reports to the Co-CEOs | Remote (U.S.) | Director: $150k-210k

About the Role

Seeking is looking for a highly entrepreneurial, hands-on Director / Sr. Director of Brand & Creative Marketing to lead the brand side of our marketing organization.

This is not a traditional management role and it is not a position for someone who wants to sit above the work.

We are looking for an operator.

This person will own Seeking's brand marketing strategy and lead an approximately 13-person organization spanning PR, creative, copy, social, influencer marketing, and broader brand initiatives and activations. They will be responsible for turning company goals into marketing strategy, turning strategy into executable plans, ensuring the right people are accountable for the right work, and ultimately determining whether that work is moving the business.

The role works closely with Seeking's Co-CEOs and alongside our Director of Growth and Lifecycle Marketing. Our Digital Marketing team owns areas such as paid acquisition, lifecycle/CRM, conversion optimization, and digital growth. This role owns the brand side of marketing while partnering closely with Growth to ensure both functions operate as one marketing organization and share accountability for company performance.

Seeking moves quickly. Our team is lean, scrappy, ambitious, and highly adaptable. The right person is comfortable making decisions, changing direction when the data requires it, getting into the details, and personally helping solve problems when necessary.

We do not need another layer of management. We need someone capable of building and leading a high-performing marketing organization.

What You Will Own

Marketing strategy, performance, and budget

  • Own Seeking's brand marketing strategy, positioning, messaging, audience strategy, and overall brand direction.
  • Translate company objectives into quarterly and annual marketing priorities, initiatives, OKRs, budgets, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Develop the marketing strategy in close partnership with the Co-CEOs, progressively assuming greater ownership as alignment and trust are established.
  • Understand Seeking's distinct audiences and develop strategies capable of effectively reaching both sides of the marketplace.
  • Identify untapped audiences, market opportunities, positioning gaps, competitive opportunities, and new ways to grow the business.
  • Own consumer research, competitive intelligence, campaign learnings, and brand insights.
  • Determine what Seeking should do more of, less of, stop doing, or approach differently based on performance and business priorities.

Integrated Campaign Leadership

  • Originate and lead major brand campaigns from initial insight through strategy, concept, execution, launch, measurement, and post-campaign analysis.
  • Develop bold, culturally relevant ideas capable of generating conversation, press, signups, and revenue.
  • Define the objective, audience, strategic insight, messaging, channels, success metrics, budget, responsibilities, and execution plan for major initiatives.
  • Work closely with Creative, Production, PR, Social, Influencer, Digital Marketing, Product, Legal, and external partners to bring campaigns to market.
  • Personally contribute ideas rather than relying exclusively on the team for campaign concepts.
  • Evaluate concepts, scripts, copy, messaging, creative direction, activations, partnerships, and channel plans with strong creative and commercial judgment.
  • Lead campaign production, including talent, agencies, production partners, shoots, post-production, rollout, media requirements, legal considerations, and timelines.

Performance & Business Accountability

  • Own the performance of the brand marketing organization and ensure marketing activity ultimately contributes to business growth.
  • Monitor company and marketing performance closely, including joins, revenue, CAC, ROAS, conversion, brand search, campaign performance, social growth, influencer performance, earned media, and other relevant KPIs.
  • Diagnose why initiatives are or are not working and make changes quickly.
  • Reallocate budget, resources, priorities, or strategy when performance does not justify the current approach.
  • Maximize ROI across productions and activations by identifying opportunities to create additional revenue-driving content within existing budgets, helping recover costs and improve the overall return on each investment.
  • Establish meaningful measurement frameworks for brand initiatives that connect marketing activity to commercial outcomes, including brand health.
  • Partner closely with the Director of Growth & Lifecycle Marketing to understand acquisition and funnel performance and ensure brand and performance marketing strengthen one another.
  • Lead campaign and quarterly retrospectives and turn learnings into concrete changes.

PR & Cultural Relevance

  • Set the overarching PR narrative and determine what Seeking should be known for culturally.
  • Lead and challenge the PR organization on strategy, angles, pitches, media opportunities, reactive opportunities, partnerships, spokesperson positioning, and execution.
  • Help develop provocative, differentiated stories that can break through crowded cultural conversations while protecting the business and brand.
  • Be comfortable operating around controversial subjects and challenging cultural conversations without becoming unnecessarily risk-averse.
  • Understand what makes a story interesting to media rather than simply what the company wants to communicate.
  • Be capable of rewriting or strengthening an angle, headline, pitch, talking point, or narrative when senior intervention is required.
  • Build and develop a strong internal PR function rather than relying exclusively on agencies to provide strategic thinking.
  • Own reputation and crisis communications, partnering with the Co-CEOs and Legal to protect the brand.

Team Leadership & Organizational Performance

  • Lead, coach, develop, and hold accountable an approximately 13-person brand marketing organization.
  • Manage managers and senior individual contributors across Creative, Production, PR, Social, Influencer, Copy, Brand Marketing, and related functions.
  • Establish clear ownership, expectations, goals, accountability, and decision-making authority across the department.
  • Evaluate talent continuously and identify where employees need coaching, clearer expectations, additional resources, changed responsibilities, or stronger performance management.
  • Recognize high-potential employees and create opportunities for them to grow.
  • Make difficult personnel recommendations when performance does not meet the needs of the business.
  • Identify organizational gaps and recommend changes to team structure, roles, hiring plans, agencies, contractors, or external resources.
  • Participate meaningfully in recruiting, interviewing, hiring, performance management, and termination decisions.
  • Build a culture that combines empathy and development with extremely high standards for performance.

Marketing Operations & Planning

  • Own the integrated marketing calendar in partnership with the Director of Growth & Lifecycle Marketing.
  • Set department priorities and determine what gets worked on, delayed, re-scoped, or stopped.
  • Turn large initiatives into clear workstreams, owners, milestones, dependencies, budgets, timelines, and success metrics.
  • Build and continuously improve the operating processes required for a sophisticated marketing organization.
  • Establish clear processes for briefs, campaign development, research, creative concepting, moodboards, reviews, approvals, production, PR planning, launch readiness, asset delivery, reporting, and postmortems.
  • Ensure teams are brought into initiatives at the right stage rather than operating reactively.
  • Remove bottlenecks before they reach the executive team.
  • Identify unclear ownership and correct it.
  • Ensure initiatives move forward without requiring the Co-CEOs to manage day-to-day execution.

Budget & Commercial Management

  • Own and manage a significant seven-figure brand marketing budget.
  • Build annual and quarterly budgets and allocate resources against the highest-value opportunities.
  • Evaluate spend based on strategic importance and expected business return.
  • Maintain visibility into commitments, actual spend, forecasts, and ROI.
  • Oversee agencies, production partners, talent, influencers, vendors, sponsorships, and other external relationships.
  • Lead or oversee high-stakes negotiations and ensure the team is negotiating effectively.
  • Challenge unnecessary spend and identify opportunities to achieve better outcomes with existing resources.

How This Role Works With Other Marketing Leaders

Director of Growth & Lifecycle Marketing

The Director / Sr. Director of Brand & Creative Marketing and Director of Growth & Lifecycle Marketing will operate as peer leaders.

This role owns brand strategy, integrated brand campaigns, PR, Creative, Copy, Social, Influencer, brand activations, consumer insights, and the brand marketing budget.

The two leaders jointly plan around company goals, audience strategy, campaign performance, acquisition, landing-page effectiveness, creative performance, the marketing calendar, and overall business growth.

Leadership vs. Delegation

The Director creates the environment in which the marketing team can perform at a higher level by setting the strategy, establishing priorities, structuring the work, challenging the thinking, coaching the team, reviewing performance, removing gaps, and holding the organization accountable for results.

At the same time, this is a hands-on leadership role.

When a major campaign needs a stronger concept, a pitch needs to be rewritten, messaging is not working, a brief is unclear, a negotiation is stuck, or an important initiative needs senior attention, this person is expected to get involved and help solve it.

Strong leaders here do not say, "That's not my job."

They also do not take over their employees' jobs.

They know when to coach, when to challenge, when to make the decision, and when to roll up their sleeves.

What We Are Looking For

  • 8+ years of progressive marketing experience, with exceptional candidates considered based on demonstrated scope and trajectory rather than years alone.
  • 4+ years of meaningful people-management experience, including experience managing managers or senior functional leaders.
  • Demonstrated experience across both brand marketing and PR/communications.
  • Strong experience developing and executing integrated consumer marketing campaigns.
  • Experience in a startup, high-growth environment, agency environment, or similarly fast-moving business, with the ability to operate with a high sense of urgency and keep pace with rapid execution, shifting priorities, and tight deadlines.
  • Experience owning or meaningfully managing substantial marketing budgets.
  • Experience working with agencies, production companies, creators, talent, vendors, and external partners.
  • Working knowledge of campaign production from concept through delivery and distribution.
  • Exceptional copy judgment and the ability to provide meaningful feedback across advertising, PR, social, influencer scripts, campaign messaging, and brand communications.
  • Strong negotiator with sound commercial judgment.
  • Experience creating structure, processes, and accountability inside growing or evolving teams.
  • Comfortable making difficult decisions with incomplete information.
  • Able to operate effectively with founders and senior executives who are highly engaged in the brand.
  • Confident enough to challenge an executive recommendation when the data, customer insight, or strategy supports a different direction.

Marketplace or two-sided consumer platform experience is a plus.

Experience with culturally provocative, unconventional, entertainment, lifestyle, dating, or otherwise conversation-driving brands is highly valued.

What Will Not Work Here

This role will likely not be a fit for someone who:

  • Primarily wants to delegate through layers of management.
  • Measures success based on outputs rather than business outcomes.
  • Is uncomfortable with provocative ideas or controversial conversations.
  • Struggles with changing priorities.
  • Avoids difficult conversations.

jobs.excerpt: At R2, we believe that small and medium businesses are the productive engine of society.
jobs.description:
At R2, we believe that small and medium businesses are the productive engine of society. Small and medium businesses (SMBs) make up over 90% of companies in Latin America, yet they face a trillion-dollar credit gap. Our mission is to unlock SMBs' potential by providing financial solutions that are tailored to their needs. We are reimagining the financial infrastructure of Latin America, where SMBs' financial needs are satisfied without ever having to go to a bank.

R2 enables platforms to embed financial services that SMBs can then leverage, starting with revenue-based financing. We are a tight-knit team coming from organizations such as Google, Amazon, Nubank, Uber, Capital One, Mercado Libre, Globant and J.P. Morgan.

We are entering a new phase of growth following a strategic investment from Ant International, focused on rapidly expanding our partner footprint, strengthening our credit and underwriting capabilities, and scaling operations across multiple markets. As part of this growth journey, eligible team members have the opportunity to participate in R2’s Phantom Share Program, a performance-based incentive designed to align our team with the company’s long-term success and value creation. We believe in building a culture of ownership, where those who help create value share meaningfully in it.

As Data Engineering Tech Lead, you will be the senior technical authority for R2's data platform and the day-to-day leader of the Data Engineering team. You will report to the Director of Data Management.

You will own the architecture, technical roadmap, tooling and vendor decisions, reliability and cost of the platform behind ingestion, data processing, underwriting and our enterprise data warehouse.

The role evolves in three stages:

  1. Lead by influence. A hands-on lead engineer who sets technical direction and standards.
  2. Run the team. Own planning, prioritization and delivery for the Data Engineering team day to day.
  3. Manage people. Take on direct management of some of our Senior Data Engineers.

As we expand from Latin America into Europe, including a fully isolated EU data platform, you will shape how our data architecture scales across countries, legal entities and regulatory regimes.

What you will do

Architecture and technical direction

  • Own the target architecture of the data platform, including ingestion, cleaning, processing, the warehouse, Airflow orchestration and the data flows behind underwriting.
  • Lead architecture decisions together with the Director of Data, and set the principles the team designs against.
  • Define and own the Data Engineering technical roadmap, balancing business priorities, platform health and tech debt.
  • Lead tool and vendor evaluation, selection and contract input.
  • Design a multi-country, multi-entity platform, including a fully isolated EU data platform and the data residency rules around it.
  • Stay hands-on in the most critical and complex parts of the stack: Snowflake, Airflow DAGs, dbt and Python.

Reliability, operations and cost

  • Own the reliability, observability and SLAs of production pipelines.
  • Design the on-call rotation, incident response process and post-mortem practice.
  • Own Snowflake spend, including warehouse sizing, usage monitoring, budgets and cost-optimization practices.
  • Define and enforce engineering standards for modeling, testing, CI/CD, documentation and code review.
  • Introduce AI-enabled tooling and agents where they measurably improve productivity or data operations.

Team leadership and delivery

  • Run the Data Engineering team day to day: planning, prioritization, delivery cadence and unblocking.
  • Project-manage data initiatives end to end: scope, estimates, plans, tracking, and clear communication of risks and trade-offs to stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow Senior Data Engineers through design reviews, code reviews and regular feedback.
  • Take part in hiring, onboarding and shaping the team's structure as it grows.
  • Progressively take on people management for part of the team, including 1:1s, performance and career development.
  • Partner with Analytics, Product, Risk and Credit, ML, Engineering and Compliance to turn business needs into platform work.

Data governance, security and compliance

  • Co-own data governance with the Director of Data, covering data quality, lineage, cataloging and access control.
  • Design how PII is handled across the platform, including classification, masking, encryption, Snowflake role-based access, retention and deletion.
  • Make sure the platform meets regulatory and audit requirements, including GDPR in Europe, LGPD in Brazil, central bank and local regulatory reporting, and investor and partner requirements such as Ant International's.
  • Translate regulatory requirements into technical controls, evidence and documentation that hold up in an audit.

Who you are

  • 8–12+ years in Data Engineering or closely related roles.
  • Prior experience as a Principal or Staff Data Engineer, or as Tech Lead of a team of 4 or more engineers.
  • Proven team leadership and project management. You have run a team's delivery, led multi-quarter initiatives and managed stakeholders end to end.
  • Deep, hands-on production experience with Snowflake, including architecture, performance tuning, cost management and role-based security. This is required.
  • Advanced experience with Airflow and dbt in production.
  • Strong software engineering background with deep Python expertise, plus advanced SQL and dimensional / analytical data modeling.
  • Hands-on experience with ELT patterns and tools such as Airbyte or Fivetran.
  • Experience running data platforms on AWS.
  • Experience building or operating data platforms across multiple countries, legal entities or regulatory regimes. This is required.
  • Practical experience applying privacy and data protection regulations such as GDPR or LGPD, and building governance controls for PII.
  • Comfortable owning systems in production, including monitoring, alerting and incident response.
  • Able to explain technical trade-offs clearly to leadership and to Risk, Product and Compliance partners.
  • Professional English, plus Spanish or Portuguese.
  • Snowflake is a hard requirement. Profiles centered on Databricks or BigQuery without significant production Snowflake experience will not be a fit.

Bonus

  • Experience in fintech, lending, credit risk or underwriting data.
  • Experience standing up a data platform in the EU, or an isolated regional platform with strict data residency.
  • Experience with data catalog, lineage or data contract tooling.
  • Experience integrating AI/ML tooling or agents into data workflows, or building feature pipelines for ML models.
  • Experience designing self-serve analytics platforms.
  • Experience with cloud data cost management (FinOps) at scale.

What We Offer

  • The chance to join a high-impact, mission-driven fintech.
  • Ownership and impact in a fast-paced, growth-oriented startup.

jobs.excerpt: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility About UsWe are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies.
jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of iOS development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior iOS App Developer with an excellent background in native iOS development using Swift and SwiftUI, together with practical experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into iOS applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our iOS application, integrate shared application logic, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development.

Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build mobile applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our native iOS application using Swift and SwiftUI.
  • Integrate Kotlin Multiplatform modules into the iOS application and collaborate on shared business logic.
  • Implement platform-specific functionality while maintaining consistent behavior across iOS and Android.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical iOS challenges such as permissions, application lifecycle, background execution, battery consumption, and device compatibility.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and investigate issues that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and clear explanations.
  • Support application signing, release preparation, and distribution through TestFlight and the App Store.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production iOS applications.
  • Excellent practical knowledge of Swift, SwiftUI, and the iOS development ecosystem.
  • Practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and its integration into native iOS applications.
  • Solid understanding of application architecture, asynchronous programming, lifecycle management, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills across application code, shared modules, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain technical decisions.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, geofencing, and sensor data.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and proximity detection.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Interoperability between Swift and Kotlin Multiplatform, including asynchronous operations and error handling.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful iOS development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing and releasing iOS applications.
  • Your experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into native iOS projects.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, App Store references, or GitHub links are welcome where available.

Own your opportunity at GDIT and you’ll be a meaningful part of improving how agencies operate. Our work depends on a Committee Operations Lead joining our team to lead IT professionals supporting the Health Resources & Services Administration (HRSA).

The Health Resources and Services Administration (HRSA) aims to improve health outcomes by enhancing access to quality services, developing a skilled health workforce, and implementing innovative programs that benefit geographically isolated, economically or medically vulnerable populations. HRSA focuses on increasing health equity and strengthening local health systems through initiatives such as community health centers, the Organ Procurement & Transplantation Network (OPTN), the Ryan White HIV/AIDS Program, and support for maternal and child health.

At GDIT, we foster a people-centric environment. The Committee Operations Lead will manage and facilitate the activities of Organ Procurement and Transplantation Network (OPTN) committees, including subcommittees, workgroups, and ad hoc groups. This role ensures that committees responsible for membership, patient safety, and policy development operate efficiently, transparently, and in alignment with statutory, regulatory, and policy-driven goals.

The Committee Operations Lead functions as a pivotal project manager, policy facilitator, and liaison, supporting committees in their critical decision-making, managing governance documentation, streamlining meeting logistics, and collaborating with internal and external stakeholders. They also support the development and implementation of evidence-based transplantation and allocation policies, ensuring compliance with HRSA and federal regulations.

This role combines project management expertise, policy analysis skills, and regulatory knowledge to deliver high-quality support to committee operations and optimize system performance. In this role, the responsibilities of the Committee Operations Lead will include:

  • Lead and support OPTN committees tasked with membership oversight, patient safety, and policy development.

  • Oversee the schedule and facilitation of committee meetings, develop detailed agendas, prepare support materials, and lead discussions in a manner promoting collaboration and timely decision-making.

  • Collaborate with committee chairs and leadership to ensure accurate tracking of activities, timely communication, and seamless facilitation of committee initiatives.

  • Fully implement a Committee(s) Meeting Facilitation Plan that ensures secure, efficient, and compliant virtual meetings, including maintaining schedules, technical support, and post-meeting documentation (recordings, minutes, summaries).

  • Develop, implement, and maintain the Committee(s) Management Plan, which outlines procedures for tracking committee activities, milestones, composition, and outputs.

  • Create and maintain governance documents, operational manuals, and SOPs related to committee structures, member selection processes, decision-making responsibilities, and conflict-of-interest logs.

  • Prepare public-facing materials highlighting committee activities, accomplishments, and membership, ensuring transparency and alignment with organizational goals.

  • Support policy development by identifying opportunities to improve organ transplantation and allocation policies through evidence-based research and committee-led initiatives.

  • Draft policy proposals, guidance documents, public comment reports, and board recommendations based on committee deliberations and feedback.

  • Collaborate with OPTN committees and stakeholders to ensure all proposed policies align with federal regulations (e.g., CMS, HRSA). Maintain thorough documentation for policy audits and regulatory reporting.

  • Analyze quantitative and qualitative data (using tools such as Excel, Tableau, or NVivo) to support committee decision-making and policy recommendations.

  • Provide detailed reports and dashboards on committee outputs, performance trends, and policy impact to OPTN leadership, HRSA, and other stakeholders.

  • Track and monitor committee projects and policy proposals through all stages (inception to implementation), ensuring alignment with public comment periods and board approval timelines.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for committee members and stakeholders, facilitating communication, responding to inquiries, and resolving operational challenges.

  • Engage with the broader transplant community to gather input, understand concerns, and encourage collaboration in policy discussions and system improvements.

  • Collaborate with external contractors, OPTN support teams, and other divisions, such as IT and policy experts, to facilitate seamless coordination across all committee activities.

  • Lead the development of the Committee(s) Training Plan, which provides onboarding, annual training, and up-to-date resources for committee members.

  • Ensure training materials address committee structures, workflows, regulatory requirements, and membership expectations.

  • Deliver virtual training sessions and maintain a secure repository of training recordings and resources.

  • Implement the Subject Matter Expertise Plan to identify, onboard, and track expert contributors across clinical, analytical, policy, and risk management domains.

  • Ensure timely and sustained access to experts who support committee initiatives related to membership evaluation, patient safety reviews, and policy recommendations.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree in Public Health, Public Policy, Health Administration, Business Administration, or a related field. Master’s degree (MPH, MPP, MHA) is preferred.

  • At least 5+ years of experience in committee coordination, project management, or policy development.

  • Experience in healthcare, compliance, regulatory, and/or nonprofit environments, especially in roles requiring meeting facilitation and multi-stakeholder engagement.

  • Proven ability to lead virtual committee meetings, guide collaborative decision-making, and manage cross-functional initiatives.

  • Strong understanding of policy drafting, federal regulations, and evidence-based research to inform recommendations and decisions.

  • Proficiency in quantitative and qualitative data analysis, with tools such as Tableau, NVivo, and Excel.

  • Familiarity with healthcare regulations (e.g., CMS, HRSA) and experience ensuring policies meet federal and organizational requirements.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication abilities, with a focus on preparing detailed reports, agendas, and governance materials.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (SharePoint, Teams), virtual meeting platforms, and committee documentation systems.

Job Title

Job Description

Coordinator, Retail Processes and Support

Location: Remote

Who We Are

At Framebridge, we are disrupting the custom framing market by replacing a cumbersome experience with a delightful one. Our mission is to make framing so delightful, customers are inspired to frame everything they love—big, little and in between. We've framed over three million pieces and counting. We are building a beloved brand, and to be successful, we have to build a great team across a number of disciplines – ecommerce, retail, design, and manufacturing.

We are a consumer business operating online and in our growing fleet of retail stores. We operate multiple manufacturing studios that allow us to deliver a high-quality custom product at an affordable price with a quick turnaround. We exist, grow, and ultimately own the market by delighting customers who trust and value us.

The Role

We're seeking a Coordinator, Retail Processes and Support who will play a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth and efficient operation of our retail stores, managing store logistics and supplies, developing documentation and SOPs, and serving as a liaison between corporate teams and store personnel. This role reports to Director, Retail Processes and Operations.

As a Framebridge Team Member, You Will:

Show Pride

We stand behind our work, we sweat the details, and we strive for continuous improvement every day. We're proud to frame the things you love, and show pride in our product and craftsmanship.

Adapt & Act

We are creative and solution-oriented, flexible, and proactive. We adapt and act quickly, embracing an environment of constant change.

Embrace Challenges

We embrace challenges with creative solutions and we know that collaboration is the only way to succeed. We set big goals and keep raising the bar together.

Secure the Baton

We take personal responsibility for delivering successful outcomes, not just completing tasks. We ensure every handoff is clear, complete, and sets the next teammates up to succeed.

Make It Special

We search everyday for opportunities to make our product and experience special. When you are building a business where every piece is priceless, making it special is core.

Build to Last

We are building a product and a business that are built to last. We work every day to build lasting relationships within our team and with our customers.

At Framebridge, our people are the heart of everything we build. We foster an inclusive, equitable, and collaborative environment where remarkable individuals take pride in their craft, elevate the customer experience, and are empowered to do the best work of their careers.

As Coordinator, Retail Processes and Support, You Will:

  • Monitor store and district compliance across a wide range of KPI measures, customer satisfaction, and productivity standards — using data to surface trends, flag risks, and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Serve as administrator and subject matter expert for store-specific systems, both proprietary and vendor-supported, maintaining a working understanding of how those systems connect and how process changes affect them.
  • Act as liaison between stores and HQ, helping to answer questions and support field team requests that come through direct messages, Slack, email, or surveys.
  • Monitor task and compliance completion, generate reporting (e.g. task completion rates, customer sentiment metrics, payroll reporting, new product launch adoption), and share results with field leadership on a regular cadence.
  • Work closely with factory logistics teams to support store shuttle schedules, supply needs and procurement, and physical inventory movement.
  • Execute internal processes such as store hours updates across platforms, creation of monthly operational trackers, and other recurring workflows.
  • Assist with the creation and upkeep of Store Policies and Procedures.

Who You Are:

  • At least 3+ years of retail experience.
  • Live in a market where you are local to a store location.
  • Analytical and data-driven, with a natural curiosity about the why behind performance trends — you use data to identify opportunities for process improvement and growth, not just to report on what happened.
  • Strong understanding of how systems work and intersect; you think about how process decisions upstream affect outcomes downstream and ask questions to understand those connections.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage with diverse stakeholders.
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a focus on accuracy and quality in all tasks.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace and/or Microsoft Office suite.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and work independently as well as part of a team.

jobs.description:
About us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role

We are seeking a Director, UX Research (M5) who can make deep customer understanding a driving force in HighLevel's product and company strategy. You have spent 12+ years conducting and leading research for complex digital products, including 5+ years leading researchers or research programs, and are ready to set the research direction for a broad platform used by agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs around the world.

This role reports to the Vice President of Product Design and is a member of Design Leadership. You will lead a small, senior research team of one or two researchers and remain a hands-on practitioner who personally leads the company's highest-stakes studies.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate exceptional research craft, strategic judgment, cross-functional influence and executive communication. You should be comfortable framing ambiguous business questions, choosing the right level of evidence for each decision and turning complex findings into clear direction for senior leaders.

Experience researching AI-powered, automation-heavy, CRM, marketing technology, platform or SMB software experiences is highly valuable. Experience using AI-powered tools for synthesis, analysis, documentation or workflow acceleration is expected.

What You'll Do

  • Align Product, Design, Engineering, Data and Product Marketing leaders on a shared research agenda so teams invest in the highest-impact questions instead of running competing studies

  • Connect customer evidence across research, product analytics, Product Marketing and customer-facing teams into one shared view of customer needs and opportunities

  • Lead foundational research, including segmentation, jobs-to-be-done, customer journeys and agency and SMB operating models, that informs company and portfolio strategy

  • Build and run Voice of the Customer programs that synthesize NPS, CSAT, support themes, sales feedback, customer councils and behavioral data into recurring, decision-ready insight

  • Personally lead high-stakes, mixed-methods studies from problem framing through synthesis, recommendation and follow-through

  • Scale research across teams by training designers and product managers, providing guardrails, templates and study reviews, and keeping democratized research rigorous

  • Coach and develop the researchers on your team, setting clear expectations for craft, influence and impact

  • Keep HighLevel executives informed through regular, concise readouts on customer insight, emerging risks and opportunities

  • Track insights through to roadmap decisions and shipped changes, and report the impact research has on product and business outcomes

  • Use AI-powered tools thoughtfully to accelerate synthesis and analysis while protecting research quality, privacy and customer trust

  • Collaborate effectively across US and India time zones in a 100% remote environment

  • Build and scale a high-performing UX Research team, owning talent capability, leadership pipeline, team structure, performance and career development standards, and resource allocation to meet evolving product and business priorities

What We Are Looking For

  • 12+ years of relevant UX research, product research or mixed-methods research experience, including 5+ years leading researchers or research programs

  • Proven experience leading research in complex B2B SaaS, platform or multi-product environments

  • A strong body of work that demonstrates research strategy, methodological judgment, clear synthesis and measurable influence on product and business outcomes

  • Expert command of qualitative and quantitative methods, including interviews, field research, usability testing, survey design, segmentation, concept testing and longitudinal research

  • Demonstrated experience leading foundational research that changed product roadmaps or company strategy, not only feature-level decisions

  • Experience building Voice of the Customer programs and enabling non-researchers to conduct sound research through training, standards and review

  • Strong understanding of research design, sampling, statistical concepts and the tradeoffs behind different levels of research confidence

  • Proven ability to align Product, Design, Engineering, Data, Product Marketing and executive leaders around shared customer evidence

  • Excellent executive communication, with experience briefing senior executives clearly and concisely

  • Fluency with modern research tools such as UserTesting, Dovetail or similar platforms, along with AI-assisted analysis and synthesis workflows

How You Work

  • You bring rigor to ambiguity without slowing teams down unnecessarily

  • You know when more research is needed and when the team has enough evidence to move forward

  • You create outsized impact from a small team by choosing the right problems and multiplying the research capability of others

  • You move comfortably between company strategy, customer insight, business outcomes and hands-on research execution

  • You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability, direct feedback and respect for your teammates as people

  • You enjoy collaborating across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates

  • You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum

  • You advocate for accessibility, inclusion, ethical research and AI experiences that remain aligned with customer goals

jobs.excerpt: Job Requisition ID # 26WD101535Position OverviewFlow Capture has a strong installed base across Autodesk's largest enterprise accounts.

Job Requisition ID #

26WD101535

Position Overview

Flow Capture has a strong installed base across Autodesk's largest enterprise accounts. Now we are taking it into an entirely new segment: mid-tier production companies. We are hiring a Flow Capture Principal Sales Specialist to break into these accounts, build demand, and close new Flow Capture business.


This is a full-cycle field sales role built for hunters. You will target a defined set of accounts that match our ideal customer profile, most of them net new to Flow Capture. You will partner closely with our Account Based Marketing team to build awareness and generate leads inside these accounts, then own the process from prospecting and discovery through negotiation and close. Enterprise accounts stay with our core enterprise sales team. The mid-tier is yours from the first call.


This is a startup inside Autodesk, and it is not starting from zero. The product is proven with some of the most demanding productions in the world, and the executive backing is in place. What is new is the segment, the team, and the motion. You will be one of the first field reps on the team, helping write the first plays, test what works, and shape how Flow Capture scales into a new market.


You will work alongside a cross-functional growth team from Marketing, Product, Strategy, and Analytics, and learn from peers on the Fusion sales team, who have spent eight years scaling a similar business in manufacturing.


Autodesk's culture emphasizes curiosity, rapid innovation, and ownership. We believe in reimagining what is possible, taking smart risks, and pursuing results with urgency. Flow lives that mindset with startup speed, bold goals, and a mission to transform how content gets made.


If you are a hunter who thrives on opening new doors, landing new logos, and building something from the ground up, this is the role.


Responsibilities


  • Break into target mid-tier production companies, post houses, and studios that fit our ideal customer profile and ignite new Flow Capture conversations
  • Partner with Account Based Marketing to plan and execute account campaigns, events, and outreach that build awareness and generate pipeline in your target accounts
  • Own the full sales cycle: prospecting, qualification, discovery, scoping, solution alignment, security review, negotiation, and close
  • Land first productions or teams inside new customers and expand them into broader, multi-project adoption
  • Build credibility and earn trust with producers, post supervisors, editors, DITs, and studio technology and security leaders
  • Lead value-driven conversations about secure camera-to-cloud dailies, real-time review, and faster collaboration across distributed teams
  • Conduct on-site meetings and visit productions, facilities, and industry events to build relationships and accelerate deals
  • Collaborate with technical specialists, partners, and product teams to deliver strong demos and validation
  • Maintain a high-velocity pipeline, accurate forecasting, and disciplined opportunity hygiene in Salesforce
  • Capture insights and document repeatable plays that help scale Flow Capture across the new segment

Minimum Qualifications


  • 7+ years of full-cycle B2B software sales experience, with a proven track record in new logo or territory hunting roles
  • Ability to open doors, qualify opportunity, and convert cold accounts into engaged pipeline
  • Experience partnering with marketing on account-based or targeted campaigns
  • Strong discovery and value selling skills with technical and creative audiences
  • Comfort running deals independently from end to end without relying on an existing account owner
  • Ability to identify the right entry points inside production companies and land initial wins that expand
  • An entrepreneurial mindset, competitive drive, and comfort operating without a fully defined playbook
  • Able to travel as needed to customers, productions, and industry events

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience selling into Media and Entertainment, production, or post-production
  • Familiarity with dailies, review and approval, media management, or camera-to-cloud workflows
  • Network of relationships across production companies, studios, or post houses
  • Startup or early-stage team experience

The Ideal Candidate


  • New Flow Capture ACV from net-new customers in your target accounts
  • Pipeline creation and progression, including conversion of ABM-generated leads
  • Expansion from first production wins into broader account adoption
  • Forecast accuracy and execution discipline

Why Flow Capture, Why Now

Production teams are more distributed than ever, and the media they manage is more valuable than ever. Flow Capture already powers some of the biggest productions in the industry. The next wave of growth is bringing it to the mid-tier production companies that need the same security and speed.


As a Flow Capture Principal Sales Specialist, you will be on the front lines of that expansion, opening new doors, creating new customers, and building the playbook for a new segment.


If you thrive in hunting environments, love owning the full sales cycle, and want to build something new with enterprise backing, we would love to talk.


About Autodesk Flow

Flow, the Industry Cloud Platform for Media and Entertainment, connects people and data across the production pipeline for faster content creation in the cloud. Flow Capture provides a secure, cloud-based dailies and review platform that connects production and post-production, so teams can manage, review, and collaborate on high-value media from anywhere.

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

Location: United States

About Pexapark

Pexapark is the price intelligence platform for clean energy. Covering solar, wind, and battery storage across more than 20 countries, Pexapark helps clean energy buyers, sellers, and investors navigate increasingly complex power markets with confidence. To do this, the company combines market-based insights and pricing solutions with expert-led transaction facilitation.

Unlike fundamental assumptions or infrequent RFPs, Pexapark is powered by real market data sourced on an ongoing basis from more than a hundred counterparties. This enables Pexapark to provide a market consensus view on otherwise non-transparent contracts. As a result, both new entrants and experienced players trust Pexapark to connect the dots across every stage of clean energy commercialization – from pre-transaction analysis, to price negotiation, to post-transaction performance and exposure management.

Founded in 2017 by power traders, Pexapark has facilitated over 40,000 megawatts of transactions and currently serves more than 250 customers across Europe and the US.

The Role

The US renewable energy market is experiencing profound change. During such a period, market participants need reliable intelligence to cut through the complexity and make data-driven decisions. Pexapark, combining our proven track record in Europe with our acquisition of US-based RenewaFi last year, is uniquely positioned to provide that intelligence.

As an Account Executive, you will own a sales quota and help build the US sales function from the ground up. This is not a role that comes with a mature team, a defined playbook, or a warm pipeline handed to you. You will help create those things. In the near term, that means owning a quota yourself, getting in front of the right buyers, and closing business.

The ideal candidate will bring strong communication skills, a track record of meeting sales quotas, and a genuine interest in the energy transition. This role offers hands-on coaching from senior members of the commercial team, with a clear growth path as you build your book of business.

What You Will Do

Account Planning and Deal Closing

  • Take ownership of US sales targets and be accountable for achieving your quota

  • Qualify leads against clear criteria and keep opportunity data accurate and up to date

  • Build and manage your pipeline, identifying and prioritizing the highest-value prospects across developers, utilities, corporations, and financial institutions active in the US renewable energy and battery storage markets

  • Manage complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, from lead qualification to close, using a value-driven sales approach

Pipeline Generation

  • Own outbound prospecting and pipeline generation, identifying and engaging new prospects across the US market

Leverage Pexapark’s Platform

  • Bring Pexapark’s market analysts, advisors, and product experts into client engagements, championing an expert-led, consultative approach to selling

  • Represent Pexapark at key US industry events, building the brand’s profile and your own network within the US renewable energy ecosystem

  • Feed market intelligence back into product and advisory teams to continuously refine Pexapark’s US proposition

What You Will Bring

  • Familiarity with the US renewable energy and battery storage markets is strongly preferred

  • 4–5 years of experience closing sales, with a track record of meeting or exceeding quota

  • Experience navigating complex, consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, with typical deal sizes ranging from $20,000 to $200,000

  • Strong CRM discipline and a data-driven approach to pipeline management and forecasting, with hands-on experience with Salesforce

  • Willingness and ability to travel to meet with prospects

  • A demonstrated ability to act with integrity, show initiative, and bring a naturally curious mindset

  • A willingness to follow a structured sales process, take coaching, and learn from senior colleagues

  • Experience in a startup environment. You know how to operate with ambiguity, move fast, and build systems from the ground up

  • A good sense of humor

We Offer

  • Options for equity participation in our company

jobs.excerpt: iFIT’s vision is to create the world's most holistic health and fitness platform, integrating all elements of health - physical fitness, mental health, nutrition and active recovery - into a seamless interactive experience.
jobs.description:
iFIT’s vision is to create the world's most holistic health and fitness platform, integrating all elements of health - physical fitness, mental health, nutrition and active recovery - into a seamless interactive experience. We develop proprietary software that learns and adjusts to the habits of each person as it delivers immersive content that guides them on their own individual fitness journey.

We run marketing across five European markets — the UK, France, Germany, Spain, and Italy — spanning the full channel mix: paid social, paid search, affiliate, influencer, retail media, and OTT/programmatic/linear TV, plus organic/AEO presence in every market. Today, the Sr Director of Global Paid Media personally owns strategy for Europe on top of running the US business. That doesn't scale across five markets with different competitive dynamics, maturity, and channel mix — the right move is a dedicated strategic owner for Europe, not a copy-pasted US playbook stretched across five countries.

We're hiring that owner. You won't run campaigns — the discipline specialists on the paid media team (affiliate, influencer, paid social, paid search, retail media, OTT) already execute at a high level across every market, and they keep doing that. What's missing is the person who decides, market by market, what those specialists should be doing and why: the channel mix for Spain versus Germany, where the next incremental dollar goes between countries, which markets are under-invested versus just under-measured, and how to tell the difference.

This is primarily a strategist-and-manager role — the discipline specialists are the default owners of execution, and you don't need to be the best person in the building at building the campaign itself. But it's a player-coach role, not a pure strategy seat: specialist attention is a shared, limited resource, and some work (a market that needs attention faster than the queue can give it, a test only one market needs, a gap no one else is positioned to close) will land on you to execute directly rather than wait on. You need broad, credible working knowledge of every channel we use — enough to direct a specialist, catch a bad plan, reallocate budget across channels and countries with judgment, and pick up the tool yourself when a market needs it faster than a handoff allows.

What you'll do

Strategy & budget ownership (~40%)

  • Own the European marketing budget end to end: allocation across channels and markets, reforecasting, and the quarterly story to leadership on where spend is going and why.
  • Build a real market-by-market strategy — channel mix, funnel priorities, and growth plan sized to each market's maturity, competitive set, and retail/DTC mix. Five countries, not one template stretched across all of them.
  • Make the channel trade-off calls with judgment: when a market's paid search is saturating, when affiliate commission structures need to flex by country, when OTT earns a slot in a market's mix and when it doesn't.

Directing execution (~30%)

  • Turn strategy into clear briefs and priorities for the discipline specialists who execute European work — you own the “what and why,” they own the “how.”
  • Run the operating cadence: regular reviews per market, catch underperformance early, and reprioritize specialist time across markets when one country needs more attention than another.
  • Keep paid and organic coherent per market — partner with SEO/AEO and, where they exist, in-market teams or agencies.

Performance & measurement (~20%)

  • Own the European performance narrative — ROAS, CAC, revenue, share of spend by market and channel — held to the same rigor as the US business.
  • Partner with marketing science/analytics to get a real read on European channel performance instead of platform-reported numbers; several markets don't have mature measurement yet, and closing that gap is part of the job.
  • Identify the highest-leverage test or investment per market each quarter and make the case for it.

Stakeholder & org management (~10%)

  • Be the single point of accountability that finance, leadership, and agency partners come to for European marketing performance and plans.
  • Build the case for where European investment should grow, shrink, or shift — the strategic voice for Europe in budget conversations.

Five critical commitments

Outcomes this role owns in year one — reviewed quarterly, each with a measurable target agreed in the first 30 days:

  1. Build the market-by-market strategic plan. Within 90 days, every one of the 5 European markets has a written channel strategy and budget allocation sized to its own growth stage — not an inherited or copy-pasted template.
  2. Raise European measurement rigor to US standard. Close the biggest attribution/incrementality measurement gaps in at least 2 priority markets this year.
  3. Own the European budget narrative end to end. Leadership gets a clear, defensible quarterly story on where the budget is going, what it's returning, and what should change.
  4. Make the specialist team's European work higher-leverage. Specialist time on European work goes to the highest-impact market/channel combinations by deliberate decision, not even distribution by habit.
  5. Grow one market meaningfully. Pick one underperforming or under-invested market and show a measurable step-change — revenue, CAC, or share — as proof the strategy works.

What your first 90 days look like

  • Audit all 5 markets: current spend, channel mix, performance, and where the strategy is (or isn't) deliberate versus inherited.
  • Meet every specialist, country stakeholder, and agency partner touching Europe; understand what's working and where Europe currently loses out on attention and budget.
  • Ship the first market-by-market strategic plan and align on budget/priority with the Sr Director of Global Paid Media.
  • Identify the single highest-leverage fix or test across the portfolio and get it moving.

What we're looking for

Must have

  • 5–8+ years in performance/growth marketing with real, hands-on fluency across multiple channels — paid social, paid search, affiliate/influencer, or retail media/OTT — enough breadth that you've run or closely overseen more than one of these, not a single deep specialty.
  • Experience owning budget and strategy (not just execution) for a meaningful seven-figure annual budget. (Exact European allocation to be confirmed before posting.)
  • Multi-market marketing experience — you know channel mix, competitive dynamics, and measurement maturity differ by country, and you don't default to “what works in the US.”
  • Strong analytical fluency: comfortable with CAC/ROAS/LTV math, can read an MMM or incrementality readout and act on it without needing the numbers pre-chewed.
  • Demonstrated ability to direct the work of specialists who are not your direct reports — through clear briefs, roadmaps, and influence, not org-chart authority.
  • Excellent stakeholder range — equally fluent running a budget conversation with finance and a channel-strategy conversation with a specialist, in each one's own language, same day.

Nice to have

  • Player-coach capability: hands-on, in-platform execution skill in at least one channel (Meta/Google Ads, affiliate network tooling, etc.) you can personally pick up when a European need outruns specialist bandwidth — not required, but a real asset in the first year while this role and its support model are still being proven out.
  • DTC / e-commerce / hardware-and-subscription business model experience.
  • Exposure to SEO/AEO as part of a channel mix, even if not hands-on.
  • Prior people-management experience (this role may pick up direct reports as the European remit grows).
  • Experience with agencies or dealer/retail-partner relationships in European markets.
  • Language skills or lived market experience in one or more of: UK, France, Germany, Spain, Italy.

jobs.title: Senior Android Developer - Kotlin Multiplatform & AI Coding
jobs.excerpt: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility About UsWe are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies.
jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of mobile development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile App Developer with strong Kotlin Multiplatform expertise and an excellent background in native Android development with Kotlin.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our application, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development. Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build Android applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our Android application using Kotlin and Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Design shared application logic and integrate it with platform-specific functionality.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical mobile challenges such as permissions, background execution, battery consumption, connectivity, and differences between devices.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and resolve problems that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and understandable explanations.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production Android applications with Kotlin.
  • Strong practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform, including shared code, platform-specific integrations, and the boundaries between them.
  • Solid understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack Compose, coroutines, Flow, application lifecycle, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills and the ability to investigate problems across application code, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain why an implementation is appropriate.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, sensor data, and proximity detection.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and signal-strength limitations.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful mobile development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing Android applications and Kotlin Multiplatform solutions.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio or GitHub links are welcome where available.

The Resource Nights & Weekend (ReNW) Nurse Practitioner (NP) is an active member of Chapters Health System’s Medical Staff and provides fully remote virtual serious illness care management to patients and families throughout our continuum of care. This continuum may include but is not limited to home-based, facility-based, and inpatient adult and pediatric hospice; palliative care; PACE, and additional service lines and programs offered or supported by Chapters Health System.

Experience Requirements:

Education Requirements:

Must hold a Masters or Doctors degree in Nursing from an accredited Family or Adult Nurse Practitioner Program.

Certificates and/or Licenses:

The ReNW NP must hold national certification, licensure, and prescriptive authority from the appropriate governing body for advanced nursing practice in their home state and in additional state(s) where care is provided. Licensure and prescriptive authority must be obtained and maintained for all required jurisdictions. Applications for required licenses must be submitted within 60 days of the date of hire and/or receiving notification. Must hold and maintain Basic Life Support certificate from an approved organization and compact RN license in their home stateby date of hire.

Schedule:

Shifts may vary and can include nights, evenings, weekends, and/or holidays based on the needs of the business.

  • Provides fully remote virtual serious illness care management to patients and families throughout our continuum of care; This continuum may include but is not limited to home-based, facility-based, and inpatient adult and pediatric hospice; palliative care; PACE, and additional service lines and programs offered or supported by Chapters Health System.
  • Consults with medical staff, and/or other members of the IDT as indicated to ensure optimal patient care in an effective and efficient manner.

Since 2010, InMarket has been the leader in 360-degree consumer intelligence and real-time activation for thousands of today’s top brands. About the Role

We are hiring a Senior Vice President, Client Success to own the post-sale engine of the business. This is a single point of accountability for how clients experience us after the contract is signed; across Activation, Measurement, and Audiences.

The right person has scaled a client-facing organization through stage transitions; from heroics to systems and knows how to do it without breaking the relationships that carried the company to this point.

Function

Client Operations

  • Campaign and program delivery, onboarding, implementation, and QA

What you Bring:
