jobs.title: Workforce Modernization Architect
jobs.excerpt: Career Team is a leading workforce development organization on a mission to transform lives.
jobs.description:
Career Team is a leading workforce development organization on a mission to transform lives. We blend cutting-edge technology with compassionate, high-touch services to drive real, measurable outcomes in the lives of job seekers across the country. At Career Team, we’re solving today’s unemployment challenges with smart software, world-class trainers, dedicated case managers, dynamic job developers, and innovative partners. If you're passionate about making a difference and believe in the power of technology to transform lives, you’ll feel right at home here.

Career Team is looking for a Workforce Modernization Architect who designs solutions around people, processes, and compliance; not code. Many of Career Team's customers run federally funded workforce development programs. These programs must submit reports to federal agencies in strictly defined formats, such as the WIOA Participant Individual Record Layout (PIRL), and follow detailed logic rules. You'll make sure our government software platform is built to meet those requirements from the start, translate federal reporting specifications into clear business rules, work with technical teams to make sure the system calculates and formats data correctly, and help customers submit accurate, on-time reports.

Role Overview:

  • Own federal reporting requirements. Interpret federal reporting specifications, data standards, and program guidance, with a focus on PIRL and related U.S. Department of Labor and Department of Education reporting. Turn them into detailed functional requirements.
  • Define reporting logic. Write clear, testable business rules for how the system must calculate each reported value. This includes:
    • Reporting periods and date ranges
    • Who counts in each reporting population, including participants, exiters, and co-enrollments across WIOA titles (Title I, Title II, Title III, Title IV)
    • Unduplicated counts and deduplication
    • Enrollment, program participation, and exit logic
    • Age and status calculated as of specific dates
    • Handling of missing, refused, or conflicting data
  • Specify output formats. Document required file layouts, field definitions, code lists, ordering, and file naming conventions (CSV, XML, fixed-width, or agency-specific templates) so exports pass federal validation the first time.
  • Solve compliance issues. Find the root cause of reporting and compliance problems, whether they come from system logic, data entry, or unclear guidance, and lead them through to a documented fix.
  • Resolve ambiguity. Identify gaps or contradictions in federal guidance. Research agency FAQs, TEGLs, and technical assistance resources. Document how the system handles edge cases and the reasoning behind each decision.
  • Lead testing and quality assurance. Build test scenarios and expected results for reporting logic. Partner with QA to review system outputs against specifications and federal validation tools, such as DOL's WIPS edit checks. Trace errors back to the rule or data that caused them.
  • Bridge state case management systems. Apply your knowledge of how different state case management systems capture and structure participant data. Anticipate integration, mapping, and consistency challenges across customers in multiple states.
  • Track regulatory change. Monitor updates to federal specifications, PIRL versions, and reporting cycles. Assess how changes affect the system and customers, and plan updates ahead of deadlines.
  • Build data quality in. Recommend intake workflows, required fields, and validation checks that keep bad data out of the system, instead of fixing it at report time.
  • Support customers during reporting cycles. Help program staff understand their reports, troubleshoot validation errors, and answer questions from grant managers, monitors, and auditors.

Qualifications:

  • Experience in workforce development, including programmatic experience in at least one WIOA program: Title I (Adult, Dislocated Worker, Youth), Title II (Adult Education and Family Literacy), Title III (Wagner-Peyser Employment Service), Title IV (Vocational Rehabilitation), or Title V (Senior Community Service Employment Program)
  • Hands-on experience with PIRL and federal reporting for grant-funded programs
  • Hands-on experience with more than one state case management system
  • Experience with government software, either as a user, implementer, or administrator in a public-sector setting
  • Grant management experience, including an understanding of how reporting ties to performance, funding, and compliance
  • A proven ability to read and interpret technical federal specifications and translate them into precise, unambiguous requirements
  • Strong logical reasoning. You're comfortable expressing rules as clear conditions (if/then logic, inclusion and exclusion criteria, date calculations) and working through edge cases methodically
  • Familiarity with testing and quality assurance practices, including writing test cases and validating report outputs against expected results
  • Meticulous attention to detail. You understand that a single miscounted field or formatting error can cause a report to be rejected or put funding at risk
  • Comfort working in spreadsheets to check counts, reconcile numbers, and trace discrepancies

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with Uniform Guidance (2 CFR 200) and general grants compliance
  • Experience with additional federal reporting systems or data standards, such as WIPS, NRS, RSA-911, HMIS, CAREWare, or Sage
  • Experience working with federal agencies, state workforce agencies, or their technical assistance providers
  • Basic SQL or reporting-tool experience for querying data during validation (helpful, not required)
  • Background as a program administrator, grants manager, or data analyst at a federally funded agency or local workforce development board

What success looks like:

  • In 30 days: You know our platform, the state systems our customers use, and the federal reporting requirements they rely on most, starting with PIRL.
  • In 90 days: You're writing reporting logic specifications and test cases on your own. You're leading requirements conversations with customers, engineers, and QA.
  • In 6 months: Customer reports pass federal validation reliably. Compliance issues are resolved at the root cause. Specification changes are planned ahead of deadlines. Sales and implementation teams rely on you as the go-to expert for compliance-heavy workforce deals.

About Career Team:
Founded in 1996, Career Team, LLC is a private workforce development organization.

Career Team’s outstanding record of accelerating the human condition has resulted in numerous honors:

  • Named by Inc. Magazine as one of America's 500 fastest growing privately held companies
  • Recipient of the US Chamber of Commerce Blue Chip Enterprise Award for innovation
  • Featured by 60 Minutes, CNN, Money Magazine, Inc. Magazine and the British Broadcasting Network as an innovative, government funded solutions program
  • Invited to the White House after being cited by the National Welfare-to-Work Partnership and National Alliance of Business as a top 10 US training provider

As a socially conscious organization, Career Team has found a healthy balance between for-profit innovation and community enrichment. Looking ahead, the organization will continue to close the nation’s opportunity divide with additional government-funded workforce sites; while also building staff capacity of workforce funding sources and industry providers. See www.careerteam.com for more information.

Background Check Requirements. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check (including criminal, prior employment and education verification). Failure to satisfactorily complete the background check may affect the application status of applicants or continued employment of current employees who apply for the position.

Today, as many as 25 million medical professionals globally don’t have access to medical imaging, which is proven to improve patient care and reduce healthcare costs. Your Role

Clarius is looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to build and lead the programs that turn marketing interest into sales-ready demand and keep customers engaged after purchase.

You will own our lifecycle marketing engine across nurture, email, content, database re-engagement, customer marketing, integrated campaigns, and emerging channels such as SMS.

This is a highly hands-on role for a strategic marketer who is also an exceptional writer. You’ll develop campaign strategy, write compelling email and blog content, lead the email experience, and create connected journeys across the customer lifecycle.

You’ll work closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, Growth Marketing, Clinical Marketing, Customer Experience, and Creative to drive engagement, MQLs, product adoption, pipeline, and revenue.

Own Content & Blog Strategy

  • Own the content and editorial calendar, ensuring it supports lifecycle, campaign, product launch, event, SEO, and business priorities.

  • Develop and repurpose content across email, nurture, webinars, events, social, and Sales follow-up.
  • Translate complex clinical and technical information into simple, compelling customer-focused messaging.
  • Partner with Creative to lead the design and customer experience of emails and campaign assets.

  • Partner with Customer Experience to build the marketing communications layer of the post-purchase journey.
  • Develop campaigns that drive awareness and adoption of new features, product capabilities, education, and resources.
  • Support product and feature launches to existing customers with targeted communications.
  • Build lifecycle programs that create future opportunities for expansion, upsell, and upgrades.

  • Build a continuous test-and-learn approach across nurture, email, content, customer marketing, and campaigns.
  • Test messaging, calls to action, sequencing, frequency, offers, segmentation, and channel mix.
  • Measure performance across engagement, MQL conversion, funnel progression, product adoption, pipeline influence, and revenue, using insights to continuously improve performance.

jobs.excerpt: Conversica is seeking a Senior Strategic Account Executive, Automotive to drive new business growth across large and strategically important automotive dealer groups.
jobs.description:
Conversica is seeking a Senior Strategic Account Executive, Automotive to drive new business growth across large and strategically important automotive dealer groups.

This is a senior individual contributor role focused on developing, navigating, and closing opportunities within complex dealer organizations. You'll own a portfolio of strategic dealer groups and work across multiple levels of these organizations, from individual rooftops and operational leaders to executive decision-makers, to build initial relationships, establish value, and expand adoption across the broader group.

We're looking for an experienced automotive technology seller who understands how dealerships operate, knows how buying decisions are made across different dealer group structures, and can quickly establish credibility in the market. You'll need to be equally comfortable opening doors, developing executive relationships, running a complex consultative sales process, and finding creative paths into accounts.

Conversica is a lean, fast-moving organization, and this role is ideal for someone who thrives with autonomy. Beyond closing business, you'll bring insights from the market back into the organization and partner with Product, Customer Success, Marketing, and executive leadership to help shape our evolving Automotive go-to-market strategy.

What You'll Do

    • Own the end-to-end sales process for an assigned portfolio of large and strategic automotive dealer groups, with a strong focus on net-new revenue.

    • Develop and execute account strategies to penetrate complex dealer organizations, identify buying centers, and build relationships with key stakeholders.

    • Build trusted relationships with senior and executive decision-makers, while also developing opportunities from the dealership level when appropriate.

    • Identify opportunities to land within individual rooftops or business units and strategically expand successful relationships across larger dealer groups.

    • Lead complex, consultative sales engagements from initial prospecting and discovery through negotiation and contract execution.

    • Independently build and manage pipeline through targeted prospecting, industry relationships, referrals, events, and other outbound strategies.

    • Develop a deep understanding of each customer's business priorities and position Conversica's AI-powered solutions around measurable business value.

    • Maintain accurate pipeline management, forecasting, and CRM activity.

    • Partner closely with Customer Success to support successful customer transitions and identify opportunities for continued growth.

    • Collaborate with Product, Marketing, and executive leadership, bringing forward customer feedback, competitive intelligence, and market insights that help strengthen our product and go-to-market approach.

    • Represent Conversica at customer meetings, industry events, dealer-group meetings, and other strategic engagements.

    • Travel as needed to develop relationships, advance strategic opportunities, and support the sales process.

What We're Looking For

    • 7+ years of B2B sales experience, including demonstrated success selling technology or SaaS solutions into automotive retail and dealer groups.

    • Deep understanding of the automotive retail ecosystem and how technology purchasing decisions are made within dealer organizations.

    • Demonstrated success developing and closing new business within large, complex dealer groups or comparable strategic automotive accounts.

    • Strong network and established credibility within the automotive retail, dealer group, or automotive technology ecosystem.

    • Proven ability to navigate complex organizations with both centralized and decentralized decision-making structures.

    • Experience engaging and influencing executive-level stakeholders while also building relationships across operational and dealership-level teams.

    • Strong track record of independently creating pipeline and managing opportunities from initial prospecting through close.

    • Excellent consultative selling, negotiation, storytelling, and presentation skills.

    • Ability to operate effectively in a lean, fast-moving environment with a high degree of autonomy and limited formal sales enablement.

    • Strategic and entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to translate customer and market feedback into actionable insights for the broader business.

    • Strong communication, collaboration, and forecasting discipline.

    • Willingness to travel as needed.

What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means becoming a trusted presence within the automotive dealer-group market while consistently creating and closing meaningful new revenue opportunities. You'll successfully penetrate major dealer organizations, build relationships across multiple levels, turn initial wins into broader group adoption, and develop a strong pipeline of strategic opportunities.

    You'll also serve as an important voice of the market internally, helping Conversica understand what customers need, where opportunities exist, and how our Automotive solutions and go-to-market approach can continue to evolve.

What We Offer

At Conversica, you'll join a fully remote, collaborative team where you'll have the autonomy to do meaningful work and the opportunity to make a visible impact as we grow our Automotive business. We offer competitive compensation, including a base salary and performance-based commission, along with a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) retirement plan, flexible time away from work, paid parental leave, and equity participation for eligible roles.

We value curiosity, accountability, collaboration, and people who are excited to help shape what's next. If you thrive in a fast-moving environment where you can influence both customer outcomes and the direction of the business, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.excerpt: For decades, DTN has been the silent force behind some of the world’s most critical industries—helping businesses navigate complexity, uncertainty, and risk with smarter, faster decisions.
jobs.description:
For decades, DTN has been the silent force behind some of the world’s most critical industries—helping businesses navigate complexity, uncertainty, and risk with smarter, faster decisions. From agriculture to energy to weather intelligence, our proprietary Operational Decisioning Platform transforms raw data into decision-grade insights—enabling companies to optimize supply chains, ensure market stability, and safeguard infrastructure against disruption. We don’t follow trends—we set the standard for precision, trust, and operational impact.

DTN is at an exciting inflection point. Building off a foundation of financial strength, profitability, and industry trust, we’re accelerating growth and expanding our global footprint. Our purpose-built solutions—powered by AI and honed by decades of vertical expertise—are helping some of the world’s most significant enterprises thrive amid operational constraints and uncover new opportunities in a fast-changing world.

Job Description:

Position Summary:

DTN is seeking a talented Platform Engineer to help build and evolve the foundational cloud-native capabilities of our Operational Decisioning Platform (ODP).


The DTN Operational Decisioning Platform is an internal platform that packages cloud infrastructure into purpose-built, higher-level capabilities so that our engineers, solutions teams, and customers can build data products, applications, and AI-powered tools without managing the underlying cloud infrastructure themselves.


As a Platform Engineer, you will build and deliver features across the platform's developer-facing APIs, software development kits (SDKs), command-line interfaces (CLIs), module framework, and managed services. You will work autonomously on well-scoped engineering initiatives while collaborating with senior engineers who provide technical guidance, design reviews, and mentorship.


This is an opportunity for an engineer with several years of professional experience to deepen their expertise in AWS cloud-native technologies, distributed systems, and platform engineering. You will help build infrastructure that other engineers depend on while developing the technical judgment and ownership skills needed to advance toward a senior engineering role.


What You Will Be Responsible For:


Platform Feature Development and Delivery

  • Design, build, test, and deploy platform features from initial planning through production delivery.
  • Implement service logic, module functionality, and business logic supporting the DTN Operational Decisioning Platform.
  • Develop and extend developer-facing APIs, SDKs, CLIs, and managed platform capabilities.
  • Write and maintain infrastructure-as-code configurations required to provision and deploy platform services.
  • Independently own moderately complex engineering features from development through deployment, with minimal oversight.
  • Solve day-to-day technical challenges independently while escalating architectural and design questions to senior engineers when appropriate.

Module Framework and Distributed Systems

  • Contribute to the development and evolution of the platform's module framework.
  • Implement interface contracts and business logic within a framework that manages common platform requirements.
  • Work with framework capabilities supporting authentication, authenticated communication, dispatch, validation, metrics, retries, and reconciliation.
  • Develop reliable software components that integrate effectively with the platform's shared services and architectural standards.
  • Apply distributed-systems principles, including asynchronous processing, retry handling, idempotency, and reliable service interactions.
  • Contribute to modular, reusable platform capabilities that enable other engineering teams to build applications and data products without directly managing underlying cloud infrastructure.

Software Quality and Engineering Practices

  • Develop reliable, maintainable, and thoroughly tested production software.
  • Create and maintain automated unit and integration tests to validate application functionality and system behavior.
  • Use established build tooling, continuous integration processes, and automated testing practices.
  • Follow trunk-based development practices to keep code changes deployable and support incremental delivery.
  • Apply established platform standards for security, interface design, infrastructure as code, and software development.
  • Participate in technical design discussions and code reviews, incorporating feedback to continuously improve engineering quality.
  • Use version control and source-management practices to support effective collaboration and reliable software delivery.

Cloud Infrastructure and Operational Support

  • Develop and maintain cloud-native services using AWS infrastructure and platform capabilities.
  • Work with cloud compute, storage, identity and access management, API services, managed data stores, and event-driven technologies.
  • Use Terraform or comparable infrastructure-as-code tools to define and manage cloud infrastructure.
  • Instrument services with appropriate metrics, monitoring, and observability capabilities to support troubleshooting and operational reliability.
  • Participate in the team's supported on-call rotation and assist with investigating service failures and operational incidents.
  • Develop experience troubleshooting distributed-system failures, cross-account interactions, and cloud infrastructure issues.
  • Apply least-privilege access principles and established cloud security practices.
  • Help maintain reliable, observable, and debuggable services across the platform.

AI-Assisted Engineering and Platform Capabilities

  • Use modern AI-assisted software development tools, including coding assistants and agentic development technologies, to support daily engineering activities.
  • Apply AI development tools responsibly to improve coding efficiency, engineering productivity, and software quality.
  • Contribute to AI-augmented platform capabilities, including features supported by large language models (LLMs), AI agents, and related technologies.
  • Collaborate with senior engineers to understand the design and implementation of AI-enabled services within the platform's modular architecture.

Collaboration and Professional Development

  • Collaborate with senior engineers, engineering leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver high-quality platform capabilities.
  • Seek and incorporate feedback from technical design reviews, code reviews, and mentoring opportunities.
  • Continuously develop expertise in AWS cloud architecture, distributed systems, infrastructure automation, and platform engineering.
  • Demonstrate increasing independence, technical judgment, and ownership as engineering responsibilities grow.

What You Will Bring to the Position:


Professional Experience and Education

  • 2–5 years of professional software engineering experience developing and shipping production software.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent professional experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently deliver moderately complex software features from development through deployment.
  • Ability to solve routine engineering challenges with minimal oversight while recognizing when additional technical guidance is appropriate.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, technical curiosity, and a commitment to continuous professional growth.

Programming and Application Development

  • Solid programming skills in TypeScript and Node.js, or strong proficiency in another modern programming language with a demonstrated ability to quickly learn TypeScript/Node.js.
  • Academic or professional software development exposure to front-end technologies such as React, Angular, or Vue.
  • Academic or professional software development exposure to back-end technologies such as Node.js or Python.
  • Experience developing APIs using RESTful services built with Node.js.
  • Experience consuming both REST and GraphQL APIs.
  • Understanding of REST API design, JSON, and service-based application development.
  • Solid understanding of source control and versioning using Git.

Cloud Infrastructure and Distributed Systems

  • Working knowledge of AWS and fundamental cloud computing concepts, including compute, storage, identity and access management, and APIs.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code technologies such as Terraform or comparable tools.
  • Understanding of fundamental distributed-systems concepts, including asynchronous processing, retries, and idempotency, or demonstrated ability to learn these concepts quickly.
  • Familiarity with standard engineering practices, including version control, code reviews, continuous integration, and automated testing.
  • Academic or professional experience with SQL and database technologies such as PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, or equivalent database platforms.
  • Interest in expanding technical expertise in cloud-native infrastructure, distributed systems, and shared platform capabilities.

AI Development and Engineering Growth

  • Familiarity with modern AI development toolkits, including AI-assisted coding tools and agentic development technologies.
  • Interest in contributing to AI-augmented platform capabilities involving LLMs, AI agents, and related services with guidance from senior engineers.
  • A growth mindset demonstrated through receptiveness to feedback, continuous learning, and a commitment to improving the quality of engineering work.

What Will Make You Stand Out:


  • Exposure to serverless and event-driven cloud services.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code modules, schema-based validation, observability tooling, containerized services, or continuous integration pipelines.
  • Interest or experience in platform engineering, developer tooling, or infrastructure development, particularly building systems and capabilities that other engineers use.
  • Exposure to cloud security concepts, including identity and access management, TLS/mTLS, service authentication, and signing.
  • Familiarity with modern AWS cloud-native architectures involving serverless compute, API layers, managed data stores, and event-driven services.
  • Experience developing reusable software components, shared service interfaces, or developer-facing platform capabilities.
  • Familiarity with tested and validated interfaces, trunk-based development, infrastructure as code, and least-privilege access practices.
  • Background or interest in operational or data-intensive industries such as energy, logistics, weather, or agriculture.

What You Can Expect from DTN

  • Competitive Salary
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Flexible working hours
  • Remote work model (position dependent)
  • Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance Plans
  • 6% 401K matching
  • Unlimited access to 13k+ courses via learning platform to support employee career advancement
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Compensation:

The targeted hiring base pay range for this position is between $85,000 and $113,000. DTN is a pay for performance organization, which means there is the opportunity to advance your compensation with performance over time. The actual base pay offered for this position will be dependent upon many factors, including but not limited to: prior work experience, training/education, transferable skills, business needs, internal equity and applicable laws. The targeted hiring base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for market competitive variable pay and benefits.


About DTN:

DTN is a global data and technology company helping operational leaders in energy, agriculture, and weather-driven industries make faster, smarter decisions. Our Operational Decisioning Platform turns complex data into decision-grade insights—empowering customers to expand their margins, accelerate growth, and outpace risk. With more than 1,200 employees globally, DTN serves the companies that feed, fuel, and protect the world.

At DTN, we value clarity,trust, and action. We’re a team of problem-solvers, outcome-drivers, and industry nerds who believe that precision matters – and that mission is at the core of what we do.

  • Trust Built: We earn it. We keep it. We protect it. Our neutrality, precision, and integrity are non-negotiable.

  • Confidence-Driven: We help customers move with clarity and conviction. We bring the data and operational knowledge leaders need to act.

  • Built for Industry: We speak operations because we come from operations. Our expertise is forged in fuel terminals, fields, flight paths, and forecasts.

  • Future-Forward: We see what’s coming- and we’re ready. We help customers lead through change with smarter decisioning.

Any offers are extended directly by our Talent Acquisition team following a formal interview process.

As electric vehicles (EVs) drive a transformation of the transport and mobility sectors, AMPECO is at the forefront of that grand revolution, and we’re just getting started.

As a Solutions Architecture Lead at AMPECO you will be a senior individual contributor who guides customers through the architecture, design, and delivery of complex technical projects, from the first conversation to a successful project go-live.

You will work on specific engagements and can join as early as the pre-sales stage. With a new prospect, you will help define the overall solution architecture and migration strategy. You will also own the planning, estimation, and risk assessment that support bidding and contracting.

Once a prospect becomes an AMPECO customer, you will lead their onboarding and migration. When the project is complete, you will hand them over smoothly to a business-as-usual setup. As existing customers take on new integrations or complex initiatives, you might again lead the planning and delivery.

This role is highly visible and carries real technical authority. You will be the senior strategic and technical voice for customers at the most critical point in their relationship with AMPECO. We are looking for someone who is equally confident in business and technical conversations, and who can turn complex requirements into clear, achievable plans.

Considered an advantage

  • Familiarity with Energy Management

Ensemble Performing Arts is seeking an experienced Senior Financial Analyst ready for the next step in their career. This role reports to the VP, FP&A and sits at the center of our financial data and reporting operations, owning everything from business analytics and reporting to budgeting and forecasting to cash flow modeling. You'll thrive in this role if you're comfortable building order out of ambiguity — pulling together disparate data sources, spotting patterns others miss, and turning raw numbers into insights leadership can act on.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is forward-thinking, process-oriented, and detail-obsessed, with strong Excel skills and a genuine curiosity about how AI tools can make financial analysis faster and sharper.

Key Responsibilities

Data & Reporting Leadership

  • Serve as a key owner of financial data integrity, reporting structures, and recurring management reporting
  • Consolidate and reconcile data from multiple, often disconnected systems and sources into clean, reliable reporting packages
  • Design and maintain dashboards and reports that give stakeholders a clear, timely view of business performance
  • Identify opportunities to standardize and automate recurring reporting processes

Business Analytics

  • Partner with business unit leaders to analyze performance drivers, margins, and key operating metrics
  • Build financial and operational models to support strategic decisions (pricing, headcount planning, new initiatives, etc.)
  • Translate complex data into concise, actionable recommendations for non-financial stakeholders

Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Lead or support the annual budgeting process, partnering with department heads to build accurate, defensible budgets
  • Own periodic forecast updates, incorporating actuals, business trends, and changing assumptions
  • Perform variance analysis between actuals, budget, and forecast, and translate the "why" into clear narrative for leadership

Cash Flow Forecasting

  • Build and maintain rolling cash flow forecasts across short- and long-term horizons
  • Monitor actual cash performance against forecast and flag risks or opportunities early
  • Support liquidity planning and working capital analysis

Who You Are

  • A data wrangler: you're energized, not intimidated, by raw data pulled from many systems (ERP, student billing platforms, e-commerce, spreadsheets), and you can turn it into one reliable source of truth
  • Detail-obsessed: you catch the error before it reaches leadership, and you build checks and reconciliations into your work
  • A process improver: you can't help but streamline, document, standardize, and automate recurring work so it scales across a growing network
  • AI-forward: you actively use AI tools to speed up modeling, data cleanup, and variance commentary, and you know how to validate what they produce
  • A business partner: you bring real business acumen, ask the right questions of business unit leaders, and turn the numbers into decisions rather than just reports
  • A P&L steward: you provide oversight of P&L performance across multiple entities, reviewing monthly results, explaining variances to budget and forecast, and flagging margin or cost issues early
  • A confident communicator: you can present to senior leadership and explain financial concepts clearly to non-finance audiences

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance or similar
  • 3–6 years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, investment banking, or a similar analytical finance role, ideally with at least one full budget cycle owned end-to-end
  • Experience working within multi-unit or multi-state environments; experience with schools, education, membership, or subscription-based businesses is a strong plus
  • Solid understanding of US GAAP principles
  • Working knowledge of a major ERP or planning system (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Workday Adaptive Planning, Anaplan)
  • Prior experience working across multiple, non-integrated data systems and building the connective tissue between them
  • Comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy in a fully remote, fast-scaling environment

Compensation & Benefits

The compensation range for this position is $85,000–$105,000 per year, commensurate with experience. A competitive benefits package is provided, including a 401(k) with employer match; health, vision, and dental benefits; and Paid Time-Off.

About Ensemble Performing Arts

Ensemble Performing Arts is one of the fastest-growing platforms of independently-run performing arts schools and businesses in the United States. We are powered by passionate educators and supported by a team that believes in preserving what makes each school and business unit special. With a multi-state, multi-entity footprint and active M&A pipeline, we are committed to operational excellence and a people-first culture grounded in respect, flexibility, and shared purpose. We offer opportunities for growth and leadership in a fast-scaling organization and a chance to directly shape the finance function of a mission-driven company.

🚀 The Vision: Building the Operating System for Product Creation

Since 2013, THE/STUDIO has been building the definitive operating system for product creation. We are combining modern SaaS technology with custom manufacturing to make producing physical goods as seamless, fast, and scalable as launching software.

We operate two core platforms: Customize Now (our best-in-class, on-demand manufacturing platform) and Source Anything (our new SaaS product that enables customers to seamlessly work with global factories beyond our own network).

💻 The Role

We’re looking for a proactive Customer Success Manager (CSM) to own the post-sales relationship and guide our clients through every step of their product development and custom manufacturing journey.

Many of our clients are launching or scaling apparel/product lines with little to no manufacturing experience, while others are seasoned industry veterans. As their primary strategic guide, you will onboard new customers, demystify the custom production process, and serve as the critical bridge coordinating between the client, our design team, and factory/sourcing partners.

You’ll spot where projects are stalling (whether on the client, design, or factory side), relentlessly unblock delays, provide hands-on guidance on fabric and garment feedback, and identify key expansion opportunities as production runs complete.

Why This Role Is Exciting:

  • Direct Access to Leadership: You will have the opportunity to work directly with our CEO and executive team, giving you high visibility, direct mentorship, and a seat at the table.

  • Product & Strategic Influence: We operate with flat hierarchies. Your daily insights from the ground level will directly shape our product roadmap, workflows, and company strategy.

  • Rapid Scale & Career Trajectory: We are growing rapidly. Joining us right now means high autonomy, minimal red tape, and massive room for personal and professional acceleration.

🎯 What You’ll Do

  • Post-Sales Journey & Onboarding: Own the end-to-end customer onboarding and post-sales experience, educating new clients on manufacturing workflows and guiding them confidently from concept to final delivery.

  • Cross-Functional Orchestration: Serve as the central air-traffic controller coordinating closely between clients, design specialists, and factory/sourcing teams to keep projects moving smoothly.

  • Proactive Risk & Bottleneck Detection: Monitor account progress to spot where production or approvals are stalling—on the client side, design side, or factory floor—and jump in to unblock issues before they cause delays.

  • Strategic Growth & Upselling: Identify timing and opportunities for expansion—for example, as a client nears the end of a bulk production run, partner with design to proactively pitch relevant trends, new products, and re-orders.

  • Portfolio & Health Management: Manage a active portfolio of SMB and mid-market accounts, maintaining clean account notes, tracking key milestones, and monitoring production metrics in HubSpot.

  • Feedback Loop: Gather real-time customer insights on their production experience and share cross-functional feedback with Sourcing, Product, and Sales to continuously improve our platform.

💡 The Profile We’re Looking For (Our Core Pillars)

Our Founder/CEO defines our top performers by three distinct traits. If this describes how you operate, you will thrive here:

  1. Raw Intelligence & Problem-Solving: High processing power, business acumen, and logical reasoning. You can think on your feet, connect complex ideas, and break down ambiguous problems quickly.

  2. "Give a Shit" Energy (Extreme Ownership): You take 100% accountability for your domain and outcomes. You don't make excuses or blame external factors. You look inward, find solutions, and push across the finish line.

  3. Rapid Adaptation & Radical Candor: You embrace blunt, constructive feedback and pivot instantly without ego. You excel in a fast-moving environment where you need to act with urgency without waiting for hand-holding.

🧩 What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or client-facing operations (preferably in e-commerce, custom apparel, manufacturing, or tech-enabled platforms).

  • High Empathy & Educational Mindset: Able to guide novice clients through complex technical/manufacturing concepts with patience and clarity, while maintaining authority with experienced buyers.

  • Cross-Functional & Project Coordinator: Skilled at managing multi-party workflows (client - internal design - factory teams) and keeping everyone on schedule.

  • Proactive Problem-Solver: A natural eye for detail who spots operational bottlenecks early and takes immediate ownership to resolve them.

  • Up-Selling & Commercial Instincts: Comfortable identifying expansion moments and partnering with design/product teams to suggest timely, trend-relevant solutions to growing accounts.

  • Technical & CRM Fluency: Strong working knowledge of HubSpot (or similar CRMs) to manage pipeline, account notes, and key activity metrics.

  • Garment/Product Knowledge (Plus): Prior experience or strong interest in apparel development, fabric sourcing, or custom production is a major advantage.

  • Startup Mindset: Resilient, high-energy, autonomous mid-to-senior individual contributor who operates with urgency and clear ownership.

💰 Compensation & Terms

  • Flexible & Competitive: We offer competitive, outcome-driven compensation packages tailored to the candidate's level of impact.

  • Engagement Type: Full-time, exclusive independent contractor role.

🔎 Our Hiring Process

  1. Submit Application: IMPORTANT! Please submit your resume/CV in English

jobs.excerpt: POSITION SUMMARY: Responsible for screening prior-authorization and coordination of specialized services requests in the medical care management program, including a broad range of requests for inpatient, outpatient and ancillary services.
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

Responsible for screening prior-authorization and coordination of specialized services requests in the medical care management program, including a broad range of requests for inpatient, outpatient and ancillary services. Adheres to policies and procedures in order to comply with performance and compliance standards and to ensure cost effective and appropriate healthcare delivery. Maintains current knowledge of network resources for referral and linkage to member’s and provider’s needs. Authorizes certain specified services, under the supervision of the manager, according to departmental guidelines. Per standard workflows, forwards specified requests to the clinician for review and processing. Answers ACD line calls from providers and other departments and redirects, as needed.

The Prior Authorization Specialist role belongs to the Revenue Cycle Patient Access team and is responsible for coordinating all financial clearance activities by navigating all pre-registration (to include acquiring or validating patient demographic, insurance, and other required elements along with insurance verification activities), obtaining referral authorization, or precertification number(s). The role ensures timely access to care while maximizing BMC hospital reimbursement. This role requires adherence to quality assurance guidelines as well as established productivity standards to support the work unit’s performance expectations. This position reports to the Patient Access Supervisor and requires interaction and collaboration with important stakeholders in the financial clearance process including but not limited to insurance company representatives, patients, physicians, Boston Medical Center (BMC) practice staff, case management and Patient Financial Counseling. This is a Remote Position.

Position: Prior Authorization Specialist I

Department: Insurance Verification

Schedule: Part Time

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES/DUTIES:

  • Prioritizes incoming Prior Authorization requests.

  • Processes incoming requests, including authorizing specified services, as outlined in departmental policies, procedures, and workflow guidelines.

  • Refers authorization requests that require clinical judgment to Prior Authorization Clinician, Manager, or Medical Director.

  • Meets or exceeds position metrics and Turn-Around Timeframes while maintaining a full caseload.

  • Supports Prior Authorization Clinicians.

  • Answers ACD line calls, verifies member eligibility and enters into CCMS or Facets the information necessary to complete the caller’s request.

  • Identifies and informs callers of network providers, services, and available member benefits.

  • Informs provider of decision per department procedure.

  • Coordinates resolution of escalated member or provider inquiries as related to Prior Authorization.

  • Works with members, providers and key departments to promote an understanding of Prior Authorization requirements and processes.

  • Maintains general understanding of applicable sections of member handbooks, and evidence of coverage.

  • Monitors accounts routed to registration and prior authorization work queues and clears work queues by obtaining all necessary patient and/or payer-specific financial clearance elements in accordance with established management guidelines.

  • Maintains knowledge of and complies with insurance companies’ requirements for obtaining prior authorizations/referrals, and completes other activities to facilitate all aspects of financial clearance.

  • Acts as subject matter experts in navigating both the BMC and payer policies to get the appropriate approvals (authorizations, pre-certs, referrals, for example) for the scheduled care to proceed. The Authorization Specialist is an important part of the larger patient care team and helps clinicians understand what payer requirements are necessary for the widest possible patient access to services.

  • Uses appropriate strategies to underscore the most efficient process to obtaining insurance verification, authorizations and referrals, including on line databases, electronic correspondence, faxes, and phone calls.

  • Obtains and clearly documents all referral/prior authorizations for scheduled services prior to admission within the Epic environment.

  • Works collaboratively with primary care practices, specialty practices, referring physicians, primary care physicians, insurance carriers, patients and any other parties to ensure that required managed care referrals and prior authorizations for specified specialty visits and other services are obtained and appropriately recorded in the relevant practice management systems for patient appointments/visits prior to scheduled patient visits or retro-actively if not in place at the time of the appointment/visit. Ensure that approval numbers are appropriately linked to the relevant patient appointment/visit.

  • Collaborates with patients, providers, and departments to obtain all necessary information and payer permissions prior to patients’ scheduled services.

  • Liaison between physician and payer for peer to peer review when needed

  • Escalates accounts that have been denied or will not be financially cleared as outlined by department policy

  • Interview patients, families or referring physicians via telephone in advance of the patient’s appointment/visit whenever possible, to obtain all necessary information, including but not limited to, financial and demographic information required for reimbursement and compliance for services rendered.

  • Ensure that all updated demographic and insurance information is accurately recorded in the appropriate registration systems for primary, secondary and tertiary insurances.

  • Review all registration and insurance information in systems and reconcile with information available from insurance carriers. For any insurance updates, utilize any available resources to validate the updated insurance information, insurance plan eligibility, primary care physician, subscriber information, employer information and appointment/visit information. Contact patients as necessary if clarifications or other follow-up is required, and at all times maintain sensitivity and a clear customer friendly approach.

  • For self-pay patients or patients with unresolved insurance, and for financial counseling, refer patients Patient Financial Counseling.

  • Maintains confidentiality of patient’s financial and medical records; adheres to the State and Federal laws regulating collection in healthcare; adheres to enterprise and other regulatory confidentiality policies; and advises management of any potential compliance issues immediately.

  • Participates in educational offerings sponsored by BMC or other development opportunities as assigned/available and complies with all applicable organizational workflows, as well as established policies and procedures.

  • Demonstrates knowledge & skills necessary to provide level of customer experience as aligned with BMC management expectations.

  • Demonstrates the ability to recognize situations that require escalation to the Supervisor.

  • Takes opportunity to know and learn other roles and processes and works together to assist with process improvement initiatives as directed.

  • Consistently meets productivity and quality expectations to align performance with assigned roles and responsibilities.

  • Handle ACD telephone calls and emails in a timely fashion, following applicable scripting and customer service standards. Appropriately manage all calls by either working with the customer or referring the call to the appropriate party.

  • Regularly undergo Quality Audits to achieve the required standard.

  • Contact the Help Desk in the BMC Information Technology Department to report faulty systems or hardware. Notify area supervisor or manager if problem is not addressed in a timely manner. For other broken or malfunctioning equipment to be serviced, contact the appropriate vendor or department and notify supervisor.

  • Communicate with all internal and external customers effectively and courteously.

  • Attend all necessary hospital and department training as required.

  • Assists in the orientation of new personnel under the direction of a manager or Supervisor.

  • Perform other related duties as assigned or required.

  • Must adhere to all of BMC’s RESPECT behavioral standards.

(The above statements in this job description are intended to depict the general nature and level of work assigned to the employee(s) in this job. The above is not intended to represent an exhaustive list of accountable duties and responsibilities required).

JOB REQUIREMENTS

EDUCATION:

  • High school diploma or GED required.

  • Associate’s Degree or higher preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 4-5 years of office experience, specifically in either a high volume data entry office, customer service call center or health care office or hospital administration is required.

  • Experience using Insurance payer websites (i.e Blue Cross Blue Shield, Medicare, etc.)

  • Customer service experience preferred.

  • Experience with insurance verification, prior authorization, pre-certification and financial clearance process. ​

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES (KSAs):

  • Bilingual preferred

  • Ability to process high volume of requests with a 95% or greater accuracy rate

  • Ability to prioritize work load when processing referrals and authorization requests per guidelines and within specified Turn Around Timeframes

  • Effective collaboration skills

  • Strong oral and written communication skills

  • Thorough knowledge of financial clearance process is a must. Familiarity with insurances, referral authorizations and third party billing procedures.

  • Knowledge of basic medical terminology and ICD-9/CPT coding is helpful.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills to build and maintain strong relationships with managers, colleagues, and third party payers.

  • Must be self-directed and highly organized with the ability to multitask, manage complex processes, and maintain fair sense of urgency.

  • Requires ability to make independent decisions under pressure.

  • Requires excellent judgment, diplomacy, collaboration, partnering, teamwork, and customer service skills.

  • Ability to maintain confidentiality of all personal/health sensitive information.

  • Must be comfortable with ambiguity, exhibit good decision making and judgment capabilities, attention to detail.

  • Knowledge of and experience within Epic is preferred.

  • Demonstrates technical proficiency within assigned Epic work queues and applicable ancillary systems, including but not limited to: ADT/Prelude/Grand Centrale.

  • Must be able to maintain strict confidentiality of all personal/health sensitive information.

  • Basic computer proficiency inclusive of ability to access, enter and interpret computerized data/information including proficiency in Microsoft Suite applications, specifically Excel, Word, Outlook and Zoom.

  • Knowledge of medical terminology and/ or coding.

jobs.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the team

US Tax Operations resolves tax notices that clients receive from the IRS and state agencies, and runs the filings and payments work that prevents those notices in the first place. The team includes a notice-resolution organization of roughly 50 specialists across 7 managers and 2 pillar leads, and a filings, payments, and amendments organization of 4 teams under a third pillar lead.

About the role

US Tax Operations has been given broad access to AI tooling, including Rippling's own AI platform, to speed up how the department builds and automates its workflows. Without a dedicated technical owner, that access has produced a lot of partially built tools with no reliable way to verify whether they work or are accurate. We're hiring a Systems Lead to bring real engineering discipline to this effort: evaluating what's been built, fixing or replacing what doesn't hold up, and owning the systems and data infrastructure the department runs on going forward.

What you'll do

  • Own the technical systems and data infrastructure behind US Tax Operations reporting, automation, and workflow tools.
  • Evaluate the AI-assisted and automated tools currently being built informally across the team, and decide what's accurate and durable versus what needs to be rebuilt.
  • Build dashboards, data pipelines, and reporting that give managers and leadership reliable, self-service visibility into volume, performance, and quality.
  • Partner directly with managers to find where automation and AI tooling can reduce manual work, and build well-governed solutions instead of one-off scripts.
  • Bring technical standards and review discipline to an organization that hasn't had a dedicated technical owner before.

What we're looking for

  • Hands-on proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience on a modern data platform such as Snowflake or Databricks.
  • Experience building dashboards and reporting with a BI tool such as Power BI or equivalent.
  • Comfortable evaluating and working with AI-assisted tooling and automation platforms. Direct experience with Rippling AI is a plus but not required.
  • 3-6 years of relevant experience spanning project-level execution to technical build.
  • Ability to work independently, assess partially built tools critically, and bring a systems-thinking, engineering-minded approach to an operations environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience in an operations, support, or shared-services environment.
  • Experience introducing technical standards or governance to a team that didn't previously have them.

Note: This role is fully remote for candidates based in India.

About AlphaSense:

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Team:

The User Management team owns the full identity lifecycle at AlphaSense — from creating and provisioning users, through managing their identities, to authenticating who they are and authorizing what they can do in the system. Our work spans three core domains:

  • User Management — creating, provisioning, and managing user identities
  • Authentication — verifying who users are
  • Authorization — determining what users can do in the system

We are a product platform team, not a product team: we build the identity and access infrastructure that other engineering teams build on top of, rather than shipping user-facing features ourselves. We also act as a security guardrail for AlphaSense, since identity and access sit at the center of how the platform stays secure.

The team is well-established and senior, based in Helsinki, Finland. We're now expanding into Canada to build follow-the-sun coverage, so our customers get proper support around the clock, and to push deliberately toward a true platform model — scaling our authentication and authorization systems so they can be safely self-served by teams across the company.

About the Role:

This is a Staff Engineer role on the team that manages identity and access for AlphaSense's entire, and constantly growing, customer base, and that nearly every product engineering team depends on for user and entitlement data. You'll work across all three pillars of identity: creating and managing users, authenticating them, and authorizing what they can do — designing systems built to scale with a constantly growing number of users. Security is core to this role, not adjacent to it — you'll work closely with our security teams to make sure what we build is secure by design, in an environment governed by SOC2 and GDPR.

We're looking for a genuinely senior, self-sufficient engineer with strong experience building and operating identity, authentication, or authorization platforms at scale, ideally in a platform/product-platform engineering context. This is someone who doesn't just execute a roadmap, but helps understand the needs behind it, shapes it, and then drives execution — largely autonomously, and in close collaboration with our core team based in Helsinki. You're genuinely interested in security, comfortable partnering closely with security teams on secure-by-design systems, and comfortable working in a distributed, cross-timezone setup — based in Canada, collaborating closely with a Helsinki-based team.

Who You Are:

  • Backend: Java 2X, Spring Boot 3.X.X, WebFlux, Maven
  • Data & APIs: SQL, GraphQL, gRPC, REST
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, Helm
  • Identity & Security Protocols: RBAC/ABAC/ReBAC; OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and JWT; SAML 2.0 and enterprise SSO federation (assertion validation, signature/encryption handling, IdP- vs. SP-initiated flows); SCIM for user provisioning and deprovisioning
  • Engineering Practices: Event-driven architecture patterns; TDD or a genuine passion for automated testing

[Nice to Have]

  • Auth0 experience
  • SpiceDB / Zanzibar-style authorization system experience
  • Apollo Federation
  • OpenTelemetry
  • Experience operating within SOC2 and/or GDPR-compliant environments

What You’ll Do:

This role spans all three pillars of our identity platform in equal measure — this is not an authorization-only or authentication-only role.

  • Design, build, and evolve our authorization platform (RBAC/ABAC/ReBAC), enabling teams across the company to answer "what can this user do?"
  • Design, build, and evolve our authentication platform, covering authentication patterns across our range of use cases, working closely with our Auth0 integration
  • Design, build, and evolve our user management platform — creating, provisioning, and managing user identities and entitlements — supporting our entire customer base
  • Partner closely with security teams to ensure our authentication, authorization, and user management platforms are secure by design and aligned with SOC2 and GDPR requirements
  • Design and implement highly scalable systems that keep pace with a constantly growing number of users and customers
  • Help define the long-term roadmap across all three domains — authentication, authorization, and user management — not just execute against one handed to you
  • Build self-service systems and APIs (GraphQL, gRPC, REST) that make authentication, authorization, and user data consumable by product engineering teams across the company
  • Drive projects autonomously from Canada while staying closely aligned with our Helsinki-based team
  • Champion strong testing, observability, and reliability practices across the platform

For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

You may also be offered equity, and a generous benefits program.

As a Scrum Master, you love contributing to the in-depth growth of development teams brought together for our clients. You will focus on the agile process of the team, support this process by making it more efficient and improving collaboration. In a nutshell, your most important task is to facilitate a good development process of the team. You enthuse the team to follow specific methodologies and solve any roadblocks the team encounters within their process. You also coach the team in their agile abilities and answer any process related questions from both the team as well as other stakeholders.

What are you going to do?

You will be part of a young and growing organization that aims to develop the best cross-platform mobile apps out there. As a Scrum Master, you’ll be responsible for creating a team spirit within a group of developers. You’ll act as a link between our developers, clients and third parties and keep the focus on the end goal. In addition, you’ll ensure that you will keep an open attitude but remain critical to make sure requirements are met for the customer while keeping everyone informed on project progress, status, schedule, deadlines, and releases.

You’ll be transparent and open about the choices made and to be made. You’ll know the ins and outs of the market and translate this into user stories. You’ll also be realistic and pragmatic and willing to cooperate.

Who are we looking for?

For this position, we are looking for someone who has very strong communication skills, experience with a role as a Scrum Master in an Agile work environment and an interest in the world of app development.

Ideally, you have some (Xamaring, C#, .NET) programming experience and you have at least two years’ experience in a comparable position. A PSM II certification is a big plus! We are known for our deep expertise in the Microsoft Xamarin mobile ecosystem as well as our signature friendly and efficient team approach.

  • Ideally, programming experience

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Game Animator - Character & Combat Animation

  • Project Scope:Project-Based Game Animation

  • Location:Fully Remote - Open to candidates across all locations.

  • Role Type:Project-Based Contractor, with potential for longer-term collaboration if the project secures funding.

  • Reports to: You will work directly with the founder to produce combat and supporting animations for a cast of humanoid characters and creatures, bringing existing 3D characters to life for a cinematic game demo.

  • Start Date: ASAP.

  • Engagement: Project-based, with compensation agreed per character or for the overall project.

  • Portfolio:Applications without attached portfolio will not be considered

The opportunity

Our client is developing a medieval Soulslike action RPG inspired by games such asDark Souls, Bloodborne, Demon's Souls,andElden Ring. The concept art, 3D models, and textures are complete, and most characters are already skinned and rigged. The next major milestone is a cinematic demo to help secure funding, and high-quality character animation is the key remaining step.

We are looking for a skilledGame Animator to produce smooth, realistic, combat-focused animations for approximately 8–10 characters, including both humanoids and creatures.You will work directly with the founder, using visual references to match the desired quality and style while independently making decisions about combat timing and feel.

All animations must be delivered in Unreal Engine 5-ready format. You can use your preferred animation software, such as Blender or Maya, and work through the character lineup one character at a time.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a significant part of the project's visual development, with the possibility of continued collaboration as the game progresses and secures funding.

About the Organization

Our Client is developing a medieval action RPG inspired by the Soulslike genre, with a focus on distinctive characters, immersive environments, and high-quality combat animation. The project is currently working toward a cinematic demo to support its next stage of development and fundraising.

What you will do

  • Create high-quality combat and supporting animations for humanoid characters and creatures, working through the cast one character at a time.

  • Produce smooth, realistic animations that match the reference quality and style provided by the founder.

  • Independently determine combat timing and feel, including attack windups, active frames, recovery periods, and dodge windows.

  • Work with existing character models, skeletons, and rigs, identifying any rigging issues or cleanup needed before animation.

  • Deliver polished animation assets in Unreal Engine 5-ready format, using your preferred 3D animation software.

  • Collaborate directly with the founder through review and feedback cycles, refining animations based on comments from the founder and project funder.

  • Coordinate with environment artists when needed to animate characters interacting with specific environmental assets or elements.

  • Support the final character presentation process, including character placement within environments as part of the cinematic demo production.


Requirements

What you bring

  • A strong character animation portfolio demonstrating smooth, realistic, high-quality combat animation in motion.

  • The ability to match the combat quality and style of Soulslike games such asDark Souls, Bloodborne, Demon's Souls,andElden Ring.

  • A strong understanding of combat timing and feel, including attack windups, active frames, recovery periods, and dodge windows, with the ability to make these decisions independently.

  • Experience animating both humanoid characters and creatures.

  • The ability to deliver polished animations in Unreal Engine 5-ready format.

  • The ability to work independently, interpret visual references, and collaborate directly with the founder throughout production and feedback cycles.

  • Experience using a suitable 3D animation tool, such as Blender or Maya. The specific tool is flexible.

Nice to have:

  • Previous credits on a shipped or in-development Soulslike game or action RPG.

Additional information:

  • Both keyframe animation and motion-capture-based workflows are welcome, provided the final animations meet the required quality standard.

  • Motion-capture equipment or studio access is not required. If needed for specific movements, the client can arrange access to a UK studio and actors.

  • Most of the work is expected to involve animation from scratch or keyframe cleanup.

  • A few characters may still require rigging adjustments or cleanup before animation.

How the Engagement works

Project-Based Contractor, initially paid per character or for the overall project, with quotes requested for both where possible. The scope will be agreed upon based on the number of characters, animation requirements, estimated workload, and portfolio quality. The project is expected to start ASAP, with the potential for longer-term collaboration if the game secures funding.

  • Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments
  • Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable)

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

In addition to base salary, employees will participate in either an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based, uncapped sales incentive plan. jobs.excerpt: Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators.
jobs.description:
Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators. World changers. Individuals who believe in progress with purpose. Since 1932, our people-centered strategy has defined us — and helped us grow a team that now serves over 180,000 learners worldwide.

Our mission to transform lives is made possible by talented people who bring diverse industry experience, backgrounds and skills to the university. And today, we're ready to expand our reach. All we need is you.

The opportunity

At SNHU, you'll have the option to work remotely in the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming.


Learn To Be is a nonprofit that gives free 1-on-1 online tutoring to K–12 students from under-resourced communities. Every week, some students are waiting for a tutor. As an Operations Assistant, your job is to make sure none of them wait too long. You’ll work with and report to the Learn To Be Operations team.


We’re looking for someone who uses AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude extensively, and not just for homework help or the basic stuff. You’ve built real things with them: an app, an automation, a spreadsheet workflow, a custom GPT, anything. You’d rather figure something out than wait to be told how, and you care about kids getting a fair shot.


Speaking Spanish is a plus, since many of our families speak Spanish at home.


Job Responsibilities

  • Keep track of every student waiting for a tutor, starting with students who come to us through our partner organizations
  • Find out why a student hasn’t been paired yet (no tutor available for that time, subject or grade, or a family that stopped responding) and fix it
  • Follow up with families and tutors by phone, email and text so pairings actually start
  • Use ChatGPT, Claude and similar tools to speed up this work: drafting messages, cleaning up spreadsheets, spotting patterns, building small tools
  • Tell the Operations team what’s broken in the process and help fix it.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Current enrollment in classes as part of a SNHU degree program
  • Work study part of financial aid package
  • Students with work study may be prioritized
  • Able to work 15–20 hours every week, reliably and predictably, including during midterms and finals
  • Experience using AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude to build something real
  • Clear, friendly written communication and comfortable making phone calls to parents and volunteers
  • Consent to a DOJ Dru Sjodin Sex Offender Database Background check
  • Have access to a device with internet access and a working webcam

Learning Outcomes (NACE Competencies)

  • Develop Communication skills through phone, email and text conversations with families, volunteer tutors and Learn To Be staff
  • Enhance Technology skills by using AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude to draft messages, organize data and build small tools that solve real problems
  • Improve Critical Thinking by figuring out why each student is still waiting for a tutor and deciding how to fix it
  • Build Professionalism through reliable weekly hours and follow-through on every family you contact
  • Strengthen Teamwork skills by working closely with the Operations team
  • Develop Equity & Inclusion awareness by working with families from many different backgrounds and communities

Work Schedule
15-20 hours per week on a consistent, reliable schedule set with Learn To Be’s Operations team. Late afternoons and evenings are a plus as that is when families are easiest to reach.


We believe real innovation comes from inclusion - where different experiences, perspectives and talents are celebrated. So if you're wondering whether SNHU is right for you, take the leap and apply. You might be just the person we're looking for.


If you have a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to fully engage in any part of the application or hiring process, please complete the Accommodation Request form or contact us at 603-626-9447. A member from the Employee Accommodation Support Center will be in contact with you within two business days to discuss your request.
