Vera Therapeutics’ flagship commercial product is TRUTAKNATM (atacicept-vymj), a B-cell activating factor (BAFF) and A proliferation-inducing ligand (APRIL) inhibitor. Vera Therapeutics is evaluating multiple diseases where the reduction of autoantibodies through inhibition of BAFF and APRIL may prove clinically meaningful. Vera Therapeutics was founded in 2016 and is based in Brisbane, California. To learn more, visit .
At Vera, our values are the cornerstone of our culture and guide how we work together every day. We lead with empathy, act with an owner’s mindset, demand clarity, work without fences, and execute with urgency because patients are counting on us. From how we hire and develop our people to how we advance rigorous science, we are building a team committed to transforming medicine in autoimmune diseases, starting with the kidney.

Position Summary:

This position is responsible for creating, directing, and managing the company’s infrastructure and staff to support the operational aspects of the pharmacovigilance operations and compliance system to adhere to all global regulatory requirements and internal processes and procedures. The qualified candidate will have experience in and perform multiple activities related to overall safety operations strategy across the portfolio, including oversight of case management, database strategy, vendor oversight, compliance, inspection readiness, contracts, departmental strategy and training. In addition, this position must build and maintain relationships with key strategic internal and external stakeholders, including the hiring and development of Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance (DSPV) personnel. As a member of the DSPV leadership team, this role partners closely with the Head of DSPV to shape PV Operations strategy, own budget and resourcing decisions, and represent DSPV Operations to senior leadership and external partners.

Responsibilities:

  • Own and drive global PV Operations strategy, including planning, implementation, and management, in the US and globally internationally, in close alignment with the Head of DSPV on portfolio-level risk, resourcing, and business priorities.
  • Serve as a key advisor to the Head of DSPV on operational risk, resource allocation, and DSPV budget planning; own accountability for the DSPV Operations budget, including CRO and vendor contract spend.
  • Represent DSPV Operations in interactions with senior leadership and, as needed, and support due diligence activities (e.g., licensing, partnerships, M&A).
  • Manage internal and external staff allocated to operational PV activities, creating a highly efficient team.
  • Own talent strategy for PV Operations, including hiring, development, performance management, and succession planning.
  • Provide expert guidance and leadership both internally and externally based on in-depth knowledge of development and post-marketing safety requirements, per ICH, US and international regulations and guidelines, and Good Pharmacovigilance Practice.
  • Build and implement pharmacovigilance systems that are fully compliant with the applicable worldwide Health Authority PV regulations.
  • Provide oversight of systems and MedDRA updates in collaboration with the relevant PV vendor.
  • Contribute to the selection of PV vendors to support an outsourced PV business model. Provide vendor oversight and management for all outsourced or insourced PV activities, including establishing and monitoring key quality and compliance metrics, invoicing and budgetary needs related to operations and compliance.
  • Develop and implement an inspection readiness program with the contribution of other PV and non-PV stakeholders.
  • Serve as the PV Operations lead/host during Health Authority inspections and audits (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA), coordinating responses and remediation.
  • Responsible for a compliant and quality execution of all operational activities related to case management and related activities. Oversee timely submissions of expedited reports to the FDA and other health authorities in conjunction with Regulatory.
  • Establish a system for identifying, preventing, and correcting compliance deviation, including applicable corrective and preventive actions, in collaboration with the Quality group and internal/external stakeholders, to maintain reporting compliance at the highest level.
  • Oversee the setup of new safety projects, including development of study-specific Safety Management Plans and setup of safety systems and database configurations in the PV database to accommodate these trials and products.
  • Contribute to, draft, and implement department SOPs and work instructions related to the PV activities.
  • Contribute to the signal detection, benefit-risk profile assessment, and aggregate reporting activities with providing accurate reports from the safety database.
  • Effectively collaborate with key stakeholders at all levels in the organization, including Clinical Operations, Clinical Development, Regulatory Affairs, Legal, Medical Affairs, and Manufacturing to develop compliant procedures in line with industry standards and best practices.
  • Represent PV Operations as a leader on project teams, cross-functional committees, and governance bodies (e.g., Safety Management Team), providing operational input to signal review and safety governance processes.
  • Elevate a quality mindset across DSPV.
  • Lead training activities, including setting training requirements and training compliance.
  • Build and oversee PV regulatory intelligence activities.

Qualifications:

  • Healthcare or life sciences degree required; advanced degree (e.g., PharmD, RN, MPH, or scientific PhD) preferred.
  • 15+ years of pharmacovigilance experience, including 5+ years in a people-leadership role managing global PV teams.
  • Experience with clinical and commercial lifecycle phases is required.

jobs.title: VP Growth & Live Games
jobs.excerpt: We are looking for an exceptional VP, Growth & Live Games to lead the next stage of growth for our portfolio of mobile games.
jobs.description:
We are looking for an exceptional VP, Growth & Live Games to lead the next stage of growth for our portfolio of mobile games.

Our development model separates early-stage innovation from large-scale execution. Our 0-to-1 teams focus on building, experimenting, and validating new game concepts. Once a title demonstrates strong product KPIs, proven market potential, and the ability to scale profitably, it transitions into our dedicated 1-to-100 growth organization.

This is where you come in.

You will take ownership of validated mobile titles and transform them into successful, sustainable, large-scale businesses.

This is not simply a user acquisition or marketing leadership position. You will operate as the General Manager of our growth business unit, with end-to-end responsibility for commercial performance, product development, live operations, user acquisition, and the multidisciplinary teams required to scale and operate successful live games.

We are looking for a commercially driven leader who combines deep mobile gaming expertise, strong product instincts, analytical rigor, and the ability to build and lead high-performing teams.

Requirements

1. Business Unit Leadership & P&L Ownership

  • Own the commercial performance and strategic direction of mobile titles transitioning from validation into scale.
  • Take full accountability for revenue, profitability, growth, and long-term product performance.
  • Establish ambitious but sustainable growth plans, operating budgets, and financial targets.
  • Allocate capital and resources across titles based on commercial potential, scalability, and expected returns.
  • Build, structure, and lead a multidisciplinary business unit capable of operating multiple live titles at scale.
  • Establish clear accountability, performance management, and execution frameworks across all functions.

2. Growth Strategy & User Acquisition

  • Develop and execute comprehensive growth strategies to scale proven titles into substantial revenue-generating businesses.
  • Own user acquisition strategy, budgets, creative performance, and channel diversification.
  • Drive profitable UA expansion through rigorous management of ROAS, LTV, CAC, retention, and payback periods.
  • Build scalable creative testing and performance marketing operations.
  • Identify opportunities to expand into new markets, audiences, and acquisition channels.
  • Balance aggressive growth objectives with sustainable unit economics and profitability.

3. Product Strategy & Live Operations

  • Own the ongoing product strategy and roadmap for all titles within the growth portfolio.
  • Lead live operations, including events, content updates, progression systems, economy balancing, and player engagement initiatives.
  • Continuously improve retention, engagement, monetization, and lifetime value through data-driven product optimization.
  • Drive experimentation across gameplay systems, monetization mechanics, offers, and player experiences.
  • Identify and prioritize product improvements that unlock additional growth potential.
  • Ensure games remain competitive, engaging, and commercially successful throughout their lifecycle.

4. Development & Operational Excellence

  • Oversee the development, engineering, QA, and maintenance functions supporting live titles.
  • Establish efficient release cycles, development roadmaps, and operational processes.
  • Balance new feature development with technical stability, performance, and maintenance requirements.
  • Ensure development resources are focused on initiatives with the greatest measurable business impact.
  • Build an organization capable of maintaining high operational standards while scaling multiple products simultaneously.

5. Data, Analytics & Commercial Optimization

  • Establish a comprehensive performance framework across acquisition, engagement, retention, monetization, and profitability.
  • Leverage cohort analysis, predictive LTV models, experimentation, and advanced analytics to guide investment decisions.
  • Identify growth constraints and work across functions to systematically remove them.
  • Develop reliable forecasting, performance reporting, and decision-making processes.
  • Build a culture where product and commercial decisions are grounded in measurable outcomes.

6. Team Building & Leadership

  • Recruit, develop, and lead exceptional talent across growth, UA, product management, live operations, analytics, and development.
  • Build a highly accountable, commercially focused culture that emphasizes ownership and execution.
  • Develop strong functional leaders capable of independently managing their teams and delivering against ambitious objectives.
  • Establish effective collaboration between the early-stage development organization and the growth business unit.
  • Create repeatable operating systems that enable the organization to scale additional titles efficiently.

What We’re Looking For

Essential Experience

  • Significant senior leadership experience within the mobile gaming industry, ideally in free-to-play, casual, or hybrid-casual games.
  • Demonstrated success scaling mobile games from early commercial validation to meaningful revenue and profitability.
  • Proven experience owning or materially influencing the P&L of successful live mobile games.
  • Deep understanding of mobile gaming economics, including user acquisition, ROAS, LTV, retention, engagement, and monetization.
  • Strong experience managing cross-functional teams spanning product, marketing, development, analytics, and live operations.
  • A track record of successfully scaling user acquisition investment while maintaining disciplined financial performance.
  • Strong understanding of free-to-play game systems, player behavior, game economies, and live operations.
  • Experience building organizations, establishing processes, and managing senior functional leaders.

Leadership & Personal Attributes

  • Commercially minded: Thinks like a business owner, not simply a functional leader.
  • Highly analytical: Comfortable making significant investment and product decisions using data, forecasting, and experimentation.
  • Product-oriented: Understands what makes mobile games successful and how to improve their long-term performance.
  • Execution-focused: Able to translate strategy into measurable outcomes through effective teams and operating systems.
  • Entrepreneurial: Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment with substantial autonomy and accountability.
  • Strategic but hands-on: Capable of setting long-term direction while remaining close enough to the business to identify opportunities and solve problems.

What Success Looks Like

Your success will be measured by your ability to build a repeatable, profitable growth engine for our mobile game portfolio.

Key outcomes include:

  • Revenue & Profitability: Sustained growth in revenue, contribution margin, and overall business unit profitability.
  • Profitable Scaling: Significant increases in UA investment and player acquisition while maintaining attractive unit economics.
  • Product Performance: Measurable improvements in retention, LTV, monetization, and long-term player engagement.
  • Operational Excellence: Reliable live operations, efficient development execution, and high-quality product maintenance.
  • Portfolio Growth: Successfully transitioning validated titles into scalable, commercially successful live businesses.
  • Organizational Leadership: Building an exceptional team capable of independently operating and scaling multiple games.

Benefits

Why This Opportunity?

This role offers the opportunity to lead a critical part of our mobile gaming business with substantial ownership, autonomy, and direct commercial impact.

Unlike traditional publishing or user acquisition leadership positions, this role provides complete ownership of the growth lifecycle, from taking over validated products to building and operating substantial live-game businesses.

You will work with titles that have already demonstrated promising product-market fit and commercial potential, allowing you to focus on what you do best: turning successful early-stage games into major businesses.

Benefits

  • Market-competitive compensation
  • Paid Time Off
  • Performance Bonus
  • Annual Performance Reviews

Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff.

About the Job

The Opportunity

As a Senior Software Engineer at Emetlab, you will design and build the systems that power elite AI training data infrastructure serving frontier laboratories, Fortune 500 enterprises, and sovereign AI programmes worldwide. Emetlab is an AI data infrastructure company delivering expert-produced, rigorously validated datasets and end-to-end AI solutions that transform good models into exceptional ones.

In this role, you will take ownership of critical platform systems, from data pipeline architecture and contributor tooling to quality assurance automation and client delivery infrastructure. You will lead technical initiatives, mentor junior engineers, and make architectural decisions that scale with the demands of a global operation spanning 5,000+ domain experts, 100+ languages, and 12 specialised dataset domains.

This is an opportunity to do meaningful engineering work at the foundation of AI's most critical bottleneck, where the systems you architect and the code you write will directly determine the quality of training data behind the world's most advanced models.

What You'll Do

Design, build, and maintain scalable services, APIs, and data pipelines that power Emetlab's global data production and delivery infrastructure. Develop and optimise systems that support multi-stage quality assurance, expert contributor workflows, and high-throughput data processing across diverse domains. Own features and systems end-to-end, from technical design and implementation through to testing, deployment, and monitoring. Lead architectural decisions that ensure platform reliability, security, and scalability as our contributor network and client base grow. Mentor and elevate junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, pairing, and architectural guidance. Collaborate cross-functionally with data operations, AI/ML, and product teams to deliver infrastructure that meets the precision demands of frontier AI development. Contribute to infrastructure and DevOps practices including CI/CD pipelines, containerisation, and cloud deployment at scale.

What You'll Need to Succeed

4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong proficiency in one or more languages such as Python, C#, Java, TypeScript, or Go. Proven experience designing and building production-grade APIs, services, and distributed systems that operate at scale. Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes), and modern deployment practices. Experience working with databases (relational and/or NoSQL), caching layers, messaging systems, and data pipeline tooling. A strong engineering mindset, comfortable navigating ambiguity, making pragmatic trade-offs, and delivering with quality under pace. Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to engineering culture through technical leadership and collaboration. A collaborative disposition, comfortable working cross-functionally with data operations, AI/ML, product, and engineering teams in a fast-paced environment. Emetlab is an AI data infrastructure company built on a single conviction: the quality ceiling of any AI system is determined by its training data, not its architecture or compute.   • Co-own a design system built for humans and AI agents. You will evolve reusable components, tokens, and documentation that are readable by both your teammates and code-generation agents, a rare opportunity to define what design systems look like in an AI-native workflow.

AWS Windows Infrastructure Engineer

Overview

The AWS Windows Infrastructure Automation Engineer automates the configuration, hardening, and deployment of a federal client's Windows Server infrastructure, hosted in a FedRAMP-authorized AWS GovCloud environment, in support of the upgrade from Windows Server 2016 to Windows Server 2019 or 2025. Working under the technical direction of the Windows Architect, the role turns upgrade designs and security baselines into automated, repeatable configurations so every server is built and maintained consistently across environment tiers.

Key Functions

  • Automate Windows Server configuration, build, and deployment using configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible, PowerShell) and PowerShell scripting.
  • Update existing Windows Server 2016 configuration baselines to Windows Server 2019/2025 standards and correct configuration drift.
  • Build and maintain hardened Windows AMIs and automate EC2 provisioning for upgraded servers.
  • Automate OS hardening and compliance checks (e.g., DISA STIGs, CIS Benchmarks, Group Policy) and remediate security findings.
  • Execute upgrades in phased waves, including pre-upgrade backups/snapshots, post-upgrade validation, and automated rollback.
  • Automate patching, inventory, and operational tasks using AWS Systems Manager.
  • Automate certificate installation and renewal for upgraded servers and services.
  • Integrate Windows automation into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub) with version-controlled, peer-reviewed code.
  • Document automation, configurations, and runbooks in Confluence and track work in Jira.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree and 5 years of relevant experience.
  • An additional 2 years of experience (7 years total) with an Associate’s Degree in lieu of a Bachelor’s Degree.
  • An additional 4 years of experience (9 years total) with a High School Diploma in lieu of a Bachelor’s Degree.
  • Hands-on experience automating Windows Server configuration with Ansible, PowerShell DSC, or similar tools.
  • Advanced PowerShell scripting skills.
  • Experience supporting Windows Server 2016 to 2019 or 2025 upgrades or migrations in AWS.
  • Experience automating Windows OS hardening, preferably in regulated federal or regulated industry.
  • Working knowledge of AWS services for Windows workloads (EC2, AMIs, VPC, Systems Manager, EBS snapshots).
  • Solid Windows Server administration skills (Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, certificates, patching).
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation) or image-building tools (e.g., Packer, EC2 Image Builder).
  • Experience with Git-based version control and CI/CD pipelines in an Agile, DevSecOps environment.

Preferred Qualifications or Skills

  • Microsoft Windows Server certification (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Administrator Associate) or AWS certification (e.g., AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate).
  • Experience integrating Windows servers with CyberArk for privileged access management.
  • Experience in managing software deployments through group policy.
  • Experience configuring Windows IIS servers and Power BI Gateway.
  • Experience supporting federal government systems with audit and vulnerability management.

Position Details

  • Employment type: Full-Time, W2
  • Location: 100% Remote (US-based)
  • Hours: 40 hours/week with availability during core business hours of 8am-5pm ET
  • Eligibility: Must be eligible to obtain a Public Trust clearance

About Protecht

At Protecht, we're on a mission to redefine the way the world thinks about risk, and we're growing fast across APAC, the UK, and North America.

We've been named a Great Place to Work® four years in a row, and that's no accident. Our people are curious, driven, and genuinely care about building technology that makes a difference.

As organisations navigate an increasingly complex world, we help them turn risk into opportunity through innovative SaaS solutions, AI-powered insights, and emerging technologies that deliver smarter, faster decision making. For marketers, it's an opportunity to shape a growing global brand, bring compelling customer stories to life, and help drive the next phase of our growth journey.

We're also big believers in flexibility, trust, and continuous learning, because we know the best work happens when people are supported to thrive.

The opportunity

Working within Protecht’s global brand strategy and positioning, this is a hands-on individual contributor role responsible for brand implementation, creative development and design standards across the customer experience. The role serves as the creative partner to global and regional Marketing, translating strategy and briefs into work that strengthens the Protecht brand and supports commercial objectives.

What you'll do

Brand Implementation & Governance

  • Translate Protecht’s global brand strategy, positioning and identity into consistent execution across marketing channels and customer touchpoints.
  • Develop, maintain and evolve practical brand standards, templates and toolkits that enable consistent execution globally.
  • Serve as the day-to-day steward of brand consistency across global and regional marketing activity.
  • Support the implementation of brand architecture across products, acquired businesses, partners and other market-facing applications.
  • Partner with Marketing leadership and Product Marketing to ensure creative execution reinforces Protecht’s positioning and value story.

Creative Development & Execution

  • Develop high-quality creative assets supporting global and regional campaigns, digital experiences, events, executive communications and corporate initiatives.
  • Translate campaign briefs and marketing objectives into compelling creative concepts and executions.
  • Create and maintain scalable templates and design systems that improve speed, consistency and quality across Marketing.
  • Support development of campaign assets, presentations, event collateral, webinar materials, social content and other marketing deliverables.
  • Balance creativity with commercial objectives, ensuring design supports communication, engagement and conversion.

Creative Partnership & Enablement

  • Partner closely with Regional Marketing, Content, Digital Experience and Product Marketing to understand objectives and deliver effective creative solutions.
  • Provide creative expertise during campaign development rather than operating solely as a downstream production resource.
  • Enable Marketing teams to work effectively within brand standards through templates, guidance and practical tools.
  • Manage competing global and regional creative requirements through clear prioritization and planning.
  • Manage freelance designers, agencies and specialist creative partners where additional expertise or capacity is required.

Brand Quality & Evolution

  • Maintain a consistent and high-quality visual experience across Protecht’s marketing ecosystem.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen and evolve creative execution as the Protecht brand and market position develop.
  • Ensure digital, campaign, event and corporate creative remains contemporary, differentiated and appropriate for target audiences.
  • Review creative performance and market trends to inform ongoing improvement in how the brand is expressed.
  • Support the integration of acquired brands and new offerings into the broader Protecht brand experience.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years of experience in brand, creative or design roles, ideally within B2B SaaS, enterprise technology or another complex business environment.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating brand development and implementation across digital, campaign, event and corporate applications.
  • Experience translating brand strategy and positioning into practical creative systems and market-facing execution.
  • Strong hands-on design capability across modern creative tools and platforms.
  • Experience developing brand guidelines, design standards, templates and scalable creative systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple creative projects and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Experience working with external creative agencies, freelancers and production partners.

Bonus if you have:

  • Experience in a PE-backed, high-growth or rapidly evolving SaaS organization
  • Experience supporting global brands across multiple markets
  • Experience with brand integration after acquisitions, rebrands or portfolio expansion

Why Protecht?

At Protecht, a positive and super friendly culture awaits you, where learning is valued and supported. We empower our people through leadership, training, knowledge-sharing, and mentorship. Here are some of the perks of working with Protecht:

At Boston Scientific, your work helps advance innovative cardiac technologies that improve patients’ lives. As a Senior Field Clinical Engineer, you will play a key, hands-on role in supporting both pre- and post-market clinical trials, working directly with leading cardiac centers in Czechia and across Europe.

This role is ideal for someone who values autonomy, ownership, and close collaboration with clinicians. You will be responsible for the day-to-day execution of clinical trial activities at assigned sites, acting as a trusted clinical and technical partner for investigators and hospital teams. The position offers strong visibility within an international clinical organization and exposure to European-level clinical programs.

The role is based in the Czech Republic and requires regular travel within Czechia and across Europe to support clinical activities.

Work mode: Remote, with up to 50% travel.

The Opportunity:

In this role, you will serve as a key clinical interface between Boston Scientific and investigational sites. You will support studies from early site engagement through patient enrollment and follow-up, directly contributing to study quality, patient safety, and the successful development of future cardiac therapies.

You will work independently in the field while remaining closely connected to a collaborative, international clinical team.

What You Will Do:

  • Own the day-to-day execution of clinical trials within your assigned territory, ensuring sites are prepared, supported, and engaged throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for investigators and site staff, providing clinical, technical, and procedural expertise.
  • Support site qualification, initiation, and enrollment readiness activities, including IRB support and investigator training.
  • Deliver hands-on technical support during electrophysiology (EP) procedures and follow-up visits, working directly in cath lab and clinical environments.
  • Build trusted, long-term relationships with physicians and clinical teams, supporting sustained engagement in clinical programs.
  • Lead clinical initiatives and projects, contributing to continuous improvement of study execution and site performance.
  • Collaborate closely with internal clinical, regulatory, and commercial stakeholders to ensure aligned and effective trial delivery.

What You Bring:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Clinical Engineering, or a related scientific or technical discipline.
  • Experience in the medical device industry, clinical research, field clinical engineering, sales support, or as a cardiac physiologist.
  • Hands-on experience in electrophysiology (EP) ablation procedures.
  • Ability to work independently in a field-based role, with a proactive and collaborative mindset.
  • Strong communication skills and confidence working directly with physicians and clinical stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel up to 50%, including international travel within Europe.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with EP mapped ablation procedures
  • Familiarity with clinical trial operations, site management, and clinical documentation

What We Offer:

At Boston Scientific, we support our employees both professionally and personally. In this role, you can expect:

  • Private medical care, lunch card and life insurance
  • Annual performance-based bonus
  • Company car or car allowance to support frequent travel within Czechia and across Europe
  • Flexible working model with a remote setup and autonomy in organizing your field activities
  • Continuous learning and development opportunities, including technical training, clinical education, and participation in international projects
  • Collaboration within a highly skilled, international clinical team across Europe
  • The opportunity to work closely with leading hospitals and physicians while supporting clinical programs across Czechia and other European countries
  • A company culture focused on innovation, ethics, and meaningful patient impact

Requisition ID: 625270

As a leader in medical science for more than 40 years, we are committed to solving the challenges that matter most – united by a deep caring for human life. Our mission to advance science for life is about transforming lives through innovative medical solutions that improve patient lives, create value for our customers, and support our employees and the communities in which we operate. Now more than ever, we have a responsibility to apply those values to everything we do – as a global business and as a global corporate citizen.

So, choosing a career with Boston Scientific (NYSE: BSX) isn’t just business, it’s personal. And if you’re a natural problem-solver with the imagination, determination, and spirit to make a meaningful difference to people worldwide, we encourage you to apply and look forward to connecting with you!

Each business we acquire brings its own platform, data and restaurant partners, and bringing them onto OrderYOYO safely is how we protect and build on that value.

Purpose of the role

You will lead the technology integration and migration of businesses that join OrderYOYO, from technical due diligence and integration planning through migration, stabilisation and the retirement of legacy platforms.

You will own the integrated programme plan across engineering, product, data and customer-facing teams, protecting restaurant continuity and tracking delivery costs and agreed benefits.

You will coordinate dependencies with Finance, People, Commercial and other functional owners, rather than owning every aspect of corporate integration.

Key responsibilities

Programme leadership

  • Own end-to-end programme plans and a consolidated view of scope, timelines, dependencies, budget forecasts and risks.
  • Lead workstream owners, agree priorities and capacity with functional leads, and run governance, escalating unresolved trade-offs to the CTPO.
  • Embed lessons learned into a repeatable migration and integration approach.

Pre-completion and Day 1

  • Inform due diligence with assessments of migration complexity, product gaps, dependencies, effort, costs and delivery risks.
  • Prepare integration plans before completion and coordinate Day 1 access, environments, tooling and working practices with incoming teams, engineering, IT and security.
  • Coordinate early technical and compliance assessments with specialists and track follow-up actions.

Data and systems

  • Coordinate data migration and integration into our data platform and business systems with data and engineering teams, agreeing mappings, quality checks and reporting requirements.

Customer migration

  • Segment customers by size, value, product usage and complexity; lead platform gap analysis and scope decisions.
  • Recommend migration waves and sequencing based on customer impact, technical readiness and capacity, adapting plans as capabilities mature and lessons emerge.
  • Agree product, data, operational and customer-readiness criteria; coordinate testing and reconciliation of order flows, payments and key integrations, securing accountable-owner sign-off.
  • Coordinate wave runbooks covering preparation, cutover, validation, rollback and support; lead go/no-go recommendations for approval by accountable business and technical owners.
  • Own operational handover, including named support owners, stabilisation exit criteria and business acceptance; plan controlled legacy retirement after migration.

Stakeholders

  • Align engineering, product, customer-facing and finance teams around one plan and timeline, working with customer-facing teams to keep restaurant partners informed and supported.

Commercial outcomes and reporting

  • Partner with Finance to establish and track business cases, covering migration and parallel-running costs, revenue at risk, legacy-retirement savings and forecast cost to complete.
  • Verify realised benefits with business owners and report progress, customer experience and value delivered to the CTPO and leadership team.

Skills and experience required

  • 5+ years of programme management experience in a technology organisation, including at least 3 years leading platform migrations, customer migrations or post-acquisition integrations.

What we offer

  • Ownership of our migration and integration capability from day one, with the autonomy to shape how it works.

Role:Quality & Regulatory Technology & Innovation Program Manager

Quality & Regulatory Technology & Innovation Program Manager

The Quality & Regulatory Technology Program Manager is responsible for supporting the development and implementation of the technology, artificial intelligence (AI), automation, data analytics, and digital transformation roadmap for Quality & Regulatory (Q&R) operations within the United States.

This position partners closely with Quality & Regulatory leadership and functional teams to identify opportunities where technology can improve quality oversight, regulatory compliance, data visibility, operational efficiency, and employee effectiveness.

The Program Manager serves as a hands-on technology and innovation resource within Q&R, translating business and regulatory needs into practical technology solutions. The position will design, build, test, implement, and transition AI agents, analytics tools, dashboards, automated workflows, and other digital solutions to functional teams for ongoing use. The role will also partner closely with Information Technology (IT) and other enterprise stakeholders to ensure solutions align with organizational technology, security, data, and AI governance requirements.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Partner with Q&R leadership and functional teams to develop and implement the Q&R technology roadmap, identifying and prioritizing opportunities to leverage AI, automation, analytics, and emerging technologies across Pharmacy Quality & Regulatory, Manufacturing Quality & Regulatory, Radiation Safety, and related functions.

Evaluate Q&R workflows and administrative processes to identify opportunities for automation and efficiency, and develop scalable technology solutions that reduce manual effort, eliminate redundant activities, improve consistency, and allow Q&R professionals to focus on higher-value activities.

Develop data collection and management tools supporting Q&R business needs, including systems and workflows that facilitate the collection, organization, validation, and accessibility of ESG metrics and other operational, quality, regulatory, and compliance data.

Develop prototypes and proof-of-concept solutions to evaluate emerging technologies, assess business value and feasibility, and establish scalable approaches for successful solutions before transitioning them to functional teams for ongoing operation.

Establish sustainable processes for technology solutions, including appropriate documentation, user guidance, training, data definitions, ownership, maintenance expectations, and knowledge transfer to ensure tools can be effectively operated and maintained by Q&R teams.

Monitor emerging AI, analytics, automation, and digital technologies and recommend opportunities that could enhance Quality & Regulatory compliance, operational performance, data-driven decision-making, or employee effectiveness.

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Engineering, Business, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related technical, scientific, or business discipline.

Experience translating business requirements and complex workflows into scalable technology solutions.

Advanced experience with Microsoft Power BI, including dashboard development, data modeling, visualization, and development of actionable business metrics.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with technical teams, functional subject matter experts, operational leaders, and senior leadership.

Evangelize technology adoption and digital capability across Q&R to help functional teams effectively use AI, automation, analytics, and other approved technologies.

Position Title:

This position is a subject matter expert in global medical device and quality system regulations and is responsible for regulatory strategy and planning, authoring and submitting regulatory applications, assessing product design, manufacturing, labeling and quality system changes, authoring change impact assessments, and ensuring product labeling documentation, labels, promotional material, and product claims are accurate and compliant with global regulations. The Specialist will ensure adherence to company policy and procedures and will assist in maintaining quality control processes. This position will help the organization maximize the number of patients served while maintaining a high level of quality and safety through the support of the business functions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides regulatory support to product development and business teams including preparation of regulatory opinion documents, coordination of labeling activities, and review/approval of design control documentation, risk management reports, technical protocols/reports, clinical documentation and other outputs of product development.
  • Prepares/writes, submits, and manages global regulatory applications (including MDSAP markets, EU, and UK) as well as internal regulatory file documentation. Supports distributors and business partners in securing and maintaining regulatory clearances.
  • Maintains systems for tracking current projects and for projection of future activity loads.
  • Acts as company representative, developing and maintaining positive relationships with global regulatory agencies and business partners through oral and written communications.
  • Works professionally and cooperatively with cross-functional teams such as research and development, operations, quality, microbiology, packaging, medical affairs, and clinical affairs to ensure project success.
  • Assesses product design, labeling, quality system, manufacturing, and material changes for regulatory impact. Communicates changes effectively throughout the organization. Authors key portions of company responses to proposed standards, directives, policies and legislation regarding company products and systems.
  • Develops, processes, and maintains assigned departmental procedures, work instructions, and forms, and facilities training. Reviews and supports creation/updates of labeling procedures.
  • Supports the design, development, review, and approval of product labels, label items, advertising/promotional materials and product claims to assure accuracy, consistency and compliance to global regulatory requirements, as well as company and customer requirements. This includes verification of labels and advertising/promotional materials, and creation, verification, review, and processing of instructions for use.

Remote Position - West Coast and Rocky Mountain Region Preferred

The Director, 211 Manufacturing Quality & Regulatory Affairs is responsible for providing enterprise Quality and Regulatory governance for U.S. operations, facilities, projects, and client programs subject to 21 CFR Parts 210 and 211.

The Director provides Quality Unit leadership and oversight of the Quality Management System, regulatory compliance, inspection readiness, quality risk management, and continuous improvement activities supporting the development, technology transfer, manufacturing, testing, and release of therapeutic radiopharmaceutical products. This position serves as a subject matter expert in pharmaceuticals, ensuring compliance with FDA regulations, current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), USP standards and all applicable federal and state regulations. The Director partners closely with internal and external stakeholders to ensure product quality, regulatory compliance, operational excellence, and client satisfaction.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

· Provide Quality and Regulatory governance for all US facilities, projects, technology transfers, client programs, and manufacturing activities operating under 21 CFR Parts 210 and 211. Serve as the primary Quality and Regulatory point of contact for all 211 facilities, providing leadership, guidance, escalation support, and consistent application of cGMP requirements and company quality standards across sites.

· Lead and maintain the Quality Management System (QMS) in compliance with FDA cGMP requirements, applicable USP standards, ICH guidelines, and applicable federal and state regulations, including oversight of deviations, investigations, CAPA, change control, OOS/OOT, complaints, document control, training, supplier quality, audits, and product quality review.

· Provide Quality Unit leadership and authority consistent with 21 CFR Part 211 requirements, including escalation of significant quality and compliance risks and appropriate authority to prevent or stop GMP activities when product quality, patient safety, date integrity, or regulatory compliance may be compromised.

· Establish Quality governance and readiness criteria for new and existing 211 operations, including facility startups and expansions, new client programs, technology transfers, equipment and facility qualification, process and cleaning validation, analytical method transfer/validation, and computerized systems.

· Maintain continuous regulatory and inspection readiness across all applicable 211 facilities and serve as the primary organizational point of contact for Quality and Regulatory matters related to 211 facilities, including serving as the lead Quality representative and FDA point of contact during regulatory inspections and interactions.

· Lead regulatory inspections and audit response activities, including response to FDA Form 483 observations, client audit findings, regulatory correspondence, and significant compliance concerns, ensuring effective root cause analysis, remediation, CAPA implementation, and verification of effectiveness.

· Monitor evolving regulatory requirements ad industry expectations, including FDA regulations and guidance, USP standards, ICH guidelines, enforcements trends, and applicable federal and state requirements, and translate changes into appropriate Quality System and operational improvements

· Provide Quality and Regulatory oversight of GMP manufacturing and product lifecycle activities, including manufacturing, laboratory operations, validation, batch record review, product disposition, data integrity, and oversight of suppliers, contract laboratories, and other GMP service providers.

· Serve as the senior Quality and Regulatory partner for CDMO clients, providing guidance and escalation support for manufacturing processes, technology transfers, validation strategies, investigations, product quality issues, regulatory submissions and requests, inspections, and other GMP compliance matters.

· Lead Quality Agreement development and governance with client sponsors and key GMP Service providers, ensuring responsibilities, regulatory commitments, escalation pathways, and quality expectations are clearly defined and maintained.

· Establish and lead Quality Management Review and continuous improvement activities, including development and trending of key quality indicators, identification of systemic risks and recurring issues, quality risk management, and implementation of cross-functional improvement initiatives.

· Build, develop, and mentor high-performing Quality and Regulatory teams while promoting consistent Quality standards and a culture of quality, accountability, regulatory compliance, data integrity, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across US operations.

Required Qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Chemistry, Biology, Microbiology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Engineering, or related scientific discipline required.

· Advanced degree preferred (MS, PharmD, or PhD).

· Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, radiopharmaceutical, or therapeutic manufacturing environments.

· Experience within a CDMO, pharmaceutical manufacturer, biotechnology company, or regulated healthcare manufacturing environment in a 211 environment.

· Proven technical knowledge of FDA cGMP regulations, 21 CFR Parts 210 and 211

Department:

Exempt

MAIN FUNCTION

The Senior Key Account Manager holds primary ownership of Exalta's most strategically significant original equipment manufacturer (OEM) accounts, serving as the senior customer-facing leader within the Commercial Operations team. This role requires substantial prior customer-facing experience within the OEM industry — medical device OEM experience strongly preferred — combined with demonstrated judgment managing complex, multi-site customer relationships at the executive level. The Senior Key Account Manager owns the customer Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) cadence for assigned strategic accounts, serves as the senior escalation point for customer-impacting issues, and partners directly with the Director of Commercial Operations and Global SIOP to translate customer demand into the SIOP process. The role also carries responsibility for mentoring and developing Key Account Managers, strengthening the team's account strategy and execution. This position is designed to build the next generation of commercial leadership within a vertically integrated medical device manufacturing environment.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES / RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Account Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end commercial relationship for Exalta's most strategically significant OEM accounts, serving as the senior point of contact across multiple product lines, programs, and sites.
  • Lead the customer S&OP cadence for assigned strategic accounts, driving rollout, phased maturity, and ongoing governance in partnership with the Director of Commercial Operations and Global SIOP.
  • Develop account-level strategic plans that align customer growth expectations with Exalta's capacity and operational constraints.
  • Represent Commercial Operations in executive-level customer business reviews, contract discussions, and new program launch conversations.

SIOP Integration & Demand Ownership

  • Serve as the senior demand data owner for assigned strategic accounts within the SIOP process; validate and reconcile the highest-exposure forecast inputs ahead of the monthly demand review gate.
  • Own forecast accuracy performance for the largest accounts in the portfolio, identify variance drivers, and present trends into the SIOP executive alignment as needed.
  • Partner with the Director of Commercial Operations and Global SIOP to ensure customer demand inputs are reflected accurately in the SIOP demand plan, surfacing capacity risk early.
  • Support new product introduction onboarding for strategic account programs, coordinating across quality, planning, and operations at the program level.

Escalation & Customer Experience Ownership

  • Serve as the senior escalation point for customer-impacting issues across assigned strategic accounts, providing strategic direction rather than case-level handling.
  • Own root-cause resolution for significant service disruptions, partnering with planning, supply chain, and quality to protect delivery commitments.
  • Drive proactive, executive-level communication with customers on constraint impacts, delays, or substitutions.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Mentor and coach Key Account Managers on account strategy, escalation handling, and demand data ownership.
  • Provide the Director of Commercial Operations and Global SIOP with structured input on Key Account Manager performance, account coverage, and development needs.
  • Support onboarding and knowledge transfer for new Key Account Management team members.

Analytics, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Own KPI reporting for the Key Account Management team, consolidating on-time delivery, backorder, and fill rate performance across the portfolio.
  • Identify systemic trends across accounts and lead continuous improvement initiatives in customer operations, demand management, and order fulfillment workflows.
  • Contribute to ERP (Epicor) and Power BI reporting enhancements supporting Commercial Operations and SIOP objectives.
  • Ensure all customer-facing operations comply with FDA, ISO 13485, ISO 9001, and company quality standards.

KEY COMPETENCIES

  • Customer Focus — advanced ability to build and sustain executive-level relationships with OEM customers.
  • Leadership and Mentorship — proven ability to guide and develop Key Account Managers.
  • Business Acumen — strong understanding of OEM contract manufacturing economics, capacity constraints, and account profitability drivers.
  • Conflict Resolution and Negotiation — expertise managing complex, high-stakes customer issues to resolution.
  • Analytical and Critical Thinking — ability to translate order, forecast, and fulfillment data into account strategy.
  • Communication — executive-level written and verbal communication skills, able to represent Exalta credibly with customer Director- and Vice President-level stakeholders.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Demonstrated ability to manage a portfolio of large, complex OEM accounts simultaneously, balancing strategic priorities with day-to-day delivery commitments.
  • Executive-level written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to represent Exalta professionally in high-visibility customer settings.
  • Advanced analytical ability to translate order, forecast, and fulfillment data into account-level strategy and risk mitigation.
  • Proven skill mentoring and developing less experienced team members.
  • Collaborative working style with a demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional follow-through at senior levels.
  • Deep familiarity with demand planning, Sales and Operations Planning processes, and customer order management.
  • Proficiency in enterprise resource planning systems (Epicor preferred), Microsoft Excel (advanced), and Power BI or equivalent reporting tools.

REQUIRED / PREFERRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, or a related field required; Master's degree a plus.
  • Minimum of five years of direct, customer-facing experience within the OEM industry required; medical device OEM or contract manufacturing experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience owning or supporting a formal Sales and Operations Planning or Sales, Inventory and Operations Planning cadence with strategic accounts.
  • Prior experience mentoring, coaching, or informally leading account management team members preferred.
  • Experience navigating FDA-regulated or ISO 13485 quality environments strongly preferred.
  • Epicor enterprise resource planning experience preferred; exposure to order management or demand planning modules is an advantage.

WORKING CONDITIONS

This position operates in a professional office environment with periodic interaction with manufacturing and warehouse functions. Travel to customer sites and offices may be required (approximately 20%, generally on a quarterly cadence). Must be able to maintain composure and professionalism in high-visibility, executive-level customer escalation scenarios.

jobs.title: Product Security Engineer
jobs.excerpt: 1.  Job Summary and OverviewAt our organization, we believe that security is the bedrock of innovation.
jobs.description:
1. Job Summary and Overview

At our organization, we believe that security is the bedrock of innovation. Our mission is to provide world-class digital services that empower our users while maintaining the highest standards of digital trust and data integrity. We foster a culture of technical excellence, where engineers are encouraged to be proactive, inquisitive, and dedicated to the craft of building resilient systems. As we continue to expand our footprint in the tech ecosystem, we are looking for a specialist who shares our passion for open-source technology and robust security architectures.

1.1 Position Specifications

Category

Details

Position Title

Product Security Engineer (RHEL Specialist)

Location

Remote

Experience Level

Senior (Minimum 5+ Years Professional Experience)

Language Requirements

Portuguese and English

Employment Type

Permanent / Full-Time

1.2 Role Summary

The Product Security Engineer (RHEL Specialist) is a critical technical position focused on the intersection of infrastructure stability and proactive security posture. The core purpose of this role is to embed automated security controls, hardening standards, and DevSecOps best practices throughout the entire product lifecycle, with a specialized focus on the Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) ecosystem. You will be the primary architect of security automation, ensuring that our RHEL-based infrastructure is resilient against modern threats while maintaining high availability and operational efficiency.

Role Mission:

To transform traditional security "gates" into automated security "guardrails" within our Linux environment. You will be tasked with identifying system inefficiencies, automating vulnerability remediation, and ensuring that security is a seamless component of our CI/CD pipelines and virtualization stacks.

The ideal candidate is not just a security enthusiast but a seasoned Linux practitioner who understands the nuances of system internals. You will move beyond manual checklists, leveraging Ansible for configuration management and Python/Bash for custom security tooling. Whether managing workloads on-premise through VMware/KVM or across AWS, Azure, or GCP, your objective remains consistent: to provide a secure, standardized, and self-healing platform that serves as the backbone for our product offerings.

1.3 Core Objectives and Expectations

Infrastructure Hardening: Design and enforce automated RHEL hardening standards across all environments using CIS benchmarks or similar frameworks.

Security Automation: Implement "Security as Code" principles to reduce manual toil and human error in security configurations.

Proactive System Optimization: Actively hunt for system inefficiencies and performance bottlenecks, providing automated resolutions before they impact product delivery.

Cloud and Container Security: Secure our transition to cloud-native architectures by ensuring Docker and Kubernetes environments meet enterprise security requirements.

Continuous Integration: Integrate security scanning and compliance auditing directly into our Jenkins and GitLab CI pipelines.

As a senior member of the technical staff, you will be expected to work with a high degree of autonomy, collaborating with both DevOps and Software Development teams to foster a culture of shared responsibility for security outcomes.

2. Key Responsibilities

The Product Security Engineer (RHEL Specialist) is tasked with safeguarding the integrity, availability, and confidentiality of our product ecosystem. This role functions at the critical intersection of system engineering and cybersecurity, requiring a hands-on approach to building resilient infrastructure. The incumbent is expected to move beyond reactive security measures, instead architecting automated, self-healing systems that adhere to global security standards.

2.1 Security Automation & Hardening

The primary accountability in this area is the conversion of complex security requirements into executable, version-controlled code. This ensures a consistent security posture across all environments, from development to production.

Ansible Orchestration: Design, develop, and maintain a library of Ansible playbooks and roles specifically focused on Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) security compliance (e.g., CIS Benchmarks, STIGs).

Automated Patch Management: Implement and manage automated patching lifecycles for RHEL systems to ensure timely remediation of Critical and High-severity vulnerabilities with minimal service disruption.

Configuration as Code: Enforce system state consistency by automating the deployment of security configurations, including SELinux policies, SSH hardening, and kernel parameter tuning (sysctl).

Identity & Access Management (IAM): Automate the provisioning and auditing of privileged access, ensuring the Principle of Least Privilege is enforced across all Linux-based product components.

Compliance Drift Detection: Develop automated monitoring solutions to detect and remediate configuration drift from established security baselines in real-time.

2.2 Secure CI/CD Pipeline Integration

This role serves as a key architect in our DevSecOps transformation, ensuring that security is not a final checkpoint but a continuous process embedded within our software delivery pipelines.

Security Tooling Integration: Embed and configure Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), and Software Composition Analysis (SCA) tools within Jenkins and GitLab CI pipelines.

Automated Gatekeeping: Define and implement "fail-build" criteria based on security risk thresholds to prevent vulnerable code or insecure configurations from reaching production.

Secrets Management: Architect and maintain secure workflows for managing API keys, certificates, and credentials within the CI/CD environment using HashiCorp Vault or native cloud secrets managers.

Pipeline Auditing: Maintain comprehensive logging and auditing of pipeline activities to ensure the integrity of the build and deployment process.

Developer Collaboration: Work closely with software engineering teams to interpret security scan results and provide actionable, automated remediation guidance.

Proactive Efficiency Focus:

Beyond standard security tasks, the Engineer must actively identify operational inefficiencies—such as slow build times due to security scans or excessive manual intervention in configuration—and engineer automated solutions to streamline these processes without compromising the security posture.

2.3 Cloud & Container Security

As we leverage hybrid and multi-cloud architectures, the Product Security Engineer is responsible for the security of our virtualized and containerized workloads.

Cloud Governance: Implement and automate security best practices for public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), focusing on VPC security, IAM roles, and encrypted storage.

Kubernetes Hardening: Design and maintain security policies for Kubernetes clusters, including Network Policies, Pod Security Admissions, and RBAC configurations.

Container Image Security: Establish automated container image scanning and signing processes to ensure only trusted and verified images are deployed via Docker.

Runtime Protection: Implement monitoring and protection tools for containerized environments to detect and respond to anomalous behavior or runtime threats.

Virtualization Security: Ensure the underlying virtualization layer (KVM, VMware) is secured and isolated according to industry best practices.

2.4 Vulnerability Management & Threat Modeling

The Engineer must act as a proactive "hunter," identifying weaknesses before they can be exploited and designing systems that are inherently resilient.

Threat Modeling: Lead threat modeling exercises (e.g., STRIDE or PASTA) for new product features and infrastructure changes to identify potential attack vectors early in the design phase.

Vulnerability Assessment: Perform regular automated vulnerability scans of the RHEL infrastructure and cloud resources, prioritizing findings based on business impact and exploitability.

Automated Remediation: Develop "auto-remediation" workflows using Python or Ansible to fix common vulnerabilities and misconfigurations without manual intervention.

Incident Response Support: Provide technical expertise and forensic support to the Incident Response team during security events, particularly those involving Linux systems or cloud infrastructure.

Security Research: Stay abreast of emerging threats, zero-day vulnerabilities, and new RHEL security features to proactively adapt our security architecture.

Accountability Metric

Expected Outcome

Compliance Coverage

95%+ of RHEL fleet adhering to automated security baselines.

Mean Time to Remediate (MTTR)

Reduction in remediation time for critical patches through automated deployment.

Pipeline Security

100% of production builds subjected to automated security gating.

3. Required Technical Skills & Qualifications

To be successful in the role of Product Security Engineer (RHEL Specialist), candidates must demonstrate a profound technical foundation in Linux systems engineering and a modern, automation-first approach to cybersecurity. We require a professional who has moved beyond basic administration into the realm of infrastructure-as-code and proactive threat mitigation.

Mandatory Experience:

A minimum of

five (5) years

of demonstrable professional experience in Systems Engineering, DevSecOps, or Product Security roles is required. Candidates must have spent a significant portion of this time managing enterprise-scale Red Hat Enterprise Linux environments.

3.1 Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) Mastery

As the core focus of this role, we require "expert-level" knowledge of the RHEL ecosystem (versions 7, 8, and 9). This includes:

Advanced Administration: Deep understanding of system internals, kernel tuning, LVM/storage management, and performance troubleshooting.

Security Hardening: Proven ability to implement and manage SELinuxpolicies (writing custom modules and troubleshooting denials) and system auditing (auditd).

Identity & Lifecycle: Experience with Red Hat Satellite or Foreman for lifecycle management, content views, and automated errata/patching workflows.

Compliance Frameworks: Implementation of OpenSCAP and automated compliance scanning against CIS Benchmarks or STIG requirements.

3.2 Automation, Orchestration & Scripting

The candidate must be able to treat infrastructure as a software project, leveraging code to eliminate manual toil and configuration drift.

Ansible: Expert-level proficiency in Ansible. Must be capable of designing modular roles, maintaining complex playbooks, and utilizing Ansible Automation Platform (or Tower/AWX) for scheduled security workflows.

Python: Strong proficiency in Python for developing custom security tooling, API integrations, and complex automation logic.

Bash: Mastery of Bash scripting for rapid system-level automation and diagnostic utilities.

3.3 Infrastructure & Cloud Platforms

Category

Requirement Detail

Cloud Platforms

Hands-on security engineering experience in at least one major provider: AWS, Azure, or GCP. Knowledge of native security services (e.g., AWS GuardDuty, Azure Security Center) is essential.

Virtualization

Proficiency in managing and securing KVM (Kernel-based Virtual Machine) and VMware vSphere environments.

Containers

Solid understanding of Docker image security and Kubernetes (or OpenShift) cluster hardening, including RBAC, Network Policies, and Pod Security Standards.

3.4 DevSecOps Tooling & Pipelines

CI/CD: Proven experience embedding security scans and gates within Jenkins or GitLab CI pipelines.

Version Control: Expert knowledge of Git (branching strategies, merge requests, and GitOps workflows).

Security Scanning: Experience with SAST/DAST/SCA tools (e.g., SonarQube, Snyk, Trivy, or Checkmarx).

3.5 Education & Certifications

While we prioritize practical experience and technical aptitude, the following formal qualifications are highly regarded:

Academic: A Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related Engineering field.

Linux Certifications: Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) or Red Hat Certified Specialist in Security (Linux or Containers).

Security Certifications: Industry-standard certifications such as CISSP(Certified Information Systems Security Professional), OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional), or CISM.

Cloud Certifications: AWS Certified Security - Specialty, or equivalent professional-level cloud certifications.

4. Desired Soft Skills & Attributes

Technical mastery of Red Hat Enterprise Linux and automation frameworks is a baseline requirement; however, the true effectiveness of a Product Security Engineer is defined by their professional character and interpersonal aptitude. In a modern DevSecOps environment, security is no longer a siloed function but a shared responsibility. We are seeking a candidate who can navigate the complexities of organizational dynamics with diplomacy, precision, and a relentless focus on the mission.

4.1 Proactive & Analytical Mindset

The ideal candidate does not wait for an alert to trigger before taking action. You possess an innate ability to dissect complex system architectures and identify subtle inefficiencies or potential threat vectors before they materialize into operational risks.

Ability to perform deep root-cause analysis rather than applying superficial fixes.

Proactively hunting for "security technical debt" and proposing scalable automation to resolve it.

Anticipating how infrastructure changes will impact the overall security posture.

4.2 Strong Sense of Ownership

We value engineers who take radical accountability for the security posture of the products they support. You treat the infrastructure as your own, ensuring that every deployment meets the highest standards of integrity.

A "stop-the-line" mentality when critical security flaws are detected in the product lifecycle.

Demonstrating persistence in seeing complex security remediations through to completion.

Taking pride in maintaining clean, well-documented, and highly secure codebases and configurations.

The "Security as an Enabler" Philosophy:

Success in this role requires a shift from being a "gatekeeper" to being a "guardrail provider." We are looking for a professional who empowers development teams to move fast securely, rather than slowing them down with manual processes and bureaucracy.

4.3 Excellent Communication & Influence

Security risks are often abstract; your job is to make them tangible and actionable. You must be able to translate complex technical vulnerabilities into business-impact terms for non-technical stakeholders, while providing specific, code-level guidance to developers.

Strong written communication for creating clear runbooks, security advisories, and architectural documentation.

Ability to remain calm and provide clear instructions during high-pressure security incidents.

Influence without authority: Persuading cross-functional teams to prioritize security enhancements.

4.4 Collaborative Spirit & Professional Empathy

The Product Security Engineer works at the nexus of DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and Development. You must be a team player who values diverse perspectives and understands the operational pressures faced by other teams.

Willingness to mentor junior engineers and share RHEL/Security knowledge across the organization.

Actively participating in peer code reviews and architectural design sessions.

Building relationships across departments to foster a healthy, security-first culture.

4.5 Continuous Learner & Tech Visionary

The cybersecurity landscape changes weekly. We need a candidate with a genuine passion for the field who treats learning as a core part of their daily routine.

Staying abreast of the latest Red Hat releases, CVEs, and open-source security tooling.

Actively participating in the security community (e.g., attending conferences, contributing to open-source projects, or following threat intelligence feeds).

An experimentation-focused mindset—willing to pilot new tools and technologies to improve the organizational security posture.

Our product works autonomously and so do our teams. We value a ‘one team’ mentality where everyone’s unique skills contribute to an environment that encourages collaboration and ownership. Account Executive

OVERVIEW

Vulnerability volume keeps climbing, and attackers now use AI to turn new disclosures into working exploits faster than most teams can test a patch. A monthly patch cycle wasn’t built for that pace.

Automox gives IT and security teams a better approach: patch what’s patchable, mitigate what’s not. The autonomous endpoint management platform automates patching and configuration across Windows, macOS, and Linux. When a vulnerability has no fix yet, Automox delivers vetted mitigations at AI speed, so teams can close exposure without waiting on a vendor. Teams set the schedule and the scope, so they can move at the pace and scale their IT/SecOps demands in 2026 and beyond. Thousands of companies and MSPs worldwide trust Automox, including NASA, Yale, Xerox, Allbirds, and UNICEF.

That same forward-looking approach shapes how we sell. Every prospect gets a personalized Blueprint for their environment before they buy. Our Turnkey Results application builds it from 1.4 billion policy runs. Buyers see their path to success while they’re still evaluating, backed by proof of value mapping and a business justification built with them.

We’re hiring an Account Executive who wants to take that story to market and show IT and security leaders a better way to manage endpoint risk.

WHO YOU ARE

You’re drawn to markets that are changing fast. You can explain to a CISO why the way they handle vulnerabilities today won’t hold up next year. You move deals forward with discipline and close what you commit. Experience matters, but we hire for drive, coachability, intelligence, and character.

You’ve sold complex SaaS or IT security solutions to enterprise buyers, ideally at a challenger brand. You’re used to:

  • Prospecting your own pipeline alongside the pipeline that lands on your desk

We work as one team. AEs, SDRs, channel, solutions engineering, and customer success work deals together, and you’ll have room to do your best work and grow your career.

Endpoint risk is growing faster than IT and security teams can hire. Automox is the autonomous endpoint management platform built for that reality. It patches and configures every endpoint automatically, with no on-premises infrastructure. For vulnerabilities that can’t be patched, an AI-speed mitigation pipeline turns new disclosures into human-vetted Worklets that customers deploy on their own terms. Patch what’s patchable, mitigate what’s not. Thousands of companies around the world rely on Automox to stay ahead of what’s coming.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TEAM
