jobs.description:
Programme Manager - Migration & Integrations

About OrderYOYO

We help takeaways and restaurants succeed online by providing them with personalised branded mobile apps, websites and personalised marketing. We are here to ensure that small to medium-sized restaurants and small chains are not subjected to high commissions, and giving the restaurant the ownership of their success!

We serve restaurants across multiple markets, including the UK, Ireland, DACH, the Netherlands and the Nordics, and acquisitions are one part of how we grow. Each business we acquire brings its own platform, data and restaurant partners, and bringing them onto OrderYOYO safely is how we protect and build on that value.

Purpose of the role

You will lead the technology integration and migration of businesses that join OrderYOYO, from technical due diligence and integration planning through migration, stabilisation and the retirement of legacy platforms.

You will own the integrated programme plan across engineering, product, data and customer-facing teams, protecting restaurant continuity and tracking delivery costs and agreed benefits.

You will coordinate dependencies with Finance, People, Commercial and other functional owners, rather than owning every aspect of corporate integration.

Key responsibilities

Programme leadership

  • Own end-to-end programme plans and a consolidated view of scope, timelines, dependencies, budget forecasts and risks.
  • Lead workstream owners, agree priorities and capacity with functional leads, and run governance, escalating unresolved trade-offs to the CTPO.
  • Embed lessons learned into a repeatable migration and integration approach.

Pre-completion and Day 1

  • Inform due diligence with assessments of migration complexity, product gaps, dependencies, effort, costs and delivery risks.
  • Prepare integration plans before completion and coordinate Day 1 access, environments, tooling and working practices with incoming teams, engineering, IT and security.
  • Coordinate early technical and compliance assessments with specialists and track follow-up actions.

Data and systems

  • Coordinate data migration and integration into our data platform and business systems with data and engineering teams, agreeing mappings, quality checks and reporting requirements.

Customer migration

  • Segment customers by size, value, product usage and complexity; lead platform gap analysis and scope decisions.
  • Recommend migration waves and sequencing based on customer impact, technical readiness and capacity, adapting plans as capabilities mature and lessons emerge.
  • Agree product, data, operational and customer-readiness criteria; coordinate testing and reconciliation of order flows, payments and key integrations, securing accountable-owner sign-off.
  • Coordinate wave runbooks covering preparation, cutover, validation, rollback and support; lead go/no-go recommendations for approval by accountable business and technical owners.
  • Own operational handover, including named support owners, stabilisation exit criteria and business acceptance; plan controlled legacy retirement after migration.

Stakeholders

  • Align engineering, product, customer-facing and finance teams around one plan and timeline, working with customer-facing teams to keep restaurant partners informed and supported.

Commercial outcomes and reporting

  • Partner with Finance to establish and track business cases, covering migration and parallel-running costs, revenue at risk, legacy-retirement savings and forecast cost to complete.
  • Verify realised benefits with business owners and report progress, customer experience and value delivered to the CTPO and leadership team.

Skills and experience required

  • 5+ years of programme management experience in a technology organisation, including at least 3 years leading platform migrations, customer migrations or post-acquisition integrations.
  • Demonstrated ownership of complex, customer-facing platform migrations, including readiness assessment, cutover, post-migration stabilisation and transition into normal operations.
  • Strong technical literacy: comfortable discussing APIs, data pipelines, CRM migrations, cutover plans and infrastructure decommissioning with engineers.
  • Experience segmenting large customer bases into migration waves, with detailed run books, rollback, hypercare and clear go or no-go criteria.
  • Commercial judgement: you can weigh the cost of a feature gap against the revenue at risk and drive a decision.
  • Excellent stakeholder management across engineering, product, commercial and executive audiences, with a proven ability to secure commitments, resolve competing priorities and lead delivery without relying on direct line-management authority.
  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication, including executive-level reporting.
  • Comfortable working across countries, cultures and time zones.

Nice to have

  • Experience in SaaS, restaurant technology, food ordering, payments or marketplaces.
  • Experience with data platform and CRM migrations.
  • Direct post-acquisition integration experience, and running a repeatable migration approach across multiple programmes.
  • A recognised programme management qualification such as MSP, PRINCE2 or PgMP.

What we offer

  • A senior role with direct visibility to the executive team and real influence on how OrderYOYO grows.
  • Ownership of our migration and integration capability from day one, with the autonomy to shape how it works.
  • Room to grow: as the portfolio expands, the opportunity to build this capability into a dedicated function and lead it.
  • Work across nine European markets alongside engineering, product, data and commercial teams.

Autodesk's culture emphasizes curiosity, rapid innovation, and ownership. We believe in reimagining what is possible, taking smart risks, and pursuing results with urgency. Flow lives that mindset with startup speed, bold goals, and a mission to transform how content gets made.

Content Production (~40% of time)

Google SEO (~25% of time)

Strategy and Growth (~10% of time)

jobs.title: RQ08750 - UX Designer - Senior
jobs.excerpt: GeneralThere are four (4) distinct delivery phases in which user experience designers (task based I&IT consultants) produce deliverables following Ontario Digital Service Design playbook, which outlines the standard process for user experience design.
jobs.description:
General

There are four (4) distinct delivery phases in which user experience designers (task based I&IT consultants) produce deliverables following Ontario Digital Service Design playbook, which outlines the standard process for user experience design.

Delivery Phase 1) Discovery:

Before building a solution, a project team needs to find out whether users need it and whether other solutions exist. The UX Designers responsibilities during this phase are to build an understanding of the problem space/statement, the long and short-term business goals, and the user and business needs.

Deliverables:

  1. Facilitate the Kick-off meeting with the project team to produce such outputs as:
  • Business Model Canvas
  • 5 Whys
  • User Personas
  • Stakeholder Mapping
  • Strategy Map
  • Short- and Long-Term Goals
  • Fears and Challenges
  • Problem Statement
  1. Facilitate user research activities to produce such outputs as:
  • User interview topic Maps, a summary of interrelated topics for the user interview
  • User Interview Scripts to plan and guide user discussion
  • User Interview Synthesis (collection, aggregation and analysis) of written observations recorded during each interview
  • User research findings report
  1. Inception (Science Fair Day):
  • Showcases the work and key findings from this stage to stakeholders outside of the core project team
  • Aligns entire team (business, technical) on what the next steps will be
  • Planning activities for next phase (Alpha)
  1. Other deliverables typically delivered in this phase include:
  • User Storyboard to communicate a story through images displayed in a sequence of panels that chronologically maps the storys main events.
  • Technical Service Blueprint, a diagram that displays the entire process of service delivery including support systems by listing all the activities that happen at each stage, performed by the different roles involved
  • Defined business Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Delivery Phase 2) Alpha:

Alpha is about testing hypotheses and experimentation. The purpose of Alpha is to determine how to meet the user needs that were identified in discovery. This phase is an opportunity to quickly test different approaches with users before building a service.

Deliverables:

  1. Optionally conduct Google Ventures five (5) Day Design Sprint (or variation). This sprint is a five (5) day process for answering critical business questions through design, prototyping, and testing ideas with customers
  2. Produce clickable prototypes of multiple possible solutions
  3. Validate "clickable prototypes with users through usability testing sessions and produce research findings report
  4. Iterate (improve) on clickable prototypes with insights garnered from research findings report
  5. Identify and document existing processes or policies that will need to change to support the new product or service
  6. Produce a business proposal to justify funding for the next phase (Beta)
  7. Define a clear vision for the solution that will be built in Beta
  8. Create a plan and prioritized list of features to be completed in the Beta phase
  9. Define user solution, and delivery of KPIs

Delivery Phase 3) Beta:

The goal of Beta is to build a real service that works well for a larger group of people. The prototypes that were developed and tested during Alpha are used to build a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) for deployment in a live, user-facing environment. Executed within the context of Scrum methodology, the UX Designer performs the following Agile ceremonies: Stand-up meetings, Sprint Planning, Backlog grooming, Reporting, Acceptance, and Retrospective.

The designers are at the spearhead of this methodology, creating and validating user stories for the developers (typical) one iteration ahead.

Deliverables:

  1. User story creation and validation:
    1. Participates in deciding which priority to tackle
    2. Sketching workshop to create visual representation of ideas or user flows
    3. Create designs
    4. Enhancements made to designs
    5. User Interviews (for validation)
    6. Synthesizing individual and overall interview findings
    7. Enhancements to designs made from synthesis
    8. Get product owner sign off and input story into backlog for future iteration planning
    9. Rinse and repeat for each feature, function within a given iteration
  2. Conduct accessibility compliance testing of the solution within each iteration.
  3. Conduct regular usability testing sessions on the MVP built as part of the Beta phase.

Delivery Phase 4) Live:

Live begins when the service has reached a point of maturity and all of the main features in the backlog have been built. While most people understand the purpose of live, its not always given the attention and resources it deserves.

Continuous improvement is one of the core principles of service design and thats what live is all about. The goal is to continuously monitor, research, test and iterate for as long as the service is active.

Deliverables:

  1. Continue to facilitate user research activities to produce such outputs as:
  • User interview topic maps, a summary of interrelated topics for the user interview
  • User interview scripts to plan and guide user discussion
  • User interview synthesis (collection, aggregation and analysis) of written observations recorded during each interview
  • User research findings report
  1. Conduct regular accessibility compliance testing of the live build as improvements are released.
  2. Conduct regular usability testing sessions on the live build.
  3. Analyze usage analytics and user behaviour patterns to track and measure key performance indicators.

SkillsExperience and Skill Set Requirements

Sr. User Experience Designer Evaluation Criteria

User Experience Design 40%

  • Extensive experience in using UX design best practices to design solutions, and a deep understanding of mobile-first and responsive design.
  • Ability to iterate your designs and solutions efficiently and intelligently.
  • 3+ years of relevant experience in participating in complex projects (products) of different sizes, ensuring alignment to plans, best practices and incorporating user-centred design processes and agile (scrum) methodologies.
  • Degree or diploma in graphic design; degree or certification in usability, human-computer interaction, and technical writing a plus
  • Experience in facilitate User Research and Usability testing. Accessibility compliance testing is a plus.
  • Experience in facilitate User Research and Usability testing activities to produce such outputs as:
    • User Interview Topic Maps
    • User Interview Scripts
    • User Interview Synthesis (collection, aggregation and analysis) of written observations recorded during each interview
    • User Research Findings Report

Relationship Management - 20%

  • Demonstrated experience in communication and mediation skills with business teams and core team members to ensure Client projects (products) are progressing according to schedule
  • Experience with strategies and actions to overcome resistance to change and capitalize on forces in support of change during all stages of projects Discovery, Alpha, Beta, Live or similar delivery methodologies
  • Ability to deliver on a (project) product with a balanced team (product owner, user experience designers, developers) by participating in Agile (SCRUM) delivery methodologies

Technical Skills - 30%

  • Expertise in UX software such as JustInMind, InVision, Sketch, Adobe Creative Cloud, Axure, Figma, and Zeplin. HTML5, CSS3, and JS skills (React, Angular, NodeJS), are a plus.

Soft skills - 10%

  • Ability to clearly and effectively communicate design processes, ideas, and solutions to teams and clients.
  • Be excited about collaborating and communicating closely with teams and other stakeholders via a distributed model to regularly deliver design solutions for approval.
  • Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills
  • Strong presentation, verbal and written communication skills
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills


Must haves:

Extensive experience in using UX design best practices to design solutions, and a deep understanding of mobile-first and responsive design

In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. What You’ll Do

BridgeBio is seeking a Director, Managed Markets - Regional - Central to lead access strategy and execution across Ohio, Michigan, Indiana, Illinois, Wisconsin, Minnesota, Iowa, Missouri, Kansas, Nebraska, North Dakota, and South Dakota. The Director will manage relationships with regional commercial payers, FFS and managed Medicaid programs, and aligned IDNs for BridgeBio's current and future rare disease portfolio. The role is accountable for launch readiness, timely formulary and policy review, appropriate coverage, and resolution of access barriers in partnership with Field Reimbursement, Sales, Medical, HEOR, Marketing, Trade, and Pricing and Contracting. The Director will also serve as the corporate relationship owner for HCSC and CareSource, coordinating strategy and regional execution across their affiliated markets. This position reports to the Vice President, Market Access.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain senior-level relationships across assigned regional commercial payers, FFS and managed Medicaid programs, integrated delivery networks, and provider-sponsored health plans throughout the Central territory
  • Own the corporate relationships for HCSC and CareSource, establish the enterprise account strategy, and coordinate affiliate and state-level execution with other aligned Regional Account Directors
  • Develop and execute account-specific business plans for the assigned Central portfolio, including Blue plans, regional payers, Medicaid-focused organizations, and provider-sponsored health plans, to support rapid and durable access for approved products
  • Profile each account's formulary and medical policy review process, utilization management requirements, decision makers, and geographic reach; identify and address launch barriers before P&T and coverage reviews
  • Coordinate with Medical, HEOR, Marketing, Trade, Pricing and Contracting, Field Reimbursement, Sales, and Operations to deliver the clinical and economic value story and resolve access issues
  • Communicate payer policy and coverage changes to field teams, support appropriate pull-through after access wins, and maintain current knowledge of relevant state Medicaid policy and regional market dynamics

Where You’ll Work

This is a remote, field-based role covering Ohio, Michigan, Indiana, Illinois, Wisconsin, Minnesota, Iowa, Missouri, Kansas, Nebraska, North Dakota, and South Dakota, with a strong preference for candidates who live within the geography. The aligned portfolio includes HCSC, CareSource, Blue Cross Blue Shield of Michigan, Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Minnesota, Medica and Dean Health Plan, HealthPartners, Priority Health and Corewell Health, Health Alliance Plan and Henry Ford Health, Medical Mutual of Ohio, Wellmark, UCare, and other assigned regional payers, Medicaid programs, and IDNs.

Who You Are

  • Education: BA/BS degree required
  • Experience: Minimum of 10 years of biotech/pharmaceutical experience, including at least five years in regional payer account management. Demonstrated rare disease launch, contracting, and pull-through experience with regional payers, Medicaid, IDNs, and Centers of Excellence required
  • Central relationships: Established relationships with decision makers at HCSC, CareSource, Blue Cross Blue Shield of Michigan, Priority Health, Medica, HealthPartners, or comparable Central regional payers and IDNs strongly preferred
  • Skills: Effective communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment
  • Solid understanding of the Payer sector, including knowledge of Medical/Pharmacy Benefit Designs, current legislation, and Medicaid (Managed/FFS)
  • Excellent analytical skills and the ability to develop sound strategies in response to the current healthcare marketplace
  • Superior communication (oral and written) and teamwork skills to effectively contribute across cross-functional teams
  • Experience coordinating corporate payer strategy across parent and affiliate relationships, with clear ownership and regional execution responsibilities
  • Ability to understand and present complex clinical data for approved indications
  • Travel: 50-60%

jobs.description:
Remote hire - ideally either UK or Turkey

At Bolt Insight, we build research technology that gives FMCG and CPG brands faster, deeper, and more actionable consumer insight. Our platform combines AI-powered qualitative and quantitative research and we need a Research Director who can bring rigour, curiosity, and strong quantitative craft to everything we do.

This is a hands-on role with real client exposure. You'll lead projects end-to-end, mentor junior researchers, and help push the boundaries of what AI-assisted research can deliver. If you have a strong quant foundation, love translating data into compelling stories, and thrive in a fast-moving environment, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll Do

Lead projects end-to-end

  • Own the full project lifecycle for global clients from methodology design and scoping through to fieldwork, analysis, and final reporting.

  • Work closely with junior Research Executives, guiding their execution, output quality, and professional development.

  • Ensure clear, proactive communication with all stakeholders, delivering strategic insights and actionable recommendations on time.

Own the client relationship

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for your client portfolio, building trust and tailoring research solutions to their specific needs.

  • Lead client calls, contribute to proposals, and follow through on every project commitment.

  • Maintain strong ongoing relationships that drive repeat engagement and client satisfaction.

Deliver rigorous quantitative research

  • Design and execute complex quantitative studies including MaxDiff, conjoint, regression, factor analysis, and segmentation independently and to a high standard.

  • Work fluently in SPSS and Excel (advanced level), including chart production, cross-tabulation, and statistical reporting.

  • Manage Quant AI (BoltQ) projects end-to-end: questionnaire design, logic setup, automated analysis, and report storytelling.

  • Ensure all quant outputs are accurate, clearly structured, and meet client expectations for rigour and insight depth.

Craft strong research narratives

  • Produce output decks that combine analytical clarity with compelling storytelling — findings that clients can act on, not just read.

  • Translate complex quantitative outputs into clear strategic implications for non-technical audiences.

  • Quality-assure AI-generated outputs and ensure all deliverables meet Bolt Insight's standards.

Drive innovation and process improvement

  • Contribute to the development of BoltChatAI and BoltQ by gathering client feedback and identifying improvement opportunities.

  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to enhance AI-driven research capabilities.

  • Develop and refine internal workflows to improve research efficiency and quality across the team.

Develop the team

  • Mentor and train junior researchers in both traditional and AI-assisted methodologies.

  • Foster a culture of learning, collaboration, and professional growth within the research team.

  • Provide input on team expansion and recruitment where needed.

What We're Looking For

Strong quantitative foundation — You've independently delivered complex quant projects — MaxDiff, conjoint, regression, factor analysis, segmentation — and you're comfortable with SPSS and advanced Excel. This isn't a nice to have; it's the core of the role.

End-to-end project ownership — You take full responsibility for delivery, from brief to debrief, and you don't need to be chased to keep things moving.

Client-facing confidence — You're comfortable leading client calls and building relationships. You listen carefully, communicate clearly, and know when to push back constructively.

Storytelling through data — You can turn a MaxDiff output or a regression model into a clear, compelling narrative that actually influences decisions.

AI research curiosity — You're open to — ideally already experienced with — AI-powered research tools. You understand their value and their limits.

Team player and mentor — You enjoy bringing junior colleagues on, sharing what you know, and building team capability over time.

A note on quantitative depth

We'll explore your quant experience directly in the interview process — not to catch you out, but because it matters for this role. We're looking for someone who has genuinely delivered advanced techniques (MaxDiff, conjoint, segmentation) independently, not just observed them. If there are areas where you'd benefit from development, be upfront — we invest in our people and we'd rather know where we can help than find gaps later.

Why Work for Bolt Insight?

At Bolt Insight, we’re a vibrant and growing start-up mentality business with a passionate team that thrives on innovation and collaboration. Here’s what you can expect when you join us:

  • Remote working and the flexibility to work in a nomadic way – Enjoy the best of both worlds, balancing work and life your way.

  • Flexible working environment – We trust you to manage your time and work in a way that suits you best.

  • Private Medical Insurance - Your health and well-being are important to us, and we’ve got you covered.

  • Business referral bonus – If you know someone who’s a great fit for the team, we’ll reward you for it!

  • Employee referral bonus – You get the chance to shape our team and be rewarded for bringing great people onboard.

  • Virtual or local team gatherings – Whether online or in person, we love to connect and celebrate our successes together.

  • In-house recognition awards – We celebrate our ‘lightning bolts’ (those who go above and beyond) and show our appreciation for hard work!

  • Annual Bonus System – If the company meets its targets, you’ll receive a bonus payment of up to two months’ salary! We win together.

At Bolt, curiosity, creativity and passion matter most. If you’re excited about shaping the future of research and contributing to a culture built on innovation and collaboration, we’d love to hear from you.

Bolt Insight is an equal opportunities employer committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive, diverse and professional workplace for all. We strive to create a welcoming environment where all individuals, no matter their background or identity, feel valued and supported.

If you have specific requirements throughout the recruitment process, please reach out to a member of our HR team who will make the appropriate adjustments.

Apply today and join a dynamic, international team driving innovation across borders!

We are seeking an experienced Senior iOS App Developer with an excellent background in native iOS development using Swift and SwiftUI, together with practical experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into iOS applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our iOS application, integrate shared application logic, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development.

Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build mobile applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our native iOS application using Swift and SwiftUI.
  • Integrate Kotlin Multiplatform modules into the iOS application and collaborate on shared business logic.
  • Implement platform-specific functionality while maintaining consistent behavior across iOS and Android.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical iOS challenges such as permissions, application lifecycle, background execution, battery consumption, and device compatibility.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and investigate issues that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and clear explanations.
  • Support application signing, release preparation, and distribution through TestFlight and the App Store.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production iOS applications.
  • Excellent practical knowledge of Swift, SwiftUI, and the iOS development ecosystem.
  • Practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and its integration into native iOS applications.
  • Solid understanding of application architecture, asynchronous programming, lifecycle management, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills across application code, shared modules, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain technical decisions.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, geofencing, and sensor data.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and proximity detection.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Interoperability between Swift and Kotlin Multiplatform, including asynchronous operations and error handling.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful iOS development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into native iOS projects.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.

Public portfolio links, App Store references, or GitHub links are welcome where available.

The Care Coach evaluates member needs, coordinates care, and drives interventions that support improved health outcomes, member experience, and quality performance. What Success Looks Like

Enformion is a dynamic powerhouse in data intelligence and AI-powered identity verification. We deliver next-generation fraud prevention, risk management, and seamless onboarding solutions that foster ironclad trust between digital marketplaces, merchants, and consumers. By leveraging our massive data repositories and advanced behavioral analysis, we provide continuous monitoring for emerging risk indicators.

In a digital world where security and trust are everything, Enformion is at the forefront of the industry—and we are growing fast.

Job Purpose

Enformion provides identity and contact data to enterprise clients through APIs, and supports a network of consumer-facing websites built on that data. Enformion is seeking a Site Reliability Engineer to keep these sites and APIs available, fast, and protected from abusive traffic. This role sits where reliability and security meet.

The SRE will work closely with software engineering, information security, and legal/compliance to build and maintain reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure. The role covers monitoring, resolving complex technical issues, and automating solutions to recurring problems, and it plays a central part in optimizing Enformion platforms and infrastructure.

Salary - $150K-$165K

Responsibilities

Reliability and monitoring

  • Monitor availability, latency, and error rates across Enformion APIs. Define service level objectives and alerting that catch problems before customers do.
  • Lead troubleshooting and resolution of production incidents. Run blameless post-incident reviews and track follow-up actions to completion.
  • Automate recurring operational work and remediation, reducing manual toil.
  • Plan capacity and tune performance across the CDN, application, and data tiers.

Traffic protection and abuse mitigation

  • Design solutions that automatically identify harmful or unwanted traffic, including scraping, malicious bots, credential stuffing, fake account creation, and API key abuse.
  • Configure and tune CDN, WAF, bot management, and rate-limiting controls to block abusive traffic without degrading the experience for legitimate users and clients.
  • Analyze traffic logs to understand how abusive actors behave, how they evade controls, and what they cost in infrastructure load and revenue.
  • Investigate new abuse patterns and trends, and work with the Data Abuse & Detection Engineer to turn findings into enforced edge and application controls.
  • Enforce acceptable-use and terms-of-service policies at the infrastructure level.

Infrastructure security

  • Manage infrastructure as code and apply security policy checks before changes reach production.
  • Apply least-privilege IAM, network segmentation, TLS management, and secrets handling across AWS environments.
  • Integrate security checks into CI/CD pipelines in partnership with the DevSecOps Lead, including dependency, container, and configuration scanning.
  • Detect and remediate configuration drift, and maintain centralized logging that supports both operations and security investigations.
  • Provide evidence from automated controls for audits and client security questionnaires.

Collaboration

  • Work with Engineering, Marketing, Product, and Legal/Compliance to update policies, close product loopholes, and protect site quality and data integrity.
  • Help marketing and product teams understand how traffic quality affects analytics, conversion metrics, and campaign reporting.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3 years of experience with security attacks and mitigation methods, particularly bot, scraping, and application-layer threats.
  • Hands-on experience with CDN providers (Akamai, Cloudflare, Fastly) and their traffic management, WAF, and bot management features.
  • Experience with Elastic/OpenSearch or a comparable platform for log mining and analytics.
  • Solid understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, and TLS, and how to manage traffic at each layer.
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and scripting (Python, Bash, or similar).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Observability tooling (e.g. Datadog).

  • Familiarity with SLOs, error budgets, and incident management practices.

The PR industry hasn't really changed in fifty years. Relationships, lunches, luck, and a clip report at the end of the month.

Interdependence is rebuilding it from the ground up. Interviewed, our proprietary platform, analyzes 300,000+ stories every day across a network of 250,000 journalists. We turn earned media into something measurable, repeatable, and worth paying for, and apply the same data and discipline across paid, social, content, and brand. Integrated marketing run by one team, on one system, accountable to one result.

Forbes named us one of America's Best PR Agencies. Our 100+ person team works with brands, CMOs, founders, and entrepreneurs across consumer, healthcare, tech, B2B, travel and entertainment.

We move fast. The best argument wins. We hire for sharp thinking, real craft, and ownership from day one. If you want comfortable, this isn't the place. If you want to win, build with us.

THE ROLE

Interdependence is looking for an enthusiastic, detail-oriented Account Executive to support our Public Relations team. In this role, you'll assist in developing and executing creative PR campaigns, supporting client relationships, and collaborating closely with a dynamic team. This position is ideal for someone eager to grow their career in public relations, media relations, and client service.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Client Support

  • Assist in the day-to-day management of PR accounts, helping build strong relationships and ensuring exceptional client service.
  • Support the development and implementation of strategic PR plans that align with client objectives.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to enhance client results.

Campaign Development & Execution

  • Contribute to the creation and execution of PR campaigns, including media outreach, influencer collaborations, and event activations.
  • Help draft press materials such as press releases, pitches, media alerts, and client communications.
  • Conduct media outreach to secure coverage and enhance brand visibility for clients.

Team Collaboration

  • Work collaboratively with senior team members and peers, actively participating in brainstorming and planning sessions.
  • Assist with project coordination to ensure timely delivery of high-quality work.

Insights & Reporting

  • Stay informed about industry trends, media landscapes, and consumer insights.
  • Help track and compile campaign results, preparing clear and insightful client reports.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in public relations, communications, marketing, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of PR or communications experience, ideally within an agency environment.
  • Experience with or interest in PR, media relations, and influencer marketing.
  • Strong writing, editing, and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven success in media outreach and securing coverage.
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple accounts and deadlines.
  • Creative, curious, and passionate about health and lifestyle storytelling.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT INTERDEPENDENCE

🏡 100% Remote, Forever - Work from anywhere in the world while you enjoy the flexibility of your fully remote workplace. Skip the annoying commute, create a workspace that works for you, and collaborate with teammates across the country, all without sacrificing connection or career growth.

📈 Career Growth - As one of the nation's fastest-growing strategic integrated marketing and communications firms, we're committed to helping ambitious people like you grow. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, lead from every level, and build a career with meaningful real impact.

🌟 Supportive, Collaborative Culture - We set high standards, celebrate big wins, and work together to achieve exceptional results. You'll join a team that's collaborative, entrepreneurial, and committed to helping one another succeed.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Paid Media Specialist (B2B Healthcare Tech)

Reports to: Director of Digital Marketing

Location: Remote, U.S.*

Type: Full-Time, Salaried, Exempt

Compensation: $70,000 - $85,000 annual salary range, depending on experience

Benefits: Generous PTO, employer-subsidized Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Life, HSA/FSA accounts, and 401(k) with 4% employer match

About the Company

In 2025, through the addition of several new business lines, Sentact expanded to form a truly unique company with the goal of strategically addressing a critical need for healthcare organizations – specifically, offering an integrated suite of solutions to encompass patient safety, quality, experience, and regulatory readiness. From credentialing to peer review, to comprehensive rounding for safety and experience, to clinical analytics, incident reporting and a market-leading patient safety organization, Sentact’s solutions address the pressing operational and regulatory challenges facing healthcare leaders today. And our story is still being written – with the help of our customers. We will continue to evolve as we listen and respond to the needs of our customers, empowering them to reimagine the path to exceptional care.

About the Role

Sentact is looking for a results-driven Paid Media Specialist to own the day-to-day execution and optimization of our paid advertising programs. You’ll manage campaigns across platforms like Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads (and potentially Meta, Bing, Adroll), partnering closely with Marketing to translate strategy into performance.

This role is ideal for someone who loves performance marketing, has strong testing instincts, and can connect campaign data to practical actions that improve efficiency and lead quality.

What You’ll Do

  • Build, launch, and manage paid campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and additional platforms as applicable (Meta, Bing, Adroll).
  • Translate campaign goals and offers (webinars, case studies, demos, content) into targeting, ad structure, budgets, and testing plans.
  • Own weekly optimization: improve CTR, CPC, conversion rate, CPL, and lead quality through ongoing iteration.
  • Manage creative testing in partnership with the marketing team and designer; provide clear feedback based on performance.
  • Coordinate with Marketing on landing page performance and conversion optimization recommendations.
  • Ensure accurate tracking and attribution:
    • Apply and QA UTM conventions (Cometly UTM conventions)
    • Validate conversion tracking and tag behavior (partnering with GTM/analytics owner as needed)
  • Monitor spend pacing and budget allocation; flag risks and opportunities early.
  • Produce clear reporting and insights, with learnings, recommendations, and next tests.
  • Maintain account hygiene: naming conventions, documentation, change logs, and platform best practices.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience (B2B preferred).
  • Strong experience in Google Ads (Search/Display/YouTube as applicable), LinkedIn Ads (Lead Gen + website conversion campaigns), and Microsoft Ads.
  • Demonstrated ability to optimize toward conversion outcomes (not just clicks/impressions).
  • AI forward approach to paid media management
  • Working knowledge of tracking fundamentals: UTMs, pixels, GA4 basics, conversion events, Google Tag Manager collaboration.
  • Comfortable managing multiple campaigns simultaneously with strong attention to detail.
  • Clear communicator. Able to explain performance, tradeoffs, and recommendations to non-specialists.
  • Proactive, test-and-learn mindset with strong ownership and follow-through.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience marketing to healthcare organizations (providers, systems, quality/safety, HR/workforce, patient experience).
  • Experience with HubSpot landing pages/forms, WordPress, lead routing, and basic funnel reporting. Hubspot certifications are a plus.
  • Experience in Google Ads (Search/Display/YouTube as applicable), LinkedIn Ads (Lead Gen + website conversion campaigns), and Microsoft Ads. Google certifications are a plus.
  • Familiarity with Cometly or similar attribution tooling and UTM frameworks.
  • Experience running retargeting and multi-touch nurture support.
  • Experience collaborating closely with creative resources (design/video) and providing performance-led direction.
  • Experience with dynamic ad and video creation an/or direction for optimizing campaigns.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Cost per lead (CPL) and lead quality
  • Conversion rate (landing page & ad platform)
  • CTR / CPC / CPM efficiency
  • Spend pacing and budget utilization
  • Pipeline influence (when tracking is available)
  • Velocity of testing and measurable iteration

Nice-to-Have Traits

  • Highly organized and documentation-oriented
  • Curious, analytical, and comfortable working with imperfect data
  • Self-starter who can operate with clear goals and minimal oversight
  • Ability to copywriter

*We are unable to employ applicants located in the State of Hawaii at this time

Sentact provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, sex or gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, age, disability, genetic information, service in the military, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances.

Salary: $70,000 - $85,000

jobs.description:
Le contexte:

Notre practice Infra Cloud & Cyber accompagne des clients grands comptes sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie de leurs infrastructures : conception, transformation, sécurisation et maintien en condition opérationnelle. Nos environnements sont majoritairement hybrides, mêlant datacenters privés, cloud public et contraintes fortes de sécurité et de conformité.

Vous intervenez comme architecte infrastructure référent, sur des sujets de refonte de datacenter, de modernisation, de virtualisation, de stockage, de réseau et de plans de continuité.

Une practice en construction, et vous en êtes acteur. Notre practice est engagée dans une démarche de structuration : construction d'offres packagées, développement d'accélérateurs, industrialisation de nos référentiels. Vous ne rejoignez pas une organisation figée — vous aurez la possibilité réelle de faire évoluer la practice, de contribuer à la définition de nos offres et de laisser votre empreinte sur nos standards techniques

Vos missions:

Architecture et conception:

  • concevoir des architectures d'infrastructure cibles : compute, stockage, réseau, virtualisation, sauvegarde
  • Réaliser des audits d'infrastructure existante et construire les trajectoires de transformation
  • Définir les architectures hybrides et les stratégies d'interconnexion avec le cloud public
  • Concevoir les plans de reprise et de continuité d'activité (PRA/PCA) et les valider par des tests 2.

Transformation et delivery

  • Piloter techniquement les projets de migration, de consolidation ou de refonte de datacenter
  • Définir les standards d'industrialisation et d'automatisation : IaC, gestion de configuration
  • Garantir la cohérence entre les choix d'infrastructure et les exigences de sécurité portées par notre verticale Cyber

Avant-vente et réponse aux appels d'offres

  • Participer à la rédaction technique de nos réponses aux appels d'offres : conception de la solution, argumentaire technique, dimensionnement, chiffrage
  • Défendre nos propositions en soutenance client
  • Contribuer à la qualification technique des besoins et à la construction des trajectoires proposées

Contribution à la structuration de la practice

  • Construire et faire évoluer nos offres packagées sur le domaine infrastructure : contenu, livrables types, modèle de chiffrage
  • Développer nos accélérateurs : référentiels d'architecture, matrices de choix technologiques, modèles de dimensionnement, kits d'audit
  • Contribuer à la structuration de la verticale Infrastructure : standards, bonnes pratiques, capitalisation des retours d'expérience
  • Animer la communauté technique de la verticale
  • Participer aux entretiens techniques de recrutement et à la qualification des profils

Le profil que nous recherchons:

Diplôme et expérience

  • BAC+5, diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent
  • Expérience : 8 ans minimum en infrastructure, dont 3 ans en position d'architecte

Compétences techniques

  • Virtualisation : VMware vSphere, et ouverture aux alternatives (Proxmox, Nutanix, Hyper-V) dans un contexte de marché en recomposition
  • Systèmes : Linux (RHEL, Debian) et Windows Server, Active Directory
  • Stockage et sauvegarde : SAN/NAS, solutions de sauvegarde et de réplication
  • Réseau : routage, switching, segmentation, load balancing, firewalling
  • Automatisation : Ansible, Terraform, scripting (PowerShell, Bash, Python)
  • Supervision et observabilité : Zabbix, Prometheus, Grafana ou équivalents
  • Culture cloud hybride : compréhension des modèles IaaS et des mécanismes d'interconnexion
  • Sensibilité forte aux enjeux de sécurité : durcissement, segmentation, gestion des accès à privilèges

Certifications

  • VMware VCP, certifications Red Hat (RHCE), Cisco (CCNP) ou équivalentes appréciées
  • Une certification cloud, niveau associate minimum, est un plus

Savoir-être

  • Capacité à prendre de la hauteur sans perdre le contact avec la réalité opérationnelle
  • Pédagogie et clarté dans la formalisation : vos livrables sont lus par des décideurs
  • Envie de construire : la structuration d'une practice demande de l'initiative autant que de l'expertise
  • Rigueur et sens du risque : sur ces environnements, l'erreur coûte cher

Ce que nous vous proposons:

  • Un rôle qui dépasse la mission : contribution directe à nos offres, à nos accélérateurs et à la structuration de la practice
  • Une implication en avant-vente : rédaction technique des appels d'offres et soutenances client
  • Un budget formation et certification dédié, avec un plan individualisé construit avec votre référent de verticale
  • Un accès à notre lab technique
  • Une communauté technique structurée : weekly de verticale, monthly de practice, temps d'échange réguliers
  • Un parcours d'évolution vers l'expertise (architecte principal, référent de verticale) ou vers le management
  • Des sujets de fond, sur des infrastructures critiques chez des clients exigeants

« Notre développement international et notre position de leader sur le marché de l’Ingénierie et du conseil en Technologies nous confèrent une responsabilité sociale, sociétale et environnementale envers l’ensemble de nos interlocuteurs et parties prenantes », Simon Azoulay – Président Directeur Général d’ALTEN.

ALTEN accompagne la stratégie de développement de ses clients dans les domaines de l’innovation, de la R&D et des systèmes d’information technologiques.

Plus qu’un poste, découvrez l’aventure ALTEN !

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Integration Project Manager (VSG UK)

The Vesta Software Group acquires, manages, and builds software companies in a variety of vertical markets, enabling them to be clear leaders in their industries. Our companies provide mission-critical enterprise solutions for vertical industries across the entire industry value chain.

Being a portfolio group of Jonas Software (within Constellation Software Inc.), the Vesta Software Group is all about strengthening businesses within the markets in which we compete and enabling them to grow – whether through organic measures such as new initiatives and product development, day-to-day business, or through acquisitions.

Role overview

We are seeking a highly organised and proactive Integration Project Manager to support the delivery of our integration and value-creation strategy. This role is suited to someone with strong project-management fundamentals who can coordinate a strategy team, maintain momentum across workstreams, and provide clear visibility of progress, risks, and decisions.

The Integration Project Manager will translate the integration thesis into an actionable plan, coordinate execution across the strategy team and wider business, and ensure challenges are identified and escalated early. The role manages the delivery process rather than directly managing the strategy team's performance.

Key responsibilities

  • Translate the integration and value-creation thesis into clear workstreams, milestones, owners, dependencies, and deliverables.
  • Coordinate the strategy team and relevant functional stakeholders to execute agreed initiatives.
  • Maintain the integrated project plan, ensuring actions, decisions, and deadlines are clearly documented.
  • Monitor delivery against agreed milestones, priorities, and expected outcomes.
  • Prepare concise weekly and monthly progress reports for senior stakeholders.
  • Track key performance indicators and support measurement of benefits delivered against the original thesis.
  • Identify risks, blockers, dependencies, and resource constraints, escalating them promptly with practical recommendations.
  • Facilitate project meetings, document decisions, and follow up with owners to ensure actions are completed.
  • Support alignment between the strategy team, operational teams, and leadership.
  • Help improve project-management tools, governance processes, and reporting templates.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation and create a clear audit trail of progress and decisions.

Candidate profile

  • Approximately 2–4 years of experience in project management, strategy, consulting, business operations, integration, or a similar role.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage several workstreams simultaneously.
  • Comfortable coordinating colleagues and stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
  • Clear and concise written and verbal communication skills.
  • Able to produce structured progress reports and communicate issues to senior stakeholders.
  • Proactive, dependable, and willing to follow through on actions.
  • Good judgement about when to resolve an issue independently and when to escalate it.
  • Strong working knowledge of PowerPoint and Excel; experience with project-management tools is beneficial.
  • Exposure to post-merger integration, transformation, private equity, or value-creation programmes is desirable but not essential.

Measures of success

  • Integration initiatives are delivered on time and remain aligned with the original thesis.
  • Senior stakeholders have accurate and timely visibility of progress.
  • Risks and challenges are identified and escalated before they affect delivery.
  • Actions, owners, dependencies, and decisions are consistently documented.
  • The strategy team and functional stakeholders remain aligned and accountable.
  • Expected benefits are tracked and supported by reliable evidence.

Business Unit:

Vesta Software Group

Scheduled Weekly Hours:

37.5

Number of Openings Available:

1

Worker Type:

Regular

Career Site:

More About Jonas Software:

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

jobs.excerpt: About SH/FT Shift Paradigm is an execution-led strategic consultancy that bridges the gap between enterprise strategy and technical reality.
jobs.description:
About SH/FT

Shift Paradigm is an execution-led strategic consultancy that bridges the gap between enterprise strategy and technical reality. We partner with Fortune 500 brands and emerging leaders to solve the inherent complexity of modern digital marketing. As partners to the world’s leading MarTech platforms, including Adobe, Salesforce, Optimizely, and Braze, we deploy integrated experts across data analytics, marketing strategy, technology development, engineering, and revenue operations to ensure our clients’ tech stacks don't just exist, but perform.

The Role

We’re searching for a high-impact sales professional who intimately understands the nuances of how professional services are bought and sold. Unlike SaaS sales roles, this position requires a consultative mindset and the ability to navigate complex multi-stakeholder enterprise environments. You will be responsible for generating and qualifying pipeline by identifying enterprise organizations with fragmented digital ecosystems, specifically those underserved in areas of lifecycle and data strategy, marketing automation, web experience, and revenue operations. Your goal is to credibly connect these complex operational gaps to SHIFT’s holistic consulting and implementation capabilities. In addition, you’ll need strong persuasion skills to turn prospects into qualified leads. Our ideal candidate is someone who has 2-4 years of sales experience specifically within a professional services agency or consultancy.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Craft relevant and compelling cold outreach messages to identified POC’s within target accounts
  • Partner with GTM and Client Partner team members to build pipeline, develop targeted campaigns (e.g. email cadences) to key segments, and close deals
  • Continuously sourcing new sales opportunities into enterprise-level organizations with complex marketing technology needs through inbound lead follow-up and outbound cold calls and emails
  • Listening for potential client buying signals and engage in high-level business conversations with CMOs, CTOs and VPs of Marketing about their long-term digital and marketing roadmaps.
  • Route qualified opportunities to the appropriate Client Partner for further development and closure
  • Achieve monthly & quarterly quotas
  • Research accounts, identify key players and generate interest
  • Maintain and expand your database of prospects, utilizing all forms of information possible
  • Support pre-meeting preparation with Client Partner & Delivery Leads and collaborate closely with technical and delivery teams to ensure prospective clients understand the depth of our experience and how we scope hours against client business requirements.
  • Conduct and facilitate effective first call meetings with prospects to validate opportunity and qualify to the next stage of the sales cycle.

What You Bring

Experience & Expertise

  • Intent-Driven & Strategic Prospecting: Ability to research an organization’s tech stack and identify specific pain points where a consultancy can add immediate value. Experience using 6sense (or similar intent platforms) to identify "in-market" accounts and prioritize outreach based on buying signals.
  • CRM & Conversation Intelligence: Proficient in Salesforce.com for pipeline management and Chorus for call analysis, coaching, and deal tracking.
  • Modern Outreach Channels: Demonstrated success using LinkedIn Sales Navigator and other social selling platforms to build relationships and secure meetings.
  • Inbound Lead Management: Experience managing high-intent leads from real-time sources, specifically Adobe Dynamic Chat or similar conversational marketing bots.
  • Agency or Consultancy Background: Proven experience working within a fast-paced agency or professional services consultancy environment (especially within the Adobe or Salesforce ecosystems). You must understand how to sell ‘hours and outcomes’ rather than ‘seats and licenses’.
  • MarTech Ecosystem Knowledge: Familiarity with enterprise ecosystems and martech stacks (i.e Adobe or Salesforce), helping you speak the "language" of our partners and clients.
  • Enterprise-Level Prospecting and Navigation: Proven track record of identifying, engaging and navigating the long sales cycles of Fortune 500/Enterprise organizations across VP and C-level decision-makers.

Skills & Capabilities

  • Speed-to-Lead Excellence: The ability to pivot quickly from outbound tasks to engage internally identified high-intent leads ensuring no lead goes cold.
  • Signal-Based Outreach: The skill to translate 6sense "intent data" into highly personalized, relevant messaging that resonates with a prospect's current pain points.
  • Active Listening & Iteration: Utilizing Chorus insights to self-coach, refine scripts, and improve discovery questions based on what is actually working in the market.
  • Multichannel Execution: Seamlessly orchestrating outreach across phone, email, LinkedIn, etc., to surround target accounts.
  • Prioritization & Organization: Managing a complex daily workflow of inbound leads, outbound "warm" accounts (from 6sense), and administrative CRM hygiene.

Mindset

  • Data-Curious: You don't just follow a list; you enjoy "playing detective" with 6sense data to find the best angle into an account.
  • Agile & Responsive: Comfortable in an "always-on" environment where you can balance deep-work prospecting with the urgency of a live chat request.
  • Growth-Oriented: Being open to feedback and constantly reviewing your own performance to sharpen your sales craft.
  • Tech-Forward: An early adopter mindset that views sales technology as an accelerator rather than a chore.
  • Consultative Curiosity: You view yourself as a partner to the prospect, not just a seller; you are eager to understand how complex ecosystems like Adobe and Salesforce can solve their business and marketing challenges.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation aligned with your experience and impact
  • Remote flexibility
  • Collaborative culture that values diverse perspectives and innovative thinking
  • Work that makes a measurable difference for your clients

Why SH/FT:

SH/FT is a consultancy built for transformation. We bridge the gap between marketing, data, and technology to unlock growth for some of the world's most recognized brands. At SH/FT you'll shape the future of how organizations connect with their customers through intelligent architecture, scalable systems, and the power of data-driven strategy.

Comp & Benefits

The salary range for this role is $65,000 to $75,000 USD + commissions. Salary is based on several factors including but not limited to skillset, relevant education, level of experience, certifications, and scope of responsibilities.

In addition to base salary, SH/FT offers benefits such as medical, dental, vision, STD/LTD, Life/AD&D, Flexible Paid Time Off, and various other ancillary benefits and perks.

We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities under the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Candidates must have current US or Canada work authorization. For US candidates, this employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the US.

No relocation assistance can be offered at this time.

All inquiries are held in strict confidence.

US Based Salary: $96,153.85 - $130,000 DOE

About Us

NGP VAN is the winningest technology platform in the history of democratic and progressive causes, working tirelessly to innovate and advance the technology our clients rely on to bolster our democracy. We help power the trailblazers, campaigners, and advocates fighting up and down the ticket for equality, racial justice, reproductive freedom, democracy, climate reform, and more— including the national Democratic committees and progressive organizations, thousands of Democratic campaigns, hundreds of labor unions, advocacy organizations, progressive and non-partisan PACs, and other organizations.

About the Role

Bonterra / NGP VAN — Fundraising & Compliance Engineering Team

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join Bonterra/NGP VAN's Fundraising & Compliance Engineering team. You'll help build and scale the tools that power how progressive campaigns and nonprofits raise money and accurately track and report that activity — work that directly supports election readiness and democratic participation at scale.

This role offers the opportunity to work on industry-leading applications using modern technologies including ASP.NET, ReactJS, SQL Server, Azure, AWS, Redis, ElasticSearch, and Auth0 for authentication and identity management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architecture & Technical Leadership: Participate in system design decisions for complex features and subsystems. Propose approaches that balance performance, maintainability, scalability, and business needs. Identify opportunities to simplify scope, reduce code complexity, and eliminate technical debt proactively.
  • Mentorship & Code Stewardship: Mentor peers through thoughtful code reviews, design collaboration, and knowledge sharing. Model engineering best practices and help raise the technical bar across your team.
  • Feature Ownership: Design and implement features for fundraising, compliance, and election readiness workflows. Develop and maintain third-party integrations. Deliver high-quality, maintainable code that meets performance, security, and scalability standards.
  • AI-Assisted Development: Apply AI coding tools independently to accelerate complex work. Write clear, well-defined specs that enable effective AI-assisted development and evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, security, and maintainability.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work with product management and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure cohesive solutions and strong alignment across the platform.

Requirements

  • Significant experience or a strong foundation in software engineering — typically 5 years
  • Solid understanding of web scalability challenges and solutions
  • Demonstrated willingness and ability to use AI coding tools to enhance your development workflow
  • Comfort working independently on complex, less-defined problems and proposing solutions
  • Experience mentoring peers and participating in architecture discussions
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

Preferred Qualifications

  • 7+ years of software development experience, or equivalent skills
  • Strong JavaScript skills, especially with ReactJS
  • Proficiency in C# and ASP.NET
  • Experience working with SQL Server; candidates with deeper experience in performance tuning or query optimization are encouraged to highlight that
  • Experience in political software, campaign technology, or election readiness
  • Hands-on experience with Azure, Redis, and ElasticSearch
  • Experience with AWS cloud services
  • Experience building or integrating AI/LLM-powered product features
  • Experience with third-party API integrations

Why Join Us

You will join a diverse, inclusive organization that celebrates each individual's unique background and expertise, helping to power impact through shared values and a collective vision.

  • Build tools that support fundraising, compliance, and election readiness for progressive campaigns and nonprofits

jobs.excerpt: ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIESRequirements Engineering• Elicit, document and maintain URS and FRS for each platform module, using structured workshops, process walkthroughs, system demonstrations and review of current SOPs, work instructions and conventions.
jobs.description:
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Requirements Engineering

  • Elicit, document and maintain URS and FRS for each platform module, using structured workshops, process walkthroughs, system demonstrations and review of current SOPs, work instructions and conventions.
  • Produce the supporting artefacts: as-is and to-be process maps, data-flow diagrams, user stories with acceptance criteria, business rules, data dictionaries, interface specifications and non-functional requirements (performance, availability, security, auditability, data retention).
  • Build and maintain the Requirements Traceability Matrix from URS to FRS to design, test cases and validation evidence, so every requirement can be implemented and tested.
  • Run requirement reviews with PV operations, Quality, IT Security, Data Privacy and Engineering; manage change control on approved requirements.
  • Prioritize with the Product Owner, write release-level scope statements and support sprint planning and backlog refinement.

Domain coverage

You will specify requirements across the following modules, working with the respective PV subject-matter experts:

  • Global and local literature search strategy management, database connectors (MEDLINE/PubMed, Embase and others), de-duplication, AI-assisted relevance screening and ICSR identification, full-text handling, reviewer workflow, hit-level audit trail, reconciliation and KPIs; alignment with GVP Module VI and local literature requirements.
  • Multi-channel intake (email, portal, call centre, partner feeds, literature, social media), duplicate detection, AI-assisted data extraction from unstructured sources, MedDRA and WHODrug coding support, seriousness and expectedness assessment, narrative generation with human review, E2B(R3) submission, follow-up management, and integration with safety databases (e.g. Argus, LifeSphere, Veeva Vault Safety).
  • Data sources (safety database, EudraVigilance, FAERS, literature), disproportionality and signal detection methods, signal validation, prioritisation, assessment and tracking workflows, signal-to-risk linkage, and documentation aligned to GVP Module IX.
  • Data retrieval and reconciliation, line listings and summary tabulations, AI-assisted section drafting with locked source-to-text traceability, author and reviewer workflow, version control, schedule and submission tracking, aligned to 21 CFR 314.80 and ICH E2C(R2).
  • Source and channel configuration, listening rules, AI classification of posts for potential adverse events, identifiability and validity criteria, PII handling, reviewer workflow and conversion to case intake, aligned to GVP Module VI and FDA guidance on internet and social media.
  • PSMF support, audit-trail reporting and query, compliance dashboards (timeliness, quality, backlog), deviation and CAPA linkage, document and training evidence retrieval, and the ability to reproduce any AI-assisted decision on request.

Agentic AI specifics

  • Define, for every agent in the platform, its role, inputs, tools, permitted actions and decision authority, and the human-in-the-loop checkpoints where a qualified person must review, approve or override.
  • Specify AI output acceptance criteria with the SMEs: target precision and recall for screening and classification tasks, confidence thresholds for auto-routing versus human review, and how performance is measured and monitored in production.
  • Write requirements for explainability and auditability of AI decisions: rationale capture, source citation, prompt and model version logging, reproducibility, and retention of the evidence an inspector would ask for.
  • Specify guardrails: what agents must never do without human approval (e.g. submit an ICSR, close a signal, finalise a report), handling of low-confidence or out-of-distribution inputs, and fallback behaviour when a model or tool is unavailable.
  • Define requirements for model lifecycle governance: evaluation datasets, change control for prompts and models, regression testing, periodic review, and restrictions on use of client data for model training.

Regulatory, quality and privacy compliance

  • Translate the following into explicit, testable requirements and work with Quality on validation strategy:
    • 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11: electronic records, electronic signatures, audit trails, access control, data integrity (ALCOA+), system security, record retention and retrieval.
    • GDPR and other applicable data-protection laws: lawful basis, data minimisation, pseudonymisation, data-subject rights, cross-border transfer, retention and deletion, privacy by design; support Data Protection Impact Assessments.
    • GVP Modules (notably I, II, IV, VI, VII, IX) and ICH E2B(R3), E2C(R2), E2D, E2E as they apply to each module.
    • Computerised system validation: GAMP 5 (second edition), risk-based and Computer Software Assurance approaches; author or contribute to validation plans, functional risk assessments, test strategies and traceability.
    • Quality Management System requirements for product development: SDLC procedures, change control, deviation and CAPA management, supplier qualification, documentation standards; alignment with ISO 9001 and information-security frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2).
    • Emerging AI-specific regulation and guidance (EU AI Act, FDA and EMA positions on AI in pharmacovigilance and GxP): assess applicability, track developments and reflect them in requirements.
  • Act as the requirements-side point of contact during internal audits and client or regulatory inspections of the platform.

Stakeholder and delivery

  • Work day-to-day with PV operations leads, medical reviewers, Quality Assurance, Data Privacy, IT Security, product management, UX, data scientists and engineers.
  • Support UAT: author or review test scripts against the FRS, coordinate business testers, triage defects and confirm requirement coverage.
  • Prepare release notes, user-facing functional documentation and training inputs for operations teams.
  • Contribute to client-facing material describing how the platform meets regulatory expectations.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Bachelor's degree in life sciences, pharmacy, nursing, medicine, computer science or a related field.
  • 6+ years in pharmacovigilance or PV systems, with at least 3 years in a business analyst, systems analyst or product requirements role on GxP software.
  • Demonstrated experience authoring URS and FRS (and ideally validation documentation) for PV or other regulated life-sciences systems.
  • Working knowledge of at least four of the six domain areas above, gained in operations, a safety-system implementation or a technology vendor; hands-on familiarity with at least one commercial safety database (Argus, LifeSphere, Veeva Vault Safety or equivalent).
  • Solid understanding of 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, data-integrity principles and GDPR, and of how they translate into system requirements.
  • Experience working within a QMS and formal SDLC (change control, CSV/CSA, traceability, deviation handling).
  • Practical understanding of how LLMs and AI agents work, their failure modes, and what it takes to make their output acceptable in a regulated setting. Prior involvement in an AI or automation project in PV is strongly preferred.
  • Strong analytical writing: you can produce a requirement that an engineer can build, a tester can test and an auditor can verify, without ambiguity.
  • Comfortable with Agile delivery and tools such as Jira, Confluence or Azure DevOps.

Preferred

  • Experience with E2B(R3) implementation, MedDRA and WHODrug coding, and EudraVigilance or FAERS data.
  • Experience specifying NLP, machine-learning or GenAI features (classification, extraction, summarisation) including evaluation metrics and acceptance criteria.
  • Familiarity with GAMP 5 second edition and the FDA Computer Software Assurance approach.
  • Awareness of the EU AI Act and of EMA/FDA reflection papers on AI in the medicinal-product lifecycle.
  • Prior participation in regulatory inspections or client audits of PV systems.
  • Certifications such as CBAP, PMI-PBA, or ISPE/GAMP training.
