Hands‑On Engineering • Autonomous System Integration • Mission‑Thread Enablement

Itegrate autonomy software with real assets, validate behaviors in simulation and field environments, and ensure that autonomous agents act over trusted data, in real time, under real mission pressures.


MISSION & IMPACT

Autonomy Integration & System Engineering

  • Integrate autonomy stacks onto UAS, multi‑vehicle swarms, and robotic platforms, including navigation, perception, cooperative behaviors, and distributed decision-making.
  • Implement real‑time autonomy pipelines that incorporate sensing, fusion, planning, and control across diverse air/ground systems.
  • Adapt and optimize autonomy algorithms for constrained edge environments (embedded systems, GPUs/VPUs, tactical compute nodes).

Data‑ and Knowledge‑Aligned Autonomy

  • Build data pipelines and semantic alignment layers so autonomous systems operate against trusted, structured, and meaning‑preserving data representations.
  • Integrate autonomy with ontology-driven or schema-governed data models to ensure consistent entity tracking, mission-state representation, and decision context.
  • Enable retrieval‑grounded behaviors where autonomous agents act based on authoritative, updated, and fused situational information.

Edge Deployment Across Contested Environments

  • Deploy AI/ML models and autonomy services to edge compute environments (K3s/RKE2, containers, bare metal).
  • Harden autonomy behaviors for degraded communications, GPS denial, EW threats, sensor loss, and variable latency.
  • Implement resilient synchronization patterns between edge devices and enterprise/tactical nodes.

Simulation, Experimentation, and Field Testing

  • Conduct structured field experiments with unmanned vehicles, swarms, multi‑agent behaviors, and C2 workflows.
  • Validate mission‑thread performance across detection, tasking, coordination, and operator-in-the-loop behaviors.

Agentic Workflow Integration

  • Integrate agent frameworks enabling autonomy agents to plan, coordinate, task, and interact with mission tools and human operators.
  • Define safety gates, oversight mechanisms, and deterministic tool‑use patterns that support “human‑on‑the‑loop” operations.
  • Support multi‑agent cooperation through standard APIs and interoperable messaging patterns.

C2, Networks, and Cross‑Domain Integration

  • Integrate autonomous systems with tactical C2 platforms, data links, secure communications, and multi‑domain operational workflows.
  • Implement open standards (MOSA, SOSA, CMOSS, open messaging protocols) for plug‑and‑play component integration.
  • Enable interoperability across joint, partner‑nation, and coalition environments with appropriate policy controls.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Build full autonomy pipelines end‑to‑end, from sensing through action execution.
  • Deploy CV, tracking, SLAM, pattern‑learning, anomaly detection, and cooperative‑agent models on real unmanned systems.
  • Integrate heterogeneous sensors, radios, and payloads with autonomy decision loops.
  • Conduct troubleshooting and rapid problem resolution across autonomy software, embedded systems, edge clusters, and C2 interfaces.
  • Translate mission problems into executable autonomy behaviors and scenario‑specific workflows.
  • Train teams and mission personnel on system configuration, safety, deployment, and best practices.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

Core Background

  • Education: BA/BS or equivalent
  • Experience: 10+ years in unmanned systems, autonomy engineering, robotics integration, or embedded AI/ML deployment.
  • Direct experience integrating autonomy into UAS, drones, swarms, robotic vehicles, or similar platforms.
  • Strong proficiency in C++, Python, and real‑time/embedded software patterns.

Technical Expertise

  • Autonomy functions: motion planning, cooperative behaviors, obstacle avoidance, distributed coordination, sensor fusion, and real‑time decision-making.
  • Robotics frameworks: ROS/ROS2, PX4/ArduPilot, MAVLink, simulation tools (Gazebo, AirSim, custom environments).
  • AI/ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX, JAX.
  • Edge compute: NVIDIA Jetson, VPUs, ruggedized x86 nodes, tactical accelerators.
  • Containerization and DevSecOps: Docker, Kubernetes (K3s/RKE2), GitLab CI, ArgoCD.
  • Interoperability standards: open architectures, modular interfaces, secure API design.

Domain Understanding

  • Experience supporting C2 integration, tactical networks, and degraded-communication workflows.
  • Understanding of multi‑domain mission threads such as ISR, counter‑UAS, logistics autonomy, multi-agent coordination, and decision-support.
  • Experience designing resilient behavior under environmental, adversarial, and operational stressors.

Security Requirements

  • U.S. Citizenship required.
  • Top Secret/SCI Required to start

DESIRED EXPERIENCE

  • Experience with distributed track fusion, detection/classification pipelines, or multi-sensor correlation.
  • Familiarity with mission‑partner interoperability and cross‑domain data release patterns.
  • Experience implementing provenance, auditability, and safety‑bounded autonomy behaviors.
  • Background in private 5G, tactical mesh networking, or mobile operations centers.

WHY THIS ROLE IS UNIQUE

This Principal-level role is tailored for someone who:

  • Builds autonomy that works in real field conditions, not just in demos.
  • Bridges AI models, mission data, and real unmanned systems.
  • Ensures autonomous behaviors are grounded in trusted, structured information.
  • Understands both the engineering and the operational realities of deploying autonomy at scale.
  • Can integrate across sensors, payloads, compute, C2, and enterprise systems.

You are the person who makes autonomous systems reliable, interoperable, safe, and mission-ready.


GDIT IS YOUR PLACE

jobs.excerpt: Our Story: Crisis Prevention Institute, Inc.  (CPI) is the worldwide leader in evidence‑based de‑escalation and crisis prevention training and dementia care services.
jobs.description:
Our Story:
Crisis Prevention Institute, Inc. (CPI) is the worldwide leader in evidence‑based de‑escalation and crisis prevention training and dementia care services. Our programs teach professionals the skills to recognize, prevent, and respond to crises in the workplace. Since 1980, we’ve helped train more than 17 million people across service‑oriented industries including education, health care, behavioral health, long‑term care, human services, security, corporate, and retail.
At CPI, we are dedicated to changing behaviors and reducing conflict for the Care, Welfare, Safety, and Security of everyone. We believe empathy, meaningful connections, personal safety, and security are the antidotes to fear and anxiety. This philosophy is central to everything we do and traces back to our beginning.
As a member of the team, you can expect to:
  • Make a difference through your work — You’ll be proud to tell your family and friends what you do.
  • Gain significant career experience within a fast‑growing organization — From entry‑level roles to executive leadership.
  • Feel fulfilled and have fun — We work hard but make time to build meaningful relationships and celebrate wins.
The Role:
As we evolve our product portfolio and go-to-market approach, we're looking for a hands-on Director of Product Marketing to build CPI's Product Marketing capability and help translate customer, market, and product insight into clearer positioning, stronger commercialization, and better go-to-market decisions.
This is a builder-doer role. You'll help shape how Product Marketing works at CPI, but you'll also personally do much of the work: developing positioning and messaging, working through portfolio and packaging questions, building commercialization plans, translating customer research into recommendations, and creating the tools teams need to bring our offerings to market.
You'll work closely with Product and Marketing leadership and lead a team spanning Industry Marketing and Customer Insights. We're looking for someone who moves quickly, learns fast, asks good questions, and is excited to build alongside the team rather than inherit an established Product Marketing function.

What You Get to Do Every Day:

Build & Execute Product Marketing
  • Develop positioning, messaging, value propositions, buyer stories, and commercialization strategies for CPI's priority products and audiences.
  • Personally create early Product Marketing deliverables and frameworks while establishing repeatable approaches the broader team can use over time.
  • Partner with Product and revenue leadership to evaluate and develop recommendations across the commercial mix, including product and portfolio structure, pricing and packaging, routes to market and buying experience, and how offerings are positioned and promoted.
  • Execute priority pricing and packaging work, bringing together customer value, competitive context, market insight, business economics, and buying behavior to develop and pressure-test recommendations.
  • Translate product capabilities and roadmap investments into clear customer value, market opportunities, and go-to-market recommendations.
Turn Customer & Market Insight into Action
  • Direct the Senior Manager, Customer Insights to identify the customer, buyer, market, and competitive questions CPI needs to answer and ensure research informs commercial decisions.
  • Synthesize customer, market, competitive, and commercial information into useful recommendations for segmentation, positioning, product strategy, commercialization, and go-to-market priorities.
  • Lead CPI's industry marketing approach across healthcare and education, working with Industry Marketing Managers to translate market dynamics, buyer needs, industry trends, and product strategy into differentiated industry positioning and go-to-market priorities.
  • Develop the team's ability to become true industry experts, connecting ongoing market learning, customer insight, Sales feedback, and external trends to the work CPI brings to market.
  • Develop evidence-based understanding of priority segments, buyers, needs, use cases, buying dynamics, and competitive alternatives and translate it into practical tools for Product, Marketing, and Sales.
Bring Products & Offerings to Market
  • Develop and execute commercialization plans for priority launches, product changes, and market opportunities in close partnership with Product, Demand Generation, Sales, and other teams.
  • Build and put into practice a repeatable commercialization and launch process, including launch tiering and readiness criteria, that helps CPI determine the appropriate level of go-to-market support based on customer impact, commercial opportunity, and organizational readiness.
  • Create the positioning, messaging, buyer insights, competitive context, sales stories, and core enablement materials customer-facing teams need to effectively bring offerings to market.
  • Work with Industry Marketing, Demand Generation, Sales, Program Management, and other teams to bring priority offerings to market and use results and feedback to improve future launches.
Build the Capability While Doing the Work
  • Lead and develop Industry Marketing and Customer Insights, working alongside the team to establish what strong Product Marketing and market-led decision-making look like.
  • Help clarify roles, processes, and ways of working across Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success as CPI builds a more disciplined commercialization model.
  • Take on priority commercial problems alongside Product and Marketing leadership, quickly moving from ambiguity to analysis, recommendation, and execution.
  • Use AI, external expertise, and new ways of working to move quickly, increase the team's capabilities, and solve unfamiliar problems.
You Need to Have:
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Product Management, or related field
  • 7+ years of experience across Product Marketing, Product Management, Customer/Market Insights, Go-to-Market Strategy, Commercialization, or related disciplines.
  • 3+ years of leadership experience, including experience building teams, functions, or new organizational capabilities.
  • Demonstrated success building or transforming Product Marketing capabilities in an organization where product architecture, segmentation, positioning, commercialization, or go-to-market disciplines were evolving.
  • Experience developing positioning, messaging, segmentation, go-to-market plans, commercialization materials, and pricing or packaging recommendations for complex B2B products or service.
  • Comfortable getting into the work, learning what you don’t know, and developing recommendations rather than handing the problem to someone else.
  • Ability to quickly learn an unfamiliar market or product, synthesize customer, competitive, product, and business information, and turn it into clear recommendations or deliverables.
  • Experience building or significantly evolving Product Marketing capabilities and working alongside a team while creating greater structure, discipline, and clarity.
  • Ability to operate in a fast-moving, highly collaborative environment where roles and processes are still evolving.
We’d Love to See:
  • Experience leading a team and launching and commercializing complex B2B products, services, or solutions.
  • Experience partnering closely with Product and Sales.
  • Experience working across pricing and packaging, portfolio strategy, customer or market research, sales enablement, or AI-enabled ways of working.
What We Offer:
  • Comprehensive compensation package
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • 401k
  • PTO
  • Health & Wellness Days
  • Paid Volunteer Time Off
  • Continuing education and training
  • Hybrid / Remote work schedule
  • Paid Parental Leave

The Company will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements. jobs.description:
Taxwell helps everyday Americans get every tax advantage they deserve by finding credits and deductions they never even knew existed. Our tax preparation software offers easy guidance and ensures your maximum tax refund. We strive to build a team of like-minded experts in both tax and technology who align with our brand purpose, are advocates for our customers and have a fresh, non-traditional approach to the tax industry.

Position Summary


Taxwell is looking to hire a Senior Product Designer to join our mission of making it affordable and easy for individuals and businesses to digitally file their taxes. This individual will apply design principles and methodologies to elevate our experience, championing AI-native thinking across the product organization. They will collaborate closely with product management and development teams to build industry-leading experiences that achieve business objectives and elevate customer outcomes. For this role, we expect a level of AI fluency that shows clear evidence that AI is changing the role and improving outcomes.


What You’ll Do


Design Excellence & Craft

  • Create user experiences and interfaces for product prototypes in keeping with industry standards and best practices
  • Translate user needs and business requirements into compelling experiences across web, mobile, and AI-driven touchpoints
  • Create user journeys, user flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes across multiple devices and interfaces
  • Create low- and high-fidelity prototypes to communicate design intent, using AI-assisted tools to rapidly explore and iterate on concepts

AI-Powered Product Design

  • Design innovative features that leverage generative AI to transform how users interact with and complete their tax filing experience
  • Contribute to defining what AI-native experiences look and feel like at scale across the Taxwell product ecosystem
  • Develop reusable AI-informed design patterns and interaction paradigms that can be applied across products and surfaces

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with product management, engineering, research, and data science to define, iterate, and ship features, ensuring alignment across user needs, business goals, and technical constraints
  • Recommend metrics to define, manage, and measure design success and prioritize enhancements

Communication & Storytelling

  • Create and present strategies and recommendations to design partners and stakeholders, articulating rationale clearly and confidently
  • Use expertise, storytelling, and persuasion to influence the product vision and design
  • Measure and explain the value of design to stakeholders using qualitative and quantitative data

AI Fluency Expectations


At Taxwell, we assess AI fluency across four dimensions—Mindset, Strategy, Building, and Accountability.

  • Mindset: You don’t just use AI—you fundamentally rethink how design work gets done. You abandon the status quo when it no longer serves, and you lead others through that transformation. Your AI fluency trajectory shows continuous evolution and a willingness to reinvent your own practice
  • Strategy: Evaluate emerging AI capabilities (LLMs, multimodal models, agentic AI) and translate them into actionable product and design opportunities. Lead cross-functional initiatives where AI creates competitive differentiation. Build and facilitate AI training that upskills the design team
  • Building: Build systems, not one-off features—pipelines and agent-driven workflows that take in customer feedback, generate specs, prototype solutions, and ship. Design AI-powered experiences that people understand, value, use, and trust. Lead new ways of building product, such as unlocking designers to ship code in production
  • Accountability: Establish quality standards for AI-augmented work across your team. Define guardrails for AI-powered experiences that balance innovation with user trust. Own the outcomes not just of your own work, but the quality bar for how AI is used across the designers you influence. You can delegate the work, but never the accountability

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent expertise in User Experience, Interaction Design, Communication Design, Information Architecture, Psychology, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Human Factors, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience or equivalent expertise designing solutions for software, web applications, or mobile native apps
  • 3+ years of experience or equivalent expertise using industry-standard design and prototyping tools to create low- and high-fidelity designs, such as Figma
  • Deep proficiency with AI-powered design tools and workflows, with a track record of integrating AI capabilities into the design process and championing adoption across your team
  • Experience designing AI-powered features or products—such as conversational interfaces, intelligent recommendations, predictive workflows, or agentic experiences—with proven ability to ship to production with real outcomes
  • Demonstrated experience influencing, negotiating with, and gaining buy-in from stakeholders, including leadership
  • Demonstrated experience applying the design decision-making process and incorporating data and key findings into designs
  • Demonstrated experience supporting the iterative design process end-to-end, including wireframing, prototyping, user testing, and high-fidelity visuals
  • Foundational understanding of common design heuristics and principles
  • Ability to accept feedback gracefully while also knowing when to push back respectfully
  • Takes ownership of own work and AI-assisted outputs alike—being accountable to deadlines and to the quality of everything that ships, regardless of how it was produced
  • Delivers impactful presentations and uses storytelling to influence and persuade others
  • Can show examples of redesigning how design work gets done: abandoning the previous status quo and reinventing the process with AI at the core
  • Resume must include a link to your design portfolio

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or equivalent experience in User Experience, Interaction Design, Communication Design, Information Architecture, Psychology, HCI, Human Factors, or a related field
  • Experience shipping end-to-end AI workflows—not just conversational interfaces—to production with measurable outcomes
  • Proficiency with vibe coding and AI-assisted prototyping—using generative AI to rapidly bring design ideas to life in code
  • Experience evaluating and adopting emerging AI technologies to improve team productivity and design quality
  • Understanding of responsible AI principles including bias awareness, transparency, and user trust
  • Experience unlocking designers to ship code in production, with a clear understanding of the tradeoffs involved
  • A strong AI fluency trajectory—a clear story of how your AI practice has evolved, what you’ve tried and abandoned, and where you’re headed

At Taxwell, we believe our work benefits from the diverse perspectives of our employees. As such, Taxwell welcomes and celebrates diversity and inclusion and is committed to equal opportunity employment. Stellen Sie sich eine Rolle vor, in der Ihre SAP SD Expertise nicht im Tagesgeschäft versickert, sondern spürbar Wirkung entfaltet. Ein Umfeld, in dem Sie Beschaffungsprozesse so gestalten können, dass sie in einer Organisation mit hunderten Märkten jeden Tag messbaren Unterschied machen.

SAP SD / Retail Inhouse (Senior) Berater (m/w/d)
wahlweise im Rheinland oder deutschlandweit aufgrund einer sehr arbeitnehmerfreundlichen Home-Office Regelung.
Warum diese Rolle gerade für erfahrene SD ExpertInnen interessant ist:

Sie landen nicht in einer endlosen Transformations-PowerPoint-Welt, sondern in einem kleinen, seniorigen Team, das seit Jahren gewachsen ist und pragmatisch arbeitet. Entscheidungen entstehen aus fachlicher Notwendigkeit, nicht aus politischer Dynamik. Es gibt kein Micromanagement, keine Silos, keine künstliche Hektik.

Sie arbeiten eigenständig, mit kurzen Wegen und realem Einfluss. Das Ganze auf Wunsch auch vertraglich zugesichert überwiegend remote. Etwa zwölf Präsenztage im Jahr reichen aus, um Workshops, Abstimmungen und Teamtermine sinnvoll zu begleiten.


Die Aufgabe: was Sie prägt

Sie bewegen sich fachlich klar im SAP-SD-Umfeld mit Fokus auf Kundenauftrags- und Vertriebsprozesse. Gleichzeitig gestalten Sie die Benutzer- und Rollenstrukturen, über die diese Prozesse im Alltag genutzt werden.

  • Sie wirken aktiv an der S/4HANA-Transformation mit, ohne den Blick für den produktiven Alltag zu verlieren.

Sie sind dabei weder reiner Konzepter noch klassischer Ticketsachbearbeiter. Sie verbinden Prozessverständnis, Systemkenntnis und Nutzerperspektive. Und sehen unmittelbar, wie Ihre Arbeit im Alltag wirkt.


Was Sie mitbringen sollten

  • Erfahrung mit Rollen- und Berechtigungskonzepten, idealerweise im Kontext von Fiori sowie Spaces & Pages
  • Freude an strukturierter Prozessarbeit und daran, Komplexität beherrschbar zu machen
  • Erfahrung in agilen Projekt- oder Produktumfeldern ist hilfreich
  • Deutsch verhandlungssicher (mind. C1 Level)

Branchenkenntnisse aus dem Handel oder im Rahmen einer S/4HANA-Transformation sind vorteilhaft, aber keine harte Voraussetzung. Entscheidend ist Ihre fachliche Tiefe und Ihr Anspruch an Qualität.


Warum sich ein Wechsel lohnen kann

  • Echte Remote-Freiheit:Arbeiten Sie von überall, solange Sie für ca. 12 Tage/Jahr präsent sein können.

  • Unbefristet, langfristig, realistisch: Keine Luftschlösser – nur ein Umfeld, das Verlässlichkeit schätzt.

Der vielleicht wichtigste Punkt: Sie arbeiten in einem Umfeld, das nicht überladen ist. Verantwortung ist klar verteilt, Unterstützung selbstverständlich und fachliche Qualität wichtiger als Lautstärke.

​

Company Overview

Join us for an enriching journey with Outset, a trailblazing medical device company that is revolutionizing the field of dialysis. Our focus is to create one high performing team, obsessed with progress, in an atmosphere that is brimming with transformative opportunities. The heart of our mission is pioneering a groundbreaking technology that redefines the landscape of dialysis, streamlining complexity and cost, because patients deserve “better” now, not some day. 

At Outset we’re revolutionizing an industry and changing lives. We’re impacting what the future of dialysis looks like by creating a first-of-its-kind technology in order to reduce the cost and complexity of dialysis. FDA cleared for use across care settings, from the hospital to the clinic to the home, the Tablo® Hemodialysis System harnesses modern technology for a new holistic approach to dialysis care. We’re giving providers time back to focus on patient care. And we’re giving patients the power to take control of their life and get back to enjoying the things they love.

Position Overview

The National Accounts Director owns the enterprise growth strategy for assigned national health systems, converting contract access into system-wide adoption of Tablo across acute-care settings. This role serves as the quarterback for complex accounts: building executive alignment, establishing clear expansion priorities, removing barriers to facility-level engagement, and coordinating execution across regions and sites.

Success requires equal strength in strategy and follow-through. The opportunity is not simply to secure a contract; it is to convert enterprise access into sustained adoption across the system.

  • Build trusted relationships with C-suite, clinical, financial, operational, supply chain, and other system-level stakeholders.

National accounts require one enterprise strategy and coordinated execution across many teams and geographies.

  • Create scalable practices, references, and expansion approaches that apply across systems.

Build the Value Case and Negotiate

  • Lead consultative discovery to understand system priorities, economics, decision dynamics, and adoption requirements.
  • Develop and present business cases, ROI models, and executive recommendations that demonstrate the value of Tablo.
  • Lead complex negotiations involving capital equipment, pricing, software, IT, cybersecurity, compliance, and long-term commercial terms.
  • Secure agreements and annual commitments that support predictable, mutually valuable growth.

Deliver Results

Strong national-account leadership is measured by both enterprise outcomes and disciplined execution.

  • Meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales objectives for assigned accounts.
  • Provide leadership with clear, actionable account plans, forecasts, risks, and progress updates.
  • Represent Outset with executive presence, integrity, sound judgment, and strong follow-through.
  • Comply with all company quality and commercial policies.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • Ten or more years of successful MedTech or complex healthcare sales experience, including at least five years in capital sales.
  • Demonstrated success growing large health-system or integrated delivery network accounts across multiple sites or regions.
  • Strong consultative-selling, contracting, negotiation, and executive-presentation capability.
  • Experience building alignment across C-suite, clinical, operational, financial, and procurement stakeholders while leading cross-functional work without direct authority.
  • Ability to travel up to 75%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading national or enterprise account strategy in hospitals, health systems, or integrated delivery networks.
  • Experience introducing disruptive technology and scaling adoption across multiple facilities.
  • Experience with software, analytics, EMR integration, or healthcare IT solutions.
  • Experience in dialysis, kidney care, or another complex capital-equipment market.

At Outset, we believe every person matters. Every Outsetter, every patient, every caregiver. Because we are here to create a revolution, and we believe in doing that by innovating everywhere with intelligent speed. Our team expects nothing less than our best display of strengths and skills, and we find joy in working together for a common goal. At Outset, we believe that curiosity, ingenuity and conviction in the power of technology will transform the lives of dialysis patients and providers.

We are fueled by the opportunity to give people their lives back. And we believe that it begins with YOU, our future Outsetter. At Outset, we’ve designed a professional world that our employees are honored and impassioned to belong to, one that offers challenge, the ability to collaborate with great people, and opportunities to build skill and expertise in a fulfilling career.

An opportunity at Outset Medical won’t just be about finding a job. Our culture revolves around the principles of moving farther, faster, together, so working here feels like a masterclass in peak performance, for individuals and teams.

Client Relationship Mastery

A successful Director, Client Services builds and sustains trusted advisor relationships with senior client stakeholders. They anticipate client needs before they are voiced, navigate complex organizational dynamics with ease, and consistently deliver commitments in ways that deepen loyalty and expand engagement.

Strategic Business Development Mindset

Success means identifying whitespace opportunities, connecting client challenges to practice capabilities, and actively contributing to pipeline development and proposal efforts. They think like a business owner, not just a service manager.

Delivery Excellence & Accountability

They hold themselves and their teams to high delivery standards. A successful director ensures engagements are scoped clearly, staffed appropriately, and executed with quality and efficiency. They course-correct proactively when engagements drift and protect both client outcomes and firm margins.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

They work fluidly across practice areas, operations, and leadership. They break down silos, connect dots between teams, and rally internal resources in service of client success — without needing formal authority to get things done.

They understand the business of consulting utilization, margins, SOW management, and revenue recognition. They use tools like Kantata and CRM platforms fluently to keep delivery and business development data clean, current, and actionable.

Adaptive Communication

They flex their communication style for the audience, executive briefings, client workshops, internal stakeholders, or at-risk conversations. They are clear, credible, and composed, even in high-stakes situations.

Outcomes Orientation

They define success in terms of measurable client impact, not just activity. They set clear KPIs, track progress rigorously, and hold the line on scope in ways that protect value for both the client and the firm.

Resilience & Composure Under Pressure

Consulting engagements rarely go exactly to plan. A successful director stays steady when things get complicated, resourceful, solution-focused, and calm in moments that would unsettle a less seasoned leader.

Integrity & Professional Credibility

They show up consistently, follow through, and tell clients the truth.

jobs.title: Director Demand Generation
jobs.excerpt: Our Story: Crisis Prevention Institute, Inc.  (CPI) is the worldwide leader in evidence‑based de‑escalation and crisis prevention training and dementia care services.
jobs.description:
Our Story:

Crisis Prevention Institute, Inc. (CPI) is the worldwide leader in evidence‑based de‑escalation and crisis prevention training and dementia care services. Our programs teach professionals the skills to recognize, prevent, and respond to crises in the workplace. Since 1980, we’ve helped train more than 17 million people across service‑oriented industries including education, health care, behavioral health, long‑term care, human services, security, corporate, and retail.
At CPI, we are dedicated to changing behaviors and reducing conflict for the Care, Welfare, Safety, and Security of everyone. We believe empathy, meaningful connections, personal safety, and security are the antidotes to fear and anxiety. This philosophy is central to everything we do and traces back to our beginning.

As a member of the team, you can expect to:
  • Make a difference through your work — You’ll be proud to tell your family and friends what you do.
  • Gain significant career experience within a fast‑growing organization — From entry‑level roles to executive leadership.
  • Feel fulfilled and have fun — We work hard but make time to build meaningful relationships and celebrate wins.
The Role:
As we evolve our marketing organization, we're looking for a hands-on Director of Demand Generation to build a more modern, integrated approach to creating and converting demand.

This is a builder-doer role. You'll set the direction for CPI's demand generation function, but you'll also be deeply involved in doing the work: developing campaigns, building ABM programs, designing audience journeys, digging into performance, partnering with Sales, and showing the team what great demand generation looks like. Many of the capabilities required for a mature demand engine, including segmentation, data, technology, lifecycle infrastructure, and measurement, are being built in parallel, so you'll need to make meaningful progress with what exists today while helping define what comes next.

Over time, the role will evolve as our capabilities, team, data, and technology mature. Initially, we're looking for someone who is excited to build while doing, not someone expecting to lead an already-established demand generation engine.

What You Get to Do Every Day:

Build & Execute CPI’s Demand Strategy
  • Develop and execute demand plans across priority markets, audiences, accounts, and revenue opportunities, connecting integrated campaigns, always-on programs, ABM, lifecycle marketing, events, paid media, content, and organic channels.
  • Personally build early programs alongside the team, from audience and journey development through briefs, activation, testing, measurement, and optimization.
  • Make recommendations about where CPI should invest, test, scale, change, or stop based on business opportunity and performance.
  • Establish the planning processes, channel frameworks and operating rhythms that allow the function to become increasingly sophisticated over time.
Build Toward Account-Based & Audience-Led Demand
  • Build CPI toward a scalable ABM capability, partnering with Sales, Product Marketing, Industry Marketing, and Marketing Operations to establish the audiences, account strategies, processes, and infrastructure required over time.
  • Develop and execute practical early account-based plays using the capabilities and data available today, while identifying what needs to be built to enable more sophisticated ABM.
  • As CPI’s segmentation, ICPs, buyer insights, account data, and technology mature, translate them into increasingly sophisticated audience, buying-group, journey, and activation strategies.
  • Build strong day-to-day alignment with Sales around priority accounts and opportunities, account engagement, demand quality, follow-up, and what Marketing is learning.
Build Integrated Campaigns & Audience Journeys
  • Personally lead the development of integrated campaign plans. Own the integrated campaign architecture and customer journey, bringing together the market, audience, message, content, channel, conversion, and measurement inputs required to create and convert demand.
  • Connect content, paid media, organic social, sponsored programs, events, email, web, sales activation, and other touchpoints into a cohesive journey rather than a collection of channel tactics.
  • Work alongside the team on early campaigns to establish strong briefs, content and journey plans, channel roles, measurement, and ways of working that can become repeatable over time.
Measure, Learn & Build the Team
  • Dig into program and audience performance to understand what's working, what isn't, and what CPI should do differently, even while our measurement capabilities are still evolving.
  • Partner with Marketing Operations to build toward stronger visibility into qualified demand, account engagement, opportunities, pipeline, revenue, and marketing efficiency.
  • Lead and develop a team spanning performance marketing, content, design, and events, working alongside them to establish what good looks like and build their capabilities.
  • Determine where AI, agencies, technology, and external specialists can increase the team's capabilities, quality, and speed.

You Need to Have:
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Product Management, or related field
  • 8+ years of B2B marketing experience, with significant experience in demand generation, growth marketing, integrated marketing, or revenue marketing.
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience, with a demonstrated ability to build and develop high-performing teams.
  • Experience building and executing integrated demand programs across multiple channels and knowledge how to move from audience and business opportunity through activation, conversion, measurement, and optimization.
  • Hands-on experience building account-based programs and working with Sales around target accounts, buying groups, engagement, and pipeline.
  • Experience with complex, multi-stakeholder B2B purchases rather than primarily transactional lead generation.
  • Experience building or significantly evolving a demand generation capability in an imperfect environment.
  • Experience creating structure where it doesn’t exist, developing people while working alongside them, and making progress without pristine data, technology, processes, or attribution.

We’d Love to See:
  • Experience leading a team and managing meaningful marketing investment, agencies, and external partners.
  • Strong analytical judgement and cross-functional leadership.
  • Familiarity with lifecycle marketing, conversion optimization, and modern AI-enabled marketing practices.

What We Offer:

  • Comprehensive compensation package
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • 401k
  • PTO
  • Health & Wellness Days
  • Paid Volunteer Time Off
  • Continuing education and training
  • Hybrid / Remote work schedule
  • Paid Parental Leave

The Company will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements. Our management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities, and general treatment during employment.

jobs.excerpt: Vericast is investing in the next generation of Advanced Analytics, Experimentation, and Measurement, and we're looking for a Principal Data Scientist to help lead the way.
jobs.description:
Vericast is investing in the next generation of Advanced Analytics, Experimentation, and Measurement, and we're looking for a Principal Data Scientist to help lead the way. This is a highly visible opportunity for a data science leader who thrives at the intersection of experimentation, causal inference, machine learning, and Generative AI.

In this role, you'll shape our analytics discipline from the ground up, partnering with executive leaders and cross-functional teams to solve complex business challenges with data. You'll design rigorous experimentation frameworks, build and deploy scalable AI and machine learning solutions, and transform complex insights into clear recommendations that drive growth and measurable business impact.

This is a senior individual contributor role that offers the opportunity to influence strategy, establish best practices, mentor other data scientists, and leave a lasting mark on how Vericast leverages data to make decisions.

What You'll Do

Lead Experimentation & Measurement Strategy (40%)

  • Own the end-to-end design, execution, and analysis of marketing and product experiments, including A/B, multivariate, geo, and holdout testing.
  • Define and manage the experimentation roadmap, including hypothesis development, prioritization, power analysis, and success metrics.
  • Develop and refine methodologies for lift measurement, incrementality testing, and causal inference.
  • Establish standards, governance, and best practices that ensure statistical rigor and actionable insights across the organization.
  • Partner with stakeholders to build a culture of experimentation and data-driven decision making.

Drive Advanced Analytics, Machine Learning & GenAI Innovation (40%)

  • Design, build, validate, and deploy machine learning and Generative AI solutions using large-scale structured and unstructured data.
  • Develop predictive, prescriptive, attribution, market mix, and uplift models that drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Lead hands-on model development, coding, testing, and production deployment while establishing technical standards for the broader team.
  • Create and maintain robust data pipelines to ensure data quality, integrity, and scalability.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and analytical approaches to improve performance and business value.

Influence the Business Through Strategic Partnership (20%)

  • Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Sales, IT, Risk, and Compliance teams to identify, prioritize, and solve high-value business opportunities.
  • Translate complex business challenges into testable hypotheses and analytical solutions.
  • Present findings and recommendations to both technical and executive audiences in a clear and compelling way.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert on experimentation, analytics, AI, and machine learning.
  • Mentor and elevate fellow data scientists through coaching, technical guidance, and best-practice sharing.

Education

  • Master's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field required.
  • PhD in Statistics, Data Science, or a related quantitative discipline strongly preferred.
  • Relevant data science, machine learning, or cloud certifications are a plus.

Experience

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in data science, analytics, or machine learning roles with significant hands-on experience working with large-scale data environments.
  • Experience within financial services or another highly regulated, data-intensive industry preferred.
  • Proven success leading or serving as a senior technical contributor on experimentation, measurement, and advanced analytics initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex business challenges into scalable analytical solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience influencing senior stakeholders and partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver data-driven insights and recommendations.

What Will Make You Successful

Experimentation, Measurement & Statistical Expertise

  • Deep expertise in marketing experimentation, including A/B testing, multivariate testing, experimental design, metric development, and lift/incrementality measurement.
  • Strong background in causal inference methodologies, hypothesis testing, statistical modeling, and power analysis.
  • Proven ability to design, execute, validate, and scale experimentation programs that enable confident business decision-making.
  • Experience establishing governance, best practices, and standards for experimentation across an organization.

Machine Learning, GenAI & Technical Skills

  • Hands-on experience developing and deploying Market Mix Models (MMM), Attribution Models, and Uplift Models.
  • Strong experience working with Machine Learning, Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI solutions, and emerging agent-based frameworks such as LangChain, LangSmith, or similar technologies.
  • Expertise in machine learning techniques including clustering, classification, regression, neural networks, anomaly detection, recommendation engines, and predictive modeling.
  • Advanced programming skills in Python, Spark/PySpark, and SQL.
  • Experience working with modern cloud-based data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or similar data lake environments.
  • Experience building and deploying solutions within AWS and Azure cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with containerization and development tools including Kubernetes, Docker, and Git.
  • Experience with data visualization and business intelligence tools, with Tableau preferred.
  • Familiarity with data science platforms such as Dataiku is a plus.

Leadership & Communication

  • Ability to thrive in ambiguous environments while driving clarity, prioritization, and business outcomes.
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills with the ability to translate complex analytical concepts into practical, executive-level recommendations.
  • Experience mentoring and providing technical leadership to data scientists and analytics professionals.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving capabilities, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven success collaborating across Product, Marketing, Sales, IT, Risk, Compliance, and other business functions.
  • Passion for fostering a data-driven culture built on rigorous experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Salary Range: $170,000 - $200,000

Position is eligible for an annual bonus incentive program

Applications will be accepted until the posted deadline of November 13, 2026, or until a sufficient candidate pool has been identified.

We’ve cultivated a culture of collaboration, a heritage of innovation and a focus on workplace flexibility.

and thrive.

Together, let’s advance performance for all.

jobs.title: Senior / Principal Power Systems Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Reporting to the Director of Power Systems Modeling, you will serve as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) for transmission planning and generation interconnection.
jobs.description:
Reporting to the Director of Power Systems Modeling, you will serve as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) for transmission planning and generation interconnection. This is a high-impact technical role where your deep understanding of power systems will not only drive complex study work but also serve as the "blueprint" for our software development team. You are the bridge between traditional electrical engineering and modern digital transformation. You are also expected to contribute towards the successful completion of a range of consulting projects focused on power system planning studies involving Steady-State, Short Circuit, Transient Stability, Generator and Renewables Interconnections, Large Loads and Data Centers, Electromagnetic Transients (EMT), Model Quality Tests (MQT) and benchmarking, Power System Economics, Market Analysis, and Grid Resilience.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Execute Complex Power System Studies: Lead and perform advanced transmission planning and generation interconnection studies (System Impact, Feasibility, and Deliverability) across multiple North American markets (WECC, PJM, MISO, ERCOT, SPP, SERC, etc.).
  • Technical Authority on Interconnection: Act as the lead expert for both large-scale generation (including IBR) and large-load interconnection requests, navigating the specific tariff and reliability requirements of various RTOs/ISOs.
  • Product Strategy & SME Support: Collaborate directly with our software engineers to translate complex engineering workflows into automated tools. You will define the logic, "teach" the software team the engineering nuances, and validate the output of our internal automation frameworks.
  • Advanced Modeling: Build, tune, and validate high-quality power system models for steady-state, short circuit, transient stability, and EMT analyses using industry-standard tools.
  • Automation Mindset: While we have dedicated software developers, you will be expected to use Python and SQL to automate your own workflows and prototype new ideas that can be scaled into production-level software.
  • Support Business Growth: Collaborate with the leadership team to develop and implement strategies for expanding our consulting services, including identifying emerging needs and new market opportunities and service offerings.
  • Engage with Stakeholders: Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including utilities, RTOs, project developers, and regulatory bodies, to advocate for and advance Simple Thread’s projects.
  • Innovate and Improve: Lead the development of innovative methodologies and tools that enhance power systems analysis and streamline processes for both internal and client use.
  • Mentor and Lead: Guide and instruct team members using a strong technical understanding of generation (including IBR), transmission, interconnection, customer and load, and modeling principles.
Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all study work and automated processes adhere strictly to NERC and regional reliability standards.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering with a focus on Power Systems; a Master’s or PhD degree is highly preferred.
  • Experience: Minimum of 8 years of experience in transmission planning, interconnection studies, EMT analyses likely gained within a utility, RTO, or specialized consulting firm.
  • Market Versatility: Proven track record of navigating the study processes and TARA/PSSE/PSCAD modules for multiple regions (e.g. ERCOT MQT, PJM GD, MISO RIST, CAISO GD, etc.).
  • Tool Proficiency: Expert-level command of PSSE, TARA, PSLF, PSCAD, EMTP, and PowerWorld.
  • Coding Literacy: Proficiency in Python is required for workflow automation. While you don't need to be a full-stack developer, you must be comfortable reading/writing scripts and eager to work in a software-centric environment.
  • Load & Generation Expertise: Deep knowledge of both traditional generation and the unique challenges of Inverter-Based Resources (IBR) and large industrial load and data centers integration.
  • Communication: The ability to distill highly technical engineering concepts into clear requirements for software developers and actionable insights for clients.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Experience with PowerGEM TARA’s automation API.
  • Familiarity with Git or other version control systems.
  • Experience with EM/ES interferences, grounding (GPR, step & touch) analysis using CDEGS,
  • Familiarity with arc flash analysis using ETAP

Join Us:

Simple Thread offers an opportunity to be at the forefront of technological innovation in the energy industry. We are looking for someone who shares our passion for making a difference and is ready to tackle the challenges of integrating software solutions with energy systems. BANC OF CALIFORNIA AND YOUR CAREER

Banc of California, Inc. (NYSE: BANC) is a bank holding company with over $34 billion in assets and the parent company of Banc of California. Banc of California is one of the nation’s premier relationship-based business banks, providing banking and treasury management services to small, middle market, and venture backed businesses. As the largest independent bank headquartered in California, the bank offers a broad range of loan and deposit products and services through a network of full-service branches and regional offices, as well as through digital and nationwide capabilities. The bank also provides full-service payment processing solutions to its clients and serves the Community Association Management industry nationwide through its technology forward platform, SmartStreet™. Banc of California is committed to supporting its local communities through the Banc of California Charitable Foundation and by partnering with organizations that promote financial literacy, job training, small business support, affordable housing, and more.

At Banc of California, our success is powered by our people and a shared commitment to delivering meaningful results. We foster an environment where entrepreneurial thinking is encouraged, and accountability and operational excellence are expected. Our team members are empowered to take ownership, make informed decisions, and make a meaningful impact as the bank continues to grow and evolve. We are dedicated to supporting your growth and wellbeing through comprehensive benefits, robust development opportunities, and inclusive programs that enable you to perform at your best. Together we win!

THE OPPORTUNITY

The Business Development Officer (“BDO”) is responsible for originating and funding SBA 7(a) and SBA 504 loans through self-sourced business development efforts. Qualified candidates will bring a strong track record in commercial real estate and cash flow lending, with demonstrated success consistently originating and funding $10 million to $15 million or more annually.

The BDO is accountable for driving new SBA lending opportunities through the development of strong referral and client relationships and partners cross functionally to deliver well structured transactions that meet borrower needs, align with credit standards, and comply with all applicable regulatory requirements. Performs all duties in accordance with the Company’s policies and procedures, all U.S. state and federal laws and regulations, wherein the Company operates.

HOW YOU’LL MAKE A DIFFERENCE

  • Establishing new referral and client relationships and fostering existing relationships
  • Independently source new loan transactions; this position does not receive internal branch referrals.
  • Assisting in the initial pre-screening, qualifying and structuring of loan opportunities
  • Analyze business and personal federal tax returns, including balance sheets and profit and loss statements.
  • Maintain regular communication with clients and referral partners regarding transaction status.
  • Partner with Underwriting and Closing to determine appropriate transaction structure and lending parameters.
  • Follow all established policies and procedures.
  • Perform other duties and projects as assigned.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Required:
    • Minimum 7 years of experience in a commercial lending environment
    • Bachelor’s Degree or additional equivalent experience
  • Preferred:
    • Bachelor’s degree in finance or accounting
  • Strong analytical, technical and documentation skills, strong time management and organizational skills
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain effective relationships; capable of working independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Established local and/or national market presence with a strong sphere of influence.
  • Experienced and knowledgeable in originating SBA 7a and SBA 504 loan products
  • Familiarity with Small Business Administration Standard Operating Procedures and eligibility requirements
  • Established referral network, including business and real estate brokers, accountants, attorneys, and other commercial banking relationships and community groups.
  • Possesses strong credit skills to determine the appropriate loan structure and assess credit risk of applicants.
  • Familiarity with technology used in the loan origination process, including standard office software (Microsoft word, excel, etc.), with the ability to quickly adapt to new platforms and tools.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of, adherence to, monitoring and responsibility for compliance with state and federal regulations and laws as they pertain to this position including but not limited to the following: Regulation Z (Truth in Lending Act), Regulation B (Equal Credit Opportunity Act), Fair Housing Act (FHA), Home Mortgage Disclosure Act (HMDA), Real Estate Settlement Procedures Act (RESPA), Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) in conjunction with the USA PATRIOT Act, Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Customer Information Program (CIP), Right to Financial Privacy Act (RFPA, state and federal) and Community Reinvestment Act (CRA)
  • High School diploma or equivalent required

HOW WE’LL SUPPORT YOU

  • Financial Security:You will be eligible to participate in the company’s 401k plan which includes a company match and immediate vesting.
  • Health & Well-Being:We offer comprehensive insurance options including medical, dental, vision, AD&D, supplemental life, long-term disability, pre-tax Health Savings Account with employer contributions, and pre-tax Flexible Spending Account (FSA).
  • Building & Supporting Your Family: Banc of California partners with providers that offer adoption, surrogacy, and fertility assistance as well as paid parental leave and family support solutions including care options for your family.
  • Paid Time Away: Eligible team members receive paid vacation days, holidays, and volunteer time off.
  • Career Growth Opportunities: To support career growth of our team members, we offer tuition reimbursement, an annual mentorship program, leadership development resources, access to LinkedIn Learning, and more.

SALARY RANGE

The base salary ultimately offered is determined through a review of education, industry experience, training, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant in alignment with market data and other factors.

The Home Health and Hospice Coding Specialist is responsible for reviewing clinical documentation and assigning accurate ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes for home health and hospice patients. This contractor supports coding accuracy, regulatory compliance, reimbursement integrity, and quality outcomes by ensuring documentation supports the patient’s diagnoses, plan of care, level of service, and Medicare requirements. This role requires strong knowledge of home health and hospice coding guidelines, Medicare Conditions of Participation, LCD/NCD guidance, PDGM requirements, hospice eligibility documentation, and appropriate sequencing of diagnoses.

What You’ll Do In This Role

  • Review home health and hospice clinical documentation across all time points (SOC, ROC, Recertification, Transfer, Discharge, Admission) to assign accurate ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes.

  • Sequence diagnoses in strict compliance with ICD-10-CM guidelines, CMS requirements, PDGM payment methodologies, and hospice coding expectations.

  • Audit clinical charts to identify documentation gaps or inconsistencies, and collaborate with clinical leadership or compliance teams to resolve query needs.

  • Support revenue cycle efficiency by meeting established productivity and turnaround time goals to prevent delays in billing and claim submissions.

  • Assist with internal quality assurance and external medical reviews, including TPE, ADRs, and compliance audits.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with clinical, QA, compliance, and revenue cycle teams to drive documentation integrity and regulatory readiness.

  • Maintain an advanced, current knowledge base of CMS guidance, Medicare regulations, LCDs, and payer-specific updates.

  • Ensure absolute data privacy and HIPAA compliance when handling all Protected Health Information (PHI).

  • Generate and maintain tracking logs, status updates, and coding reports for management as required.
Core Competencies

  • Professional Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills tailored for cross-functional collaboration with clinical, quality, compliance, and billing teams.

  • Independent Execution: Highly autonomous self-starter capable of managing priorities, meeting tight turnaround times, and executing responsibilities with minimal supervision.

  • Clinical Accuracy: Strong clinical judgment paired with meticulous attention to detail.

  • Risk Management: Proficient in proactive problem identification, timely escalation, and maintaining absolute confidentiality and HIPAA compliance.

The Experience You’ll Bring
Required

  • Experience: 2+ years in Home Health, ICD-10 coding, and OASIS review.

  • Certification: Active HCS-D and HCS-O certifications.

  • Skills: Extensive background in Plan of Care (POC) and HOPE documentation review.

  • Knowledge Base: Comprehensive mastery of PDGM, Medicare CoPs, HHVBP, Star Ratings, and ICD-10 Official Coding Guidelines.

Preferred

  • CHS-C certified

  • Dual-specialty coding experience across both Home Health and Hospice care settings.

  • Direct experience supporting TPE, ADR, medical reviews, and internal/external compliance audits.

  • Proficiency in industry-standard EMRs (e.g., Homecare Homebase, WellSky, MatrixCare, Careficient, Netsmart).

  • Solid understanding of OASIS accuracy, clinical quality measures, hospice documentation integrity, and billing-related coding guidelines.

Compensation
  • Pay per chart : Minimum of six charts per day
    • Coding only: $15 per chart
    • Coding and OASIS/HOPE: $35 - $38 per chart (based on relevant experience)
    • Coding/OASIS/HOPE/POC: $35 - $40 per chart (based on relevant experience)

jobs.title: Helpline Contact Center Supervisor
jobs.excerpt: Health Resources in Action, Inc.  (HRiA) is a non-profit organization working to improve and reimagine public health.
jobs.description:
Health Resources in Action, Inc. (HRiA) is a non-profit organization working to improve and reimagine public health. We connect, consult, and collaborate to solve complex challenges of access and equity in our health and social systems. Together with our partners, clients, and collaborators, we create actionable solutions so that all people can thrive.

In 1957, The Medical Foundation (TMF) was created to primarily fund biomedical research in Massachusetts. Since then, we’ve been on a journey of evolution. We changed our name to Health Resources in Action (HRiA) to reflect our impact in the field of public health. Today, HRiA works with individuals, organizations, and communities to drive a policy and systems change approach to advance health and racial equity.

HRiA seeks sustainable solutions for complex problems using an anti-racist approach. We aim to be adaptable and flexible in meeting clients and partners where they are, offering our decades of knowledge and resources to collectively realize our dream of equitable, sustainable health for all. The foundation of this work is centered on our values:

  • Health and racial equity by identifying and addressing the root causes of health inequities, intentionally working to shift narratives and power imbalances and disrupt all systems of oppression.
  • Leading with heart by demonstrating our passionate commitment to our work, continuously challenging ourselves with humility and vulnerability while pursuing and holding ourselves accountable to our mission.
  • Collaboration by intentionally and respectfully leading, partnering, and following to strengthen relationships, uplift different voices and build trust.
  • Innovation by driving toward new strategies, questioning norms, and continuously learning and evolving to support the needs of our clients and communities.

HRiA offers exciting, engaging, and challenging employment opportunities for facilitators, trainers, researchers, analysts, policy specialists, grant managers, and more. People come to HRiA because of our commitment to advancing health equity and inspiring work; they stay for our wonderful clients, partners, and dedicated and dynamic staff. With our growing portfolio of high-impact work, person-centered policies, and generous benefits, our team continually invests in making HRiA a great place to work. Our diverse staff of over 270 people hail from 30+ states, with a homebase in Boston’s Chinatown neighborhood.

As part of our Public Health Services, HRiA manages an extensive portfolio of behavioral health initiatives, including statewide substance use helplines in Vermont and Oregon and substance use and problem gambling helplines in Massachusetts and Illinois. The Illinois Helpline for Opioids and Other Substances (Illinois Department of Human Services, Division of Substance Use Prevention and Recovery) was launched in 2017, building upon our experience operating the MA Substance Use Helpline (Massachusetts Department of Public Health, Bureau of Substance Addiction Services) for over 23 years. HRiA launched the Vermont Helplink (Vermont Department of Health, Division of Substance Use Programs) in 2019. HRiA began operating the MA Problem Gambling Helpline (Massachusetts Department of Public Health, Office of Problem Gambling Services) in 2020 and the Illinois Problem Gambling Helpline (Illinois Department of Human Services, Division of Substance Use Prevention and Recovery) in 2022. In December 2023, HRiA launched the Oregon Recovery Center Hotline, now the Oregon Hopeline (Oregon Health Authority).

The Helpline contact center is the hub for the Helplines. Screening & Information Specialists (SIS) comprise most of the contact center team and respond to incoming Helpline inquiries. Four Contact Center Supervisors provide Helpline services and provide direct supervision to a portion of the SIS team. Three Masters-level Clinicians supervise a portion of the SIS, implement follow-up services, and provide additional coverage and support. Additional Helpline team members deliver and support program operations, marketing and communication, web management, and data analysis and management, supervision, and leadership. The larger team is overseen by the Managing Director, Behavioral Health.

To learn more about HRiA and our helplines, visit the following:

  • HRiA:
  • IL Problem Gambling Helpline:
  • MA Problem Gambling Helpline:
  • IL Helpline for Opioids and Other Substances:
  • VT Helplink: www.VTHelplink.org
  • MA Substance Use Helpline:
  • Oregon Hopeline:

Opportunity

We are seeking a full-time Helpline Contact Center Supervisor to join our team on the Oregon Recovery Center Hotline (Oregon Hopeline), Massachusetts Substance Use & Problem Gambling Helplines (MA Helpline), the Illinois Helpline for Opioids and Other Substances (IL Helpline), the Illinois Problem Gambling Helpline, and the Vermont Helplink (VT Helplink). This is an exciting opportunity to take on a newly developed position to support substance use treatment access across three states and supervise a diverse team of staff.

Position Description

We are seeking a full-time Helpline Contact Center Supervisor to join our team for the MA Helpines, the IL Helplines, and VT Helplink. We refer to these projects collectively as “the Helplines.” This is an exciting opportunity to support substance use treatment and problem gambling treatment access across three states and supervise a diverse team of staff.

The Contact Center Supervisors are responsible for handling incoming Helpline inquiries and providing supervisory support to the contact center team. A portion of their time is providing scheduled and as-needed Helpline coverage, in addition to our dedicated team of 22 Screening & Information Specialists (SIS). This includes responding to incoming calls, online chats, and SMS text messages from people seeking information about and help with accessing substance use and/or problem gambling services for themselves, a family member or friend, and/or a client. In this capacity, they assess Helpline users’ needs, determine the most appropriate substance use prevention, treatment, and/or recovery support service options, identify available options (through the Helplines’ databases), and refer callers to those services. They provide accurate information, education, support, and referrals in a non-judgmental, respectful, and culturally competent manner.

About half of their time, Contact Center Supervisors provide supervisory support to the SIS team. Each Supervisor acts as a shift supervisor for SIS while they are working. This includes monitoring SIS consumer interactions, consulting with SIS and intervening during difficult interactions, and addressing any urgent issues as well as supporting the social-emotional wellbeing of staff and fostering their skill-building and professional growth. The Contact Center Supervisor will provide on-going training to SIS through periodic in-service trainings on relevant topics and will assist in the onboarding of new SIS.

Each Supervisor also directly supervises up to six SIS team members. This includes providing bi-weekly supervision, processing timesheets, and assisting with schedule coordination. (SIS also receive regular, group-level supervision from one of our Clinicians.) Contact Center Supervisors are responsible for supporting contact center operations, including helping to coordinate a 24/7 coverage schedule, staffing, and technology needs. They are the liaisons between the contact center team and information technology (IT) support. The Contact Center Supervisor will also be called upon to contribute expertise to the development of policies, procedures, protocols, and curricula to support the Helplines, and may be engaged in providing this expertise to other HRiA teams and projects focused on substance use, problem gambling, and/or behavioral health equity.

This is a full-time, remote position with a salary range of $57,000 to $64,000 based on skills and experience. Supervisors will receive training to assess the needs of Helpline users, provide appropriate information and referrals to services, and engage with and motivate Helpline users to follow through on referrals. They will also receive training on Contact Center operations, supervision essentials, and addiction, screening, treatment services, and resources.

Benefits

HRiA offers strong benefits to its employees, including:

  • Competitive salaries
  • Health insurance
  • Retirement plan
  • Flexible summer hours
  • Vacation starting at four weeks
  • 13 paid holidays, and office closure at the end of December

Duties and Responsibilities

Management

  • Coordinate and implement projects related to contact center operations, including technology, equipment, onboarding & training, among others, as assigned.
  • Work with Helpline Management to coordinate Helpline staffing schedules to ensure continuous 24-hour staffing coverage.
  • Serve as liaison between SIS and other project and organizational teams, to ensure appropriate representation and facilitate team integration.
  • Supervise up to six SIS.
  • Participate in on-call rotation.

Project Work

  • Troubleshoot technical contact center issues, and serve as liaison to IT support.
  • Assist with coordination and implementation of onboarding and professional development activities.
  • Assess the needs of Helpline users by telephone, online chat, and SMS texting.
  • Provide appropriate information and referrals to substance use, problem gambling, and/or related services.
  • Engage and motivate Helpline users to follow through on referrals by using active listening and motivational interviewing techniques.
  • Obtain feedback on interactions with Helpline users.
  • Gather and record data from Helpline users in Helpline database.
  • Verify Helpline users’ insurance status, as applicable.
  • Escalate Helpline user interactions to Helpline Managers as needed.
  • Represent the Helpline at outreach events, meetings, and/or presentations as needed.

Thought Leadership

  • Continue to build and develop expertise in substance use disorders, problem gambling, and behavioral health equity.
  • Suggest ideas/improvements through participation in teams and committees.
  • Attend and actively participate in Helpline meetings and other activities to develop skills and make suggestions for project enhancements.

New Business Development

  • Maintain updated resume and bio for use in new business proposals.
  • Assist with technical components of new business proposals as needed.

Candidate Qualifications

  • Five years of related experience (lived or professional) in the fields of substance use, recovery, problem gambling, and/or harm reductions Services, and manage mentor bachelor’s degree in psychology, social work, human services, or related field in lieu of experience.
  • Certified Resource Specialist (through Inform USA) preferred or willingness to obtain certification (at HRiA expense) within one year of hire.
  • Demonstrated experience and ability to supervise staff, and provide appropriate guidance, feedback, mentorship, and support.
  • Experience in information and referral services, customer service, counseling, substance use, problem gambling, or human services required.
  • Ability to adapt to changes in work environment and expectations.
  • Customer/consumer focused with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Good computer skills and experience and/or ability to use online systems and databases.
  • Openness to information that may be different from personal views.
  • Willingness to work with consumers who may be ambivalent, resistant, impaired or have psychological disorders.
  • Must be open to providing information about a variety of treatment options and paths to recovery based on a caller’s needs.
  • Must be respectful of cultural differences and value diversity of thought, backgrounds, and perspectives.
  • Must have high ethical standards and a willingness to comply with professional expectations.
  • Demonstrated history of dependability needed.
  • Two years of sobriety requested for people in recovery.
  • Fluency in a language other than English (e.g., Spanish, Portuguese, Mandarin) is a plus.

Hours for this position will be non-traditional, requiring either early morning or late evening and weekend availability. The position includes weekend or overnight on-call duties. The Helplines are open 24 hours/day, 7 days/week, 365 days a year.

This description is intended to indicate the kinds of work duties that will be required in this position. It is not intended to limit, or in any way modify, the rights of any supervisor to assign, direct, and contract work of staff under his/her supervision. The use of a particular illustration describing duties shall not be held to exclude other duties, not mentioned, that are of a similar level or difficulty.

Procedure for Candidacy

HRiA is actively seeking to build a diverse and experienced staff. The organization encourages multiple perspectives and experiences, supports a multicultural environment, and strives to hire and retain a diverse work force that reflects the populations we work with and the communities where we work. Diversity is a core value of HRiA resulting in culturally competent services, materials, resources, and programs. Our hiring and business practices appreciate the strengths offered through different backgrounds.

HRiA is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer and is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

Generally, our interviews take place between 9am-5pm ET. If you are contacted for an interview, please let us know if this timeframe is a challenge, so we can work with the interview team to find alternatives.
