Description

At Transcom, we are a global customer experience specialist with over 35 000 employees across the globe. We have already successfully deployed cutting-edge CX products, including AI Agents, Voice automations and real-time translation solutions that transform how millions of people experience customer service every day.


Now we are turning that same firepower inwards. We are looking for someone to make 35 000 colleagues measurably better at their jobs by giving each of them access to the right AI support toolset.


Join Transcom as a Workplace AI Enablement Lead


You are not starting from a blank page. Google's AI suite is Transcom's standard and is already deployed across the business, our security, privacy and compliance colleagues have already done the hard work of clearing the way. Pockets of the organisation are already running on this: early adopters who built their own notebooks, teams who rewired how they handle documentation, people who will happily show you a workflow they invented themselves.


What we need now is someone to take that momentum and make it the norm. The proof of concept phase is behind us. This is now about scale and a broader adoption across the company.


You will be the person who sits down with the HR team, a workforce planner or a country manager and shows them the one workflow that gives them back three hours a week, and then builds the network that spreads it without you in the room.


Your audience is deliberately not IT and not developers. It is everyone else. Your success is measured in habits changed, not features demoed.

This role is open to candidates inCroatia ideallybut we will consider candidates based in Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Egypt, Latvia, Lithuania, Macedonia, Serbia, Slovenia, Spain or Tunisia.


You will


  • Own adoption:Take e.g. Gemini Enterprise and Google NotebookLM from "used well by some" to "indispensable to most", and be accountable for a measurable, visible spike in real daily and weekly usage across the business

  • Build the champion network:Our early adopters already exist and are already sharing — informally, generously and without much structure. You will find them, formalise the network, train them and give them the backing of a proper mandate, so they can sell the tools inside their own teams far better than any central function ever could. Adoption cannot be forced top-down — you will make it grow sideways

  • Create virtual teammates:Some teams have already built their own AI assistants and are seeing the benefit. You will make that repeatable — teaching leaders and contributors to configure specialised notebooks, reusable templates and custom instructions for the routine documentation, analysis and onboarding work that eats their week

  • Cut through the noise:Workspace AI ships new features constantly. You will vet them ruthlessly, ignore what is merely clever, and translate what is genuinely useful into plain, non-technical business language

  • Hold the line on safety:You are not inventing our guardrails from scratch — our security, privacy and ethical AI principles are established, and the specialists behind them are engaged and ready to support you. Your job is to make those boundaries land in everyday practice, so people know exactly what they can put into a prompt, and why they still have to check the answer

  • Prove it: Gather the field intelligence from your champions, build on the success stories we already have, and give leadership short, honest updates with the adoption metrics behind them


What's in it for YOU

  • A genuinely rare mandate: a global company that has already made the AI investment and is now serious about the most important part – getting people to actually drive value out of it

  • Visibility. This role touches every function and every geography.

  • The freedom to shape your own approach and actively influence how ways of working evolve across the organization

  • International and inclusive environment, that makes you feel supported, encouraged and welcome from day one

  • A personalized development plan and a dedicated education budget

  • Flexible work schedule and life-work balance


To be successful in this role, the following is needed:

  • A practitioner, not a commentator:real hands-on experience with Gemini Enterprise, Gemini Advanced and NotebookLM, or close equivalents such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise or Claude – you use these tools daily, not occasionally

  • Deep working knowledge of a collaboration suite (Google Workspace strongly preferred: Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Meet)

  • A translator:a proven ability to explain complex AI capability in simple, non-technical language to people who did not ask for a tech lesson

  • A pragmatist: instinctive bias towards workflows that save time over features that impress engineers

  • An influencer without authority: high credibility among peers, and a track record of inspiring, coaching and building networks of advocates without a reporting line to lean on

  • Confidence facilitating live sessions – demos, lunch-and-learns, open Q&A – and the ability to hold a room, including a sceptical one

  • A solid understanding of and genuine respect for enterprise compliance, security and data privacy principles

  • Experience in digital adoption, enablement, product or platform ownership, or a technical/analytical role in a large distributed organisation

  • A degree in Business Administration, Technology Management, Communication or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • English verbal and written is required (C1 or higher level)

  • Well-developed communication skills, a team player mentality and a willingness to share ideas and best practice

PHILANTHROPY OFFICER

Department: Development

PLEASE NOTE: This position is open to clients Texas or Ohio.

JOB SUMMARY

The Philanthropy Officer builds and strengthens meaningful, long-term relationships with donors and prospects who have the capacity and affinity to make significant philanthropic investments in One More Child. Reporting to the Senior Director of Philanthropy, this role engages and grows an assigned portfolio within a specific region, engaging donors through discovery, meaningful engagement, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship. The Philanthropy Officer develops individualized engagement strategies, builds a healthy pipeline of qualified prospects, and secures annual, capital, endowment, Comprehensive Campaign, and other strategic commitments in alignment with donor interests and One More Child’s priorities. Working collaboratively with the Executive Director of Philanthropy, Chief Advancement Officer and other organizational leaders, the Philanthropy Officer serves as a trusted ambassador for One More Child and invites donors into meaningful participation in the organization’s mission.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND FUNCTIONS

Donor Relationships & Portfolio Management

  • Manage an assigned portfolio of donors, building authentic, long-term relationships through meaningful engagement, discovery, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.
  • Develop individualized relationship strategies based on each donor’s interests, passions, capacity, giving history, and relationship with One More Child.
  • Maintain consistent, thoughtful contact with donors through personal visits, calls, meetings, stewardship touchpoints, ministry experiences, events, and other meaningful engagement opportunities.
  • Listen to and understand donor interests and motivations, connecting them with opportunities to meaningfully advance the mission of One More Child.
  • Create meaningful donor experiences in partnership with regional, campus, program, and organizational leaders that deepen understanding of One More Child’s mission and impact.
  • Personally solicit and steward 5- and 6-figure gifts, multi-year commitments, and other philanthropic investments in collaboration with the Executive Director of Philanthropy and organizational leaders.

Prospect & Pipeline Development

  • Identify, engage in discovery, and cultivate prospective donors with the capacity and affinity to make significant investments in One More Child.
  • Build and maintain a healthy portfolio and pipeline, advancing qualified prospects through intentional relationship strategies and appropriate next steps.
  • Participate in regular portfolio and pipeline reviews with the Executive Director of Philanthropy and the Director of Development Strategy, using relationship intelligence to prioritize opportunities and strengthen donor investment.
  • Partner with the Director of Development Strategy to effectively use CRM data, metrics, analytics, and pipeline reporting to inform portfolio management and fundraising strategies.

Strategic & Campaign Fundraising

  • Develop and execute donor strategies that align donor interests and passions with One More Child’s strategic priorities and funding opportunities.
  • Participate in the Comprehensive Campaign and other strategic fundraising initiatives, cultivating and soliciting individual commitments for capital, endowment, annual giving, and other organizational priorities.
  • Collaborate with the Executive Director of Philanthropy, Chief Advancement Officer, Senior Vice President of Strategic Development, and other organizational leaders on significant donor strategies and solicitations.

Donor Communications & Collaboration

  • Provide donor insight and strategic direction for proposals, presentations, stewardship communications, and other materials supporting cultivation and solicitation.
  • Partner with the Director of Development Communications to develop compelling, donor-centered proposals and communications that connect donor interests with meaningful philanthropic opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Advancement, Communications, Programs, Partnerships, regional, and campus teams to ensure a coordinated and compelling donor experience.
  • Serve as an ambassador for One More Child, clearly and authentically communicating its mission, impact, vision, and opportunities for philanthropic partnership through events, personal visits, and speaking opportunities.

Performance & Professional Development

  • Meet established fundraising, portfolio, meaningful engagement, and pipeline goals while maintaining a focus on long-term donor relationships and sustainable philanthropic growth.
  • Maintain accurate and timely records of donor interactions, strategies, next steps, and portfolio activity in the organization’s CRM.
  • Continuously develop knowledge of One More Child’s programs, impact, strategic priorities, and funding opportunities to effectively engage and inspire donors.
  • Demonstrate integrity, discretion, professionalism, initiative, sound judgment, and commitment to ethical, relationship-based philanthropy.
  • Stay current with best practices in philanthropy and continually strengthen skills in donor engagement, discovery, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.
  • Travel within assigned region regularly; at least annual visit to Headquarters in Lakeland.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Professional & Organizational Expectations

  • Pursues ongoing personal and professional growth to strengthen expertise and effectiveness in writing, proposal development, project management, and related areas through seminars, webinars, workshops, books, software, professional publications, and professional affiliations.
  • Brings creativity, initiative, strong organizational skills, and a high level of motivation to the role.
  • Demonstrates integrity, sound judgment, and maturity consistent with the organization’s core beliefs and values.
  • Demonstrates a positive attitude and genuine passion for the organization’s mission of providing Christ-centered services to children and families in need.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • N/A


REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in nonprofit management, business, communications, marketing, public relations, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in philanthropy, fundraising, development, sales, relationship management, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain authentic, trust-based relationships with individuals and organizations.
  • Experience cultivating relationships and securing financial support, investments, or other commitments from donors, customers, clients, or partners.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to listen effectively, ask thoughtful questions, understand motivations, and communicate compellingly with diverse audiences.
  • Ability to develop and execute individualized relationship strategies and manage multiple relationships, priorities, and opportunities with strong organization and follow-through.
  • Demonstrated initiative, sound judgment, professionalism, integrity, and discretion in working with individuals and confidential information.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with organizational leaders, colleagues, and cross-functional teams to advance shared goals.
  • Commitment to the mission, values, and Christian identity of One More Child.
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly in assigned region for donor visits, meetings, ministry experiences, events, and other relationship-building activities.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Demonstrated experience in major gifts, individual philanthropy, or relationship-based fundraising, preferably within a nonprofit or ministry environment.
  • Proven success personally cultivating, soliciting, and stewarding significant individual gifts, including multi-year commitments.
  • Experience securing six-figure or transformational gifts.
  • Experience participating in a Comprehensive, capital, or endowment campaign.
  • Established relationships within the philanthropic community, particularly within the assigned geographic region.
  • Experience managing a donor portfolio and using a CRM to track donor relationships, engagement, strategies, and next steps.

COMPETENCIES

Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

The Lead Product Manager – Ethernet Network owns the strategy, roadmap, delivery, go-to-market execution, and lifecycle performance of Lumen’s Ethernet network product. This role serves as the accountable business voice for the product within its Agile Release Train (ART), translating customer needs, market opportunities, product-line priorities, and network strategy into a clear, prioritized feature backlog that engineering teams can execute. The Lead Product Manager partners across architecture, engineering, operations, sales, marketing, finance, legal, and regulatory teams to evolve the Ethernet network, improve customer outcomes, and deliver sustainable revenue and margin growth. The role requires strong technical and commercial judgment, disciplined product leadership, and hands-on Agile Product Manager accountability within Lumen’s SAFe operating model.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Own the Ethernet network product vision, strategy, roadmap, objectives, and key results across the full lifecycle—from concept and investment through launch, growth, optimization, and retirement.
  • Act as the voice of the customer by analyzing customer needs, market trends, competitive alternatives, sales insights, and operational data to define differentiated product capabilities and priorities.
  • Develop and maintain a 12–24 month product roadmap aligned with Lumen’s network evolution, business strategy, transformation priorities, and related product portfolios.
  • Own, maintain, and prioritize the product’s feature backlog, ensuring features have clear business outcomes, requirements, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and readiness for engineering execution.
  • Write and prioritize features in close partnership with Product Owners, System Architects, engineering teams, and other delivery partners; decompose higher-level capabilities and strategic direction into executable increments of value.
  • Represent the product in SAFe planning and delivery activities, including PI Planning, roadmap and vision reviews, backlog refinement, PO Sync, System Demos, and outcome reviews.

  • Lead product-level business planning, including business cases, pricing inputs, investment and resource needs, revenue and margin opportunities, and ongoing measurement of ROI, KPIs, OKRs, and backlog health.
  • Coordinate go-to-market and launch readiness across engineering, network operations, marketing, sales, customer success, support, finance, legal, and regulatory stakeholders.
  • Enable sales and solution teams with clear positioning, customer benefits, competitive differentiation, roadmap guidance, and assessment of qualified feature or customization requests.
  • Maintain accurate, current product documentation and communications, and provide clear updates on strategy, roadmap, delivery progress, product performance, and decisions.
  • Build subject-matter expertise in Ethernet services, network capabilities, customer use cases, and the applicable competitive and regulatory environment.
  • Influence and align cross-functional teams without direct authority, using data, customer insight, and sound product judgment to drive decisions and accountability.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent education and relevant experience.
  • Five or more years of experience in product management, technical product ownership, or a related discipline within telecommunications, networking, software, platform, or technology services.
  • Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of a product or major feature area, including strategy, roadmap development, requirements, delivery, launch, and performance management.
  • Experience translating customer and business needs into well-defined features, requirements, and acceptance criteria in partnership with engineering teams.
  • Working knowledge of Ethernet services and network technologies, with the technical aptitude to evaluate product, platform, API, operational, and architectural trade-offs.
  • Experience operating in an Agile or SAFe delivery environment, including backlog prioritization, PI Planning, and cross-functional delivery coordination.
  • Demonstrated ability to use customer insight, market analysis, financial data, and performance metrics to make product investment and prioritization decisions.
  • Experience developing business cases and supporting pricing, go-to-market, launch-readiness, and sales-enablement activities.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, business partners, and senior leaders.
  • Proven ability to lead through influence, manage competing priorities, resolve ambiguity, and deliver results in a fast-paced matrixed organization.
  • Hands-on proficiency with Jira and Microsoft Excel; familiarity with APIs, product analytics, and roadmap or portfolio-management tools is preferred.

  • Provide legal guidance on strategic initiatives, mergers and acquisitions, partnerships, and corporate restructuring.

About Ascent

Ascent Global Logistics, headquartered in Belleville, Michigan, is a leading global provider of expedited, time-critical logistics solutions and other direct transportation services. The company connects customers to its extensive carrier network, internal ground fleet and airline via its proprietary, digital PEAK freight marketplace, which provides robust carrier capacity and transparent pricing, backed by 24/7/365 logistics experts. Ascent’s offerings include air charter and ground expedited solutions as well as truckload, less-than-truckload, global forwarding, brokerage, and managed transportation services. The experienced Ascent team solves customers’ most challenging logistics needs by providing industry-leading service and top-tier satisfaction.

Our Guiding Principles


At the core of Ascent's culture is a strong commitment to excellence, driven by the passion and dedication of every team member. We're equally dedicated to going above and beyond for our customers, ensuring this commitment extends beyond our team and brings exceptional value to those we serve. We aim for perfect execution in everything we do and ‘play hard’ by creating an environment where tasks are performed with a can-do attitude from start to finish. We ‘play smart’ by delivering on our commitments in an honest, fair, and ethical manner. We treat every person with whom we interface with the utmost dignity and respect. We understand that our teammates are our most valuable assets, so we ‘play together’ by making every effort to provide a professional and enjoyable experience, enabling careers to flourish and personal growth to be achieved.

What You’ll Do

The Program Manager owns the program of related technology initiatives for a single business domain. For this position, the domain is two shared programs: Ascent's customer-facing shipment visibility platform, which serves every business unit, and the final-mile business unit and its operating application. The Program Manager aligns that work to the domain's strategic objectives and carries it from framing through delivery and benefits realization. It is a strategic, hands-on role: the Program Manager is the connective owner across the domain's initiatives, the primary partner to its business sponsors, and the internal IT subject-matter expert for the domain's applications, with agentic AI as primary leverage. The core of the role is translating business needs into a clear, sequenced program roadmap that product owners and delivery teams can build against.

Program Ownership and Strategic Alignment

  • Own the domain's portfolio of related initiatives as a single program; align it to the business area's objectives and shape sequencing and roadmap.
  • Frame major project outcomes with the business and translate them into a coherent program plan.
  • Serve as the internal IT subject-matter expert for the domain's applications, maintaining deep knowledge of how those systems work and how the business uses them.
  • Maintain one integrated roadmap for the shared customer visibility platform with its product owner, so requests from every business unit are sequenced in a single plan.

Business Need to Program Roadmap

  • Understand how the business units operate and how the platforms are used by employees and customers, so requests are evaluated against how the work is done.
  • Work with the business to define the current state, the target state and the process change in between before a build begins, so requirements reflect the real workflow rather than assumptions.
  • Turn business needs into outcome statements, scope and sequencing on the program roadmap; make the trade-offs visible and get them decided.

Cross-Initiative Coordination and Dependencies

  • Manage interdependencies across the domain initiatives and across the IT delivery teams, so the program advances.
  • Coordinate timing, handoffs, and sequencing across initiatives; surfacing conflicts early.
  • Governance and Reporting
  • Run the program's governance and cadence: decisions, transparency, and status to sponsors and leadership.
  • Champion PMO methodology and standards to ensure consistency across the program.

Benefits Realization

  • Determine the business value of program initiatives based on defined outcomes.
  • Provide visibility into progress toward program outcomes and value delivery

Business UAT Engagement (major and higher-risk projects)

  • Identify, recruit, and engage business UAT testers.
  • Responsible for UAT schedule and milestones; UAT team owns validation protocols and sign-off.

Stakeholder and Program Risk

  • Own the sponsor and stakeholder relationship for the domain and keep expectations aligned as the program evolves.
  • Manage program change management communication to promote clear, timely messaging about what is changing and when.
  • Track program-level risks and issues and escalate to the appropriate level with context, options, and a recommendation.

Agentic AI

  • Use AI to draft plans, status, and reporting, accelerate program documentation, and reduce routine coordination overhead.

What You’ll Bring

  • 7+ years managing programs or large, cross-functional initiatives, ideally within a PMO.
  • Strong command of program governance, dependency management, and benefits realization.
  • Experience partnering with senior business stakeholders to align technology outputs with business outcomes.
  • Strong executive communication skills: able to brief senior leaders concisely, present options and recommendations, and communicate key decision points for leaders to act on.
  • Proven ability to translate business needs into program roadmaps: outcome statements, scope, actionable plans for sequencing and trade-offs that product owners and delivery teams.
  • Strong experience in logistics or supply chain, including time spent in or supporting an operation’s role and its business processes.
  • Working knowledge of Agile and structured delivery methods.
  • Demonstrated fluency using AI tools to accelerate program and reporting work.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field; PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, or similar certification preferred.

About the role:

Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Senior Director serves as a leader within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group, establishing oneself as a credible voice within their designated market at local, regional and global levels. Utilizing exceptional research and analytical skills, a Senior Director plays a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations.

What you will do:

  • Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have insights” content
  • Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act
  • Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward
  • Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing Insights positions across a team of analysts
  • Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda
  • Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights
  • Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to their designated content area via virtual or face-to-face interactions
  • Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings
  • Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business
  • Provide high quality and timely content peer review
  • Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy
  • Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community
  • Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery
  • Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members
  • Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions

What you will need:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; Graduate degree preferred
  • 15+ years of relevant industry experience
  • Expertise in data management platforms or data integration practices
  • Expertise in data architecture and data operations
  • Experience in AI-ready data management approaches
  • Experience with using agents in data management processes
  • Demonstrate executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders
  • Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables
  • Demonstrate excellence in research and writing ability
  • Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions
  • Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges
  • Strong communication skills - able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply
  • Subject matter expertise; comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements
  • Strong business and financial acumen
  • Deep knowledge of the global and competitive landscape within subject area as well as the interplay in that market
  • Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team
  • Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments
  • Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25%


Who you are:

  • Experience from a Data Management background and may have been a hands-on practitioner in the past but as your career progressed you may have transitioned into a leadership role, where you started leading teams or teams of teams.
  • Experience of the full lifecycle of data where considerations are made in data management platforms, data integration, data quality and metadata management solutions, relating to enabling data for AI use cases.
  • Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges.
  • Enjoy learning and being challenged intellectually on new topic areas or adjustments to previously held beliefs.
  • Strong communicator who can explain complex concepts concisely and simply.
  • A subject matter expert who is comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements.
  • Can demonstrate executive presence and can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders.


What makes Gartner Research a GREAT fit for you?

  • You are a team player who values expert insights, bold ideas, and intellectual courage.
  • You are always learning and looking to discover what’s next in technology.
  • You pursue personal excellence through team collaboration and consensus.
  • You love to shape ideas and business-related recommendations to solve clients’ biggest challenges.



Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Gartner believes in fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is 172,000 USD - 202,500 USD. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. In addition to base salary, employees will participate in either an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based, uncapped sales incentive plan. Our talent acquisition team will provide the specific opportunity on our bonus or incentive programs to eligible candidates. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Recherche, Dramaturgie und Zuschauerbindung.

Deine Aufgaben

Ideation: Uns gehen nie die Themen aus

  • ⁠ ⁠Du findest regelmäßig Themen, die gerade relevant sind und die Menschen sehen wollen, und baust dabei auch ungewöhnliche Brücken zu Bitcoin und den Finanzmärkten, zum Beispiel von Popkultur, Politik oder Tech.
  • ⁠ ⁠Du bereitest jede Idee mit passenden Titelvorschlägen und Referenz-Thumbnails auf, damit wir die stärksten Themen auswählen können.
  • ⁠ ⁠Du reagierst schnell auf aktuelle Ereignisse, damit News-Videos zeitnah online gehen.
  • ⁠ Du recherchierst Reel-Ideen, die bei ähnlichen Creatorn funktionieren, für Instagram.“

Audience Retention: Skripte, die bis zum Ende tragen

  • ⁠ ⁠Du schreibst vollständige, retention-optimierte Skripte für YouTube-Langformate, vom Intro bis zum letzten Kapitel, so dass sie direkt vom Teleprompter gelesen werden können.
  • ⁠ ⁠Du entwickelst Hook und Value Proposition, die klar machen, was das Video liefert und warum es sich lohnt, bis zum Payoff dranzubleiben.
  • ⁠ ⁠Du baust jedes Video in drei bis vier Kapiteln mit steigender Spannung auf, so dass das Stärkste am Ende kommt und das Thema Substanz hat.
  • ⁠ ⁠Du schreibst gelegentlich Trading-Videos zu Strategien und Grundlagen, zum Beispiel „Wenn ich als Trader heute neu starten müsste".

User Retention: Zuschauer, die wiederkommen

  • ⁠ ⁠Du schreibst Short-Form-Inhalte und Posts für X (Twitter), die die Community zwischen den Videos aktiv halten.
  • ⁠ ⁠Du sorgst dafür, dass die Personal Brand über alle Formate wiedererkennbar klingt und Vertrauen aufbaut

Retention-optimiertes Copywriting im Alltag

  • ⁠ ⁠Du übersetzt komplexe Krypto- und Trading-Themen in klare, verständliche Sprache, ohne Gewinnversprechen und unseriöse Übertreibungen.
  • ⁠ ⁠Du unterstützt bei Bedarf die morgendliche Recherche für Markt-Updates: News, X und On-Chain-Daten kurz zusammengefasst.
  • ⁠ ⁠Du hilfst dabei, dem Editing- und Motion-Team zu erklären, welche Charts, Screenshots und Animationen ein Video braucht.
  • ⁠ ⁠Du nutzt KI-Tools für Recherche und Tempo, überarbeitest den Output aber immer selbst. Ein Skript übernimmst du nie eins zu eins.

Was du mitbringst

  • ⁠ ⁠YouTube-Skripte: Du hast bereits Skripte für längere YouTube-Videos geschrieben und kannst zwei bis drei Arbeitsproben zeigen. Du kannst erklären, welchen Teil du selbst übernommen hast und warum du das Video so aufgebaut hast.
  • ⁠ ⁠Dramaturgie und Zuschauerbindung: Du weißt, wie ein starker Einstieg funktioniert, welche Fragen eine Geschichte vorantreiben und wann eine Information ihre größte Wirkung entfaltet. Du erkennst Längen und kannst ein Skript gezielt verbessern.
  • ⁠ Recherche: Du arbeitest dich selbstständig in komplexe Themen ein, prüfst Quellen und trennst bei investigativen Geschichten belegte Fakten, Vorwürfe und eigene Einordnung sauber voneinander.
  • ⁠ ⁠Krypto, Trading und News: Du kennst die Grundlagen von Krypto und Finanzmärkten, verfolgst aktuelle Entwicklungen und kannst relevante Nachrichten schnell einordnen. Profi-Trader musst du nicht sein.
  • ⁠ ⁠Ideenreichtum: Du findest eigenständig Themen und ungewöhnliche Blickwinkel – für aktuelle News, verständliche Erklärvideos und investigative Geschichten. Du erkennst, welche Ideen genug Substanz für ein längeres Video haben.
  • ⁠ ⁠Schreiben: Du schreibst fehlerfreies Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau. Deine Texte klingen gesprochen natürlich und machen auch schwierige Zusammenhänge verständlich.
  • ⁠ ⁠Social Media: Du verstehst, wie Inhalte für YouTube, Shorts und X aufbereitet werden, und kannst ihre Planung und Veröffentlichung zuverlässig koordinieren.
  • ⁠ ⁠Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest selbstständig, nimmst Feedback konstruktiv auf und hältst Absprachen ein. Für gelegentliche Abstimmungen bist du auch abends nach deutscher Zeit erreichbar.

Nicht das Richtige für dich, wenn:

  • ⁠ Trading und Finanzmärkte für dich Neuland sind und du dir die Grundlagen erst erarbeiten müsstest.
  • ⁠ ⁠Du bisher ausschließlich für Lifestyle-, Beauty- oder E-Commerce-Marken geschrieben hast und Finanzthemen dich nicht wirklich interessieren.
  • ⁠ ⁠Du schreibst, ohne danach auf Watchtime und Retention zu schauen.
  • ⁠ ⁠Du klare Vorgaben und enge Abstimmung brauchst, um ins Arbeiten zu kommen.

Benefits

  • ⁠ ⁠Verantwortung für die Skripte eines wachsenden YouTube-Kanals, mit dem Ziel, von einem auf zwei Videos pro Woche zu gehen
  • ⁠ ⁠Zusammenarbeit mit einem Berater, der Erfahrung mit YouTube-Videos im sechs- bis siebenstelligen Aufrufbereich hat
  • ⁠ ⁠Ein Team aus Top-Performern und Gründern, das gemeinsam auf Wachstum hinarbeitet
  • ⁠ ⁠Eine Kultur, in der Verantwortung, Leistung und Ehrlichkeit zählen und Ergebnisse mehr wiegen als Worte
  • ⁠ ⁠Arbeiten von überall: Wir sind zu 100 % remote und arbeiten in deutscher Zeitzone
  • ⁠ ⁠Workations sind fester Bestandteil unserer Kultur
  • ⁠ ⁠Raum für Experimente, Lernen und persönliche Weiterentwicklung

Practice and Sales Support:

TheServiceNow IRM Architect supports Templar Shield’s business development andpractice growth by providing solution leadership and subject-matter expertisethroughout the sales process.

  • Help develop reusable service offerings, implementation methodologies, reference architectures, integration patterns, demonstrations, accelerators, templates, and training materials.

Technical Knowledge and Skills:

Candidates must demonstratestrong solution architecture, platform, and IRM knowledge, including:

  • Strong knowledge of ServiceNow IRM applications, data models, workflows, workspaces, and related platform capabilities.
  • Experience designing solutions across Risk Management, Policy and Compliance Management, Audit Management, Third-Party Risk Management, Business Continuity Management, Operational Resilience, Regulatory Change Management, Issues Management, or related applications.

Qualifications

Benefits

  • 100% remote-first culture
  • Benefits include health, dental, LTD, and life insurance coverage

jobs.excerpt: AHEAD builds platforms for digital business.  By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
jobs.description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.
We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.

As a Analyst – Intelligence & Advisory, you will work alongside AHEAD’s consultants and practice teams at the intersection of technology, AI and business - turning ambiguous business questions from consulting teams into structured, hypothesis-led research and clear, actionable recommendations. You will independently own deliverables end-to-end, act as a credible thought partner to onsite consulting and pursuit teams, and help raise the quality bar by guiding junior analysts. Your work will directly shape how AHEAD’s consulting teams understand markets, position against competitors, plan for accounts, and win complex enterprise technology deals — and how sharply those insights are communicated to CXO audiences.

You will scope and prioritize requests, clarify objectives, and select the right insights on clients, markets, offerings and competition to address them. You will conduct data-driven analyses and turn the results into accurate, client-ready documents, models and charts, and join team problem-solving discussions so that recommendations are actionable and strategically relevant. Beyond individual requests, you will help build and maintain AHEAD’s knowledge assets, databases and proposal and use-case material, using scripts and automation to prepare and validate data, while continuing to grow with the industry.

Being part of this exciting team, you will get long term opportunities to lead client discussions with global IT leaders, identify and creatively solve complex problems using both qualitative and quantitative research methods. You will design and build written research, graphics, and tools/frameworks to support clients in critical processes, and help organizations transform the way they operate.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

    Problem Solving & Advisory Support

  • Translate pursuit, account and client questions into structured problem statements, hypotheses, issue trees and research plans; clarify scope, success criteria and timelines with stakeholders up front.
  • Apply consulting frameworks and structured thinking (e.g., MECE issue trees, hypothesis-driven analysis, value-chain and maturity assessments, 2x2 prioritization) to break down complex problems, test hypotheses and arrive at defensible answers.
  • Exercise sound judgement when data is incomplete — triangulate across sources, state assumptions, size the opportunity and flag confidence levels — and always answer the “so what” with a recommendation, not just data.
  • Apply sound judgement to prioritize what matters: separate signal from noise, assess the reliability of sources and data, challenge assumptions, and clearly call out risks, trade-offs and confidence levels in every recommendation.
  • Advisory Engagements: Support pursuit and advisory engagements by delivering market insights, competitive benchmarking and strategic guidance that shape deal strategy and client conversations.

    • Research Delivery & Insights

  • Own end-to-end delivery of assigned items from AHEAD's research product stack — Market Size & Outlook, Industry/Technology POVs, Account Intelligence Packs, Competitive Profiles & Battlecards, Buying Behaviour Analysis, market trend summaries/briefs, Capability Heatmaps, Benchmark Reports and other custom research products where required
  • Synthesize intelligence from primary research and secondary sources — tier-1 analyst platforms (e.g., Gartner, Everest Group, Forrester, Nelson Hall, IDC, Avasant), business databases (e.g., Hoovers, AlphaSense ,ZoomInfo) and proprietary sources — into crisp, executive-ready insight narratives.
  • Track competitor strategies, partnerships, offerings and deal signals, and translate them into actionable pursuit positioning.
  • Analyze market dynamics across AHEAD-relevant technology areas—including Applications, cloud and infrastructure, application modernization, data and AI, cybersecurity, digital workplace, platform engineering, automation, and emerging technologies—to assess business needs and technology linkages.
  • Build account-level intelligence to support strategic account planning, C-suite engagement and opportunity identification.
  • Know how in helping service providers make informed pricing and solutioning decisions — e.g., peer price benchmarking, delivery-improvement and competitive analysis to improve win-rates (Good to have or is a plus)
  • Validate sources for currency, credibility and relevance; maintain high standards of accuracy and referencing across all deliverables.

    • Reporting, Dashboards & AI-Enabled Research

  • Design, build and maintain interactive dashboards and reports in Power BI and lightweight HTML dashboards (e.g., competitor trackers, account, and market views, CoE performance reporting) that let stakeholders self-serve insights.
  • Clean, model and visualize data from multiple sources (Excel, databases, analyst-platform exports); ensure accuracy, clear metric definitions and version control.
  • Use AI tools and agents to automate and accelerate research workflows — source scanning, competitor monitoring, summarization and first-draft creation — with human validation of every output.
  • Verify AI-generated content for accuracy, bias and source traceability; build reusable prompts and agent workflows and share good practices with the team.

    • Storytelling & Visual Communication

  • Convert research findings into answer-first storylines, proposal narratives and CXO-level communications that persuade rather than merely present.
  • Build polished, consulting-grade decks and data visualizations using AHEAD’s brand-compliant templates; partner with visual communication specialists for high-impact pursuit and proposal material.
  • Present findings and recommendations to senior internal stakeholders and handle questions and pushback with confidence.

    • Stakeholder Partnership

  • Act as a day-to-day research partner with consulting, sales, practice and deal teams to translate business needs into hypothesis-led research and concise, insight-rich narratives aligned with AHEAD’s solutions.

  • 5+ years of hands-on Acumatica ERP experience, with at least 3 years in a technical/development capacity (customization projects, integrations, upgrades). Experience as an Acumatica implementation or technical consultant at a VAR or partner is highly valued.

  • Good verbal and written communication in English; able to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and to write clear documentation.
  • Comfortable working in a distributed multinational team, with flexibility to overlap several working hours a day with colleagues on the US East Coast.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Accounting/Finance or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Relevant Acumatica developer or consultant certifications.
  • Experience with Acumatica version upgrades on a heavily customized on-premises instance.
  • Experience integrating Acumatica with Workato or a comparable integration platform.
  • Exposure to SOX/ITGC controls, audit support and change-management processes in a finance systems environment.

  • Experience with modern AI integration, e.g. building MCP servers or agent tooling around ERP APIs, or using LLMs for support triage and data quality analysis.

HOW WE WORK

  • Financial Systems is a small, senior team with a high degree of ownership: each of us runs our own areas end to end and covers for one another when needed. We value people who are responsive, detail-oriented, make decisions, and follow through.

jobs.excerpt: Join beqom — where tech meets impactbeqom is a high-growth B2B SaaS company that provides industry-leading tools for pay equity and transparency, compensation, and performance management.
jobs.description:
Join beqom — where tech meets impact

beqom is a high-growth B2B SaaS company that provides industry-leading tools for pay equity and transparency, compensation, and performance management.

Trusted by some of the world’s most respected companies, beqom enables HR and business leaders to navigate global compliance and make smarter pay decisions that attract, retain, and motivate top talent.

Founded in Switzerland and serving clients worldwide, our powerful, enterprise-ready products are fuelled by beqom pay intelligence.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Agentic Backend Engineer to join our Data Platform Core team, which owns the services at the heart of beqom’s data architecture — multi-tenant data ingestion, schema management, snapshots, calculated fields, and the data contracts powering analytics and reporting across the product.

In this role you will not write the code. AI agents will. You will own the specifications that govern these services, the agentic pipeline that turns those specifications into production software, and the verification machinery that proves the output is correct — with the explicit goal of reaching fully AI-embedded development: no human-written code, no human line-by-line review, and external behavioural scenarios, not traditional test suites, as the quality gate.

You will collaborate closely with Data Platform and Analytics engineers, Support teams, and Product stakeholders — translating their needs into agent-executable specifications. Specs are our system of record; agents do the typing.

What you'll be doing

Agentic Delivery

  • Deliver features across multi-tenant data platform services — data ingestion, schema management, effective dating, snapshots, calculated fields, and exports — exclusively through AI agents working from your specifications.
  • Author structured, testable Product Requirement Prompts (PRPs) and spec files as the primary engineering artefact, and maintain the versioned spec library that governs the codebase.
  • Run multiple agents in parallel across workstreams; evaluate outcomes against specs; progress agent first-pass success rate, defect escape rate, and the share of changes merged without human review steadily upward.

Pipeline Engineering

  • Build and maintain the agentic pipeline: agent harness, blueprint engine interleaving deterministic steps (lint, build, git) with AI reasoning, MCP tool layer exposing internal APIs, warm sandbox pool, and retrieval over the codebase, tickets, and historical PRs.
  • Own the economics of the pipeline: observability over token usage, task latency, and cost per run; model-tier routing and cost-per-outcome gating.
  • Embed governance into the pipeline — machine-generated audit trails, named ownership per feature, data-classification gates keeping production secrets and PII out of agent context.

Verification Engineering

  • Engineer verification, not code: external behavioural scenario suites and holdout sets stored outside the codebase (agents never see the evaluation criteria), digital twins of the systems we integrate with, layered AI-reviews-AI gates, and automated remediation for self-healing services.
  • Set and enforce the constraints that keep agent output correct on performance-critical paths: bulk ingestion throughput, large export streaming, memory behaviour, and complex SQL — validated by scenario and load gates rather than line-by-line reading.

Production Ownership & Collaboration

  • Diagnose and resolve production data issues through agents — with deep enough functional understanding of every service you own to steer remediation quickly, in collaboration with Support and Engineering.
  • Document the specs, scenarios, and pipeline decisions that govern the platform — artefacts both humans and agents can act on — and help other engineers make the same shift.

Skills & Experience

What you'll bring

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience building production backend services — including .NET/C# and PostgreSQL systems — with a demonstrable shift from writing code to directing agents: the majority of your recent production output should be AI-generated under your direction.
  • Hands-on mastery of AI coding agents — Claude Code strongly preferred — including parallel agent sessions, custom skills and sub-agents, and structuring codebases and context so agents work reliably.
  • Excellence in specification writing — turning ambiguous business needs into precise, agent-executable PRPs and spec files. In this role, spec quality is the single most load-bearing skill.
  • Strong verification engineering: behavioural and scenario-based testing, holdout evaluation, quality gates, and validation frameworks — the ability to trust and judge output you did not write.
  • Strong architecture judgement: assessing whether an agent-proposed solution meets performance, scalability, and reliability requirements, and challenging designs that will not hold up under real workloads.
  • Experience building agent infrastructure: MCP servers and tool layers, sandboxed execution, and CI/CD adapted for agent-driven workflows.
  • Deep enough .NET/C# and SQL reading fluency to audit generated code when quality gates flag it — schema design, query plans, streaming vs. buffering, memory behaviour.
  • Excellent written communication: specs, scenario definitions, and design docs that both humans and agents can act on.

Bonus points if you have

  • Experience building digital twins or service virtualisations of external systems for agent evaluation environments.
  • Experience with LLM evaluation at scale: eval suites, red-teaming AI-generated code, benchmarking agent workflows.
  • Multi-tenant SaaS architecture experience, CDC/event-driven ingestion (Debezium, Kafka, RabbitMQ/MassTransit), or lakehouse exposure (Microsoft Fabric).
  • Azure services, Docker, Kubernetes/Helm.
  • Experience with legal, security, or compliance frameworks for AI-authored code.
  • Familiarity with compensation, HR, or pay transparency domains.

Why join us?

  • Your career, your design. Unleash your ambition in our dynamic, autonomous environment.
  • Drive meaningful change. Build a fairer future for every employee by joining a market leader that is improving the world of work.
  • Belong to something bigger. Collaborate with a passionate, diverse and talented team around the globe.

Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice before submitting your application.

An Industry Leader With a Heart as Big as Its Ambition and Innovation

jobs.title: [REMOTE] Senior LiveOps Developer - Mobile Games
jobs.excerpt: Senior LiveOps Developer - Mobile GamesRemote - Full TimeCrazyGames, one of the world's largest browser game platforms with over 60 million monthly active users, is doubling down on its IP portfolio.
jobs.description:
Senior LiveOps Developer - Mobile Games

Remote - Full Time

CrazyGames, one of the world's largest browser game platforms with over 60 million monthly active users, is doubling down on its IP portfolio. We own the games we publish, and we treat each one as a live product rather than a finished project.

We're looking for a Senior LiveOps Developer who has already done this on mobile. Someone who has taken a title through soft launch and global launch, knows which live systems need to exist before you scale UA behind a game, and can build them.

This is a hands-on development role. You'll write the code for the events, the progression systems, the offers, the economy and the remote config that keep a game growing. You'll also be the person who looks at a game's numbers and says what should ship next and why, because you've run this playbook before at a mobile publisher.

What this role is not: greenfield game development, or working through a feature backlog someone else wrote. You'll be inside existing codebases almost all of the time, on games that already have players, and you'll be the one deciding what those games need.

Key outcomes for the role

  • Within 1 month, you've onboarded to one of our live published titles, gotten comfortable in its codebase, shipped your first live update to production on web and mobile, and given us your first read on what that game's LiveOps setup is missing.

  • Within 3 months, you own the LiveOps roadmap for at least one title. You've set an update cadence, shipped a meaningful live system (event framework, progression, offers, remote config, economy tuning), and we can see the effect in retention or monetization.

  • Within 6 months, you've taken a title through the run-up to global launch. The live systems, the event calendar, the balancing and the tooling are in place before UA scales behind it, and you decided what belonged there.

  • Within 12 months, LiveOps is a repeatable system across our IP portfolio rather than something that depends on you personally. Multiple live titles run in parallel on the cadence, tooling and playbook you put in place.

On a typical day you might

  • Look at retention, session length, ARPDAU and conversion for a live title, and decide what to build next.

  • Ship a seasonal event, content drop or offer to one of our live IP games on web and mobile.

  • Build the live system behind it: event framework, remote config, A/B test, progression or economy change.

  • Dive into an unfamiliar codebase to plan how a new system slots in without breaking what's already there.

  • Tell us a game is not ready for global launch yet, and what has to exist first.

  • Design and implement a new game mode, progression system or monetization hook tailored to the genre.

  • Align with the Publishing team on the LiveOps roadmap and prioritization across titles.

  • Maintain clean Git history, write down what you did, and make sure the next update is easier than the last.

What we offer

  • Join a rapidly growing publishing team at a company with 50M+ monthly users and proven platform reach.

  • Make a real impact by directly shaping the games millions of people actually play, week after week.

  • A lot of responsibility and freedom. We hire only experts and trust them to deliver excellent results.

  • Flexible working hours and location. The results are what counts!

  • 1 to 2 team weeks per year. We pay for flights and accommodation so you can have fun with the team.

  • The opportunity to play games and claim it's work.

Requirements

You're a great fit if you

  • Have 2+ years running LiveOps on shipped mobile titles. Update cadence, events, progression, economy, offers, and the reasoning behind each of them. This is the requirement we weigh most heavily. If your experience is game development without live ownership, this is not the role.

  • Have been through a mobile soft launch and a global launch, and know what has to be in place before UA scales behind a game.

  • Bring a playbook, not just execution. You've seen how strong mobile publishers run live titles, and you can apply that here instead of waiting for someone to hand you a backlog.

  • Have 3+ years of professional game development experience with shipped titles, and are still hands-on. You build the live systems yourself rather than specifying them for someone else.

  • Read metrics as a developer, not just as a consumer of dashboards. Retention, session length, ARPDAU, conversion and cohort behaviour drive what you build next.

  • Have strong mobile game development experience (iOS and Android), and understand the differences in performance, input and UX across platforms.

  • Work with analytics, A/B testing, remote config and live tooling as part of your normal workflow, not as something a separate team owns.

  • Are comfortable with monetization and ads SDKs in a LiveOps context (events, offers, balancing).

  • Are fluent in multiple languages and ecosystems, at minimum C# and JavaScript/TypeScript, and have a solid grasp of software architecture and OOP principles.

  • Can step into an existing codebase, read it, understand it, and extend it confidently.

  • Use Git effectively in team environments and care about leaving the codebase better than you found it.

  • Are pragmatic, detail-oriented, and focused on getting high-quality updates shipped fast.

  • Are a strong team player with a true ownership mindset: you collaborate openly, take full responsibility for what you ship, and treat every game you work on as your own product to nurture and grow.

  • Are proficient in English (working language).

Nice to have

  • Web game development experience. Our platform is browser-first, so our games ship on web as well as mobile. We'd rather hire the right live experience and get you up to speed on web than compromise on the LiveOps side.

  • Multiplayer and networking experience: client/server architecture, real-time sync, matchmaking, dedicated servers. Open to learning if you haven't done it yet, but excited about it.

  • Game design instincts: the ability to look at one of our games and have informed opinions on what to build next, how to fit a feature to a specific genre or audience, and how to keep the experience cohesive as it grows.

  • Ability to speak Turkish (mother tongue of most members of the Publishing team).

Highlights

As part of our Publishing team, you'll take ownership of the games we own. You'll push regular updates, ship new content and features, and run live events.

jobs.description:
Role Summary

Ciroos is hiring a Technical Customer Success / Customer Program Manager to own the customer program from onboarding through adoption — connecting the dots across the customer, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Product, and Engineering. This is a role for someone who knows how to drive: you'll know what needs to happen, who owns it, what's blocked, what needs to be prioritized, and what comes next to keep the customer moving forward. You'll be the person making sure things don't fall through the cracks.

You need enough technical depth to be comfortable working with SRE, observability, cloud, infrastructure, integrations, and enterprise IT teams — but you are not expected to be the FDE building everything yourself. Your job is to make the entire program move.

What You'll Do

Program Ownership & Cross-Functional Orchestration

  • Own the customer program end-to-end from onboarding through adoption, tracking what needs to happen, who owns it, what's blocked, and what to prioritize next.
  • Drive accountability across teams: when Engineering owes something, you drive it to closure; when Product needs to make a decision, you get it in front of them; when priorities compete, you help create clarity.
  • Coordinate complex, multi-stakeholder technical deliverables to a clean finish — for example, driving an enterprise security questionnaire (such as a Splunk-integration review covering data retention, permissions, token encryption, and incident response) from a draft with open “pending engineering confirmation” items to a fully-owned, sign-off-ready response, assigning clear owners and chasing each item to closure.
  • Maintain a single source of truth on program status — open items, owners, and dates — so nothing depends on memory or gets lost between Slack threads, docs, and meetings.

Customer Relationship & Value Delivery

  • Build strong relationships with customers, understand what success looks like for them, and keep them engaged throughout onboarding and adoption.
  • When the customer is waiting, make sure they always know exactly where things stand — proactive, clear, and specific status, not “checking on it.”
  • Make sure Ciroos is delivering measurable value against what the customer actually cares about, not just what was scoped at kickoff.

Technical Fluency & Escalation Support

  • Engage credibly with customer SRE, observability, cloud/infrastructure, security, and enterprise IT stakeholders — understanding enough of the technical substance (integrations, permissions, data handling, deployment mechanics) to keep a conversation moving without needing to build the solution yourself.
  • Partner with FDE and Engineering on technical questions, security/compliance reviews, and integration asks that surface mid-program, translating between customer language and internal owners in both directions.
  • Flag risk early — a stalled dependency, an unanswered question, an unclear owner — before it becomes a customer-visible problem.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience leading complex enterprise customer programs — technical customer success, customer/program/project management, TAM, or solutions delivery — with a track record of driving multi-team initiatives to completion.
  • A natural “what's next, who owns it, and when will it be done” operator: organized, persistent, and comfortable creating structure in a fast-moving startup environment without waiting to be told.
  • Enough technical curiosity and depth to be comfortable in conversations spanning SRE, observability, cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), Kubernetes, integrations (e.g., Splunk, Datadog, ServiceNow), and enterprise security/compliance reviews.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication — able to represent status clearly to customers and internally, and to get concise, unambiguous commitments out of Engineering and Product.
  • Customer-focused and relationship-driven, with the judgment to balance advocating for the customer with realistic internal prioritization.

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing programs for large enterprise or Fortune 500 customers, where multiple stakeholders (security, IT, SRE, procurement, legal) and layers of internal approval are the norm, not the exception.
  • Background working alongside SRE, DevOps, or observability teams, or prior experience in a Forward Deployed Engineering, solutions engineering, or technical account management function.
  • Experience at an early-stage startup, including comfort with ambiguity and building process rather than inheriting it.
  • Familiarity with ITSM and collaboration tooling (ServiceNow, Slack, Jira/Linear) used to run customer programs day to day.

What Success Looks Like (First 6 Months)

  • Every active customer program has a clear, current picture of status, owners, and next steps — available at any moment without a scramble.
  • Cross-functional blockers get resolved in days, not weeks, because you know exactly who to go to and how to get a decision made.
  • Customers describe you as their go-to point of contact — someone who keeps them informed and consistently follows through.
  • Complex technical deliverables that touch multiple teams (security reviews, integration sign-offs, onboarding milestones) close out cleanly, with nothing left pending indefinitely.
  • You've built lightweight process — trackers, templates, cadences — that make the next customer program easier to run than the last.

About Ciroos

Ciroos (pronounced "Sai rose") is a seed-stage startup founded in February 2025 by experienced executives and distinguished engineers with deep expertise in observability, AI, distributed systems, cloud, cybersecurity, and networking. Our mission is to provide an AI SRE Teammate that empowers SREs to be superheroes — a multi-agentic AI platform that uses expert human-like reasoning to decrease toil, investigate incidents faster, and drive autonomous operations. We’ve raised $21M in seed funding led by Energy Impact Partners and prominent angel investors. We’re headquartered in Pleasanton, CA with growing operations in India.

Why Work at Ciroos?

We dream big and execute fast. Build. Test. Iterate — all at lightning speed in service of our customers. Our "BEST" perks:

  • Benefits: Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental benefits, plus meals and snacks in-office.
  • Equity: Meaningful equity — real ownership, not just a nice line on paper.
  • Stewardship: A high-impact role with mentorship from founders and senior engineers.
  • Teamwork: High-IQ, high-EQ coworkers. No politics. No bureaucracy. No permission-seeking.

About POMS

POMS develops Manufacturing Execution System (MES) software solutions for the life sciences industry. POMS is investing heavily in automated quality engineering, modern software delivery practices, and AI-assisted testing to further product quality and accelerate delivery.


Position Summary

POMS is seeking a hands-on Quality Engineering Lead / Automation Architect to lead the shift from predominantly manual testing to automation-driven quality engineering. This is a hands-on role: the successful candidate will personally help enhance the automation foundation (Playwright framework, standards, and CI/CD integration) and lead a global QA team to deliver automation at scale, using data to measure outcomes and prioritize investments.


Key Responsibilities


Automation Strategy and Architecture

  • Own POMS' test automation strategy and roadmap, serving as technical lead for the Playwright framework, automation standards, coding guidelines, and review practices.
  • Design and build scalable Playwright suites in TypeScript, making effective use of fixtures, workers, parallelization, test isolation, retries, traces, and reporting.
  • Organize workflow-based testing suites with clear smoke, core regression, and release regression layers across functional, API, integration, and end-to-end testing.
  • Assess the existing manual test inventory and prioritize which tests should be automated, redesigned, consolidated, kept manual, or retired
  • Partner with Development and DevOps to enhance our automated regression pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar), with sound environment, test-data, and parallel-execution strategies across TFVC and Git repositories.
  • Apply AI-assisted tools to test generation, maintenance, coverage analysis, and defect identification, and evaluate emerging testing tools and practices.

Team Leadership

  • Build, mentor, and develop a small, high-performing QA team, with particular responsibility for building automation capability
  • Put in place the standards, coaching, delegation, and ownership models that allow the team to scale automation without relying on the lead to author most tests.
  • Set goals, performance expectations, and career development plans, and support hiring, onboarding, and succession planning.
  • Foster quality ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Quality and Release Management

  • Champion shift-left and risk-based testing, and participate in requirements, design, and architecture reviews to identify risks early.
  • Define data-driven release readiness criteria and quality gates, and own QA for all software releases.
  • Build operational and executive dashboards and KPIs covering automation coverage, defect escape rates, release readiness, and team performance, and use them to prioritize investments.
  • Lead root cause analysis of escaped defects and implement preventive improvements.
  • Support validation and compliance activities within a regulated software environment.

Qualifications


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of software quality assurance and testing experience
  • Expert-level experience building enterprise-scale test automation frameworks using Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or comparable tools, with strong TypeScript or JavaScript skills.
  • Strong software engineering skills, preferably in TypeScript and JavaScript, including Git, API testing, SQL, debugging, and code review.
  • Experience integrating automated regression testing into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience scaling automation capability through coaching, standards, and delegation.
  • Proven use of quality metrics, dashboards, and KPIs to drive decisions and outcomes.
  • Experience testing complex web-based enterprise applications in Agile environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and excellent verbal and written communication.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience building substantial Playwright suites in TypeScript (fixtures, workers, parallelization, test isolation, retries, traces).
  • Experience leading QA teams or large-scale testing initiatives.
  • Experience in regulated industries such as life sciences, pharmaceutical manufacturing, healthcare, or medical devices, including GxP and 21 CFR Part 11.
  • Experience working across mixed TFVC and Git environments, including migration to Git.
  • Demonstrated success transforming a predominantly manual QA organization into an automation-heavy one
  • Experience using AI or machine learning to improve testing efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Knowledge of performance and security testing methodologies.

Success Measures

  • Establish a baseline quality scorecard and show measurable KPI gains within 12 months.
  • Increase automated coverage of core and critical product areas
  • Deliver reliable, fast, and maintainable automated regression running on every build.
  • Enable the QA team to produce automation at scale against consistent standards.
  • Detect defects earlier in the lifecycle and improve release confidence.
